guide.html: Cuốn sách giúp bạn luyện viết câu cho IELTS Writing Task 2, từ band 5.0 đến 7.5. Sách không yêu cầu viết cả bài luận; mỗi câu trả lời dài tối đa hai câu. Mục tiêu là viết câu chính xác, đa dạng và phù hợp với yêu cầu của đề.
Cấu trúc sách
Unit 0 — Diagnostic Test: 40 câu kiểm tra đầu vào, kèm bảng gợi ý nên học Unit nào trước.
Phần A (Unit 1–5): paraphrase đề bài, khung câu mở bài, đối tượng (chủ thể), cụm từ đắt giá và từ vựng theo chủ đề.
Phần B (Unit 6–12): cấu trúc theo chức năng: cách mở đầu câu, nguyên nhân – kết quả, mục đích, phủ định, mức độ chắc chắn, thời gian và cách viết gọn.
Phần C (Unit 13–20): ngữ pháp nâng cao: mệnh đề quan hệ, cụm phân từ, câu điều kiện, đảo ngữ, câu chẻ, bị động và tương phản.
Phần D (Unit 21): câu theo chức năng trong đoạn văn: câu chủ đề, câu hỗ trợ, câu ví dụ.
Phần E (Unit 22–25): chữa lỗi theo bốn tiêu chí chấm: TR, CC, LR và GRA, dựa trên lỗi thật của học viên.
Final Review: 50 câu ôn tập tổng hợp và bảng tự đánh giá. Đáp án nằm ở cuối sách.
Cấu trúc mỗi Unit
A. Lý thuyết: Mục đích (cấu trúc dùng để làm gì trong bài thi), bảng công thức, câu mẫu, hộp Lỗi cần tránh và Chọn cho đúng.

B. Bài tập: Bài tập 1 luyện có kiểm soát; Bài tập 2 dịch Việt – Anh rồi viết lại bằng cấu trúc của bài; Bài tập 3 tìm và sửa lỗi; Bài tập 4 áp dụng vào đề thi thật; một số Unit có thêm Bài tập 5 và 6.
Ba cấp độ
● dành cho band 5.0–6.0: có gợi ý từ khóa hoặc những từ đầu tiên.
●● dành cho band 6.0–6.5: chỉ cho biết tên cấu trúc.
●●● dành cho band 7.0–7.5: ít hoặc không có gợi ý, thường yêu cầu viết hai câu.
Nếu bạn đang ở band 5.0–5.5, hãy làm các câu ● và ●● trước rồi quay lại câu ●●● sau khi học xong Phần C.
Cách tự chữa bài

Đáp án đưa ra một câu mẫu và một đến hai cách viết khác cũng chấp nhận được. Câu của bạn có thể khác nhưng vẫn đúng nếu giữ đúng nghĩa, đúng cấu trúc được yêu cầu và không có lỗi. Phương án Cũng chấp nhận luôn dùng đúng cấu trúc được yêu cầu; câu của bạn chỉ được tính đúng khi dùng đúng cấu trúc đó.
Với bài tập sửa lỗi, phần sai được gạch ngang và tô màu theo tiêu chí, ngay sau đó là phần sửa viết bằng CHỮ IN HOA ĐẬM, kèm một dòng giải thích.
Ghi lại những lỗi bạn hay mắc và xem lại hộp Lỗi cần tránh của Unit tương ứng trước khi viết bài thật.
Lộ trình gợi ý

Làm Unit 0 trước và dùng hai bảng ở cuối bài để chọn Unit cần học. Học theo thứ tự Phần A → E, hoặc tập trung vào những Unit ứng với câu sai. Khi học xong, làm Final Review và điền Bảng tự đánh giá để biết cần ôn lại phần nào.

Cuốn sách dùng một màu cho mỗi tiêu chí chấm IELTS Writing. Khi sửa câu, hãy tô mỗi lỗi bằng màu của tiêu chí tương ứng. Trong phần đáp án, từ sai được gạch ngang và tô màu, ngay sau đó là phần sửa viết bằng CHỮ IN HOA ĐẬM.

head: Tiêu chí
Màu
Nội dung đánh giá
Ví dụ trong phần đáp án

cells: Trả lời đủ mọi phần của đề; quan điểm rõ ràng; ý liên quan, được giải thích và có dẫn chứng; không tuyệt đối hóa.
Technology will destroy all traditional jobs COULD REPLACE SOME ROUTINE JOBS.
Sắp xếp ý logic; dùng từ nối chính xác; quy chiếu rõ ràng (this, they, such); không dùng từ nối máy móc hoặc sai.
Otherwise, MOREOVER, these comparisons can cause jealousy.
Chọn từ, kết hợp từ (collocation), giới từ đi kèm, chính tả, từ loại, danh từ đếm được/không đếm được và văn phong.
The advantages may overwhelm OUTWEIGH the drawbacks.
Độ đa dạng và độ chính xác của cấu trúc: hòa hợp chủ – vị, dạng động từ, mạo từ, mệnh đề, dấu câu.
When AI replace REPLACES human workers, costs fall.

guide.html: Nếu một lỗi liên quan đến hai tiêu chí (ví dụ: thiếu một bước lập luận và đồng thời sai ngữ pháp), phần đáp án sẽ nêu cả hai và giải thích mỗi lỗi trong một dòng.

intro.html: Bài kiểm tra đầu vào gồm 40 câu chia thành bốn phần, kiểm tra cả bốn tiêu chí chấm: Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource và Grammatical Range and Accuracy. Hãy làm bài trong khoảng 60 phút, không dùng tài liệu.

Sau khi làm xong, đối chiếu với phần Đáp án. Mỗi câu đúng được 1 điểm. Ở Phần 2, chỉ chấm câu Viết lại; bản dịch không tính điểm. Với các câu viết, câu được tính là đúng nếu giữ đúng nghĩa, dùng đúng cấu trúc được yêu cầu và không có lỗi ngữ pháp hoặc từ vựng. Trong phần Đáp án, mỗi câu đều ghi rõ Unit kiểm tra kỹ năng đó.
Dùng hai bảng ở cuối bài để biết bạn nên bắt đầu từ Unit nào.

exercises.title: Phần 1 — Paraphrase đề bài
intro: Paraphrase phần nhận định của mỗi đề (không phải câu hỏi) thành một câu. Giữ đúng phạm vi: ai, cái gì, mức độ.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that we should return to older and more traditional values in order to create a better world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is argued by some that … + từ đồng nghĩa
items.answer: It is argued by some that returning to traditional values would help to create a better world.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that not all children have a natural ability to learn a foreign language and that it is therefore wrong to make every child study one at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some people believe that not every child is naturally able to learn a foreign language, so it is unfair to make the subject compulsory.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Countries where people work long hours are often economically successful, but long working hours can also have negative social consequences. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Although long working hours may bring economic success, they can also cause social problems.

items.cue: Climate · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that instead of trying to prevent climate change, we should learn how to live with it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some argue that we should adapt to climate change rather than try to prevent it.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: In developing countries, children in rural areas often have less access to education. Some people believe the best solution is to provide more schools and teachers, while others think computers and Internet access are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: While one school of thought holds that …, others maintain that …
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that rural children need more schools and teachers, others maintain that computers and Internet access matter more.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that museums should be free to enter, while others think visitors should pay an admission fee. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Some people argue that …, while others believe that …
items.answer: Some people argue that museums should be free, while others believe that visitors should pay to enter.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many countries, older people are not treated with enough respect. Why is this happening, and what problems can it cause?
items.answer: It is true that older people are not given enough respect in many countries.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some countries, university students move away from home to study in another city. Do the disadvantages of living away from home outweigh the advantages?
items.hint: Tự chọn kỹ thuật. Paraphrase phần nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: In some countries, students leave their family homes to attend university in another city.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: More and more people are becoming interested in finding out about their family history. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn kỹ thuật. Paraphrase phần nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: Tracing one's family history has gained increasing popularity in recent years.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some people believe that the characteristics we are born with have a greater influence on our personality and development than the experiences we have in life. Which of these do you think has the greater influence?
items.hint: Tự chọn kỹ thuật. Paraphrase phần nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: Some people believe that the traits we are born with shape our personality and development more than our life experiences do.

exercises.title: Phần 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Đối với nhiều người lao động, việc cân bằng giữa công việc và gia đình là rất khó.
items.translation: Balancing work and family is very hard for many workers.
items.answer: For many workers, it is very difficult to balance work and family life.
items.alt: For many employees, balancing work and family life is extremely difficult.

items.cue: Khi ngày càng nhiều người mua sắm trực tuyến, nhiều cửa hàng nhỏ đang đóng cửa.
items.translation: As more and more people shop online, many small shops are closing.
items.answer: With more and more people shopping online, many small shops are closing.
items.alt: With online shopping becoming increasingly popular, many small shops are closing down.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên đầu tư vào giáo dục để người trẻ có thể tìm được việc làm tốt hơn.
items.translation: The government should invest in education to help young people find better jobs.
items.answer: The government should invest in education so that young people can find better jobs.
items.alt: Governments should put more resources into education so that young people can secure better jobs.

items.cue: Áp lực thi cử ngăn cản nhiều học sinh tận hưởng việc học.
items.translation: Exam pressure makes many students unable to enjoy studying.
items.answer: Exam pressure prevents many students from enjoying learning.
items.alt: The pressure of exams stops many students from enjoying their studies.

items.cue: Mạng xã hội có thể khiến một số thanh thiếu niên cảm thấy lo âu.
items.translation: Social media can make some teenagers feel worried.
items.answer: Social media may make some teenagers feel anxious.
items.alt: Some teenagers may feel anxious as a result of using social media.

items.cue: Trong những thập kỷ qua, du lịch quốc tế đã tăng nhanh chóng.
items.rewriteWith: Over the past few decades + hiện tại hoàn thành
items.translation: International tourism has increased quickly in recent decades.
items.answer: Over the past few decades, international tourism has grown rapidly.
items.alt: Over the past few decades, the number of international tourists has risen sharply.

items.cue: Thu nhập thấp đồng nghĩa với ít lựa chọn hơn về nhà ở.
items.rewriteWith: câu chỉ có một động từ (noun phrase + mean + noun phrase)
items.translation: If people have low incomes, they have fewer housing choices.
items.answer: Low incomes mean fewer housing options.
items.alt: Low incomes mean fewer choices when it comes to housing.

items.cue: Trường có nhiều giáo viên trẻ, phần lớn trong số họ chưa có nhiều kinh nghiệm.
items.translation: The school has many young teachers, and most of them do not have much experience.
items.answer: The school has many young teachers, most of whom have little experience.
items.alt: The school employs many young teachers, most of whom are inexperienced.

items.cue: Nếu chính phủ đánh thuế cao hơn đối với thuốc lá, ít người trẻ sẽ hút thuốc hơn.
items.translation: If the government taxes cigarettes more, fewer young people will smoke.
items.answer: If the government taxed cigarettes more heavily, fewer young people would smoke.
items.alt: If cigarettes were taxed more heavily, fewer young people would smoke.

items.cue: Mặc dù xe điện thân thiện với môi trường, chúng vẫn còn quá đắt với nhiều gia đình.
items.translation: Electric cars are environmentally friendly, but they are still too expensive for many families.
items.answer: Although electric cars are environmentally friendly, they are still too expensive for many families.
items.alt: Although they are kind to the environment, electric cars remain too expensive for many families.

exercises.title: Phần 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Video games make all children violent.
items.answer: Video games make all children violent MAY MAKE SOME CHILDREN MORE AGGRESSIVE.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (all) và quá mạnh (make … violent).

items.cue: Learning English is important because English is an important language.
items.answer: Learning English is important because English is an important language BECAUSE IT OPENS UP INTERNATIONAL JOB OPPORTUNITIES.
notes: TR Lặp ý: lý do nhắc lại chính nhận định.

items.cue: Many people who work from home are more productive, especially those with long commutes.
items.answer: ✓ Many people who work from home are more productive, especially those with long commutes.
notes: Đúng: phạm vi hợp lý, có nhóm cụ thể.

items.cue: Technology saves time. Even more, it reduces costs.
items.answer: Technology saves time. Even more, MOREOVER, it reduces costs.
notes: CC Even more không phải là từ nối.

items.cue: Governments should regulate apps for children. If this works, they can protect children.
items.answer: Governments should regulate apps for children. If this works, they can protect children SUCH RULES CAN PROTECT CHILDREN.
notes: CC If this works mơ hồ (this chỉ điều gì?) và they dễ hiểu nhầm; dùng danh từ tóm tắt such rules.

items.cue: The advantages of tourism overwhelm the disadvantages.
items.answer: The advantages of tourism overwhelm OUTWEIGH the disadvantages.
notes: LR So sánh lợi – hại dùng outweigh.

items.cue: Children should learn foreign languages in an early age.
items.answer: Children should learn foreign languages in an early age AT AN EARLY AGE.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: at an early age.

items.cue: Organising international events bring many benefits.
items.answer: Organising international events bring BRINGS many benefits.
notes: GRA Chủ ngữ V-ing → động từ số ít.

items.cue: Many families are unable to save any money.
items.answer: ✓ Many families are unable to save any money.
notes: Đúng: cấu trúc be unable to + V.

items.cue: Many people use their phones in bed, it affects their sleep.
items.answer: Many people use their phones in bed, it affects, WHICH AFFECTS their sleep.
notes: GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; dùng which.

exercises.title: Phần 4 — Biến đổi cấu trúc
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cấu trúc được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa.

items.cue: Some teachers work in rural schools. They often lack resources.
items.answer: Teachers who work in rural schools often lack resources.
items.alt: Teachers who work in rural areas often lack teaching resources.

items.cue: Many elderly people live alone. They often feel isolated.
items.answer: Living alone, many elderly people often feel isolated.
items.alt: Living on their own, many older people often feel isolated.

items.cue: Politicians seldom admit their mistakes.
items.answer: Seldom do politicians admit their mistakes.
items.alt: Seldom do politicians acknowledge their mistakes.

items.cue: If the city had planted more trees, the streets would be cooler now.
items.answer: Had the city planted more trees, the streets would be cooler now.
items.alt: Had more trees been planted in the city, the streets would be cooler now.

items.cue: Children need attention from their parents most.
items.answer: What children need most is attention from their parents.
items.alt: What children need most is their parents' attention.

items.cue: People say that tourism damages local culture.
items.answer: Tourism is said to damage local culture.
items.alt: Tourism is said to harm local culture.

items.cue: Prices are rising, which means that families are spending less.
items.hint: câu chỉ có một động từ
items.answer: Rising prices mean lower family spending.
items.alt: Rising prices mean less spending by families.

items.cue: Many young people cannot buy a home. The main reason is that prices have risen faster than wages.
items.hint: (Much of) this comes down to the fact that
items.answer: Many young people cannot buy a home. Much of this comes down to the fact that house prices have risen faster than wages.
items.alt: Many young people cannot afford a home. Much of this comes down to the fact that property prices have outpaced wages.

items.cue: Cities are building bus lanes. This reduces journey times for commuters.
items.answer: Cities are building bus lanes, thereby reducing journey times for commuters.
items.alt: Cities are building bus lanes, thereby cutting commuters' journey times.

items.cue: Topic: a benefit of learning to cook (saves money).
items.hint: câu chủ đề One major benefit of … is that
items.answer: One major benefit of learning to cook is that it saves money.
items.alt: One major benefit of learning to cook is that it reduces food spending.

after.html: Mức điểm chỉ mang tính tham khảo cho câu văn, không phải điểm IELTS chính thức.

cells: Học tuần tự từ Unit 1. Ưu tiên Phần A và B, làm kỹ các câu ● và ●●.
Học các Unit ứng với những câu bạn làm sai (Bảng 1), sau đó làm Phần E (Unit 22–25).
Tập trung vào Phần C (Unit 13–20) và Phần E; ưu tiên các câu ●●●.
Làm các câu ●●● trong mọi Unit, sau đó làm Bài ôn tập tổng hợp.

theory.html: Phần mở bài phải diễn đạt lại đề bài bằng lời của bạn. Nếu chép nguyên đề, giám khảo không thể đánh giá vốn từ của bạn, và những từ chép từ đề cũng không được tính như từ bạn tự viết. Kỹ năng paraphrase còn cần xuyên suốt cả bài: mỗi lần nhắc lại chủ đề, bạn cần một cách gọi tên mới nhưng phải chính xác.

Một câu paraphrase tốt thường kết hợp hai hoặc ba kỹ thuật trong bảng dưới đây, ví dụ: thay từ đồng nghĩa + đổi chủ ngữ + rút gọn mệnh đề thành cụm từ. Chỉ đổi một từ thì thường chưa đủ; còn đổi tất cả các từ thì rất dễ làm sai nghĩa.

Nguyên tắc chính xác: câu paraphrase phải giữ nguyên ba yếu tố của câu gốc: ai (children ≠ teenagers), cái gì (advertising aimed at children ≠ all advertising) và mức độ (some ≠ most; should be banned ≠ should be limited). Một câu paraphrase đơn giản mà giữ đúng nghĩa luôn tốt hơn một câu nghe "xịn" nhưng làm sai nghĩa.

Từ đồng nghĩa không phải lúc nào cũng thay thế được cho nhau. Rice is produced in Vietnam là đúng, nhưng Rice is made in Vietnam thì không, dù make và produce thường được liệt kê là đồng nghĩa. Hãy kiểm tra cách dùng của từ trước khi thay thế.

cells: Thay các từ khóa bằng từ cùng nghĩa và cùng văn phong
The hardest language to learn → The most difficult language to master
Đổi từ loại: danh từ ↔ động từ ↔ tính từ ↔ trạng từ
Spending on mobile phones was $20 million → Consumers spent $20 million on mobile phones
Biến cả một mệnh đề thành một cụm danh từ
people move from the countryside to cities → rural-to-urban migration
Chọn một danh từ khác làm chủ ngữ của câu
The number of people who learn English has increased → More people now learn English
Đưa tân ngữ lên đầu câu (bị động), hoặc ngược lại
Governments should fund the arts → The arts should be funded by the state
Rút gọn mệnh đề thành cụm từ, hoặc mở rộng cụm từ thành mệnh đề
after they graduate → after graduation; people who live in cities → city residents
Đảo thứ tự mệnh đề chính và mệnh đề phụ
Because fuel is expensive, people drive less → People drive less because fuel is expensive
Diễn đạt bằng not hoặc từ trái nghĩa, nhưng không làm thay đổi mức độ
It is difficult to find work → Finding work is not easy
Diễn đạt cùng mối quan hệ bằng một từ nối khác
Although the job pays well, … → The job pays well, but …
Gộp hai câu ngắn thành một, hoặc tách một câu dài
Paris has beautiful churches. It is the capital of France. → Paris, the capital of France, has beautiful churches.

items: Many people are choosing to live alone. → A growing number of individuals are opting to live on their own. (từ đồng nghĩa)
More men and women are choosing to have children later in life. → Delayed parenthood is becoming more common. (danh từ hóa + đổi chủ ngữ)
Older people are using social media more than before. → Social media use among older people has increased. (đổi từ loại + đổi chủ ngữ)
The government should spend more on public transport. → Public transport should receive more government funding. (đổi chủ ngữ)
Some people think that schools should teach cooking. → Some argue that cooking should be taught in schools. (từ đồng nghĩa + bị động)
Many students struggle to find a job after they graduate. → Many students struggle to find work after graduation. (mệnh đề → cụm từ + từ đồng nghĩa)
Most people in rural areas cannot access good healthcare. → Most rural residents lack access to good healthcare. (diễn đạt trái nghĩa + mệnh đề → cụm từ)

items.bad: Children today have too much freedom. → Teenagers today have too much freedom. TR
items.good: Today's children have too much freedom.
items.note: Teenagers (13–19 tuổi) là nhóm hẹp hơn children. Đổi ai nghĩa là bạn đang trả lời một câu hỏi khác.

items.bad: Many kids spend hours playing video games. LR
items.good: Many children spend hours playing video games.
items.note: kids mang tính thân mật (informal). Hãy dùng children, young people hoặc schoolchildren.

items.bad: Some people believe … → Most people believe … TR
items.good: Some people believe … / Some argue that …
items.note: some ≠ most. Không được thay đổi số lượng người giữ quan điểm.

items.bad: Advertising should be banned. → Advertising should be limited. TR
items.good: Advertising should be prohibited.
items.note: limited nhẹ hơn banned. Hãy giữ nguyên mức độ của nhận định gốc.

items.bad: The benefits overwhelm the drawbacks. LR
items.good: The benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
items.note: overwhelm nghĩa là tác động rất mạnh lên ai đó. Khi so sánh lợi ích và bất lợi, phải dùng outweigh.

items.bad: Companies should pay for pollution. → Entrepreneurs should pay for pollution. LR
items.good: Businesses should pay for the pollution they cause.
items.note: Công ty là một tổ chức; entrepreneur (doanh nhân) là một người. Một từ "gần nghĩa" có thể làm thay đổi nghĩa của câu.

items.html: Một số từ không có từ đồng nghĩa phù hợp và nên giữ nguyên: the Internet, university, recycling, vaccines, tax. Thay vào đó, hãy thay đổi các từ xung quanh chúng: Students can now find a great deal of information online → A wealth of information is now available to students on the Internet.

children = dưới khoảng 13 tuổi (hoặc dưới 18 tuổi theo pháp luật); pupils = học sinh phổ thông (Anh-Anh, thường dùng cho tiểu học và trung học); students = sinh viên đại học, hoặc người học nói chung; teenagers = 13–19 tuổi; young people = khoảng 15–25 tuổi. Hãy chọn từ khớp với nhóm đối tượng trong đề.

items.h: make hay produce? (Kiểm tra trước khi thay)
items.html: Các từ đồng nghĩa trong từ điển thường khác nhau về cách dùng. Rice is produced in Vietnam (không dùng made); The factory makes shoes (hoặc produces); Electricity is generated* (không dùng made*). Khi không chắc chắn, hãy giữ từ gốc và thay đổi cấu trúc ngữ pháp xung quanh nó.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Paraphrase bằng kỹ thuật cho sẵn
intro: Paraphrase mỗi câu bằng kỹ thuật được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa của câu gốc. Câu ● có gợi ý những từ đầu tiên; câu ●● cho biết tên kỹ thuật; câu ●●●: tự do kết hợp các kỹ thuật, nhưng phải giữ đúng ai, cái gì và mức độ.

items.cue: Many people are choosing to live alone.
items.hint: Thay từ đồng nghĩa, giữ nguyên trật tự từ. Bắt đầu: A growing number of individuals …
items.answer: A growing number of individuals are opting to live on their own.
items.alt: An increasing number of people are deciding to live by themselves.

items.cue: Most students use the Internet to do their homework.
items.hint: Thay từ đồng nghĩa. Bắt đầu: The majority of …
items.answer: The majority of students rely on the Internet to complete their homework.
items.alt: The majority of pupils turn to the Internet to complete their assignments.

items.cue: Some people think that schools should teach cooking.
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa + chủ động → bị động. Bắt đầu: Some argue that cooking …
items.answer: Some argue that cooking should be taught in schools.
items.alt: Some people believe that cookery should be part of the school curriculum.

items.cue: Many young people are moving from the countryside to cities.
items.hint: Danh từ hóa. Bắt đầu: Rural-to-urban migration …
items.answer: Rural-to-urban migration is now common among young people.
items.alt: The migration of young people from rural areas to cities is common.

items.cue: People are spending more money on fast food.
items.hint: Đổi từ loại: spend → spending. Bắt đầu: Spending on …
items.answer: Spending on fast food is increasing.
items.alt: Expenditure on fast food is rising.

items.cue: Many women are choosing to have children when they are older.
items.hint: Thay từ đồng nghĩa. Bắt đầu: A large number of women …
items.answer: A large number of women are opting to start a family later in life.
items.alt: A large number of women are choosing to give birth at an older age.

items.cue: Older people are using social media more than before.
items.hint: Đổi chủ ngữ. Bắt đầu: Social media …
items.answer: Social media is being used more widely by older people than before.
items.alt: Social media use among older people has increased.

items.cue: Many students find it hard to get a job after they graduate.
items.hint: Mệnh đề → cụm từ: after they graduate → after …
items.answer: Many students struggle to find a job after graduation.
items.alt: Many students find it difficult to secure employment after graduation.

items.cue: More and more companies are allowing employees to work from home.
items.hint: Chủ động → bị động. Bắt đầu: Working from home …
items.answer: Working from home is being allowed by more and more companies.
items.alt: Remote working is being permitted by a growing number of companies.

items.cue: Cities are becoming more crowded.
items.answer: Crowding in cities is increasing.
items.alt: Urban crowding is on the rise.

items.cue: The government should spend more money on public transport.
items.hint: Đổi chủ ngữ: bắt đầu bằng Public transport
items.answer: Public transport should receive more government funding.
items.alt: More public money should be invested in public transport.

items.cue: People are buying more things online than in shops.
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa / kết hợp từ: buying things → make purchases; đổi chủ ngữ thành Consumers
items.answer: Consumers now make more purchases online than in physical shops.
items.alt: More goods are now bought online than in shops.

items.cue: Young people do not respect older people as much as they did in the past.
items.hint: Danh từ hóa: bắt đầu bằng Respect for …
items.answer: Respect for older people among the young has declined.
items.alt: Young people today show less respect for the elderly than previous generations did.

items.cue: Most people in rural areas cannot access good healthcare.
items.hint: Diễn đạt trái nghĩa: cannot access → lack access to; mệnh đề → cụm từ: people in rural areas → rural residents
items.answer: Most rural residents lack access to good healthcare.
items.alt: Good healthcare is out of reach for most people in rural areas.

items.cue: Children today have more freedom than children had in the past.
items.hint: Kỹ thuật tùy chọn; giữ phép so sánh với quá khứ
items.answer: Today's children enjoy greater freedom than previous generations did.
items.alt: Children nowadays are given more freedom than they were in the past.

items.cue: More and more people are becoming interested in finding out about their family history.
items.hint: Danh từ hóa: bắt đầu bằng Interest in …
items.answer: Interest in tracing one's family history is growing.
items.alt: There is growing interest in researching family history.

items.cue: Machines are becoming increasingly complex, and more and more work is being automated.
items.hint: Một câu; giữ cả hai ý nhưng không thêm quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả không có trong câu gốc
items.answer: Machines are growing in complexity, and an increasing share of work is now automated.
items.alt: Alongside the growing sophistication of machines, the automation of work is becoming more widespread.

items.cue: Some people believe that parents should be held responsible when their children behave badly.
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa + mệnh đề → cụm từ: when their children behave badly → for their children's …
items.answer: Some argue that parents should be held accountable for their children's misbehaviour.
items.alt: Some people believe that parents should bear responsibility for their children's bad behaviour.

items.cue: Consumer goods are becoming cheaper and more widely available.
items.hint: Danh từ hóa: a fall in … and a rise in …
items.answer: There has been a fall in the price of consumer goods and a rise in their availability.
items.alt: Consumer goods are becoming increasingly affordable and easy to obtain.

items.cue: In many countries, people watch more foreign films than films made in their own country.
items.hint: Kỹ thuật tùy chọn; giữ in many countries và phép so sánh
items.answer: In many parts of the world, audiences watch more foreign films than domestically produced ones.
items.alt: In numerous countries, imported films are watched more widely than locally made ones.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Nhiều người trẻ đang lựa chọn làm việc tự do thay vì làm việc cho các công ty.
items.rewriteWith: Thay từ đồng nghĩa (từ khóa: a growing number of, opt, freelance, rather than)
items.translation: Many young people are choosing to work freelance instead of working for companies.
items.answer: A growing number of young people are opting to work freelance rather than for companies.
items.alt: Increasing numbers of young people are choosing freelance work over company employment.

items.cue: Ngày càng nhiều người mua sắm trực tuyến.
items.rewriteWith: Đổi từ loại: shop → shopping (từ khóa: online shopping, increasingly common)
items.translation: More and more people are shopping online.
items.answer: Online shopping is becoming increasingly common.
items.alt: Consumers are increasingly buying goods online.

items.cue: Nhiều phụ nữ đang lựa chọn sinh con muộn hơn.
items.rewriteWith: Danh từ hóa (từ khóa: a growing preference, delayed motherhood)
items.translation: Many women are choosing to have children later.
items.answer: There is a growing preference for delayed motherhood among women.
items.alt: Delayed motherhood is becoming increasingly common.

items.cue: Trẻ em ngày nay dành nhiều thời gian trước màn hình hơn so với các thế hệ trước.
items.rewriteWith: Thay từ đồng nghĩa (từ khóa: today's children, screen time, previous generations)
items.translation: Children today spend more time in front of screens than previous generations did.
items.answer: Today's children have more screen time than previous generations did.
items.alt: Children nowadays spend longer in front of screens than children did in the past.

items.cue: Số người cao tuổi sống một mình đang tăng lên.
items.rewriteWith: Mệnh đề → cụm từ: who live alone → living alone (từ khóa: elderly people, living alone, growing)
items.translation: The number of elderly people who live alone is increasing.
items.answer: The number of elderly people living alone is growing.
items.alt: The number of older people living on their own is rising.

items.cue: Nhiều học sinh gặp khó khăn với môn toán.
items.rewriteWith: Thay từ đồng nghĩa (từ khóa: a large number of, pupils, struggle with)
items.translation: Many students have difficulty with maths.
items.answer: A large number of pupils struggle with mathematics.
items.alt: Many schoolchildren find mathematics challenging.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên đầu tư nhiều hơn vào y tế công.
items.rewriteWith: Đổi chủ ngữ (từ khóa: public healthcare, receive, investment)
items.translation: The government should invest more in public healthcare.
items.answer: Public healthcare should receive more government investment.
items.alt: More public funding should be allocated to healthcare.

items.cue: Người dân thành phố ngày càng ít đi bộ.
items.translation: City residents are walking less and less.
items.answer: There has been a decline in walking among city residents.
items.alt: Walking is becoming less common among urban residents.

items.cue: Nhiều công ty đang thay thế nhân viên bằng máy móc.
items.translation: Many companies are replacing workers with machines.
items.answer: Many firms are substituting machines for human workers.
items.alt: Many businesses are using machines in place of employees.

items.cue: Ngày càng nhiều sinh viên đi du học.
items.rewriteWith: Từ đồng nghĩa (a growing number of, overseas)
items.translation: More and more students are studying abroad.
items.answer: A growing number of students are studying overseas.
items.alt: Studying abroad is becoming increasingly popular among students.

items.cue: Người trẻ ít quan tâm đến chính trị hơn thế hệ trước.
items.translation: Young people are less interested in politics than previous generations.
items.answer: Interest in politics is lower among young people than among previous generations.
items.alt: Young people show less interest in politics than their parents' generation did.

items.cue: Nhiều người lo ngại rằng trí tuệ nhân tạo sẽ lấy mất việc làm của họ.
items.translation: Many people worry that artificial intelligence will take their jobs.
items.answer: There is widespread concern that artificial intelligence will take over many people's jobs.
items.alt: Many workers fear that artificial intelligence could make their jobs obsolete.

items.cue: Việc sở hữu ô tô cá nhân ngày càng phổ biến ở các nước đang phát triển.
items.translation: Owning a private car is becoming more and more common in developing countries.
items.answer: Private car ownership is becoming increasingly widespread in developing countries.
items.alt: More and more people in developing countries now own a private car.

items.cue: Nhiều người không biết hàng xóm của mình.
items.rewriteWith: Thay từ đồng nghĩa (tránh lặp lại people và know)
items.translation: Many people do not know their neighbours.
items.answer: Many residents are unfamiliar with the people who live next door.
items.alt: A large number of people are not acquainted with their neighbours.

items.cue: Ngày càng nhiều người dân ở các thành phố lớn chọn đi xe đạp đi làm.
items.translation: More and more people in big cities are choosing to go to work by bicycle.
items.answer: A growing number of residents in large cities are choosing to cycle to work.
items.alt: Cycling to work is becoming increasingly popular in major cities.

items.cue: Các món ăn truyền thống đang dần bị thay thế bởi đồ ăn nhanh.
items.translation: Traditional foods are gradually being replaced by fast food.
items.answer: Fast food is gradually taking the place of traditional dishes.
items.alt: Fast food is steadily replacing traditional cuisine.

items.cue: Khoảng cách giàu nghèo ở nhiều nước đang ngày càng lớn.
items.translation: The gap between rich and poor in many countries is getting bigger.
items.answer: Many countries are experiencing a widening gap between the rich and the poor.
items.alt: A widening gap between rich and poor can be seen in many countries.

items.cue: Mọi người ngày càng phụ thuộc vào điện thoại thông minh trong cuộc sống hằng ngày.
items.translation: People are becoming more and more dependent on smartphones in their daily lives.
items.answer: Reliance on smartphones in everyday life is increasing.
items.alt: There is a growing dependence on smartphones in daily life.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng nghệ thuật không nên được chính phủ tài trợ.
items.rewriteWith: Đổi chủ ngữ: bắt đầu mệnh đề that bằng public money
items.translation: Some people think that the government should not fund the arts.
items.answer: Some argue that public money should not be spent on the arts.
items.alt: Some believe that the state should not provide financial support for the arts.

items.cue: Người lao động ở nhiều nước đang làm việc nhiều giờ hơn nhưng lại ít hài lòng hơn với công việc.
items.rewriteWith: Kết hợp các kỹ thuật; giữ cả hai vế
items.translation: Workers in many countries are working longer hours but are less satisfied with their jobs.
items.answer: In many countries, employees are working longer hours yet feel less satisfied with their jobs.
items.alt: Longer working hours are being accompanied by declining job satisfaction in many countries.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Children today have too much freedom. → Teenagers nowadays enjoy excessive freedom.
items.answer: Children today have too much freedom. → Teenagers CHILDREN nowadays enjoy excessive freedom.
notes: TR Teenagers là nhóm hẹp hơn children: câu paraphrase đã đổi ai.

items.cue: Many children spend hours playing video games. → Many kids devote hours to video games.
items.answer: Many children spend hours playing video games. → Many kids CHILDREN devote hours to video games.
notes: LR kids mang tính thân mật; giữ children hoặc dùng young people.

items.cue: Some people believe that university education should be free. → Most people argue that tertiary education should be free of charge.
items.answer: Some people believe that university education should be free. → Most SOME people argue that tertiary education should be free of charge.
notes: TR some ≠ most: câu paraphrase đã đổi số lượng người giữ quan điểm.

items.cue: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages. → The benefits overwhelm the drawbacks.
items.answer: The advantages outweigh the disadvantages. → The benefits overwhelm OUTWEIGH the drawbacks.
notes: LR overwhelm nghĩa là tác động rất mạnh lên ai đó; khi so sánh lợi – hại phải dùng outweigh.

items.cue: More and more people are choosing to live alone. → A growing number of people are opting to live on their own.
items.answer: ✓ More and more people are choosing to live alone. → A growing number of people are opting to live on their own.
notes: Đúng: thay từ đồng nghĩa và giữ trật tự từ; ai, cái gì và mức độ không đổi.

items.cue: Diabetes is a cause of kidney disease. → Diabetes causes to kidney disease.
items.answer: Diabetes is a cause of kidney disease. → Diabetes causes to CAUSES kidney disease.
notes: GRA Khi đổi sang động từ cause, động từ này đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ, không có to.

items.cue: Advertising should be banned. → Advertising should be limited.
items.answer: Advertising should be banned. → Advertising should be limited PROHIBITED.
notes: TR limited nhẹ hơn banned: câu paraphrase đã đổi mức độ của nhận định.

items.cue: Companies should pay for the pollution they cause. → Entrepreneurs should pay for the pollution they cause.
items.answer: Companies should pay for the pollution they cause. → Entrepreneurs BUSINESSES should pay for the pollution they cause.
notes: LR entrepreneur là một người; công ty là một tổ chức.

items.cue: Many people use their cars for short journeys. → Many people drive even when they are only travelling short distances.
items.answer: ✓ Many people use their cars for short journeys. → Many people drive even when they are only travelling short distances.
notes: Đúng: cấu trúc ngữ pháp thay đổi nhưng nghĩa giữ nguyên.

items.cue: Older people should continue working for longer. → The elderly should keep working forever.
items.answer: Older people should continue working for longer. → The elderly should keep working forever FOR LONGER.
notes: TR forever phóng đại nhận định gốc.

items.cue: Governments should spend more on public transport. → More public money should be invested in public transport.
items.answer: ✓ Governments should spend more on public transport. → More public money should be invested in public transport.
notes: Đúng: tân ngữ trở thành chủ ngữ; governments được thay bằng public money.

items.cue: Many young people cannot afford to buy a home. → Many young people cannot affort to purchase a house.
items.answer: Many young people cannot afford to buy a home. → Many young people cannot affort AFFORD to purchase a house.
notes: LR Lỗi chính tả.

items.cue: Children should learn a foreign language at primary school. → Children should acquire a foreign language at elementary level of education.
items.answer: Children should learn a foreign language at primary school. → Children should acquire a foreign language at elementary level of education AT PRIMARY SCHOOL.
notes: LR Paraphrase gượng ép, thiếu tự nhiên. Primary school là thuật ngữ cố định; hãy giữ nguyên và thay đổi các từ khác.

items.cue: Crime rates among teenagers are increasing. → Youth crime rates are raising.
items.answer: Crime rates among teenagers are increasing. → Youth crime rates are raising RISING.
notes: LR rise (nội động từ) = tăng lên; raise cần có tân ngữ.

items.cue: People are living longer than in the past. → Life expectancy is higher than it used to be.
items.answer: ✓ People are living longer than in the past. → Life expectancy is higher than it used to be.
notes: Đúng: danh từ hóa (living longer → life expectancy) mà không đổi nghĩa.

items.cue: Many people believe that the news media focus too much on negative stories. → Many people believe that the media only report bad news.
items.answer: Many people believe that the news media focus too much on negative stories. → Many people believe that the media only report bad news FOCUS TOO HEAVILY ON NEGATIVE STORIES.
notes: TR only biến too much thành một nhận định tuyệt đối (tuyệt đối hóa).

items.cue: Machines are becoming more complex, and more work is being automated. → Because machines are becoming more complex, more work is being automated.
items.answer: Machines are becoming more complex, and more work is being automated. → Because machines are becoming more complex, more MACHINES ARE GROWING MORE COMPLEX, AND MORE work is being automated.
notes: TR Câu gốc nêu hai sự việc; câu paraphrase thêm quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả không có trong đề.

items.cue: In many countries, women can join the army. → In all countries, women are allowed to join the army.
items.answer: In many countries, women can join the army. → In all countries IN MANY COUNTRIES, women are allowed to join the army.
notes: TR all tuyệt đối hóa many.

items.cue: Fewer people are using bicycles as their main form of transport. → The bicycle is becoming less common as a primary means of transport.
items.answer: ✓ Fewer people are using bicycles as their main form of transport. → The bicycle is becoming less common as a primary means of transport.
notes: Đúng: chủ ngữ đổi từ people sang the bicycle mà vẫn giữ nghĩa.

items.cue: Some people believe that young people should follow the traditions of their society. → Some argue that the youth must obey social traditions.
items.answer: Some people believe that young people should follow the traditions of their society. → Some argue that the youth must obey SHOULD FOLLOW social traditions.
notes: TR must obey mạnh hơn should follow. (the youth không sai, nhưng young people tự nhiên hơn.)

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Paraphrase phần nhận định của mỗi đề (không phải câu hỏi) thành một câu. Với đề có câu bối cảnh, paraphrase câu nêu quan điểm. Giữ đúng ai, cái gì và mức độ.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Older generations often have traditional ideas that are not useful to younger people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Thay từ đồng nghĩa. Từ khóa: the older generation, traditional views, of little use to
items.answer: The older generation often holds traditional views that are of little use to young people.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that distance-learning programmes cannot provide the same benefits as studying at a college or university in person. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa; giữ nguyên thuật ngữ distance learning. Bắt đầu: Some argue that …
items.answer: Some argue that distance learning cannot offer the same advantages as studying at a college or university in person.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: More men and women are choosing to have children later in life. Why is this happening, and what effects can it have on families and society?
items.answer: Delayed parenthood is becoming increasingly common.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Children today have more freedom than children had in the past. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Thay từ đồng nghĩa: today's children, greater freedom, previous generations
items.answer: Today's children enjoy greater freedom than previous generations did.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The news media have a negative influence on people's lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Đổi chủ ngữ. Bắt đầu: People's lives …
items.answer: People's lives are negatively affected by the news media.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People are living longer than in the past, so older people should continue working for longer. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: With rising life expectancy, older people should stay in the workforce for longer.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some students take a year off between finishing school and starting university. Do the advantages of taking a gap year outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa: students who finish school → school-leavers; a year off → a gap year
items.answer: Some school-leavers take a gap year before starting university.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Many people attend university to study academic subjects. Some people believe that more students should be encouraged to learn vocational skills, such as plumbing or electrical work. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa + đổi từ loại: learn vocational skills → vocational training
items.answer: Some argue that more students should be encouraged to undertake vocational training in trades such as plumbing or electrical work.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The spread of multinational companies and increasing globalisation have positive effects on everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The expansion of multinational corporations and growing globalisation benefit everyone.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Politicians, rather than individuals, are responsible for preventing global environmental damage. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The responsibility for preventing global environmental damage lies with politicians rather than individuals.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that teenagers should study all school subjects, while others think they should focus only on the subjects they are good at or interested in. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa + mệnh đề → cụm từ: the subjects they are good at → their strongest subjects
items.answer: Some argue that teenagers should study every school subject, while others feel they should concentrate only on their strongest or favourite subjects.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that healthcare should be free for everyone, while others think individuals should pay for their own medical treatment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Từ đồng nghĩa + đổi chủ ngữ (everyone should receive …)
items.answer: Some believe that everyone should receive free healthcare, while others argue that patients should pay for their own medical treatment.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: More and more people are using the Internet to carry out tasks that they used to do in person. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Danh từ hóa: The use of the Internet for …
items.answer: The use of the Internet for tasks that were once done in person is becoming increasingly widespread.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Crimes committed by teenagers are increasing in many places. What are the reasons for this, and what measures can be taken to reduce teenage crime?
items.hint: Mệnh đề → cụm từ: crimes committed by teenagers → teenage crime
items.answer: Teenage crime is on the rise in many places.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Multicultural societies, in which people from different ethnic groups live together, bring more benefits than drawbacks. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Kết hợp ít nhất hai kỹ thuật. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: Societies in which people of different ethnic backgrounds live side by side bring more advantages than disadvantages.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that individuals in modern society are becoming more dependent on one another, while others think they are becoming more independent. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Kết hợp ít nhất hai kỹ thuật. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: Some believe that people in modern society increasingly rely on one another, whereas others feel that they are becoming more self-reliant.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that politicians have the greatest influence on the world, while others think scientists have a greater influence. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Kết hợp ít nhất hai kỹ thuật. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: Some argue that politicians shape the world more than anyone else, whereas others believe that scientists have a greater impact.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that success in life depends mainly on hard work and determination, while others think that factors such as money and appearance are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Kết hợp ít nhất hai kỹ thuật. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: While some attribute success in life mainly to hard work and determination, others believe that wealth and appearance play a greater role.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: People's lifestyles are becoming increasingly similar around the world. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Kết hợp ít nhất hai kỹ thuật. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: Lifestyles in different parts of the world are becoming increasingly alike.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Two-part question
items.prompt: In many societies, mothers and fathers have traditionally had different roles in the family. Why has this been the case, and how do you think parental roles will change in the future?
items.hint: Kết hợp ít nhất hai kỹ thuật. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu.
items.answer: In many societies, parental roles within the family have traditionally differed.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Phát hiện thay đổi về nghĩa
intro: So sánh mỗi câu gốc (chữ xám) với câu paraphrase của nó. Khoanh A, B, C hoặc D theo bảng chú giải dưới đây.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Many students find maths difficult. → A large number of students find mathematics challenging.
items.note: Chỉ thay từ đồng nghĩa; nghĩa không đổi.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Children should help with housework. → Teenagers should help with housework.
items.note: teenagers là nhóm hẹp hơn children.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Some people want to ban cars from city centres. → Many people want to ban cars from city centres.
items.note: some → many làm thay đổi số lượng người giữ quan điểm.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Smoking should be banned in public places. → Smoking should be discouraged in public places.
items.note: discouraged nhẹ hơn nhiều so với banned.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Fast food is becoming more popular. → Fast food is becoming cheaper.
items.note: Mức độ phổ biến và giá cả là hai điều khác nhau.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Most workers want a secure job. → For most workers, job security is very important.
items.note: Paraphrase tự nhiên, giữ nguyên nghĩa.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Young people are moving to cities. → Young people are moving to the countryside.
items.note: Điểm đến bị đảo ngược.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Companies should reduce packaging. → Consumers should reduce packaging.
items.note: Đối tượng đổi từ công ty sang người tiêu dùng.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Governments should fund the arts. → The arts should receive public funding.
items.note: Đổi chủ ngữ mà không đổi nghĩa.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Online learning can be as effective as classroom learning. → Online learning is more effective than classroom learning.
items.note: as effective as thành more effective than: nhận định mạnh hơn.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Some parents allow their children too much freedom. → All parents give their children too much freedom.
items.note: some → all là tuyệt đối hóa.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Older people are lonely. → Many older people are lonely.
items.note: Thêm many làm nhận định nhẹ đi. Việc giảm nhẹ (hedging) nên dùng trong lập luận của bạn, không dùng khi diễn đạt lại đề.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Traffic congestion is a serious problem in many cities. → Many cities suffer from severe traffic congestion.
items.note: Cùng nghĩa, khác cấu trúc.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Universities should prepare students for work. → Schools should prepare students for work.
items.note: universities và schools là hai loại cơ sở giáo dục khác nhau.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Technology has made communication easier. → Technology has improved the quality of communication.
items.note: easier (dễ hơn) không giống better quality (chất lượng tốt hơn).

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Advertising aimed at children should be banned. → Advertising should be banned.
items.note: Câu paraphrase bỏ mất aimed at children nên giờ nói về mọi loại quảng cáo.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: The gap between rich and poor is widening in many countries. → The wealth gap is widening in many countries.
items.note: Danh từ hóa, phạm vi giữ nguyên.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: People should be allowed to keep all the money they earn. → People should pay lower taxes.
items.note: keep all the money (không đóng thuế) mạnh hơn nhiều so với lower taxes.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Museums are visited mainly by tourists rather than local people. → Museums are visited only by tourists.
items.note: mainly thành only: tuyệt đối hóa.

options.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

items.cue: Children who grow up in poor families are better prepared for adult life than wealthy children. → Children who grow up in poor families are better prepared for university than wealthy children.
items.note: adult life (cuộc sống trưởng thành) thành university: đổi cái gì.

legend.text: Đổi nghĩa: mức độ / số lượng

theory.html: Phần mở bài chỉ cần hai câu: (1) diễn đạt lại đề bài bằng lời của bạn; (2) một câu nêu quan điểm (position sentence) trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề. Ở Band 7, bài viết phải có quan điểm rõ ràng xuyên suốt, và giám khảo sẽ tìm quan điểm đó trước tiên ở phần mở bài.

Mỗi đề bài gồm một khung (một sự thật hoặc xu hướng, một quan điểm, hoặc hai quan điểm trái chiều) và một yêu cầu (To what extent do you agree or disagree?…). Bảng 1 đưa ra cách paraphrase đáng tin cậy cho từng loại khung. Bảng 2 đưa ra câu nêu quan điểm cho từng dạng đề.

Câu nêu quan điểm phải dứt khoát. This essay will discuss both views không cho người đọc biết bạn nghĩ gì; … before concluding that I agree with the latter thì có. Hãy paraphrase cả các từ nội dung của đề (Unit 1): các khung câu chỉ thay thế cho phần Some people believe that ….
Giữ đúng phạm vi của đề: nếu đề viết many people, hãy dùng It is widely believed that …, không dùng by some.

cells: It is true that + S + V
Overseas travel is becoming cheaper. → It is true that international travel has become increasingly affordable.
More people work from home. → Remote working has gained increasing popularity.
It is believed / argued / suggested by some that + S + V
Some people believe older people should keep working. → It is suggested by some that older people should continue working.
One school of thought holds that + S + V
→ One school of thought holds that stricter penalties for driving offences are the only way to make roads safer.
Some people argue that S1 + V1, while others believe that S2 + V2
→ Some people argue that children should begin school very young, while others believe that they should wait until they are older.
While one school of thought holds that S1 + V1, others maintain that S2 + V2
→ While one school of thought holds that hosting international sports events benefits the host country, others maintain that the costs are greater.
Opinions are divided on whether + S + V
→ Opinions are divided on whether technology is widening or narrowing the gap between rich and poor.

theory.text: Bảng 2 — Câu nêu quan điểm theo dạng đề

cells: I firmly agree with this view. / I fully share this view.
I disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the reasons for it. / While acknowledging the benefits of + noun phrase, I largely disagree with this view.
bạn hoàn toàn hoặc phần lớn không đồng ý
Đồng ý / Không đồng ý (đề đưa ra giải pháp)
While acknowledging the benefits that this could bring, I believe it is not a universally applicable solution.
đề đề xuất một biện pháp chỉ hiệu quả trong một số trường hợp

This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter / former. / While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the former / latter. / While the former approach can offer advantages, I maintain that the latter is superior.
bạn ủng hộ một trong hai quan điểm
While this admittedly has certain benefits, I would argue that the drawbacks are more significant. / Although X offers certain benefits, I believe these are outweighed by its drawbacks.
bất lợi lớn hơn (đảo các danh từ nếu bạn có quan điểm ngược lại)
Phát triển tích cực hay tiêu cực
Despite certain concerns surrounding this trend, I believe it is a beneficial one.
bạn đánh giá xu hướng là tích cực (dùng a harmful one nếu tiêu cực)
This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this phenomenon before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.
đề hỏi tại sao và cần làm gì
This trend has caused several problems, but I believe there are viable measures that could be taken to tackle them.
đề hỏi về tác động/vấn đề và giải pháp
This essay will argue that this trend is driven mainly by [nguyên nhân chính] and that its most serious effect is [tác động chính].
đề hỏi tại sao và tác động là gì
There are two main reasons behind this trend, and in my opinion, this is a negative / positive development overall.
ví dụ Why is this happening? Is it positive or negative?: trả lời cả hai phần

items: Some people believe that children should start school at five. → One school of thought holds that children should begin formal education at the age of five.
Many people think technology makes us less sociable. → It is widely believed that technology is making people less sociable.
More and more people work from home. → It is true that a growing number of people now work from home.
Agree/disagree, mostly disagree: While acknowledging the benefits of investing in railways, I largely disagree that roads should be given lower priority.
Discuss both views: This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.
Advantages/disadvantages: Although this trend offers certain benefits, I believe these are outweighed by its drawbacks.
Causes/solutions: This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this phenomenon before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.

items.bad: While one school of thought holds that saving money brings various benefits, especially for the younger generation. GRA
items.good: While one school of thought holds that saving money brings various benefits, I believe this is not always realistic for everyone.
items.note: Mệnh đề bắt đầu bằng While là mệnh đề phụ. Nếu không có mệnh đề chính, câu bị thiếu thành phần (fragment).

items.bad: I am totally agree with this opinion. GRA
items.good: I firmly agree with this view.
items.note: agree là động từ nên không dùng am. Totally cũng mang tính thân mật.

items.bad: It is believed by some that university should be free. (Prompt: Many people believe …) TR
items.good: It is widely believed that university should be free.
items.note: many people ≠ some: hãy chọn khung câu giữ đúng phạm vi của đề.

items.bad: This essay will discuss both views. TR
items.good: This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.
items.note: "Give your own opinion" là một phần yêu cầu của đề. Quan điểm phải xuất hiện ngay ở mở bài.

items.bad: There are some relative measures which should be carried out. TR LR
items.good: This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this problem before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.
items.note: Câu nêu quan điểm mơ hồ, và relative phải là relevant. Hãy nói rõ bạn sẽ làm gì trong bài.

items.bad: This trend has both positive and negative sides. TR
items.good: Despite certain concerns surrounding this trend, I believe it is a beneficial one.
items.note: Câu hỏi positive or negative đòi hỏi một câu trả lời rõ ràng.

items.html: the former = quan điểm thứ nhất trong hai quan điểm; the latter = quan điểm thứ hai. Chỉ dùng khi vừa nhắc đến đúng hai quan điểm.
It is believed by some that … = một số người; It is widely believed that … = nhiều người. Hãy chọn cho khớp với some / many trong đề.

items.h: outweigh: so sánh mức độ, không phải số lượng
items.html: Trả lời câu hỏi Do the advantages outweigh …? bằng outweigh / are more significant than. There are more advantages nói về số lượng, không phải mức độ quan trọng.

Tránh viết I partly agree and partly disagree mà không nói rõ đồng ý phần nào. Nếu đồng ý một phần, hãy nêu giới hạn: I agree that X, but only when Y / While acknowledging the benefits of X, I largely disagree … — và giữ nguyên quan điểm đó đến cuối bài.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại với khung câu cho sẵn
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu trong đề, hoặc viết câu nêu quan điểm theo mô tả, bằng khung câu được cho (Bảng 1 và Bảng 2).

items.cue: Some people believe that university education should be free.
items.hint: It is believed by some that …
items.answer: It is believed by some that university education should be free of charge.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that higher education should be free.

items.cue: Some people think that children should start school at the age of five.
items.hint: One school of thought holds that …
items.answer: One school of thought holds that children should begin school at the age of five.
items.alt: It is suggested by some that children should start school at five.

items.cue: Some people believe that zoos should be closed, while others think they are useful.
items.hint: Some people argue that …, while others believe that …
items.answer: Some people argue that zoos should be closed, while others believe that they serve a useful purpose.
items.alt: While one school of thought holds that zoos should be shut down, others maintain that they are beneficial.

items.cue: Prompt: Smoking should be banned in all public places. Your view: you fully agree.
items.answer: I firmly agree that smoking should be prohibited in all public places.
items.alt: I also hold the view that smoking should be banned in all public places.

items.cue: Discuss both views. Your view: you support the second view.
items.hint: This essay will examine both views before concluding that …
items.answer: This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.
items.alt: While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the latter.

items.cue: Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Your view: the disadvantages are greater.
items.hint: While this admittedly has certain benefits, I would argue that …
items.answer: While this admittedly has certain benefits, I would argue that the drawbacks are more significant.
items.alt: Although this trend offers certain benefits, I believe these are outweighed by its drawbacks.

items.cue: Is this a positive or negative development? Your view: positive.
items.hint: Despite certain concerns surrounding …, I believe …
items.answer: Despite certain concerns surrounding this trend, I believe it is a beneficial one.
items.alt: Despite certain concerns, I believe this is a largely positive development.

items.cue: More and more people are working from home.
items.answer: It is true that a growing number of people now work from home.
items.alt: It is true that working from home has become increasingly common.

items.cue: Some people think that technology makes people less sociable.
items.hint: It is argued by some that …
items.answer: It is argued by some that technology is making people less sociable.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that technology reduces people's social interaction.

items.cue: What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?
items.hint: This essay will first outline … before suggesting …
items.answer: This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this problem before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.
items.alt: This essay will examine why this problem occurs before proposing some practical solutions.

items.cue: Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development? Your view: two main causes; negative.
items.hint: There are two main reasons behind …, and in my opinion …
items.answer: There are two main reasons behind this trend, and in my opinion, this is a negative development overall.
items.alt: This trend has two main causes, and I believe it is a negative development overall.

items.cue: Prompt: Governments should spend money on railways rather than roads. Your view: you largely disagree.
items.hint: While acknowledging the benefits of …, I largely disagree …
items.answer: While acknowledging the benefits of investing in railways, I largely disagree that roads should be given lower priority.
items.alt: While acknowledging the benefits of railways, I largely disagree that they should take priority over roads.

items.cue: Some people say that the best way to reduce crime is longer prison sentences. Others believe there are better alternatives.
items.hint: While one school of thought holds that …, others maintain that …
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that longer prison sentences are the most effective way to reduce crime, others maintain that alternative methods work better.
items.alt: Some people argue that longer sentences are the best deterrent, while others believe that alternative approaches are more effective.

items.cue: Some think studying history has little value; others think it helps us understand the present. Your view: the second.
items.hint: While there are justifications for both perspectives, …
items.answer: While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the latter.
items.alt: While there are justifications for both perspectives, I believe that studying history helps us understand the present.

items.cue: Some people believe that the government should provide free housing for those who cannot afford it. Your view: it works only in some cases.
items.hint: Hai câu: khung câu ở Bảng 1 + khung câu cho đề đưa ra giải pháp (proposed solution)
items.answer: It is believed by some that the state should provide free homes for those who cannot afford housing. While acknowledging the benefits that this could bring, I believe it is not a universally applicable solution.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that free housing should be given to those who cannot afford a home. While this could help some families, I believe it is not a universally applicable solution.

items.cue: Rote learning is still used in many education systems. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Your view: the advantages.
items.hint: Hai câu: khung câu sự thật/xu hướng + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: It is true that memorisation remains a common teaching method in many school systems. Although it has certain drawbacks, I believe these are outweighed by its benefits.
items.alt: Rote learning is still widely used in schools, and while it admittedly has some weaknesses, I would argue that its advantages are more significant.

items.cue: Some cities have introduced congestion charges. Is this a positive or negative development? Your view: positive.
items.hint: Hai câu: khung câu sự thật/xu hướng + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: It is true that several cities now charge drivers to enter congested areas. Despite certain concerns surrounding this policy, I believe it is a beneficial one.
items.alt: A number of cities have begun charging motorists to enter busy areas, and despite some concerns, I believe this is a positive development.

items.cue: Many children find it difficult to concentrate at school. Why? What can be done?
items.hint: Hai câu: khung câu sự thật/xu hướng + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: It is true that many children struggle to stay focused in class. This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this problem before suggesting some viable measures to improve their concentration.
items.alt: Many pupils find it hard to pay attention at school, and this essay will explain why before proposing some solutions.

items.cue: More people are interested in finding out about their family history. Why? Is this positive or negative?
items.hint: Hai câu: has gained increasing popularity + câu nêu quan điểm cho đề hai câu hỏi
items.answer: Tracing one's family history has gained increasing popularity in recent years. There are two main reasons behind this trend, and in my opinion, it is a positive development overall.
items.alt: It is true that more people are researching their ancestry. This is largely due to easier access to online records, and I believe it is a positive development.

items.cue: Some believe parents should read stories to their children; others think children should learn to read stories by themselves.
items.hint: Hai câu: Opinions are divided on whether … + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: Opinions are divided on whether parents should read stories to their children or whether children should learn to read stories by themselves. While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the former.
items.alt: Some people argue that parents should read to their children, while others believe that children should learn to read independently. In my view, being read to matters more in the early years.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng học sinh nên được học về quản lý tài chính ở trường.
items.rewriteWith: It is suggested by some that (từ khóa: financial management, be taught)
items.translation: Some people think that students should learn about financial management at school.
items.answer: It is suggested by some that financial management should be taught at school.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that schools should teach students how to manage money.

items.cue: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với quan điểm này.
items.translation: I completely agree with this opinion.
items.answer: I firmly agree with this view.
items.alt: I also hold this view.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng các kỳ thi là cần thiết, trong khi những người khác tin rằng chúng gây áp lực không cần thiết cho học sinh.
items.rewriteWith: Some people argue that …, while others believe that … (từ khóa: examinations, unnecessary pressure)
items.translation: Some people think exams are necessary, but others believe they put unnecessary pressure on students.
items.answer: Some people argue that examinations are necessary, while others believe that they place unnecessary pressure on students.
items.alt: While one school of thought holds that exams are essential, others maintain that they put students under needless pressure.

items.cue: Mặc dù xu hướng này có một số lợi ích, tôi tin rằng những bất lợi của nó lớn hơn.
items.rewriteWith: Although … offers certain benefits, … outweighed by … (từ khóa: certain benefits, outweighed, drawbacks)
items.translation: Although this trend has some benefits, I believe its disadvantages are bigger.
items.answer: Although this trend offers certain benefits, I believe these are outweighed by its drawbacks.
items.alt: While this admittedly has certain benefits, I would argue that the drawbacks are more significant.

items.cue: Bài viết này trước hết sẽ phân tích những nguyên nhân sâu xa của hiện tượng này, sau đó đề xuất một số biện pháp khả thi để giải quyết nó.
items.rewriteWith: This essay will first outline … before suggesting … (từ khóa: underlying causes, viable measures, tackle)
items.translation: This essay will first analyse the deep causes of this phenomenon and then propose some feasible measures to solve it.
items.answer: This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this phenomenon before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.
items.alt: This essay will examine the main causes of this problem and suggest some practical solutions.

items.cue: Việc sống một mình ngày càng được giới trẻ ưa chuộng.
items.rewriteWith: … has gained increasing popularity among … (từ khóa: living alone, young people)
items.translation: Living alone is becoming more and more popular with young people.
items.answer: Living alone has gained increasing popularity among young people.
items.alt: It is true that a growing number of young people are choosing to live on their own.

items.cue: Mặc dù có một số lo ngại xung quanh xu hướng này, tôi tin rằng nó mang lại lợi ích.
items.rewriteWith: Despite certain concerns surrounding …, I believe it is a beneficial one
items.translation: Although there are some concerns about this trend, I believe it is beneficial.
items.answer: Despite certain concerns surrounding this trend, I believe it is a beneficial one.
items.alt: Despite some concerns, I believe this is a largely positive development.

items.cue: Nhiều người tin rằng chính phủ nên tăng thuế đối với thực phẩm không lành mạnh.
items.rewriteWith: It is widely believed that (giữ đúng nghĩa many people)
items.translation: Many people believe the government should increase taxes on unhealthy food.
items.answer: It is widely believed that governments should raise taxes on unhealthy food.
items.alt: Many are of the opinion that unhealthy food should be taxed more heavily.

items.cue: Bài viết này sẽ xem xét cả hai quan điểm trước khi kết luận rằng tôi đồng ý với quan điểm thứ hai.
items.rewriteWith: This essay will examine both views before concluding that …
items.translation: This essay will look at both opinions and then conclude that I agree with the second one.
items.answer: This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.
items.alt: This essay will examine both opinions before concluding that I support the second.

items.cue: Mặc dù quan điểm này có phần hợp lý, tôi phần lớn không đồng ý với nó.
items.rewriteWith: I … disagree with this view, despite acknowledging …
items.translation: Although this view is partly reasonable, I mostly disagree with it.
items.answer: I largely disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the reasons for it.
items.alt: While this view has some merit, I largely disagree with it.

items.cue: Mặc dù làm việc từ xa có một số bất lợi, tôi tin rằng chúng không đáng kể bằng những lợi ích mà nó mang lại.
items.rewriteWith: Although … has certain drawbacks, … outweighed by its benefits
items.translation: Although working from home has some disadvantages, I believe they are less significant than its benefits.
items.answer: Although remote working has certain drawbacks, I believe these are outweighed by its benefits.
items.alt: In my view, the advantages of remote working clearly outweigh its disadvantages.

items.cue: Một trường phái cho rằng mạng xã hội gắn kết mọi người, trong khi những người khác cho rằng nó khiến con người cô đơn hơn.
items.rewriteWith: While one school of thought holds that …, others maintain that …
items.translation: Some people say social media brings people together, while others say it makes people lonelier.
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that social media brings people closer together, others maintain that it leaves people feeling lonelier.
items.alt: Some people argue that social media connects people, while others believe that it increases loneliness.

items.cue: Có hai nguyên nhân chính dẫn đến xu hướng này, và theo tôi, đây nhìn chung là một bước phát triển tiêu cực.
items.rewriteWith: There are two main reasons behind …, and in my opinion …
items.translation: There are two main causes of this trend, and in my opinion, it is generally a negative development.
items.answer: There are two main reasons behind this trend, and in my opinion, this is a negative development overall.
items.alt: This trend has two main causes, and I believe it is largely negative.

items.cue: Dù thừa nhận lợi ích của việc miễn học phí đại học, tôi phần lớn không đồng ý với quan điểm này.
items.rewriteWith: While acknowledging the benefits of …, I largely disagree …
items.translation: Although I accept the benefits of free university education, I mostly disagree with this view.
items.answer: While acknowledging the benefits of free university education, I largely disagree with this view.
items.alt: I disagree that university should be free for everyone, despite acknowledging the benefits it could bring.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng các công ty nên chịu trách nhiệm về rác thải nhựa mà họ tạo ra, và tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý với quan điểm này.
items.translation: Some people think companies should be responsible for the plastic waste they create, and I completely agree.
