items.answer: It is argued by some that companies should take responsibility for the plastic waste they produce. I firmly agree with this view.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that businesses should be accountable for the plastic waste they generate, a view I also hold.

items.cue: Việc mua hàng hiệu ngày càng phổ biến, và theo tôi, điều này chủ yếu là do ảnh hưởng của mạng xã hội.
items.rewriteWith: … has gained increasing popularity + câu trả lời
items.translation: Buying branded products is becoming more popular, and in my opinion this is mainly because of social media.
items.answer: Branded goods have gained increasing popularity, and I believe this is largely due to the influence of social media.
items.alt: It is true that more people are buying well-known brands, a trend driven largely by social media.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng người cao tuổi nên nghỉ hưu sớm để nhường việc cho người trẻ, nhưng tôi không đồng ý với quan điểm này, dù tôi hiểu lý do của nó.
items.translation: Some people believe older people should retire early to give jobs to young people, but I disagree, although I understand why.
items.answer: It is suggested by some that older people should retire early to make way for younger workers. I disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the reasons for it.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that older employees should step aside for the young, a view I disagree with despite understanding its reasoning.

items.cue: Bài viết này trước hết sẽ phân tích vì sao ngày càng ít người đọc sách, sau đó đề xuất một số cách để khuyến khích thói quen đọc.
items.rewriteWith: This essay will first outline … before suggesting …
items.translation: This essay will first analyse why fewer and fewer people read books and then suggest some ways to encourage reading.
items.answer: This essay will first outline why fewer people now read books before suggesting some viable ways to encourage a reading habit.
items.alt: This essay will examine the reasons for the decline in reading before proposing measures to reverse it.

items.cue: Mặc dù có một số lo ngại xung quanh việc trẻ em sử dụng máy tính ở trường, tôi tin rằng đây là một bước phát triển có lợi.
items.translation: Although there are some concerns about children using computers at school, I believe this is a beneficial development.
items.answer: Despite certain concerns surrounding the use of computers in schools, I believe it is a beneficial development.
items.alt: Although it raises some concerns, I consider children's use of computers at school a largely positive development.

items.cue: Tôi không đồng ý rằng các môn nghệ thuật nên bị loại khỏi chương trình học, dù tôi hiểu lý do của quan điểm này.
items.translation: I do not agree that arts subjects should be removed from the curriculum, although I understand the reasons for this view.
items.answer: I disagree that arts subjects should be removed from the curriculum, despite acknowledging the reasons for this view.
items.alt: I disagree that arts subjects should be dropped from the curriculum, despite acknowledging why some people hold this view.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: I am totally agree with this opinion.
items.answer: I am totally agree COMPLETELY AGREE with this opinion.
notes: GRA agree là động từ nên không dùng am; totally mang tính thân mật.

items.cue: Some people believe that children should learn a second language at the age of three, while others thinks it is too early.
items.answer: Some people believe that children should learn a second language at the age of three, while others thinks OTHERS THINK it is too early.
notes: GRA Hòa hợp chủ – vị: others là số nhiều.

items.cue: It is argued by some that public libraries are no longer necessary.
items.answer: ✓ It is argued by some that public libraries are no longer necessary.
notes: Đúng: It is argued by some that … là cách paraphrase Some people believe that ….

items.cue: While one school of thought holds that keeping funds for later use may bring various benefits for people, especially the younger generation.
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that keeping funds for later use may bring various benefits for people, especially the younger generation. ESPECIALLY THE YOUNGER GENERATION, I BELIEVE THIS IS NOT ALWAYS REALISTIC FOR EVERYONE.
notes: GRA Câu thiếu thành phần (fragment): mệnh đề While cần một mệnh đề chính.

items.cue: (Discuss both views) This essay will discuss both views.
items.answer: (Discuss both views) This essay will discuss both views. THIS ESSAY WILL EXAMINE BOTH VIEWS BEFORE CONCLUDING THAT I AGREE WITH THE LATTER.
notes: TR Câu không nêu ý kiến, trong khi đề yêu cầu.

items.cue: In my opinion, I think that this is a negative development.
items.answer: In my opinion, I think that IN MY OPINION, this is a negative development.
notes: LR Thừa: In my opinion và I think có cùng nghĩa.

items.cue: Many people argue that technology has made our lives more convenience.
items.answer: Many people argue that technology has made our lives more convenience CONVENIENT.
notes: LR Từ loại: sau more cần tính từ.

items.cue: (Advantages/disadvantages) This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.
items.answer: (Advantages/disadvantages) This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend. ALTHOUGH THIS TREND OFFERS CERTAIN BENEFITS, I BELIEVE THESE ARE OUTWEIGHED BY ITS DRAWBACKS.
notes: TR Đề hỏi bên nào lớn hơn; câu này không trả lời.

items.cue: (Causes/solutions) I will explain why this happens, and there are some relative measures which should be carried out.
items.answer: (Causes/solutions) I will explain why this happens, and there are some relative measures which should be carried out I WILL THEN SUGGEST SOME VIABLE MEASURES TO TACKLE IT.
notes: TR Quan điểm mơ hồ (và relative phải là relevant). Hãy nói rõ bạn sẽ đề xuất gì.

items.cue: While one school of thought holds that zoos protect endangered species, others maintain that keeping animals in captivity is cruel.
items.answer: ✓ While one school of thought holds that zoos protect endangered species, others maintain that keeping animals in captivity is cruel.
notes: Đúng: khung hai quan điểm While one school of thought holds that …, others maintain that ….

items.cue: It is suggest by some that young people today are less polite than previous generations.
items.answer: It is suggest SUGGESTED by some that young people today are less polite than previous generations.
notes: GRA Khung tường thuật bị động It is suggested by some that … cần quá khứ phân từ.

items.cue: (Prompt: distance learning cannot provide the same benefits as studying in person) Nowadays, technology is developing rapidly and has many effects on our lives.
items.answer: (Prompt: distance learning cannot provide the same benefits as studying in person) Nowadays, technology is developing rapidly and has many effects on our lives. IT IS SOMETIMES ARGUED THAT DISTANCE LEARNING CANNOT OFFER THE SAME BENEFITS AS STUDYING ON CAMPUS.
notes: TR Câu mở đầu chung chung, dùng được cho bất kỳ bài nào. Hãy paraphrase đúng đề này.

items.cue: Although this development raises some concerns, I believe it is largely positive.
items.answer: ✓ Although this development raises some concerns, I believe it is largely positive.
notes: Đúng: câu trả lời dứt khoát cho dạng đề tích cực/tiêu cực.

items.cue: Some people claim that university should be free, while other believe that students should pay.
items.answer: Some people claim that university should be free, while other believe OTHERS BELIEVE that students should pay.
notes: GRA others là đại từ số nhiều, nghĩa là những người khác.

items.cue: (Prompt: governments should spend more on public services than on the arts) I partly agree and partly disagree with this statement because both sides have advantages.
items.answer: (Prompt: governments should spend more on public services than on the arts) I partly agree and partly disagree with this statement because both sides have advantages. I LARGELY AGREE WITH THIS VIEW, ALTHOUGH I BELIEVE A MODEST ARTS BUDGET IS STILL WORTHWHILE.
notes: TR Không có quan điểm rõ ràng. Hãy nói bạn chấp nhận phần nào và ở mức độ nào.

items.cue: (Discuss both views) While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the latter.
items.answer: ✓ (Discuss both views) While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the latter.
notes: Đúng: quan điểm rõ ràng cho dạng đề thảo luận.

items.cue: It is true that the number of people who choose to live alone has been increasing in recent decades in many countries all over the world.
items.answer: It is true that the number of people who choose to live alone has been increasing in recent decades in many countries all over the world IN MANY COUNTRIES.
notes: LR Thừa: all over the world lặp lại ý của many countries.

items.cue: (Positive/negative development) This trend has both positive and negative sides, which will be discussed in this essay.
items.answer: (Positive/negative development) This trend has both positive and negative sides, which will be discussed in this essay. DESPITE CERTAIN CONCERNS SURROUNDING THIS TREND, I BELIEVE IT IS A BENEFICIAL ONE.
notes: TR Đề yêu cầu bạn đánh giá; hãy đưa ra câu trả lời rõ ràng.

items.cue: It is often argued that the news media focus too heavily on negative stories, a view with which I largely agree.
items.answer: ✓ It is often argued that the news media focus too heavily on negative stories, a view with which I largely agree.
notes: Đúng: paraphrase và quan điểm được gộp trong một câu.

items.cue: Some people believe that students should be allowed to evaluate their teachers. Others believe that this could lead to a loss of respect, I agree with the latter view.
items.answer: Some people believe that students should be allowed to evaluate their teachers. Others believe that this could lead to a loss of respect, I agree with the latter view. . I AGREE WITH THE LATTER VIEW.
notes: GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy (comma splice): hai mệnh đề chính cần dấu chấm (hoặc dấu chấm phẩy).

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Viết phần mở bài gồm hai câu cho mỗi đề: (1) diễn đạt lại đề bằng lời của bạn, dùng một khung câu ở Bảng 1; (2) một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that it is no longer necessary to teach children handwriting skills. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is believed by some that … + I disagree with this view, despite acknowledging …
items.answer: It is believed by some that children no longer need to learn handwriting. I disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the growing importance of typing.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: University students should pay the full cost of their education themselves. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is argued by some that … + While acknowledging the benefits of …, I largely disagree …
items.answer: It is argued by some that university students should cover the entire cost of their studies. While acknowledging the benefits of this for public finances, I largely disagree with this view.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: As well as making money, businesses also have social responsibilities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is argued by some that … + I firmly agree …
items.answer: It is argued by some that businesses have social responsibilities as well as the aim of making money. I firmly agree with this view.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Mobile phones should be banned in public places such as libraries, public transport and shops. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is suggested by some that … + khung câu cho đề đưa ra giải pháp (proposed solution)
items.answer: It is suggested by some that mobile phones should be prohibited in public places such as libraries, buses and shops. While acknowledging the benefits that this could bring, I believe it is not a universally applicable solution.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that public money should be spent on promoting healthy lifestyles rather than on treating people who are ill. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: One school of thought holds that … + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: One school of thought holds that public funds should go towards promoting healthy lifestyles rather than treating illness. I also hold this view, as prevention reduces the need for costly treatment.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way to reduce crime is to educate prisoners so that they can find work after they are released. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: One school of thought holds that … + khung câu cho đề đưa ra giải pháp (proposed solution)
items.answer: One school of thought holds that educating prisoners so that they can find work after release is the most effective way to cut crime. While acknowledging the benefits that this could bring, I believe it is not a universally applicable solution.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Senior managers in a company should receive much higher salaries than other employees. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is argued by some that … + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: It is argued by some that senior managers deserve far higher salaries than other staff. I disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the reasons for it.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should pay for healthcare and education, while others think these are the responsibility of individuals. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Some people argue that …, while others believe that … + câu nêu quan điểm
items.answer: Some people argue that governments should fund healthcare and education, while others believe these are individual responsibilities. I firmly agree with the first view.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that schools should group students according to their academic ability, while others think students of different abilities should study together. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Some people argue that …, while others believe that … + khung câu thảo luận
items.answer: Some people argue that schools should group students by academic ability, while others believe that mixed-ability classes are better. This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: In many families, both parents work. Some people believe that grandparents are the best people to look after young children, while others think childcare centres are better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: While one school of thought holds that …, others maintain that … + khung câu thảo luận
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that grandparents are the best carers for young children, others maintain that childcare centres are preferable. This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the former.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that industrial growth is necessary to reduce poverty, while others argue that it causes serious environmental problems. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: While one school of thought holds that …, others maintain that … + khung câu thảo luận
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that industrial growth is essential for reducing poverty, others maintain that it causes serious environmental damage. This essay will examine both views before concluding that the latter is more convincing.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that personal happiness depends mainly on economic success, while others think it depends on many different factors. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Opinions are divided on whether … + khung câu thảo luận
items.answer: Opinions are divided on whether personal happiness depends mainly on economic success or on a range of other factors. This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that women should have the same opportunities as men to work in the police and armed forces, while others think women are not suitable for these jobs. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Some people argue that women should have equal opportunities to serve in the police and armed forces, while others believe these roles are unsuitable for women. Considering the arguments for both perspectives, I agree with the former.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many societies, antisocial behaviour and a lack of respect for others are becoming more common. What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.hint: It is true that … + khung câu nguyên nhân/giải pháp
items.answer: It is true that antisocial behaviour and disrespect for others are becoming more common in many societies. This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this phenomenon before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.

items.cue: Work · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many people try to achieve a balance between work and other parts of their lives, but few succeed. Why is this difficult, and what can be done to achieve a better work-life balance?
items.hint: Hai câu: một khung câu ở Bảng 1 + một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that, although many people try to balance work with the rest of their lives, few succeed. This essay will first outline why this is so difficult before suggesting some viable measures to achieve a healthier balance.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: It has become easy for people to obtain credit cards, but some users have difficulty repaying their debts. Do the advantages of easy access to credit cards outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: một khung câu ở Bảng 1 + một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that credit cards have become easy to obtain, although some holders struggle to repay their debts. While this admittedly has certain benefits, I would argue that the drawbacks are more significant.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In many countries, women are entitled to take maternity leave after giving birth. Do the advantages of maternity leave outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: một khung câu ở Bảng 1 + một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that, in many countries, women are legally entitled to maternity leave after giving birth. Although this policy has certain drawbacks for employers, I believe these are outweighed by its benefits.

items.cue: Education · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some fast-food restaurants and supermarkets provide money to schools in order to promote their products. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một khung câu ở Bảng 1 + một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that some fast-food chains and supermarkets now fund schools as a way of promoting their products. Despite the financial support this provides, I believe it is a harmful development.

items.cue: Work · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: In some countries, it is illegal for employers to reject job applicants because of their age. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một khung câu ở Bảng 1 + một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that, in some countries, employers are now legally banned from rejecting job applicants because of their age. Despite certain concerns surrounding this law, I believe it is a beneficial one.

items.cue: Education · Two-part question
items.prompt: In some countries, schools arrange unpaid work placements so that students can gain experience. How beneficial is this for students and for the companies or organisations involved?
items.hint: Hai câu: một khung câu ở Bảng 1 + một câu nêu quan điểm ở Bảng 2. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that schools in some countries arrange unpaid work placements for students. In my view, these placements benefit students greatly, while the benefits for employers are more limited.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn câu nêu quan điểm tốt nhất
intro: Đọc mỗi đề và chọn câu nêu quan điểm trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề nhất.

I disagree, as this would deter talented students from poorer families.

units.name: Who Does What: People, Institutions and Agents

theory.html: Bài Task 2 thường xoay quanh vài đối tượng quen thuộc: children, schools, people, the government. Lặp lại các từ này khiến bài viết đơn điệu (LR), còn chọn sai đối tượng sẽ làm lập luận yếu đi (TR). Một giải pháp chỉ thuyết phục khi đối tượng bạn nêu thực sự có quyền hạn để thực hiện nó.

Bài này cung cấp các từ thay thế chính xác cho bốn từ phổ biến trên, cùng một nhóm đối tượng khác (doanh nghiệp, nhà quảng cáo, truyền thông, cơ quan quản lý, lực lượng thực thi pháp luật). Bài cũng giới thiệu mẫu we as voters / consumers, giúp biến câu chung chung people should thành một vai trò cụ thể.

Ghép đúng đối tượng với hành động. Lawmakers làm ra luật; cảnh sát thực thi luật. Cơ quan quản lý (regulators) đặt ra tiêu chuẩn và giám sát; chính quyền địa phương vận hành các dịch vụ địa phương; người sử dụng lao động (employers) quyết định điều kiện làm việc.

theory.text: Từ thay thế cho các đối tượng phổ biến

cells: schoolchildren, primary schoolchildren, school-age children, young learners; pupils (học sinh phổ thông, Anh-Anh)
Advertising aimed at primary schoolchildren should be restricted.
educational institutions, schools and universities, the education system
In some educational institutions, there are far more male than female students.
the public, members of the public, individuals, citizens, residents, consumers; For many, …
The public should have better access to healthcare.
the authorities, the state, governments, policy makers, lawmakers (legislators), local authorities, city officials, political leaders
Local authorities should create more cycle lanes.
Employers should offer more flexible working hours.
advertisers, the media / the press, regulatory bodies (e.g. food safety regulators), law enforcement agencies (the police)
Regulatory bodies should ensure that food labels are accurate.
we as consumers / voters / citizens + should / can + V
We as consumers can reduce plastic waste by choosing products with less packaging.

items: Policy makers should introduce a sugar tax to discourage the consumption of sugary drinks.
Local authorities could make cycling safer by building separate cycle lanes.
Regulatory bodies need to ensure that food labels give accurate nutritional information.
Employers should offer flexible hours so that staff can balance work and family life.
We as consumers can reduce plastic waste by choosing products with less packaging.
The media can raise public awareness of the dangers of drink-driving.
Lawmakers should restrict junk food advertising aimed at primary schoolchildren.
Law enforcement agencies need more resources to tackle online fraud.

items.bad: Law enforcement should increase fines and penalties to deter crime. LR
items.good: Lawmakers should increase fines and penalties to deter crime.
items.note: Cảnh sát thực thi luật; còn lawmakers (nhà làm luật) mới là người làm ra luật.

items.bad: Big companies damage rivers, so these entrepreneurs should pay. LR
items.good: Big companies damage rivers, so these firms should pay.
items.note: entrepreneur là một người (doanh nhân), không phải một công ty.

items.bad: Kids should not use phones in class. LR
items.good: Pupils should not use phones in class.
items.note: kids mang tính thân mật (informal).

items.bad: The government should make peoples aware of the risks. LR
items.good: The government should make the public aware of the risks.
items.note: people vốn đã là số nhiều. (peoples nghĩa là các dân tộc.)

items.bad: Criminal gangs run most cybercrime, so people should be more careful online. TR
items.good: Criminal gangs run most cybercrime, so governments should cooperate across borders to dismantle these networks.
items.note: Giải pháp không khớp với nguyên nhân: một nguyên nhân lớn, có tổ chức cần một đối tượng có quyền lực tương xứng.

items.bad: Teachers should control how children use the Internet at home. TR
items.good: Parents should supervise how children use the Internet at home.
items.note: Sai đối tượng: giáo viên không có quyền quản lý những gì diễn ra ở nhà.

items.html: the government = chính phủ của một quốc gia cụ thể; governments = các chính phủ nói chung (an toàn nhất trong IELTS); the state = nhà nước như một hệ thống, thường đi với tiền bạc: state funding, the state should pay.
citizens = công dân mang quốc tịch của một nước (quyền lợi, bầu cử); residents = cư dân sống tại một nơi (city residents); the public = người dân nói chung (public awareness, members of the public).
employers tạo việc làm và trả lương; employees / staff / workers là người làm việc. Staff là danh từ tập hợp: the staff are …, không bao giờ dùng staffs.
pupils = học sinh phổ thông (Anh-Anh, đặc biệt ở tiểu học); students = sinh viên đại học, hoặc người học nói chung.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Gọi tên đúng đối tượng
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu với một đối tượng cụ thể hơn (và nếu cần, một động từ chính xác hơn). Câu ● cho sẵn đối tượng; câu ●● có gợi ý; câu ●●●: tự chọn đối tượng.

items.cue: The government should build more parks in the city.
items.answer: Local authorities should create more parks in the city.
items.alt: City officials should provide more green spaces.

items.cue: People should have better access to healthcare.
items.answer: The public should have better access to healthcare.
items.alt: Members of the public should have better access to healthcare.

items.cue: Kids in primary school should not see junk food adverts.
items.answer: Primary schoolchildren should not be exposed to junk food advertisements.
items.alt: Junk food advertising aimed at primary schoolchildren should be restricted.

items.cue: Companies should give workers more flexible hours.
items.answer: Employers should offer their staff more flexible working hours.
items.alt: Employers should give employees greater flexibility over their working hours.

items.cue: Many people think money is more important than family.
items.answer: For many, money is more important than family.
items.alt: For many, financial security matters more than family.

items.cue: People should buy products with less packaging.
items.answer: We as consumers should choose products with less packaging.
items.alt: Consumers should opt for products with less packaging.

items.cue: The government should make a law to ban smoking in restaurants.
items.answer: Lawmakers should ban smoking in restaurants.
items.alt: Legislators should introduce a law banning smoking in restaurants.

items.cue: The police should make tougher laws against drink-driving.
items.hint: Sửa lại đối tượng; có thể cần hai đối tượng
items.answer: Lawmakers should introduce tougher laws against drink-driving, and the police should enforce them strictly.
items.alt: Legislators should pass stricter drink-driving laws.

items.cue: The government should check that food sold in shops is safe.
items.answer: Food safety regulators should ensure that the food sold in shops is safe to eat.
items.alt: Regulatory bodies should monitor the safety of food sold in shops.

items.cue: Schools should help students who have emotional problems.
items.answer: Educational institutions should help students with emotional problems.
items.alt: Schools should support pupils who are experiencing emotional difficulties.

items.cue: TV and newspapers should tell people about the dangers of gambling.
items.answer: The media should raise public awareness of the dangers of gambling.
items.alt: The press and broadcasters should inform the public about the risks of gambling.

items.cue: People who live in the city complain about noise.
items.answer: City residents complain about noise.
items.alt: Residents of the city complain about noise levels.

items.cue: People should vote for politicians who protect the environment.
items.answer: We as voters should support politicians who are committed to protecting the environment.
items.alt: As voters, we should back candidates who prioritise environmental protection.

items.cue: The government and companies should work together to train unemployed people.
items.answer: The state and businesses should work together to retrain jobseekers.
items.alt: Governments and employers should cooperate on training programmes for the unemployed.

items.cue: The government should stop advertisers showing unhealthy food to children.
items.hint: Gọi tên chính xác cơ quan quản lý, nhà quảng cáo và nhóm trẻ em
items.answer: Regulators should prevent advertisers from targeting schoolchildren with unhealthy food.
items.alt: Lawmakers should ban unhealthy food advertising aimed at young children.

items.cue: People are using too much water, so the government should do something.
items.hint: Đối tượng cụ thể + hành động cụ thể
items.answer: Local water authorities could introduce higher charges for excessive water use.
items.alt: Policy makers could introduce tiered water pricing to discourage waste.

items.cue: Companies pollute rivers, so people should stop throwing rubbish in rivers.
items.hint: Sửa lỗi giải pháp không khớp với nguyên nhân
items.answer: Since factories are the main source of river pollution, regulators should impose heavy fines on companies that discharge waste.
items.alt: As industrial waste is the main cause of river pollution, environmental agencies should strictly monitor factories.

items.cue: Everyone should help to reduce traffic congestion.
items.hint: Nêu hai đối tượng và việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm
items.answer: City authorities should improve public transport, while employers could allow flexible start times to reduce rush-hour traffic.
items.alt: Local authorities could invest in bus lanes, and businesses could let staff work from home on some days.

items.cue: Children should learn about money at school and at home.
items.hint: Nêu hai đối tượng và việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm
items.answer: Schools could include financial education in the curriculum, while parents can teach children to budget their pocket money.
items.alt: Education policy makers should add money management to the curriculum, and parents should reinforce it at home.

items.cue: The government should protect people's personal data online.
items.hint: Nêu hai đối tượng cụ thể
items.answer: Lawmakers should require technology companies to protect users' personal data and to report any breaches promptly.
items.alt: Data protection regulators should ensure that technology firms store users' information securely.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Chính quyền địa phương nên xây thêm nhiều công viên công cộng.
items.translation: The local government should build more public parks.
items.answer: Local authorities should create more public parks.
items.alt: City officials should provide more public parks.

items.cue: Người dân nên được tiếp cận tốt hơn với giáo dục.
items.rewriteWith: the public (từ khóa: the public, better access to)
items.translation: People should have better access to education.
items.answer: The public should have better access to education.
items.alt: Members of the public should have better access to education.

items.cue: Học sinh tiểu học không nên dùng điện thoại di động trong lớp.
items.translation: Primary school students should not use mobile phones in class.
items.answer: Primary schoolchildren should not use mobile phones in class.
items.alt: Mobile phones should not be used by primary schoolchildren during lessons.

items.cue: Các nhà tuyển dụng nên cho phép nhân viên làm việc linh hoạt hơn.
items.translation: Employers should let employees work more flexibly.
items.answer: Employers should offer their staff more flexible working arrangements.
items.alt: Employers should give their employees greater flexibility in how and when they work.

items.cue: Với tư cách là người tiêu dùng, chúng ta có thể giảm rác thải nhựa.
items.rewriteWith: we as consumers (từ khóa: we as consumers, reduce, plastic waste)
items.translation: As consumers, we can reduce plastic waste.
items.answer: We as consumers can reduce plastic waste.
items.alt: Consumers can play their part in reducing plastic waste.

items.cue: Các nhà làm luật nên cấm quảng cáo thuốc lá.
items.translation: The people who make laws should ban cigarette advertising.
items.answer: Lawmakers should ban tobacco advertising.
items.alt: Legislators should prohibit cigarette advertising.

items.cue: Đối với nhiều người, sự ổn định trong công việc quan trọng hơn mức lương.
items.rewriteWith: For many, … (từ khóa: a sense of job security)
items.translation: For many people, job stability is more important than salary.
items.answer: For many, a sense of job security is more important than salary.
items.alt: For many workers, a secure job matters more than a high salary.

items.cue: Các cơ quan quản lý nên đảm bảo rằng nhãn thực phẩm cung cấp thông tin dinh dưỡng chính xác.
items.translation: The relevant authorities should make sure that food labels contain accurate nutritional information.
items.answer: Regulatory bodies should ensure that food labels provide accurate nutritional information.
items.alt: Food regulators should make sure that labels give accurate information about nutrition.

items.cue: Truyền thông có thể nâng cao nhận thức của công chúng về tác hại của rượu bia.
items.translation: The media can make people more aware of the harmful effects of alcohol.
items.answer: The media can raise public awareness of the harmful effects of alcohol.
items.alt: The press and broadcasters can help the public understand the dangers of alcohol.

items.cue: Cảnh sát cần thực thi luật giao thông nghiêm ngặt hơn.
items.translation: The police need to enforce traffic laws more strictly.
items.answer: Law enforcement agencies need to enforce traffic laws more strictly.
items.alt: The police need to apply traffic laws more rigorously.

items.cue: Các nhà hoạch định chính sách nên đánh thuế cao hơn đối với đồ uống có đường.
items.translation: Policy makers should put higher taxes on sugary drinks.
items.answer: Policy makers should impose higher taxes on sugary drinks.
items.alt: Policy makers should raise taxes on drinks with a high sugar content.

items.cue: Cư dân thành phố thường phàn nàn về ô nhiễm tiếng ồn.
items.translation: People living in cities often complain about noise pollution.
items.answer: City residents often complain about noise pollution.
items.alt: Urban residents frequently complain about noise pollution.

items.cue: Các tập đoàn đa quốc gia nên chịu trách nhiệm với cộng đồng địa phương nơi họ hoạt động.
items.translation: Multinational companies should be responsible to the local communities where they operate.
items.answer: Multinational corporations should be accountable to the local communities in which they operate.
items.alt: Multinationals should be accountable to the communities in which they do business.

items.cue: Các nhà quảng cáo định hình thái độ của công chúng đối với ngoại hình.
items.translation: Advertisers shape the public's attitudes to appearance.
items.answer: Advertisers shape public attitudes towards physical appearance.
items.alt: Advertisers strongly influence how the public views physical appearance.

items.cue: Với tư cách là cử tri, chúng ta nên gây áp lực lên chính phủ để hạn chế việc sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu.
items.translation: As voters, we should put pressure on the government to limit the use of pesticides.
items.answer: We as voters should put pressure on the government to restrict the use of pesticides.
items.alt: As voters, we should urge the government to limit pesticide use.

items.cue: Nhà nước và doanh nghiệp nên hợp tác để đào tạo lại những người lao động bị mất việc do tự động hóa.
items.translation: The government and companies should cooperate to retrain workers who lose their jobs because of automation.
items.answer: The state and businesses should work together to retrain workers who have lost their jobs to automation.
items.alt: Governments and employers should jointly fund retraining for workers displaced by automation.

items.cue: Cha mẹ nên giám sát việc con cái sử dụng internet, trong khi nhà trường nên dạy học sinh cách nhận biết tin giả.
items.translation: Parents should monitor their children's use of the Internet, while schools should teach students how to recognise fake news.
items.answer: Parents should supervise their children's Internet use, while schools should teach pupils how to recognise fake news.
items.alt: Parents need to oversee how their children use the Internet, and schools should teach pupils to identify false information.

items.cue: Chính quyền thành phố có thể giảm ùn tắc bằng cách cải thiện giao thông công cộng.
items.translation: The city government can reduce traffic jams by improving public transport.
items.answer: City authorities could reduce congestion by improving public transport.
items.alt: Local authorities could ease traffic congestion by investing in public transport.

items.cue: Các nhà lãnh đạo chính trị nên dùng vị thế của mình để nâng cao hiểu biết về nạn buôn người.
items.translation: Political leaders should use their position to increase understanding of human trafficking.
items.answer: Political leaders should use their position to raise awareness of the dangers of human trafficking.
items.alt: Political leaders should use their influence to inform the public about human trafficking.

items.cue: Không chỉ chính phủ mà cả các công ty công nghệ cũng phải chịu trách nhiệm bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân của người dùng.
items.rewriteWith: Responsibility for … lies not only with … but also with …
items.translation: Not only the government but also technology companies must be responsible for protecting users' personal data.
items.answer: Responsibility for protecting users' personal data lies not only with governments but also with technology companies.
items.alt: Responsibility for safeguarding users' personal data lies not only with the state but also with tech companies.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Law enforcement should increase fines and penalties to deter crime.
items.answer: Law enforcement LAWMAKERS should increase fines and penalties to deter crime.
notes: LR Cảnh sát thực thi luật; nhà làm luật mới quy định mức phạt.

items.cue: Kids should not be allowed to use smartphones at school.
items.answer: Kids PUPILS should not be allowed to use smartphones at school.
notes: LR kids mang tính thân mật.

items.cue: The government should make peoples aware of the dangers of smoking.
items.answer: The government should make peoples THE PUBLIC aware of the dangers of smoking.
notes: LR people vốn đã là số nhiều; peoples nghĩa là các dân tộc.

items.cue: Local authorities should improve street lighting to make residents feel safer.
items.answer: ✓ Local authorities should improve street lighting to make residents feel safer.
notes: Đúng: đối tượng ở cấp địa phương cho một dịch vụ địa phương.

items.cue: Employees should provide better working conditions for their staff.
items.answer: Employees EMPLOYERS should provide better working conditions for their staff.
notes: LR Employers mới cung cấp điều kiện làm việc; employees là nhân viên.

items.cue: The public are increasingly concerned about food safety.
items.answer: ✓ The public are increasingly concerned about food safety.
notes: Đúng: trong tiếng Anh-Anh, the public có thể đi với động từ số nhiều.

items.cue: Big companies should pay for the pollution, because these entrepreneurs often damage rivers.
items.answer: Big companies should pay for the pollution, because these entrepreneurs THESE FIRMS often damage rivers.
notes: LR entrepreneur là một người, không phải một công ty.

items.cue: Young people should be allowed to vote at the age of 16.
items.answer: ✓ Young people should be allowed to vote at the age of 16.
notes: Đúng: young people chính xác cho nhóm 16 tuổi.

items.cue: Organised criminal gangs are behind most cybercrime, so people should be more careful when using the Internet.
items.answer: Organised criminal gangs are behind most cybercrime, so people should be more careful when using the Internet GOVERNMENTS SHOULD COOPERATE ACROSS BORDERS TO DISMANTLE THESE NETWORKS.
notes: TR Giải pháp không khớp với nguyên nhân: sự cẩn thận của cá nhân không thể đánh bại tội phạm quốc tế có tổ chức.

items.cue: Regulatory bodies should ensure that financial advisers act in their clients' best interests.
items.answer: ✓ Regulatory bodies should ensure that financial advisers act in their clients' best interests.
notes: Đúng: cơ quan quản lý giám sát tiêu chuẩn nghề nghiệp.

items.cue: Educational institution should offer more vocational courses.
items.answer: Educational institution EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS should offer more vocational courses.
notes: GRA Danh từ đếm được số ít cần mạo từ; ở đây dùng số nhiều chỉ chung là đúng.

items.cue: We as voters needs to put more pressure on politicians.
items.answer: We as voters needs NEED to put more pressure on politicians.
notes: GRA Hòa hợp chủ – vị: we … need.

items.cue: The media should raise public awareness on the dangers of drink-driving.
items.answer: The media should raise public awareness on AWARENESS OF the dangers of drink-driving.
notes: LR Kết hợp từ (collocation): raise awareness of sth.

items.cue: Advertisers shape the public's attitudes, so they should be regulated more strictly.
items.answer: ✓ Advertisers shape the public's attitudes, so they should be regulated more strictly.
notes: Đúng: đối tượng cụ thể với hệ quả hợp lý.

items.cue: Humans should take action to reduce air pollution in cities.
items.answer: Humans should take action CITY AUTHORITIES SHOULD RESTRICT THE MOST POLLUTING VEHICLES to reduce air pollution in cities.
notes: TR Đối tượng và hành động đều mơ hồ: hãy nói rõ ai nên làm gì.

items.cue: The government should solve the problem of obesity.
items.answer: The government should solve the problem of obesity COULD TAX SUGARY DRINKS AND FUND SPORTS FACILITIES IN SCHOOLS.
notes: TR solve the problem là cụm rỗng nghĩa; hãy nêu một hành động cụ thể.

items.cue: Police makers should introduce stricter gun laws.
items.answer: Police makers POLICY MAKERS should introduce stricter gun laws.
notes: LR Sai từ: policy makers là người hoạch định chính sách.

items.cue: While lawmakers set the rules, it is law enforcement agencies that ensure they are obeyed.
items.answer: ✓ While lawmakers set the rules, it is law enforcement agencies that ensure they are obeyed.
notes: Đúng: mỗi đối tượng được ghép với đúng hành động.

items.cue: Teachers should supervise how children use the Internet at home.
items.answer: Teachers PARENTS should supervise how children use the Internet at home.
notes: TR Sai đối tượng: giáo viên không kiểm soát hoạt động của trẻ ở nhà.

items.cue: The goverment and the corporations should cooperate together to create jobs.
items.answer: The goverment GOVERNMENT and the corporations CORPORATIONS should cooperate together COOPERATE to create jobs.
notes: LR Lỗi chính tả.
GRA Nói chung chung thì không dùng mạo từ.
LR Thừa: cooperate đã có nghĩa là work together.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) hoặc tối đa hai câu (●●●) nêu rõ một đối tượng cụ thể và việc đối tượng đó nên hoặc có thể làm.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Housing is a basic human need, so governments should provide free housing for people who cannot afford it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Đối tượng: the state. Viết một câu nêu việc đối tượng này nên làm.
items.answer: The state should offer subsidised rather than free housing to low-income families, so that public money can help more people.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that individuals should be allowed to keep all the money they earn and should not have to pay taxes to the government. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Đối tượng: citizens. Viết một câu giải thích vì sao cần có thuế.
items.answer: Citizens benefit from roads, schools and hospitals, which can only be funded if everyone pays a fair share of tax.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Companies and individuals, rather than governments, should pay the costs of the pollution they cause. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Regulators should require manufacturers to pay for cleaning up the pollution their factories cause.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The news media often report violent crimes, which can frighten the public and may encourage criminals. Some people believe that crime news should not be shown on television. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Broadcasters could report violent crime responsibly, avoiding graphic details that might frighten viewers.

items.cue: Traffic · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to improve road safety is to increase the minimum legal age for driving cars and riding motorcycles. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Rather than raising the driving age, lawmakers could introduce stricter tests, and the police could enforce speed limits more rigorously.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Prison is the most common way to deal with crime in many countries. Some people believe that providing better education would be a more effective solution. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Prison authorities should offer inmates education and vocational training to reduce reoffending.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Men hold most senior positions in many organisations. Governments should require a certain proportion of these jobs to be reserved for women. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Employers could offer mentoring programmes that prepare more women for senior roles, without the need for compulsory quotas.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that everyone has the right to a university education and that governments should make university free for all students, regardless of their financial background. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The state could fund university places for students from low-income families, while universities offer scholarships to the most able.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should strictly control the supply of fresh water because it is a limited resource, while others think people should be free to use as much water as they want. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Water authorities could charge higher rates for heavy water use, which would encourage households to save water.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that charities should help people in their own country, while others think they should help people in need wherever they live. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Charities should direct their resources to wherever the need is greatest, whether at home or abroad.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: An increasing amount of advertising is aimed at children and encourages them to buy products such as toys and snacks. Many parents are concerned, while advertisers argue that such advertising provides useful information. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Regulators should prevent advertisers from targeting young children, who cannot yet recognise persuasive techniques.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that teachers should teach children the difference between right and wrong, while others think that schools should focus only on academic subjects. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While parents remain children's main moral guides, teachers can reinforce values such as honesty and fairness in the classroom.

items.cue: Environment · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many countries do not recycle enough household waste, such as paper, glass and aluminium cans. Why is this the case, and what can be done to increase recycling?
items.answer: Local authorities could provide separate collection bins for paper, glass and cans, making recycling easier for households.

items.cue: Traffic · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Heavy road traffic is a serious problem in many towns and cities. What are the main causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.answer: City authorities could ease traffic by investing in reliable public transport and dedicated bus lanes.

items.cue: City development · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some governments encourage businesses to move from cities to rural areas. Do the advantages of this policy outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Tự chọn đối tượng và nêu việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm.
items.answer: Governments that offer tax incentives to businesses moving to rural areas can create local jobs and reduce pressure on overcrowded cities.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some countries, criminal trials are shown on television so that members of the public can watch them. Do the advantages of broadcasting court cases outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Tự chọn đối tượng và nêu việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm.
items.answer: Courts should allow trials to be broadcast only when the identities of victims and witnesses can be protected.

items.cue: Traffic · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some cities have introduced congestion charges during busy periods in order to reduce traffic. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn đối tượng và nêu việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm.
items.answer: City authorities should use the revenue from congestion charges to improve public transport, so that drivers have a realistic alternative.

items.cue: Media and communication · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Many young people admire media and sports stars who do not always set a good example. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn đối tượng và nêu việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm.
items.answer: Sports bodies and the media can encourage young fans to follow better role models by giving more coverage to stars who behave responsibly.

items.cue: Media and communication · Two-part question
items.prompt: Consumers are exposed to an increasing number of advertisements from competing companies. To what extent are consumers influenced by advertising, and what measures can be taken to protect them?
items.hint: Tự chọn đối tượng và nêu việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm.
items.answer: Advertising regulators should require companies to make all claims verifiable, while schools teach young consumers to question what they see.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should make laws about nutrition and healthy lifestyles, while others think these should be matters of personal choice and responsibility. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Tự chọn đối tượng và nêu việc mỗi đối tượng nên làm.
items.answer: Policy makers could require clear nutrition labels and restrict junk food advertising, while leaving final food choices to individuals.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn đúng đối tượng
intro: Chọn đối tượng phù hợp nhất để hoàn thành mỗi câu.

items.cue: ______ should enforce the new speed limits.
items.note: Cảnh sát thực thi luật.

items.cue: ______ should pass a law banning single-use plastic bags.
items.note: Nhà làm luật thông qua luật.

items.cue: ______ can raise awareness of mental health issues through documentaries.
items.note: Truyền thông sản xuất phim tài liệu.

items.cue: ______ should give staff paid leave to care for newborn babies.
items.note: Employers cho nhân viên nghỉ phép.

items.cue: ______ can choose products with less packaging.
items.note: Người tiêu dùng chọn mua sản phẩm.

items.cue: A primary school in Hanoi has started providing free lunches for its ______.
items.note: pupils = học sinh của trường; citizens và the public không dùng được sau its trong ngữ cảnh này.

items.cue: ______ should keep public parks clean and safe.
items.note: Công viên là dịch vụ công ở địa phương.

items.cue: ______ need to ensure that medicines are tested before they are sold.
items.note: Cơ quan quản lý đặt ra và kiểm tra tiêu chuẩn an toàn.

items.cue: ______ often influence what young people consider fashionable.
items.note: Nhà quảng cáo định hình thái độ của công chúng.

items.cue: Better street lighting would make ______ feel safer at night.
items.note: residents = những người sống trong khu vực.

items.cue: ______ should be accountable to the local communities in which they operate.
items.note: Các công ty hoạt động (operate) trong cộng đồng.

items.cue: If more ______ supported green candidates, politicians would take climate change more seriously.
items.note: Ứng cử viên phụ thuộc vào cử tri.

items.cue: ______ should give teachers more freedom to decide lesson content.
items.note: Nhà hoạch định chính sách quyết định chương trình học.

items.cue: ______ should check how much time their children spend on screens.
items.note: Cha mẹ giám sát con cái ở nhà.

items.cue: Since most river pollution comes from factories, ______ should impose heavy fines on firms that discharge waste.
items.note: Cơ quan quản lý môi trường có thẩm quyền xử phạt doanh nghiệp; cá nhân và trường học thì không. Đối tượng khớp với nguyên nhân.

items.cue: To reduce rush-hour traffic, ______ could allow staff to start work at different times.
items.note: Employers quyết định giờ làm việc.

items.cue: ______ should not be allowed to target young children with adverts for sugary snacks.
items.note: Quy định hạn chế áp dụng cho nhà quảng cáo.

items.cue: Because cybercrime crosses borders, ______ need to cooperate internationally.
items.note: Tội phạm xuyên quốc gia cần sự hợp tác giữa lực lượng thực thi pháp luật các nước.

items.cue: ______ can reduce food waste by planning meals and buying only what they need.
items.note: Việc lên kế hoạch bữa ăn diễn ra trong gia đình.

items.cue: If ______ invested more in staff training, they would find it easier to fill skilled vacancies.
items.note: Employers chi trả cho việc đào tạo nhân viên.

theory.html: Bài này tập hợp các cụm từ "đắt giá" giúp bạn thay thế những từ quá cơ bản xuất hiện trong hầu hết bài viết: try, spend money, difficult, related to, such as, help, want, busy, change, cheap, at home…. Các cụm từ được nhóm theo chức năng (bạn muốn diễn đạt điều gì), để khi viết bạn có thể tìm đúng nhóm cần dùng.

Mỗi cụm từ đi kèm một khuôn ngữ pháp cố định (ví dụ put resources into + V-ing, suffer from + danh từ, leave sb unable to + V). Hãy học cả khuôn chứ không chỉ học từ: phần lớn lỗi LR ở band 5.5–6.5 đến từ sai giới từ hoặc sai dạng từ đi sau cụm từ.
Đừng nhồi nhét. Một cụm từ "xịn" dùng sai ngữ cảnh bị đánh giá thấp hơn một từ đơn giản dùng đúng. Mỗi đoạn văn chỉ cần một hoặc hai cụm từ trong bài này, đặt đúng chỗ.

cells: The government should put more resources into building affordable housing.
struggle to V; leave sb unable to V; require considerable effort; there is more effort involved in A than in B
Falling standards leave many children unable to read well.
There are health problems associated with mobile phone use.
…, including diabetes. / The upgrade, along with higher maintenance costs, …
at the expense of; put sth at risk; represent a danger to
Air pollution puts residents' health at risk.
(those who were V3) as children; grow up to V
Those who were maltreated as children often grow up to have health problems.
Vai trò, thành phần, mục đích
in a team; in the curriculum; to (do)
as a team / family; as part of; as a way to V / of V-ing
Arts subjects should be included as part of the curriculum.
in many countries; a lot of time
in many parts of the world; a good part of their time
Many children spend a good part of their time online.
life at school / in the city
school life; city life; rural life
For many, city life is less enjoyable than rural life.
raise public awareness of; launch educational programmes to V; through educational initiatives
Campaigns can raise public awareness of the dangers of gambling.
develop / foster / instil a sense of; a sense of job security
Schools can foster a sense of national pride.
form opinions on; form one's personality; form relationships with
Businesses need to form long-lasting relationships with customers.
contribute to; make it easier than ever for sb to V; help sb with sth
The Internet makes it easier than ever for us to communicate.
lead to economic development; contribute to national prosperity; the key to a healthier economy lies in
The key to a healthier economy lies in education.
online; according to; companies in Vietnam
Internet-based / arts-based; based on; based in
Many companies based in Vietnam export most of their products.
improve academic performance; achieve good grades; thrive at school; high-performing students
High-performing students often face intense pressure.
Many students suffer from stress before exams.
a lot of; much greater than
The benefits of gaming can go far beyond enjoyment.
work around the clock; be inundated with; an always-on culture. Ghi chú: working adults = người đi làm (dùng để gọi tên nhóm, không mang nghĩa "bận").
Many people are inundated with work commitments.
one's immediate circle; widen one's social circles; an ever-widening circle of
The Internet allows us to widen our social circles.
have a profound impact on; transform; revolutionise; make a huge difference to
The Internet has revolutionised the way we live.
A major railway project is under way.
when X happens, Y also happens
With the rise of smartphones comes greater use of social media.
Smartphones have become ubiquitous in daily life.
affordable; ease the financial burden on
Subsidised housing eases the financial burden on low-income families.
wish to V; seek to V
Parents wish to ensure the safety of their children.
in the comfort of one's own home
Students can now study in the comfort of their own home.

items: The government should put more resources into ensuring that global firms pay their taxes.
The declining quality of education leaves many children unable to read or write.
There are several social and medical problems associated with the use of mobile phones.
Air pollution levels in big cities have been rising, putting people's health at risk.
Teachers need to instil a sense of curiosity in their students.
Many working adults have little or no time for their personal hobbies.
The advent of the Internet has revolutionised the way we live.
Lower bus fares ease the financial burden on residents who rely on public transport.

items.bad: Governments should invest for essential industries. LR
items.good: Governments should invest in essential industries.
items.note: invest đi với giới từ in.

items.bad: Good communication is an essential part for teamwork. LR
items.good: Good communication is an essential part of teamwork.
items.note: Luôn là part of sth / as part of sth.

items.bad: Data centres require for a huge amount of energy. LR
items.good: Data centres require a huge amount of energy.
items.note: require là ngoại động từ: require sth, không có for.

items.bad: Many students suffer from accommodation and food fees. LR
items.good: Many students struggle with the rising cost of accommodation and food.
items.note: suffer from dùng cho bệnh tật, căng thẳng, vấn đề tâm lý; với chi phí, dùng struggle with the cost of ….

items.bad: Cybercrime is a growing threat for citizens. LR
items.good: Cybercrime is a growing threat to citizens.
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm là to: a threat / danger / risk to sb.

items.bad: Students can study at the comfort of their home. LR
items.good: Students can study in the comfort of their own home.
items.note: Cụm cố định: in the comfort of one's own home.

items.html: Cả hai đều giới thiệu ví dụ và đều cho biết danh sách chưa đầy đủ. including thường đứng sau dấu phẩy: health problems, including diabetes. Không dùng including để mở đầu một mệnh đề mới.
suffer from + bệnh tật / vấn đề kéo dài (stress, obesity, health problems); suffer + danh từ chỉ tổn thất hoặc chấn thương (suffer losses, suffer hearing damage, suffer a severe blow).
struggle to + động từ nguyên mẫu (struggle to pay the rent); struggle with + danh từ hoặc V-ing (struggle with debt, struggle with reading).
want mang tính khẩu ngữ; wish to + V trang trọng hơn (Parents wish to ensure …); seek to + V nhấn mạnh nỗ lực có chủ đích (The policy seeks to reduce congestion). Không dùng wish + V-ing.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Chọn cụm từ đúng (nhóm 1)
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng trong mỗi câu. Chú ý giới từ và dạng từ đi sau cụm từ.

items.cue: The government should put more resources ( on / into ) building affordable housing.
items.answer: into
items.note: put resources into + V-ing / danh từ.

items.cue: Many children ( struggle / struggle with ) to read or write.
items.answer: struggle
items.note: struggle to + V; struggle with + danh từ.

items.cue: There are several health problems ( associated to / associated with ) the use of mobile phones.
items.answer: associated with
items.note: Cụm cố định: associated with.

items.cue: Many people suffer from chronic diseases, ( such / including ) diabetes and heart disease.
items.answer: including
items.note: including + danh sách ví dụ; such phải đi với as.

items.cue: Air pollution is putting people's health ( at risk / in risk ).
items.answer: at risk
items.note: Cụm cố định: put sth at risk.

items.cue: Arts subjects should be included ( as part of / as a part for ) the school curriculum.
items.answer: as part of
items.note: Cụm cố định: as part of sth.

items.cue: The government has launched campaigns ( in a way to / as a way to ) raise awareness of recycling.
items.answer: as a way to
items.note: as a way to + V diễn tả mục đích.

items.cue: In many ( parts of the world / parts in the world ), children still have little access to clean water.
items.answer: parts of the world
items.note: Cụm cố định: in many parts of the world.

items.cue: Teachers should help students develop a ( sense / sensation ) of responsibility.
items.answer: sense
items.note: Kết hợp từ: develop a sense of responsibility.

items.cue: A daily reading habit can help ( form / make ) children's personalities.
items.answer: form
items.note: form one's personality; không dùng make.

items.cue: The Internet has made it easier than ever ( us to / for us to ) communicate.
items.answer: for us to
items.note: Cấu trúc: make it easier than ever for sb to V (cần for trước tân ngữ).

items.cue: Schools need to help children ( with / for ) emotional problems.
items.answer: with
items.note: Cấu trúc: help sb with sth.

items.cue: Investment in vocational training can ( contribute to / contribute ) a more prosperous nation.
items.answer: contribute to
items.note: contribute luôn đi với to khi có tân ngữ chỉ kết quả.

items.cue: Those who were maltreated ( as children / when children ) are more likely to have poor health later in life.
items.answer: as children
items.note: as children = khi còn là trẻ em.

items.cue: The tobacco industry contributes to economic growth, but this is ( at the cost for / at the expense of ) public health.
items.answer: at the expense of
items.note: Cụm cố định: at the expense of sth.

items.cue: The consumption of wild animals represents a danger ( to / for ) public health.
items.answer: to
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: represent a danger to sth.

items.cue: Many children these days spend a ( good part / good deal part ) of their time playing video games.
items.answer: good part
items.note: Cụm cố định: spend a good part of one's time + V-ing.

items.cue: Political leaders could help young people develop a sense of national pride ( by / through ) educational initiatives.
items.answer: through
items.note: through educational initiatives = thông qua các chương trình giáo dục.

items.cue: If businesses want to succeed, they need to form long-lasting ( relationships to / relationships with ) their customers.
items.answer: relationships with
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: form relationships with sb.

items.cue: There are several drawbacks ( involved with / involved in ) using mobile phones while driving.
items.answer: involved in
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: drawbacks involved in + V-ing.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên dành nhiều nguồn lực hơn cho việc xây dựng nhà ở giá rẻ.
items.translation: The government should spend more money on building cheap housing.
items.answer: The government should put more resources into building affordable housing.
items.alt: Governments should put more resources into providing affordable homes.

items.cue: Nhiều sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp gặp khó khăn trong việc tìm việc làm.
items.translation: Many new graduates have difficulty finding a job.
items.answer: Many recent graduates struggle to find work.
items.alt: A large number of new graduates struggle to secure employment.

items.cue: Có nhiều vấn đề sức khỏe liên quan đến việc ngồi quá lâu.
items.translation: There are many health problems related to sitting too long.
items.answer: There are several health problems associated with sitting for long periods.
items.alt: Sitting for long periods is associated with a number of health problems.

items.cue: Nhiều người cao tuổi mắc các bệnh mãn tính như tiểu đường và cao huyết áp.
items.translation: Many elderly people have chronic diseases such as diabetes and high blood pressure.
items.answer: Many elderly people suffer from chronic diseases, including diabetes and high blood pressure.
items.alt: A large number of older people suffer from long-term conditions, including diabetes and high blood pressure.

items.cue: Ô nhiễm tiếng ồn đang đe dọa sức khỏe của người dân thành phố.
items.rewriteWith: put … at risk (từ khóa: noise pollution, city residents)
items.translation: Noise pollution is threatening the health of city residents.
items.answer: Noise pollution is putting the health of city residents at risk.
items.alt: High levels of noise put urban residents' health at risk.

items.cue: Âm nhạc nên được đưa vào như một phần của chương trình học.
items.translation: Music should be included in the school curriculum.
items.answer: Music should be included as part of the school curriculum.
items.alt: Music should be taught as part of the curriculum.

items.cue: Nhiều người đi làm bận rộn có rất ít hoặc không có thời gian cho sở thích cá nhân.
items.translation: Many busy workers have very little or no time for their personal hobbies.
items.answer: Many working adults have little or no time for their personal hobbies.
items.alt: Many people in full-time work have little time to pursue their hobbies.

items.cue: Cha mẹ mong muốn đảm bảo sự an toàn cho con cái mình.
items.translation: Parents want to make sure their children are safe.
items.answer: Parents wish to ensure the safety of their children.
items.alt: Parents wish to ensure that their children are safe.

items.cue: Chất lượng giáo dục giảm sút khiến nhiều trẻ em không thể đọc thông viết thạo.
items.translation: Falling educational quality means that many children cannot read and write well.
items.answer: The declining quality of education leaves many children unable to read and write properly.
items.alt: Falling educational standards are leaving many children unable to read or write well.

items.cue: Ngành du lịch phát triển dựa trên sự hy sinh môi trường tự nhiên.
items.translation: The tourism industry develops by sacrificing the natural environment.
items.answer: The growth of the tourism industry has come at the expense of the natural environment.
items.alt: Tourism has expanded at the expense of the natural environment.

items.cue: Học lịch sử có thể góp phần hình thành tình cảm gắn bó với đất nước.
items.translation: Studying history can help create a feeling of attachment to the country.
items.answer: Studying history can contribute to a sense of attachment to one's country.
items.alt: Learning history can foster a sense of national belonging.

items.cue: Internet giúp việc học ngoại ngữ trở nên dễ dàng hơn bao giờ hết.
items.rewriteWith: make it easier than ever for sb to
items.translation: The Internet makes learning foreign languages easier than ever.
items.answer: The Internet makes it easier than ever for people to learn foreign languages.
items.alt: The introduction of the Internet has made it easier than ever for learners to study foreign languages.

items.cue: Nhiều doanh nghiệp chịu thiệt hại tài chính nặng nề trong đại dịch.
items.translation: Many businesses had big financial losses during the pandemic.
items.answer: Many businesses suffered heavy financial losses during the pandemic.
items.alt: A large number of firms suffered a severe financial blow during the pandemic.

items.cue: Tác hại của việc nghiện mạng xã hội có thể vượt xa những gì người dùng hình dung.
items.translation: The harms of social media addiction can be much greater than users imagine.
items.answer: The harmful effects of social media addiction can go far beyond what most users imagine.
items.alt: The damage caused by social media addiction may go far beyond what users expect.

items.cue: Mạng xã hội giúp chúng ta mở rộng các mối quan hệ xã hội.
items.translation: Social media helps us expand our social relationships.
items.answer: Social media allows us to widen our social circles.
items.alt: Social networking sites enable people to widen their social circles.

items.cue: Một chương trình trồng rừng quy mô lớn đang được triển khai ở miền Trung.
items.translation: A large-scale reforestation programme is being carried out in central Vietnam.
items.answer: A large-scale reforestation programme is under way in central Vietnam.
items.alt: A major tree-planting scheme is currently under way in the central region.

items.cue: Học bổng có thể giảm bớt gánh nặng tài chính cho sinh viên nghèo.
items.translation: Scholarships can reduce the financial burden for poor students.
items.answer: Scholarships can ease the financial burden on students from low-income families.
items.alt: Scholarships help to ease the financial burden on disadvantaged students.

items.cue: Điện thoại thông minh đã thay đổi sâu sắc cách chúng ta làm việc.
items.translation: Smartphones have changed the way we work profoundly.
items.answer: Smartphones have had a profound impact on the way we work.
items.alt: Smartphones have transformed the way we work.

items.cue: Mạng xã hội hiện diện ở khắp nơi trong cuộc sống của giới trẻ.
items.translation: Social media is present everywhere in young people's lives.
items.answer: Social media has become ubiquitous in young people's lives.
items.alt: The ubiquity of social media shapes much of young people's lives.

items.cue: Nhiều người chọn khóa học trực tuyến dựa trên chi phí.
items.translation: Many people choose online courses according to cost.
items.answer: Many people choose online courses based on cost.
items.alt: Many learners select Internet-based courses largely on the basis of cost.

items.cue: Những học sinh có thành tích cao thường chịu áp lực lớn từ gia đình.
items.translation: Students with high achievements often face great pressure from their families.
items.answer: High-performing students often face considerable pressure from their families.
items.alt: Top students are often under intense pressure from their parents.

items.cue: Việc cùng nhau nấu ăn như một gia đình có thể giúp các thành viên gắn kết hơn.
items.translation: Cooking together as a family can help members bond.
items.answer: Cooking together as a family can strengthen family bonds.
items.alt: Preparing meals together as a family can bring family members closer.

items.cue: Học tập dựa trên Internet cho phép sinh viên học một cách thoải mái tại nhà.
items.rewriteWith: Internet-based learning + in the comfort of their own home
items.translation: Internet-based learning allows students to study comfortably at home.
items.answer: Internet-based learning allows students to study in the comfort of their own home.
items.alt: Online learning enables students to complete their studies in the comfort of their own home.

items.cue: Cùng với chi phí bảo trì tăng cao, việc cải thiện hệ thống giao thông công cộng có thể tạo gánh nặng tài chính lớn cho nhà nước.
items.translation: Together with high maintenance costs, improving public transport can create a big financial burden for the state.
items.answer: The improvement of the public transport system, along with rising maintenance costs, can impose a heavy financial burden on the state.
items.alt: Upgrading public transport, along with higher maintenance costs, may place a heavy financial burden on the state.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Governments should invest for essential industries such as healthcare and education.
items.answer: Governments should invest for INVEST IN essential industries such as healthcare and education.
notes: LR Giới từ đi kèm: invest in sth.

items.cue: Good communication is an essential part for teamwork.
items.answer: Good communication is an essential part for PART OF teamwork.
notes: LR Giới từ đi kèm: part of sth.

items.cue: Cybercrime is a growing threat for citizens and businesses.
items.answer: Cybercrime is a growing threat for THREAT TO citizens and businesses.
notes: LR Giới từ đi kèm: a threat to sb.

items.cue: Many working adults have little or no time for their personal hobbies.
items.answer: ✓ Many working adults have little or no time for their personal hobbies.
notes: Đúng: working adults + little or no time for sth.

items.cue: Data centres require for a huge amount of energy.
items.answer: Data centres require for REQUIRE a huge amount of energy.
notes: LR require là ngoại động từ, không đi với for.

items.cue: Many students suffer from accommodation and food fees in big cities.
items.answer: Many students suffer from accommodation and food fees STRUGGLE WITH THE RISING COST OF ACCOMMODATION AND FOOD in big cities.
notes: LR suffer from dùng cho bệnh tật hoặc vấn đề tâm lý; với chi phí, dùng struggle with the cost of.

items.cue: Students can now study at the comfort of their home.
items.answer: Students can now study at the comfort of their home IN THE COMFORT OF THEIR OWN HOME.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: in the comfort of one's own home.

items.cue: The government should put more resources into building affordable housing.
items.answer: ✓ The government should put more resources into building affordable housing.
notes: Đúng: put resources into + V-ing.

items.cue: Online games are particularly attractive to people who have lack of awareness of the risks.
items.answer: Online games are particularly attractive to people who have lack of awareness WHO LACK AWARENESS of the risks.
notes: LR lack là động từ: lack awareness; hoặc have a lack of.

items.cue: Social media has changed the way we communicate, especially young generation.
items.answer: Social media has changed the way we communicate, especially young generation ESPECIALLY AMONG YOUNG PEOPLE.
notes: LR young generation thiếu mạo từ và giới từ; dùng especially among young people hoặc the younger generation.

items.cue: Many children struggle reading and writing because of poor teaching.
items.answer: Many children struggle reading STRUGGLE WITH READING and writing because of poor teaching.
notes: LR struggle with + V-ing, hoặc struggle to read.

items.cue: The quality of education is decreasing, which leaves many children unable reading.
items.answer: The quality of education is decreasing, which leaves many children unable reading UNABLE TO READ.
notes: GRA leave sb unable to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: The improvement of public transport, along with higher maintenance costs, places a heavy burden on the state.
items.answer: ✓ The improvement of public transport, along with higher maintenance costs, places a heavy burden on the state.
notes: Đúng: along with bổ sung thông tin; động từ hòa hợp với chủ ngữ chính The improvement.

items.cue: Tourism has grown at the expense for local communities.
items.answer: Tourism has grown at the expense for AT THE EXPENSE OF local communities.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: at the expense of.

items.cue: The excessive of digital platforms could make a extreme degradation of employment opportunities.
items.answer: The excessive of EXCESSIVE RELIANCE ON digital platforms could make a extreme degradation of CAUSE A SHARP DECLINE IN employment opportunities.
notes: LR excessive là tính từ, không làm danh từ; cần một danh từ như reliance on.
LR Kết hợp từ không tự nhiên (và sai mạo từ a extreme); dùng cause a sharp decline in.

items.cue: Smartphones have become ubiquity in everyday life.
items.answer: Smartphones have become ubiquity UBIQUITOUS in everyday life.
notes: LR Từ loại: sau become cần tính từ ubiquitous.

items.cue: A large-scale effort to develop a vaccine against the virus is under way.
items.answer: ✓ A large-scale effort to develop a vaccine against the virus is under way.
notes: Đúng: be under way = đang được tiến hành.

items.cue: Many students wish improving their English proficiency.
items.answer: Many students wish improving WISH TO IMPROVE their English proficiency.
notes: GRA wish to + V nguyên mẫu, không dùng V-ing.

items.cue: The benefits of cycling go far above saving money on fuel.
