items.answer: The benefits of cycling go far above GO FAR BEYOND saving money on fuel.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: go far beyond.

items.cue: Subsidised housing eases the financial burden on disadvantaged families.
items.answer: ✓ Subsidised housing eases the financial burden on disadvantaged families.
notes: Đúng: ease the financial burden on sb.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cụm từ được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cụm từ tự chọn trong bài. Câu viết phải liên quan trực tiếp đến đề.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the most important benefit of being wealthy is the ability to help other people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: contribute to. Bắt đầu: Wealthy people can contribute to …
items.answer: Wealthy people can contribute to their communities by funding schools and hospitals.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Countries where people work long hours are often economically successful, but long working hours can also have negative social consequences. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In some economically successful countries, many employees work around the clock and have little time for their families.

items.cue: Art and museums · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Governments should spend more money on public services than on the arts, such as music and painting. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Governments should put more resources into public services such as healthcare and transport than into the arts.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Governments should invest more money in teaching science than in teaching other subjects because science is more important for national progress. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Investment in science education can lead to the economic development of a nation by producing skilled engineers and researchers.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that everyone should become vegetarian because people do not need to eat meat to have a healthy diet. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: People who follow a balanced vegetarian diet are less likely to suffer from heart disease.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Individuals and countries cannot help everyone in the world who needs support, so they should focus only on helping people in their own communities and countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In many parts of the world, people still lack access to clean water and basic healthcare.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Good relationships between countries are becoming increasingly important for solving global problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Countries are forming closer diplomatic ties as a way to tackle global problems such as climate change.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The rapid development of communication technology, such as smartphones and other mobile devices, has more disadvantages than advantages. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Communication technology allows people to widen their social circles far beyond their local area.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should provide free public libraries in every town, while others think this is a waste of money because people can access information online. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Free public libraries ease the financial burden on low-income families who cannot afford books or home Internet access.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that economic growth is necessary to reduce poverty, while others argue that economic growth should be limited because it damages the environment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: In some countries, rapid economic growth has come at the expense of the natural environment.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that rich countries should give aid to all poorer countries, while others think that aid should not be given to countries where corruption is common. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Corruption can leave aid unable to reach the people who need it most.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that job satisfaction is more important than job security, while others think having a secure, permanent job is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: For many workers, a sense of job security is more important than enjoying their work.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people prefer to use gyms and health clubs to stay healthy, while others think everyday activities such as walking and climbing stairs are more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Many working adults have little or no time to visit a gym, so everyday activities such as walking are more realistic.

items.cue: Food and health · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Experts say that older people are healthier and happier when they exercise regularly and spend time with other people. However, many elderly people experience loneliness and poor physical health. What are the causes of these problems, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.answer: Many elderly people suffer from loneliness because members of their immediate circle rarely visit them.

items.cue: Media and communication · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many young people know a great deal about international pop and film stars but know little about important people from their own country's history. Why is this the case, and what can be done to encourage young people to learn more about historical figures?
items.hint: Tự chọn hai cụm từ trong bài và dùng trong hai câu.
items.answer: Pop and film stars have become ubiquitous on social media, while historical figures rarely appear there. Schools could raise awareness of national heroes through educational initiatives such as museum visits.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Many people throw away old products in order to buy the latest fashions and technology. Do the disadvantages of this 'throwaway society' outweigh the advantages?
items.hint: Tự chọn hai cụm từ trong bài và dùng trong hai câu.
items.answer: Replacing products before they wear out puts pressure on natural resources. This comes at the expense of the environment, as discarded devices often end up in landfill.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that all young adults should spend a period of time doing unpaid work in their local community. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Tự chọn hai cụm từ trong bài và dùng trong hai câu.
items.answer: Unpaid community work can help young adults develop a sense of responsibility. However, it may leave those from low-income families unable to earn the money they need.

items.cue: Education · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Sending children to boarding schools, either in their own country or abroad, is becoming increasingly popular. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn hai cụm từ trong bài và dùng trong hai câu.
items.answer: Boarding schools are becoming more popular because many working parents are inundated with work commitments. Such schools may help children thrive in a structured environment.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Many people want to buy well-known brands of clothes, cars and other consumer goods. Why is this the case, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn hai cụm từ trong bài và dùng trong hai câu.
items.answer: Advertisers have made luxury brands ubiquitous on social media. Many young people therefore seek to display their status through what they wear.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Two-part question
items.prompt: More and more young people from wealthy countries do unpaid work in poorer countries, for example by teaching or helping to build houses. Why do they do this, and who benefits more: the local communities or the young volunteers?
items.hint: Tự chọn hai cụm từ trong bài và dùng trong hai câu.
items.answer: Many young people volunteer abroad as a way to gain experience and widen their social circles. However, local communities may benefit less, as short-term volunteers often lack the skills required.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn cụm từ đúng (nhóm 2)
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng trong mỗi câu.

items.cue: Providing decent healthcare for the public ( requires / requires for ) considerable effort.
items.answer: requires
items.note: require + tân ngữ trực tiếp.

items.cue: Many young people these days suffer ( from / with ) stress and anxiety.
items.answer: from
items.note: suffer from + vấn đề sức khỏe / tâm lý.

items.cue: The team suffered ( a heavy defeat / from a heavy defeat ) in the final.
items.answer: a heavy defeat
items.note: Cụm cố định: suffer a defeat (không có from).

items.cue: Many working adults are ( inundated with / inundated for ) work commitments.
items.answer: inundated with
items.note: be inundated with sth = ngập trong.

items.cue: The Internet allows us to ( open / widen ) our social circles.
items.answer: widen
items.note: Kết hợp từ: widen one's social circles.

items.cue: The Internet has had a profound impact ( to / on ) the way we live.
items.answer: on
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: have a profound impact on sth.

items.cue: Students can now complete their studies ( in the comfort of / at the comfort of ) their own home.
items.answer: in the comfort of
items.note: Cụm cố định: in the comfort of one's own home.

items.cue: There is often more effort involved in searching for information in a library ( than / than on ) a website.
items.answer: than on
items.note: Hai vế so sánh phải song song: in a library … than on a website.

items.cue: The benefits of gaming could ( go far above / go far beyond ) finding a sense of enjoyment.
items.answer: go far beyond
items.note: Cụm cố định: go far beyond.

items.cue: A major railway project aimed at reducing congestion is currently ( under way / on the way ).
items.answer: under way
items.note: be under way = đang được triển khai; on the way = đang trên đường đến.

items.cue: Smartphones have become ( ubiquity / ubiquitous ) in modern life.
items.answer: ubiquitous
items.note: Sau become cần tính từ.

items.cue: Subsidised housing eases the financial burden ( on / for ) disadvantaged families.
items.answer: on
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: ease the burden on sb.

items.cue: Parents ( wish / wish to ) ensure the safety of their children.
items.answer: wish to
items.note: wish to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Only ( high-performed / high-performing ) students can secure places at top universities.
items.answer: high-performing
items.note: Tính từ ghép chủ động: high-performing students.

items.cue: Many businesses suffered ( heavy financial losses / from heavy financial losses ) during the pandemic.
items.answer: heavy financial losses
items.note: Với tổn thất: suffer losses, không có from.

items.cue: For many, there is no clear ( border / boundary ) between work and private life.
items.answer: boundary
items.note: boundary = ranh giới (trừu tượng); border = biên giới.

items.cue: Students should not be assessed solely ( based on / based in ) their academic performance.
items.answer: based on
items.note: based on = dựa trên.

items.cue: Many multinational companies ( based in / based on ) Vietnam export most of their products.
items.answer: based in
items.note: based in + nơi chốn = có trụ sở tại.

items.cue: The improvement of public transport, ( along / along with ) higher maintenance costs, places a heavy burden on the state.
items.answer: along with
items.note: Cụm đầy đủ: along with.

items.cue: With every major industrial project ( come / comes ) the responsibility to minimise environmental impact.
items.answer: comes
items.note: Đảo ngữ: động từ hòa hợp với chủ ngữ đứng sau (the responsibility).

exercises.title: Bài tập 6 — Nâng cấp câu đơn giản
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cụm từ được gợi ý. Giữ nguyên nghĩa của câu gốc.

items.cue: The government should try to reduce youth unemployment.
items.answer: The government should put more resources into reducing youth unemployment.
items.alt: Governments should put more resources into tackling youth unemployment.

items.cue: Many elderly people find it difficult to use smartphones.
items.answer: Many elderly people struggle to use smartphones.
items.alt: Many older people struggle to get used to smartphones.

items.cue: There are many health problems related to fast food.
items.answer: There are many health problems associated with fast food.
items.alt: A number of health problems are associated with eating fast food.

items.cue: Many countries face environmental problems such as air pollution and flooding.
items.answer: Many countries face environmental problems, including air pollution and flooding.
items.alt: Many countries are dealing with environmental problems, including air pollution and flooding.

items.cue: Many students have stress before exams.
items.answer: Many students suffer from stress before exams.
items.alt: Students often suffer from stress and anxiety before exams.

items.cue: Parents want their children to be safe.
items.answer: Parents wish to ensure the safety of their children.
items.alt: Parents wish to keep their children safe.

items.cue: Many people now buy things at home on the Internet.
items.hint: in the comfort of their own home
items.answer: Many people now shop online in the comfort of their own home.
items.alt: Many consumers now buy goods online in the comfort of their own home.

items.cue: The quality of education is falling, so many children cannot read well.
items.answer: The falling quality of education leaves many children unable to read well.
items.alt: Declining standards of education are leaving many children unable to read properly.

items.cue: Air pollution affects the health of city residents.
items.answer: Air pollution is putting the health of city residents at risk.
items.alt: High levels of air pollution put city residents' health at risk.

items.cue: Arts subjects help children feel attached to their country.
items.answer: Arts subjects can contribute to a sense of attachment to the country among children.
items.alt: The study of arts subjects can foster a sense of national attachment in children.

items.cue: Many working adults are very busy and do not have time for hobbies.
items.answer: Many working adults have little or no time for their hobbies.
items.alt: Many working adults are inundated with work commitments and have little time for personal pastimes.

items.cue: The Internet has changed the way we live.
items.answer: The advent of the Internet has revolutionised the way we live.
items.alt: The Internet has had a profound impact on the way we live.

items.cue: Lower bus fares make travel cheaper for city residents.
items.answer: Lower bus fares ease the financial burden on city residents who rely on public transport.
items.alt: Cheaper bus fares ease the financial burden on urban commuters.

items.cue: The government is building a new metro line now.
items.answer: Construction of a new metro line is currently under way.
items.alt: A major metro project is under way.

items.cue: Many people play video games to relax, and games have a lot of other benefits too.
items.answer: The benefits of video games can go far beyond relaxation.
items.alt: The advantages of gaming go far beyond providing a way to relax.

items.cue: Smartphones are used everywhere, and this affects how young people communicate.
items.answer: The ubiquity of smartphones affects how young people communicate.
items.alt: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, influencing the way young people communicate.

items.cue: People who were treated badly when they were children often have health problems when they grow up.
items.answer: Those who were maltreated as children often grow up to have health problems.
items.alt: People who were mistreated as children are more likely to suffer from poor health later in life.

items.cue: Without mobile phones and the Internet, it would be hard for most of us to contact anyone except our family and close friends.
items.answer: Without mobile devices and the Internet, most of us would struggle to contact anyone outside our immediate circle.
items.alt: Without mobile phones and the Internet, many of us would struggle to stay in touch with people outside our immediate circle.

items.cue: Many people find it more difficult to search for information in a library than on a website.
items.hint: there is more effort involved in … than …
items.answer: There is more effort involved in searching for information in a library than on a website.
items.alt: Searching for information in a library involves more effort than searching online.

items.cue: Cities want to reduce pollution, so they are investing in green energy and building sustainable infrastructure.
items.answer: Cities wish to reduce pollution, so they are investing in renewable energy along with sustainable infrastructure.
items.alt: Cities wish to cut pollution and are therefore investing in clean energy, along with greener infrastructure.

theory.html: Mỗi chủ đề IELTS có một nhóm khái niệm lặp đi lặp lại trong đề: university education, older people, the gap between rich and poor, renewable energy…. Nếu có sẵn hai hoặc ba cách diễn đạt chính xác cho mỗi khái niệm, bạn sẽ paraphrase đề nhanh hơn và tránh lặp từ trong cả bài.

Các bảng dưới đây liệt kê 10 khái niệm cho mỗi chủ đề trong 12 chủ đề xuất hiện nhiều nhất trong ngân hàng đề. Các cách diễn đạt được chọn để giữ đúng phạm vi của khái niệm gốc. Những cặp chỉ gần nghĩa (ví dụ climate change và global warming) được ghi chú rõ.
Văn phong: tránh các từ khẩu ngữ, mơ hồ hoặc phóng đại như kids, lots of, things, stuff, huge, terrible. Dùng từ trung tính, mang tính học thuật nhưng tự nhiên.

cells: higher education; tertiary education; a university degree
the curriculum; areas of study (academic subjects = các môn học thuật, hẹp hơn)
vocational training; hands-on skills; job-related skills
Internet-based learning; online courses; remote study
formal examinations; tests (assessment rộng hơn: gồm cả bài tập, dự án)
state-funded education; the cost of tuition
a gap year; a break between school and university

theory.text: 2. Văn hóa – xã hội (Socio-cultural and global issues)

cells: a diverse society; communities of different ethnic backgrounds
growing global integration; the spread of international trade and culture
the convergence of lifestyles; cultural homogenisation
supporting those in need; charitable activities
cooperation between nations; joint international efforts
people who move to another country

theory.text: 3. Tuổi tác, thế hệ, giới (Age, generation and gender)

cells: the elderly; senior citizens; people over retirement age
the younger generation; people in their teens and twenties
mothers and fathers (caregivers rộng hơn: gồm cả người chăm sóc không phải cha mẹ)
delay parenthood; start a family later in life
looking after young children (nursery care hẹp hơn)
gender equality; equal opportunities for both sexes
the influence of people of the same age
household composition; the make-up of families
children's independence (gần nghĩa, nhẹ hơn freedom); autonomy

theory.text: 4. Kinh tế, tiền bạc, thương mại (Economy, money and trade)

cells: the gap between rich and poor
household products; goods for personal use
taxation; tax revenue (= số tiền nhà nước thu được)
a growing economy; growth in national output (economic development rộng hơn)
a cap on earnings; a maximum wage
a balance between work and personal life
extended working hours; working long days (overtime = làm thêm ngoài giờ hợp đồng, khác nghĩa)
the press; news outlets; journalists and broadcasters

theory.text: 7. Chính phủ, chính trị (Government, politics and diplomacy)

cells: the state; the authorities; policy makers
taxpayers' money; public funds; the state budget
state services such as healthcare and education
a country's citizens; nationals (khác the public — xem Unit 3)
single-person households; living on one's own
a disposable culture; replacing rather than repairing goods

theory.text: 9. Thực phẩm và sức khỏe (Food and health)

cells: processed food high in fat, sugar or salt
excessive food consumption (overeating); severe overweight (obesity) — hai khái niệm khác nhau
state-funded medical care; publicly funded treatment
changes in the global climate; global warming chỉ khi nói về nhiệt độ tăng
waste recycling; reprocessing used materials (reusing = tái sử dụng, khác nghĩa)
renewable sources such as wind and solar power (clean energy rộng hơn: gồm cả hạt nhân)
environmental degradation; harm to the environment

theory.text: 11. Khoa học, công nghệ (Science, technology and innovation)

cells: the use of machines and robots; automated systems
going online; using online services (giữ nguyên the Internet)
scientific studies; research (R&D rộng hơn: gồm cả phát triển sản phẩm)
digital services; carrying out tasks online

theory.text: 12. Tội phạm và pháp luật (Crime, punishment and law)

cells: break the law; engage in criminal activity
unpaid work in the community (non-custodial sentences rộng hơn: gồm cả phạt tiền, án treo)

items: university education → Access to tertiary education has expanded rapidly.
older people → Many senior citizens live alone.
the gap between rich and poor → Income inequality is widening in many countries.
renewable energy → Governments should invest in wind and solar power.
criminals → Young offenders need education and training.
the news media → The press has a strong influence on public opinion.

items.bad: Climate change threatens crops. → Global warming threatens crops. TR
items.good: Changes in the global climate threaten crops.
items.note: global warming chỉ là một phần của climate change (nhiệt độ tăng). Dùng thay thế sẽ thu hẹp phạm vi.

items.bad: The city attracts millions of tourisms every year. LR
items.good: The city attracts millions of tourists every year.
items.note: tourism (ngành du lịch, không đếm được) ≠ tourists (khách du lịch).

items.bad: Mass migrating to cities puts pressure on housing. LR
items.good: Mass migration to cities puts pressure on housing.
items.note: Chủ ngữ cần một danh từ: migration.

items.bad: Rich countries should help third-world countries. LR
items.good: Rich countries should help developing countries.
items.note: third-world là cách nói cũ và có thể gây phản cảm; dùng developing countries hoặc low-income countries.

items.bad: Factories produce a high rate of wastes. LR
items.good: Factories produce large amounts of waste.
items.note: waste (rác thải) không đếm được; rate dùng cho tỉ lệ, không dùng cho số lượng.

items.bad: Many countries have a heavily dependence on fossil fuels. LR
items.good: Many countries have a heavy dependence on fossil fuels.
items.note: Danh từ dependence cần tính từ heavy, không dùng trạng từ heavily.

items.html: economic = thuộc về kinh tế (economic growth); economical = tiết kiệm (an economical car).
Cả hai đều đúng. the elderly đi với động từ số nhiều (the elderly are …) và không thêm s (the elderlies là sai).
crime = hành vi phạm tội nói chung; criminals / offenders = người phạm tội. Viết crime rates (tỉ lệ tội phạm), không viết criminal rates.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Chọn cách diễn đạt chính xác
intro: Chọn phương án diễn đạt đúng nghĩa và đúng phạm vi nhất cho phần in đậm.

items.cue: University education should be free.
items.note: tertiary education = giáo dục đại học/cao đẳng; secondary là bậc phổ thông.

items.cue: Many school-leavers take a gap year.

options.text: those who have just finished secondary school

items.note: school-leavers là người vừa học xong phổ thông; dropouts là người bỏ học giữa chừng.

items.cue: Multicultural societies bring many benefits.

options.text: societies made up of people from different ethnic backgrounds

items.note: Đúng định nghĩa: nhiều nhóm dân tộc cùng chung sống.

items.cue: Many traditions are disappearing.
items.note: traditions = phong tục lâu đời.

items.cue: The elderly are often lonely.
items.note: senior citizens đồng nghĩa; retired workers only hẹp hơn vì không phải người cao tuổi nào cũng từng đi làm.

items.cue: Many couples have children later.
items.note: delay parenthood = trì hoãn việc làm cha mẹ; fewer nói về số lượng, không phải thời điểm.

items.cue: The gap between rich and poor is widening.
items.note: poverty chỉ nói về người nghèo, không nói về khoảng cách giữa hai nhóm.

items.cue: Multinational companies operate worldwide.
items.note: global corporations đồng nghĩa với multinationals.

items.cue: Many people value job security.
items.note: job security = sự ổn định việc làm, không phải an toàn lao động.

items.cue: Working from home is increasing.
items.note: remote working = làm việc từ xa; hai phương án còn lại là khái niệm khác.

items.cue: The news media influence public opinion.
items.note: the news media gồm báo chí và đài phát thanh, truyền hình.

items.cue: Much of the information online is inaccurate.
items.note: inaccurate = không chính xác; outdated = lỗi thời, khác nghĩa.

items.cue: Public money should be spent on healthcare.
items.note: public money là tiền thuế của người dân.

items.cue: Rich countries give international aid.
items.note: foreign aid = viện trợ nước ngoài.

items.cue: More people live alone.
items.note: unmarried không đồng nghĩa với sống một mình.

items.cue: Consumer goods are becoming cheaper.
items.note: consumer goods gồm mọi hàng hóa tiêu dùng, không chỉ hàng xa xỉ.

items.cue: Junk food is popular among teenagers.

options.text: processed food high in fat, sugar or salt

items.note: Đúng bản chất của junk food.

items.cue: Some people support free healthcare.
items.note: free healthcare = chăm sóc y tế do nhà nước chi trả.

items.cue: Renewable energy is growing.

options.text: renewable sources such as wind and solar power

items.note: Năng lượng hạt nhân không phải năng lượng tái tạo.

items.cue: Climate change threatens crops.
items.note: air pollution và deforestation là các vấn đề khác.

items.cue: More and more work is automated.
items.note: automated = được máy móc thực hiện.

items.cue: Space exploration is expensive.
items.note: space exploration = nghiên cứu và các sứ mệnh vào không gian.

items.cue: Young offenders need education.
items.note: offenders là người phạm tội, không phải nạn nhân.

items.cue: Prison is the most common punishment.
items.note: fines và community service là các hình phạt khác.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Giáo dục đại học nên được miễn phí cho sinh viên từ các gia đình thu nhập thấp.
items.rewriteWith: tertiary education (từ khóa: free of charge, low-income families)
items.translation: University education should be free for students from low-income families.
items.answer: Tertiary education should be free of charge for students from low-income families.
items.alt: Higher education should be provided free to students from low-income backgrounds.

items.cue: Nhiều học sinh vừa học xong phổ thông chọn học nghề thay vì vào đại học.
items.translation: Many students who have just finished high school choose vocational training instead of university.
items.answer: Many school-leavers opt for vocational training rather than university.
items.alt: A growing number of secondary school graduates choose vocational courses over a university degree.

items.cue: Nhiều phong tục truyền thống đang dần biến mất ở các thành phố lớn.
items.translation: Many traditional customs are gradually disappearing in big cities.
items.answer: Many long-standing customs are gradually dying out in major cities.
items.alt: Traditional practices are slowly disappearing in large cities.

items.cue: Một xã hội đa văn hóa có thể giúp người dân cởi mở hơn với sự khác biệt.
items.rewriteWith: a diverse society (từ khóa: open to cultural differences)
items.translation: A multicultural society can help people become more open to differences.
items.answer: A diverse society can make people more open to cultural differences.
items.alt: Living in a multicultural community can make people more accepting of difference.

items.cue: Nhiều người cao tuổi sống một mình mà không có sự hỗ trợ của gia đình.
items.translation: Many old people live alone without support from their families.
items.answer: Many senior citizens live alone without family support.
items.alt: A large number of elderly people live on their own with little help from their families.

items.cue: Ngày càng nhiều cặp vợ chồng trì hoãn việc sinh con.
items.translation: More and more couples are delaying having children.
items.answer: A growing number of couples are delaying parenthood.
items.alt: More couples are choosing to start a family later in life.

items.cue: Khoảng cách giàu nghèo đang ngày càng lớn ở nhiều quốc gia.
items.translation: The gap between rich and poor is getting bigger in many countries.
items.answer: Income inequality is widening in many countries.
items.alt: The wealth gap is growing in many parts of the world.

items.cue: Các tập đoàn đa quốc gia tạo ra nhiều việc làm ở các nước đang phát triển.
items.translation: Multinational companies create many jobs in developing countries.
items.answer: Multinationals create a large number of jobs in developing nations.
items.alt: Global corporations generate considerable employment in low-income countries.

items.cue: Đối với nhiều người, sự ổn định trong công việc quan trọng hơn mức lương cao.
items.translation: For many people, a stable job is more important than a high salary.
items.answer: For many, job security matters more than high pay.
items.alt: Many workers value a permanent position more than a high salary.

items.cue: Làm việc từ xa giúp nhân viên tiết kiệm thời gian đi lại.
items.translation: Working from home helps employees save travel time.
items.answer: Remote working saves employees commuting time.
items.alt: Working remotely allows staff to cut their commuting time.

items.cue: Báo chí có ảnh hưởng lớn đến dư luận.
items.translation: Newspapers have a big influence on public opinion.
items.answer: The press has a strong influence on public opinion.
items.alt: News outlets shape public opinion to a considerable extent.

items.cue: Thông tin sai lệch lan truyền nhanh chóng trên các nền tảng trực tuyến.
items.translation: False information spreads quickly on online platforms.
items.answer: Misinformation spreads rapidly on online platforms.
items.alt: Inaccurate information circulates quickly on social networking sites.

items.cue: Tiền thuế của người dân nên được ưu tiên dành cho y tế và giáo dục.
items.translation: People's tax money should be prioritised for healthcare and education.
items.answer: Taxpayers' money should be spent primarily on healthcare and education.
items.alt: Public funds should go first to healthcare and education.

items.cue: Viện trợ nước ngoài không phải lúc nào cũng đến được với những người cần nó nhất.
items.translation: Aid from other countries does not always reach the people who need it most.
items.answer: Foreign aid does not always reach those most in need.
items.alt: International aid often fails to reach the people who need it most.

items.cue: Số hộ gia đình chỉ có một người đang tăng nhanh.
items.translation: The number of families with only one person is increasing quickly.
items.answer: The number of single-person households is rising rapidly.
items.alt: Single-person households are becoming increasingly common.

items.cue: Lối sống tiêu dùng khiến nhiều người mua những thứ họ không thực sự cần.
items.translation: A consumer lifestyle makes many people buy things they do not really need.
items.answer: Consumerism leads many people to buy goods they do not genuinely need.
items.alt: A culture of consumerism encourages people to purchase items they do not need.

items.cue: Đồ ăn chế biến sẵn thường chứa nhiều đường, muối và chất béo.
items.translation: Ready-made food often contains a lot of sugar, salt and fat.
items.answer: Processed food is often high in sugar, salt and fat.
items.alt: Many processed foods contain high levels of sugar, salt and fat.

items.cue: Hoạt động thể chất thường xuyên giúp giảm nguy cơ mắc bệnh tim.
items.translation: Regular exercise helps reduce the risk of heart disease.
items.answer: Regular physical activity reduces the risk of heart disease.
items.alt: Taking regular exercise can lower the risk of heart disease.

items.cue: Các nguồn năng lượng tái tạo như gió và mặt trời đang trở nên rẻ hơn.
items.translation: Clean energy like wind and solar is becoming cheaper.
items.answer: Renewable sources such as wind and solar power are becoming more affordable.
items.alt: Renewable energy, including wind and solar power, is becoming cheaper.

items.cue: Nạn phá rừng đang đẩy nhiều loài động vật đến bờ vực tuyệt chủng.
items.translation: Cutting down forests is pushing many animal species close to extinction.
items.answer: Deforestation is pushing many animal species to the brink of extinction.
items.alt: The loss of forests is putting many species at risk of extinction.

items.cue: Nhiều công việc lặp đi lặp lại đang được tự động hóa.
items.translation: Many repetitive jobs are being done by machines.
items.answer: Many repetitive tasks are being automated.
items.alt: Machines are increasingly taking over repetitive jobs.

items.cue: Đầu tư vào nghiên cứu khoa học có thể mang lại lợi ích lâu dài.
items.translation: Investment in scientific research can bring long-term benefits.
items.answer: Funding scientific research can yield long-term benefits.
items.alt: Investment in scientific studies can bring long-term rewards.

items.cue: Nhiều phạm nhân tái phạm sau khi ra tù.
items.translation: Many prisoners commit crimes again after leaving prison.
items.answer: Many offenders reoffend after their release from prison.
items.alt: A large proportion of ex-prisoners return to crime after release.

items.cue: Lao động công ích có thể là hình phạt phù hợp hơn cho người phạm tội lần đầu.
items.translation: Community work may be a more suitable punishment for people who commit a crime for the first time.
items.answer: Community service may be a more appropriate punishment for first-time offenders.
items.alt: Unpaid work in the community may be a more suitable punishment for first-time offenders than prison.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Thousands of tourisms visit Ha Long Bay every year.
items.answer: Thousands of tourisms TOURISTS visit Ha Long Bay every year.
notes: LR tourism là ngành du lịch (không đếm được); người đi du lịch là tourists.

items.cue: Many childrens spend hours on social media every day.
items.answer: Many childrens CHILDREN spend hours on social media every day.
notes: LR children đã là số nhiều; không thêm s.

items.cue: Income inequality is widening in many countries.
items.answer: ✓ Income inequality is widening in many countries.
notes: Đúng: income inequality paraphrase chính xác cho the gap between rich and poor.

items.cue: Many senior citizens lives alone in big cities.
items.answer: Many senior citizens lives LIVE alone in big cities.
notes: GRA Hòa hợp chủ – vị: citizens số nhiều → live.

items.cue: The urbanities rate in Vietnam has risen sharply.
items.answer: The urbanities rate URBANISATION RATE in Vietnam has risen sharply.
notes: LR Từ loại: danh từ đúng là urbanisation.

items.cue: Factories in the area produce a high rate of wastes.
items.answer: Factories in the area produce a high rate of wastes LARGE AMOUNTS OF WASTE.
notes: LR waste không đếm được; rate chỉ tỉ lệ, không chỉ số lượng.

items.cue: The proportion of participations who supported the plan was low.
items.answer: The proportion of participations PARTICIPANTS who supported the plan was low.
notes: LR Từ loại: người tham gia là participants.

items.cue: Many school-leavers opt for vocational training rather than university.
items.answer: ✓ Many school-leavers opt for vocational training rather than university.
notes: Đúng: school-leavers và vocational training được dùng chính xác.

items.cue: Children need to learn a balance use of technology.
items.answer: Children need to learn a balance use A BALANCED USE of technology.
notes: LR Từ loại: trước danh từ cần tính từ balanced.

items.cue: Radio has lost listeners because of its less popularity among young people.
items.answer: Radio has lost listeners because of its less popularity ITS DECLINING POPULARITY among young people.
notes: LR less không bổ nghĩa cho danh từ popularity theo cách này; dùng its declining / lower popularity.

items.cue: The economical growth of Vietnam has been impressive.
items.answer: The economical ECONOMIC growth of Vietnam has been impressive.
notes: LR economic = thuộc về kinh tế; economical = tiết kiệm.

items.cue: Climate change is contributing to more frequent floods and droughts.
items.answer: ✓ Climate change is contributing to more frequent floods and droughts.
notes: Đúng: nhận định có mức độ hợp lý (contributing to) và đúng phạm vi.

items.cue: Young offenders should be offered education and training in prison.
items.answer: ✓ Young offenders should be offered education and training in prison.
notes: Đúng: young offenders paraphrase chính xác cho young criminals.

items.cue: Many people suffer from obese because of unhealthy diets.
items.answer: Many people suffer from obese OBESITY because of unhealthy diets.
notes: LR Sau suffer from cần danh từ obesity; obese là tính từ.

items.cue: AI can perform tasks with greater sophisticate than humans.
items.answer: AI can perform tasks with greater sophisticate SOPHISTICATION than humans.
notes: LR Từ loại: sau greater cần danh từ sophistication.

items.cue: Many developing nations still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
items.answer: ✓ Many developing nations still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
notes: Đúng: trạng từ heavily bổ nghĩa cho động từ depend.

items.cue: Rich countries should send more aids to the third-world countries.
items.answer: Rich countries should send more aids AID to the third-world countries DEVELOPING COUNTRIES.
notes: LR aid (viện trợ) không đếm được.
LR third-world là cách nói cũ, có thể gây phản cảm; khi nói chung thì không dùng the.

items.cue: Criminal rates have fallen in cities with better street lighting.
items.answer: Criminal rates CRIME RATES have fallen in cities with better street lighting.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: crime rates.

items.cue: Many people distrust the medias because of false reports.
items.answer: Many people distrust the medias THE MEDIA because of false reports.
notes: LR media đã là số nhiều của medium; không thêm s.

items.cue: Smoking and drinking alcohol will definitely destroy everyone's health.
items.answer: Smoking and drinking alcohol will definitely destroy everyone's health CAN SERIOUSLY DAMAGE PEOPLE'S HEALTH.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (definitely, destroy, everyone); hãy dùng mức độ phù hợp.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Paraphrase phần nhận định của mỗi đề (không phải câu hỏi) thành một câu, dùng cách diễn đạt trong các bảng khái niệm. Giữ đúng phạm vi: ai, cái gì, mức độ.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that attending university lectures is no longer necessary because information is available in other ways. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some believe that attending lectures in person is no longer essential, as learning materials are now widely available online.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that children today have too much freedom. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: children today → children nowadays; have too much freedom → are given excessive freedom
items.answer: Some believe that children nowadays are given excessive freedom.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: In some countries, a small number of people earn extremely high salaries. Some people believe that governments should place limits on how much people can earn. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: extremely high salaries → very high earnings; place limits on → cap
items.answer: Some argue that governments should cap how much people can earn.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Social skills are as important as good qualifications for success in a job. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Interpersonal skills are as important as academic credentials for success at work.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that much of the information we receive today is inaccurate. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some believe that much of the information people receive today is false or misleading.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should not provide international aid while there are disadvantaged people, such as the unemployed and homeless, in their own countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some argue that governments should not give foreign aid while many of their own citizens remain in need.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Eating meals together is an important social activity for families and communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view in relation to your own country?
items.answer: Shared meals play an important role in family and community life.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that air travel should be restricted because it causes pollution and uses large amounts of the world's fuel resources. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some people believe that flying should be limited because it pollutes the atmosphere and consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that a university education is necessary for success in life, while others think it is possible to succeed without going to university. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While some believe that a degree is essential for success in life, others argue that people can succeed without one.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that the amount of noise people make should be strictly controlled, while others think people should be free to make as much noise as they want. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While some believe that noise levels should be tightly regulated, others feel that people should be free to make as much noise as they like.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Young people today are generally richer, safer and healthier than in the past, but many are less happy. Why might this be the case, and what can be done to improve young people's happiness?
items.answer: Although the younger generation is wealthier, safer and healthier than before, many young people report lower levels of well-being.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: The gap between rich and poor people is becoming wider in many countries. What problems can this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.hint: the gap between rich and poor → income inequality
items.answer: Income inequality is widening in many countries.

items.cue: Work · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people choose temporary jobs so that they have more time for other activities. Do the advantages of temporary work outweigh the disadvantages?
items.answer: Some people choose short-term contracts so that they have more free time for other activities.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: The number of television programmes is increasing. Some people think this gives viewers more choice, while others believe it lowers the overall quality of television. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While some think the growing number of TV shows gives viewers more choice, others believe it lowers the overall quality of broadcasting.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should give the highest priority to healthcare, while others think that other areas are equally or more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While some argue that health services should be the government's top priority, others believe other areas deserve equal or greater attention.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: More and more people around the world want to own consumer goods such as cars, televisions and refrigerators. Do the disadvantages of this development outweigh the advantages?
items.answer: More and more people around the world aspire to own consumer products such as cars, televisions and refrigerators.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that schools should teach children about healthy eating, while others think this is the responsibility of parents. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While some believe that schools should teach children about nutrition, others think this is the responsibility of parents.

items.cue: Food and health · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: People are consuming more and more drinks that contain large amounts of sugar. Why is this happening, and what measures can be taken to reduce the consumption of sugary drinks?
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: The consumption of drinks high in sugar is rising steadily.

items.cue: Environment · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Fossil fuels such as coal, oil and natural gas remain the main sources of energy in many countries, while some countries are encouraging the use of renewable energy such as wind and solar power. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: While many countries still rely mainly on coal, oil and gas, others are promoting renewable sources such as wind and solar power.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that nuclear energy is the best way to meet the world's growing demand for energy. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: Some argue that nuclear power is the most effective way to meet rising global energy demand.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: When humans first landed on the Moon, it was described as a great achievement for humankind. Some people, however, believe that space exploration has little effect on our daily lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: Some believe that space exploration, despite being hailed as a major human achievement, has little impact on everyday life.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to reduce crime is to give criminals longer prison sentences, while others think that alternative methods are more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: While some argue that longer prison sentences are the best way to cut crime, others believe that alternatives to imprisonment are more effective.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some scientists believe that studying the behaviour of three-year-old children can help predict which children may become criminals later in life. To what extent is criminal behaviour influenced by human nature, and to what extent can children be prevented from becoming criminals?
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: Some scientists claim that observing the behaviour of three-year-olds could help identify children at risk of becoming offenders later in life.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Differences between countries are becoming less noticeable because people increasingly wear similar clothes and watch the same television programmes. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Tự chọn khái niệm cần paraphrase. Paraphrase toàn bộ nhận định thành một câu, giữ đúng phạm vi.
items.answer: National differences are fading as people around the world increasingly dress alike and watch the same television programmes.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Văn phong học thuật và lỗi từ vựng thường gặp
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng và phù hợp với văn phong học thuật của bài IELTS Writing.

items.cue: Many ( children / kids ) spend hours online every day.
items.answer: children
items.note: kids mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: The government should spend ( lots of / a considerable amount of ) money on healthcare.
items.answer: a considerable amount of
items.note: lots of mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Air pollution is a ( serious / huge ) problem in many cities.
items.answer: serious
items.note: huge mang tính chủ quan, phóng đại.

items.cue: Young people today buy too many ( consumer goods / things ).
items.answer: consumer goods
items.note: things quá chung chung.

items.cue: Fast food has a ( harmful / terrible ) effect on health.
items.answer: harmful
items.note: terrible mang tính khẩu ngữ và cảm tính.

items.cue: Online learning is ( way better / considerably more effective ) for working adults.
items.answer: considerably more effective
items.note: way better chỉ dùng trong văn nói.

items.cue: Many young people ( don't / do not ) read printed newspapers.
items.answer: do not
items.note: Không viết tắt trong văn viết học thuật.

items.cue: Parents should give children useful ( advice / advices ).
items.answer: advice
items.note: advice không đếm được.

items.cue: Teachers need more ( information / informations ) about students' needs.
items.answer: information
items.note: information không đếm được.

items.cue: Many companies cut ( staff / staffs ) during the recession.
items.answer: staff
items.note: staff là danh từ tập hợp, không thêm s.

items.cue: Factories should invest in new ( equipments / equipment ).
items.answer: equipment
items.note: equipment không đếm được.

picks: In my personal opinion, I think
items.cue: ( In my opinion, / In my personal opinion, I think ) the Internet has changed the way we learn.
items.answer: In my opinion,
items.note: Cụm còn lại lặp nghĩa (my, personal, I think).

items.cue: Children should spend more time playing ( outdoor / outdoors ).
items.answer: outdoors
items.note: outdoors là trạng từ; outdoor là tính từ (outdoor activities).

items.cue: Many young people cannot ( effort / afford ) to buy a home.
items.answer: afford
items.note: afford (đủ khả năng chi trả) là động từ; effort là danh từ.

items.cue: This policy could ( have / cause ) an impact on low-income families.
items.answer: have
items.note: Kết hợp từ: have an impact on, không dùng cause an impact.

items.cue: The reason why prices rose is ( because / that ) demand increased.
items.answer: that
items.note: The reason … is that …; is because là lỗi lặp nghĩa.

items.cue: Many young people ( succeed to find / succeed in finding ) work abroad.
items.answer: succeed in finding
items.note: Cấu trúc: succeed in + V-ing.

items.cue: ( To be honest, / In fact, ) few people read printed newspapers today.
items.answer: In fact,
items.note: To be honest mang tính khẩu ngữ, thể hiện cảm xúc cá nhân.

items.cue: Online shopping is popular because it is ( cheap and convenient / cheap and stuff ).
items.answer: cheap and convenient
items.note: and stuff là khẩu ngữ, mơ hồ.

items.cue: Social media can ( mess up / disrupt ) teenagers' sleep.
items.answer: disrupt
items.note: Hạn chế cụm động từ khẩu ngữ như mess up.

theory.html: Nhiều bài viết band 5.5–6.0 có gần như mọi câu bắt đầu bằng The government…, People…, It…, Children…. Ý tưởng không sai, nhưng cấu trúc lặp lại khiến bài đơn điệu và không thể hiện được độ đa dạng ngữ pháp (GRA). Cách đơn giản nhất để thay đổi là thay đổi cách mở đầu câu mà vẫn giữ câu ngắn gọn, rõ ràng.

Bảng dưới đây đưa ra mười cách mở đầu câu. Mỗi cách có một chức năng riêng: With + N + V-ing nêu bối cảnh/xu hướng, In order to nêu mục đích, It is + adj + for sb to V nêu đánh giá, Those who… thu hẹp đối tượng. Hãy chọn cách mở đầu phù hợp với ý bạn muốn nói, đừng chọn chỉ vì nó "lạ".
Mỗi đoạn văn chỉ cần hai hoặc ba cách mở đầu khác nhau. Dùng quá nhiều cấu trúc "đặc biệt" liên tiếp cũng khiến bài viết thiếu tự nhiên.

cells: It is + adj + for sb + to V
It is important for the government to create more jobs for young people.
There is a need for + sb + to V / + noun
There is a need for stricter regulations on advertising aimed at children.
With the availability of online shops, consumers often buy things they do not need.
With the job market becoming increasingly competitive, many graduates struggle to find work.
V-ing + O + V (động từ thật, không dùng should be done by)
Creating more jobs for young people should be a priority for the government.
Young people should be given more job opportunities.
As the labour market becomes more competitive, graduates need practical skills.
In order to + V, S + V
In order to combat climate change, people should recycle regularly.
For + sb, it is + adj + to V / S + V
For recent graduates, it is not easy to find a well-paid job.
Those who + V + … are more likely to …
Those who read regularly from a young age are more likely to succeed as adults.

items: It is essential for children to learn to swim, as this skill may one day save their lives.
There is a need for more green spaces in crowded cities.
With climate change becoming more serious than ever, we need to reduce our energy consumption.
Investing in public transport would help reduce traffic congestion.
As the population ages, the demand for healthcare is rising.
In order to reduce plastic waste, many cities have banned single-use bags.
For many families, paying university tuition fees is a heavy financial burden.
Those who exercise regularly are less likely to fall ill.

items.bad: With the job market becomes more competitive, many graduates struggle. GRA
items.good: With the job market becoming more competitive, many graduates struggle.
items.note: With + danh từ + V-ing; không dùng động từ chia thì sau With.

items.bad: It is important for the government create more jobs. GRA
items.good: It is important for the government to create more jobs.
items.note: Cấu trúc It is + adj + for sb to V.

items.bad: There is a need of stricter laws. LR
items.good: There is a need for stricter laws.
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: a need for sth.

items.bad: Creating more jobs should be done by the government. GRA
items.good: Creating more jobs should be a priority for the government.
items.note: Chủ ngữ V-ing cần một động từ chính thật sự; should be done by là cấu trúc bị động gượng ép.

items.bad: As the population is ageing, so the demand for healthcare is rising. GRA
items.good: As the population is ageing, the demand for healthcare is rising.
items.note: As đã nối hai mệnh đề; thêm so là dùng hai từ nối cho một quan hệ.

items.bad: Living in a big city, the cost of housing is very high. GRA
items.good: For people living in a big city, housing is very expensive.
items.note: Cụm V-ing mở đầu phải có cùng chủ ngữ với mệnh đề chính; the cost of housing không thể living in a big city (lỗi dangling).

items.h: It is + adj + for sb to V hay It is + adj + that …?
items.html: It is important for children to learn to swim nhấn mạnh hành động của một đối tượng; It is important that children learn to swim trang trọng hơn và dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không to sau that. Cả hai đều đúng; không trộn hai cấu trúc (It is important that children to learn).
With + danh từ (+ V-ing) là một cụm từ, ngắn gọn hơn; As + mệnh đề đầy đủ. With prices rising, … = As prices rise, …. Không viết With prices are rising.

In order to reduce waste, plastic bags should be banned được chấp nhận rộng rãi trong văn viết trang trọng vì người thực hiện mục đích được hiểu ngầm. Tuy nhiên, câu chủ động (the government should ban plastic bags) thường rõ ràng hơn.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại với cách mở đầu cho sẵn
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cách mở đầu được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa. Câu ● có gợi ý những từ đầu tiên; câu ●● chỉ cho biết cách mở đầu; câu ●●● có yêu cầu khó hơn.

items.cue: The government should create more jobs for young people.
items.hint: It + adj + for sb to V. Bắt đầu: It is important for …
items.answer: It is important for the government to create more employment opportunities for young people.
items.alt: It is essential for the government to create more jobs for young people.

items.cue: Schools should teach children how to manage money.
items.hint: There is a need for sb to V. Bắt đầu: There is a need for schools …
items.answer: There is a need for schools to teach children how to manage money.
items.alt: There is a need for financial education in schools.

items.cue: Many people are moving to cities, so housing is becoming more expensive.
items.hint: With + N + V-ing. Bắt đầu: With more people …
items.answer: With more people moving to cities, housing is becoming more expensive.
items.alt: With growing numbers of people moving to cities, housing costs are rising.

items.cue: We should recycle regularly to fight climate change.
items.hint: In order to. Bắt đầu: In order to combat …
items.answer: In order to combat climate change, we should get into the habit of recycling regularly.
items.alt: In order to tackle climate change, people should recycle on a regular basis.

items.cue: Young people find it hard to find work in big cities.
items.answer: Finding work in a big city is not easy for young people.
items.alt: Finding employment in big cities has never been easy for young job seekers.

items.cue: The government should give young people more job opportunities.
items.hint: Passive. Bắt đầu: Young people should be …
items.answer: Young people should be given more job opportunities by the government.
items.alt: Young people should be offered more employment opportunities.

items.cue: It is not easy for university graduates to get a high-paying job.
items.hint: For sb, it is … Bắt đầu: For university graduates, …
items.answer: For university graduates, it is not easy to get a high-paying job.
items.alt: For recent graduates, securing a well-paid job is far from easy.

items.cue: The labour market is becoming more competitive. The government should support young job seekers.
items.answer: As the labour market becomes increasingly competitive, the government should support young job seekers.
items.alt: As competition in the job market intensifies, governments should help young people find work.

items.cue: Children should learn to swim because it may save their lives.
items.hint: It is + adj + for sb to V
items.answer: It is vital for children to learn to swim, as this skill may save their lives.
items.alt: It is important for children to learn to swim, since it could one day save their lives.

items.cue: Climate change is becoming more serious, so we need to use less energy.
items.answer: With climate change becoming more serious than ever, we need to reduce our energy consumption.
items.alt: With the effects of climate change worsening, we must use less energy.

items.cue: If people exercise regularly, they are less likely to fall ill.
items.answer: Those who exercise regularly are less likely to fall ill.
items.alt: People who take regular exercise are less likely to suffer from illness.

items.cue: The government should invest in public transport to reduce congestion.
items.hint: V-ing subject + một động từ thật
items.answer: Investing in public transport would help reduce traffic congestion.
items.alt: Investing in public transport is one way for governments to ease congestion.

items.cue: Some people believe that university education should be free.
items.answer: It is sometimes argued that university education should be free.
items.alt: It is argued by some that higher education should be free of charge.

items.cue: Online shops are now everywhere, so consumers often buy things they do not need.
items.answer: With the availability of online shops, consumers are often tempted to buy things they do not need.
items.alt: With online shopping so widely available, consumers often buy items they do not genuinely need.

items.cue: Many young people cannot find jobs, so the government should create more opportunities.
items.hint: As + clause + It is + adj + for sb to V (một câu)
items.answer: As many young people struggle to find work, it is essential for the government to create more employment opportunities.
items.alt: As youth unemployment remains high, it is important for the government to create more jobs.

items.cue: People should learn to cook at home because it saves money and is healthier.
items.answer: Learning to cook at home should be encouraged, as it saves money and improves people's diets.
items.alt: Cooking at home should be a skill that everyone learns, since it is cheaper and healthier.

items.cue: The government wants to reduce plastic waste, so it should ban plastic bags.
items.hint: In order to + câu bị động
items.answer: In order to reduce plastic waste, single-use plastic bags should be banned.
items.alt: In order to cut plastic waste, the government should ban single-use bags.

items.cue: Older people should be able to keep working if they want.
items.hint: There is a need for + noun phrase
items.answer: There is a need for more flexible retirement policies that allow older people to keep working.
items.alt: There is a need for policies that let older people continue working if they wish.

items.cue: Housing prices are already falling. Families now have more choice.
items.answer: With housing prices already falling, families looking for accommodation have more options than ever.
items.alt: With house prices falling, families now have a wider choice of homes.

items.cue: People who read regularly when they are young are more successful later.
items.hint: Those who … from a young age … as adults
items.answer: Those who get into the habit of reading from a young age are more likely to be successful as adults.
items.alt: People who read regularly from childhood are more likely to succeed later in life.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Chính phủ cần tạo thêm cơ hội việc làm cho người trẻ.
items.translation: The government needs to create more job opportunities for young people.
items.answer: It is important for the government to create more employment opportunities for young people.
items.alt: It is essential for governments to create more jobs for young people.

items.cue: Cần phải có thêm nhiều trường học ở vùng nông thôn.
items.rewriteWith: There is a need for + noun (từ khóa: rural areas)
items.translation: More schools are needed in rural areas.
items.answer: There is a need for more schools in rural areas.
items.alt: There is a need to build more schools in rural areas.

items.cue: Khi giá nhà ngày càng tăng, nhiều người trẻ phải sống cùng bố mẹ.
items.translation: As house prices keep rising, many young people have to live with their parents.
items.answer: With house prices rising, many young people have to live with their parents.
items.alt: With housing costs rising steadily, many young adults have to stay in the family home.

items.cue: Để giảm ùn tắc giao thông, chính phủ nên đầu tư vào giao thông công cộng.
items.translation: To reduce traffic jams, the government should invest in public transport.
items.answer: In order to reduce traffic congestion, the government should invest in public transport.
items.alt: In order to ease congestion, governments should put more resources into public transport.

items.cue: Học một ngoại ngữ khi đã lớn tuổi không hề dễ dàng.
items.translation: It is not easy to learn a foreign language when you are older.
items.answer: Learning a foreign language later in life is not easy.
items.alt: Learning a new language as an adult is far from easy.

items.cue: Trẻ em nên được dạy tính tự lập từ nhỏ.
items.rewriteWith: Passive (từ khóa: be taught, independent, from a young age)
items.translation: Children should learn to be independent from childhood.
items.answer: Children should be taught to be independent from a young age.
items.alt: From a young age, children should be taught to be independent.

items.cue: Đối với sinh viên mới ra trường, tìm được một công việc lương cao là không dễ.
items.rewriteWith: For sb, it is … (từ khóa: recent graduates, well-paid)
items.translation: For new graduates, finding a well-paid job is not easy.
items.answer: For recent graduates, it is not easy to find a well-paid job.
items.alt: It has never been easy for recent graduates to find well-paid work.

items.cue: Vì thị trường lao động ngày càng cạnh tranh, người trẻ cần phát triển kỹ năng mềm.
items.translation: Because the labour market is more and more competitive, young people need to develop soft skills.
items.answer: As the labour market becomes increasingly competitive, young people need to develop soft skills.
items.alt: As competition for jobs grows, young people need to develop interpersonal skills.

items.cue: Việc trẻ em học bơi là vô cùng cần thiết.
items.rewriteWith: It is + adj + for sb to V
items.translation: Learning to swim is extremely important for children.
items.answer: It is essential for children to learn to swim.
items.alt: It is vital for children to learn how to swim.

items.cue: Cần có những quy định chặt chẽ hơn về quảng cáo nhắm vào trẻ em.
items.translation: Stricter rules are needed for advertising targeted at children.
items.answer: There is a need for stricter regulations on advertising aimed at children.
items.alt: Tighter rules on advertising aimed at children are needed.

items.cue: Những người đọc sách thường xuyên có xu hướng có vốn từ phong phú hơn.
items.translation: People who read books often usually have a richer vocabulary.
items.answer: Those who read regularly tend to have a wider vocabulary.
items.alt: People who read on a regular basis usually have a broader vocabulary.

items.cue: Tập thể dục thường xuyên giúp giảm căng thẳng.
items.translation: Doing exercise regularly helps reduce stress.
items.answer: Exercising regularly helps reduce stress.
items.alt: Taking regular exercise can help to relieve stress.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng điện thoại nên bị cấm trong trường học.
items.translation: Some people think phones should be banned in schools.
items.answer: It is sometimes argued that mobile phones should be banned in schools.
items.alt: It is argued by some that mobile phones should not be allowed in schools.

items.cue: Với sự phổ biến của mạng xã hội, tin tức lan truyền nhanh hơn bao giờ hết.
items.translation: Because social media is popular, news spreads faster than ever.
items.answer: With the popularity of social media, news spreads faster than ever.
items.alt: With the rise of social media, news now travels faster than ever before.

items.cue: Khi ngày càng nhiều người dùng ô tô cá nhân, chính phủ cần hành động để giảm ô nhiễm không khí.
items.rewriteWith: With + N + V-ing + There is a need for
items.translation: As more and more people use private cars, the government needs to act to reduce air pollution.
items.answer: With more and more people driving private cars, there is a need for government action to reduce air pollution.
items.alt: With car ownership rising, there is a need for government action to cut air pollution.

items.cue: Để bảo vệ môi trường, mỗi người nên sống theo cách thân thiện hơn với thiên nhiên.
items.rewriteWith: In order to + in a way that (xem Unit 8)
items.translation: To protect the environment, everyone should live in a more nature-friendly way.
items.answer: In order to protect the environment, people should live in a way that is kinder to nature.
items.alt: In order to protect the environment, individuals should adopt a more environmentally friendly lifestyle.

items.cue: Việc tạo thêm việc làm cho người trẻ nên là ưu tiên của chính phủ.
items.rewriteWith: V-ing subject + một động từ thật (không dùng should be done by)
items.translation: Creating more jobs for young people should be the government's priority.
items.answer: Creating more jobs for young people should be a priority for the government.
items.alt: Job creation for young people should be high on the government's agenda.

items.cue: Đối với nhiều gia đình, việc chi trả học phí đại học là một gánh nặng lớn.
items.translation: For many families, paying university fees is a big burden.
items.answer: For many families, paying university tuition fees is a heavy financial burden.
items.alt: For many households, university tuition fees represent a heavy financial burden.

items.cue: Vì ngân sách có hạn, chính phủ nên ưu tiên y tế và giáo dục.
items.translation: Because the budget is limited, the government should prioritise healthcare and education.
items.answer: As public funds are limited, the government should prioritise healthcare and education.
items.alt: With limited public funds, governments should give priority to healthcare and education.

items.cue: Người trẻ nên được khuyến khích tham gia các hoạt động tình nguyện.
items.translation: Young people should be encouraged to join volunteer activities.
items.answer: Young people should be encouraged to take part in voluntary work.
items.alt: Young people should be encouraged to do voluntary work in their communities.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: With the job market becomes more competitive, many graduates struggle to find work.
items.answer: With the job market becomes BECOMING more competitive, many graduates struggle to find work.
notes: GRA With + danh từ + V-ing; không dùng động từ chia thì.

items.cue: It is important for the government create more jobs for young people.
items.answer: It is important for the government create TO CREATE more jobs for young people.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đúng: It is + adj + for sb to V.

items.cue: There is a need of stricter laws on drink-driving.
items.answer: There is a need of NEED FOR stricter laws on drink-driving.
notes: LR Giới từ đi kèm: a need for sth.

items.cue: Finding affordable housing in big cities has never been easy for young people.
items.answer: ✓ Finding affordable housing in big cities has never been easy for young people.
notes: Đúng: chủ ngữ V-ing + động từ số ít has.

items.cue: In order to reduce traffic, so the city built new metro lines.
items.answer: In order to reduce traffic, so the city, THE CITY built new metro lines.
notes: GRA In order to đã nêu mục đích; không thêm so.

items.cue: Creating more jobs for young people should be done by the government.
items.answer: Creating more jobs for young people should be done by the government SHOULD BE A PRIORITY FOR THE GOVERNMENT.
notes: GRA Câu không sai ngữ pháp nhưng bị động gượng ép, làm câu kém tự nhiên; với chủ ngữ V-ing, nên dùng một động từ chính tự nhiên (should be a priority for).

items.cue: For many students, it is difficult finding part-time work.
items.answer: For many students, it is difficult finding TO FIND part-time work.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đúng: it is + adj + to V.

items.cue: As the population is ageing, so the demand for healthcare is rising.
items.answer: As the population is ageing, so the demand, THE DEMAND for healthcare is rising.
notes: GRA As đã nối hai mệnh đề; bỏ so.

items.cue: There is a need for more green spaces in crowded cities.
items.answer: ✓ There is a need for more green spaces in crowded cities.
notes: Đúng: There is a need for + danh từ.

items.cue: Those who exercises regularly are less likely to suffer from depression.
items.answer: Those who exercises EXERCISE regularly are less likely to suffer from depression.
notes: GRA Hòa hợp chủ – vị: Those số nhiều → exercise.

items.cue: Living in a big city, the cost of housing is very high.
items.answer: Living in a big city, the cost of housing is very high. FOR PEOPLE LIVING IN A BIG CITY, HOUSING IS VERY EXPENSIVE.
notes: GRA Lỗi dangling: the cost of housing không thể là chủ thể của living.

items.cue: It is sometimes argue that schools should ban mobile phones.
items.answer: It is sometimes argue ARGUED that schools should ban mobile phones.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc bị động tường thuật: It is argued that ….

items.cue: With the availability of online shops, consumers are often tempted to buy things they do not need.
items.answer: ✓ With the availability of online shops, consumers are often tempted to buy things they do not need.
notes: Đúng: With + cụm danh từ, dấu phẩy, mệnh đề chính.

items.cue: Young people should be given more job opportunities from the government.
items.answer: Young people should be given more job opportunities from the government BY THE GOVERNMENT.
notes: GRA Trong câu bị động, người thực hiện hành động đi với by.

items.cue: It is essential for children learning how to manage money.
items.answer: It is essential for children learning TO LEARN how to manage money.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đúng: It is + adj + for sb to V.

items.cue: There is a tendency of young people to delay marriage.
items.answer: There is a tendency of TENDENCY FOR young people to delay marriage.
notes: LR Giới từ đi kèm: a tendency for sb to V.

items.cue: As competition for university places intensifies, many students take private lessons.
items.answer: ✓ As competition for university places intensifies, many students take private lessons.
notes: Đúng: As + mệnh đề, dấu phẩy, mệnh đề chính.

items.cue: Being a member of a sports team, it helps children learn to cooperate.
items.answer: Being a member of a sports team, it helps BEING PART OF A SPORTS TEAM HELPS children learn to cooperate.
notes: GRA Chủ ngữ V-ing đã đủ; thêm it làm câu sai cấu trúc.

items.cue: In order to cut emissions, many cities are investing in electric buses.
items.answer: ✓ In order to cut emissions, many cities are investing in electric buses.
notes: Đúng: In order to + V, mệnh đề chính có cùng chủ thể (many cities).

items.cue: With climate change is becoming more serious, governments must act faster, they cannot wait any longer.
items.answer: With climate change is becoming BECOMING more serious, governments must act faster, they cannot wait any longer. ; THEY CANNOT WAIT ANY LONGER.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đúng: With + danh từ + V-ing.
GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy: hai mệnh đề chính cần dấu chấm phẩy hoặc dấu chấm.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) mở đầu bằng cách được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cách mở đầu khác nhau. Câu viết phải liên quan trực tiếp đến đề.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that reading stories from books is better for children than watching television or playing computer games. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Reading stories from books can develop children's imagination more than watching television.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Choosing a career is the most important decision that young people have to make. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: It is + adj + for sb to V. Bắt đầu: It is essential for young people …
items.answer: It is essential for young people to choose a career that matches their interests and abilities.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that celebrities should accept media attention to their private lives as part of being famous. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: For + sb, … Bắt đầu: For many celebrities, …
items.answer: For many celebrities, constant media attention to their private lives causes considerable stress.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People who move to another country should adopt the culture of their new country rather than live as a separate minority group. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: There is a need for + noun
items.answer: There is a need for language classes that help immigrants integrate into their new communities.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Caring for children is an important responsibility. Some people believe that all parents should be required to take childcare training courses. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In order to care for their children safely, all new parents should learn basic first aid.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should reduce environmental pollution and improve housing conditions in order to prevent illness and disease. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: With more people living in overcrowded housing, infectious diseases spread more easily.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that allowing police officers to carry guns can lead to higher levels of violence. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In some countries, police officers are trained to use guns only as a last resort.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Government funding for postgraduate research is limited. Some people believe that this money should be spent only on scientific research rather than on other subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: As research funding is limited, governments need to decide which subjects offer the greatest benefit to society.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
