items.prompt: Some people believe that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others think it is more important to reward students who make the greatest improvement. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: It is + adj + for sb to V
items.answer: It is important for schools to reward students who make the greatest improvement, as this motivates weaker learners.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that companies should give the greatest importance to their employees, while others think customers should come first. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Those who feel valued at work are more likely to provide excellent customer service.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that celebrities can draw attention to important problems by supporting international aid organisations, while others think that celebrity involvement makes these problems seem less serious. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: With their huge social media following, celebrities can draw attention to humanitarian crises very quickly.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that children should obey rules and do what their parents and teachers tell them, while others think that children who are controlled too much may be unable to deal with problems independently. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Making decisions independently helps children learn how to deal with problems on their own.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that the main benefit of international cooperation is protecting the environment, while others think its main benefit is promoting global business. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: For developing countries, international cooperation can bring both environmental protection and new trade opportunities.

items.cue: Education · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many countries, not enough university students choose to study science subjects. What are the causes of this problem, and what effects does it have on society?
items.answer: As science courses are often seen as demanding, many students choose subjects they find easier.

items.cue: Food and health · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Recent research suggests that overeating has become a bigger global problem than hunger. What are the causes of overeating, and what can be done to address this problem?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu mở đầu bằng một cách khác nhau trong bảng.
items.answer: With processed food becoming cheaper and more available, many people eat far more than they need. In order to address this, governments could tax foods high in sugar and fat.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Many goods are transported over long distances before they reach consumers. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu mở đầu bằng một cách khác nhau trong bảng.
items.answer: Transporting goods over long distances gives consumers access to a wider range of products. However, it is important for governments to consider the environmental cost of these journeys.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that international student exchange programmes would benefit all school students. Do the advantages of these programmes outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu mở đầu bằng một cách khác nhau trong bảng.
items.answer: Taking part in an exchange programme can broaden students' understanding of other cultures. For students from low-income families, however, the cost may be a serious barrier.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Family structures and the roles of family members have changed in recent years. Why has this happened, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu mở đầu bằng một cách khác nhau trong bảng.
items.answer: With both parents now working in many families, household roles are shared more equally. For children, this means growing up with both parents sharing responsibility, which I consider a positive development.

items.cue: Work · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some countries have introduced laws that limit the number of hours employees can work. Why have these laws been introduced, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu mở đầu bằng một cách khác nhau trong bảng.
items.answer: As long working hours can damage employees' health, some governments have limited them by law. There is a need for such laws in countries where overwork is common.

items.cue: Education · Two-part question
items.prompt: Education is considered essential for both individual development and the wellbeing of society. What should be the main aims and content of education?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu mở đầu bằng một cách khác nhau trong bảng.
items.answer: It is important for education to develop both knowledge and practical skills. Those who leave school with good communication and problem-solving skills are more likely to contribute to society.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn phiên bản tốt nhất
intro: Mỗi câu có ba phiên bản của cùng một ý. Chọn phiên bản đúng ngữ pháp, tự nhiên và phù hợp nhất với Band 7.

options.text: The government should create jobs. It is important.
It is important the government to create jobs for young people.
It is important for the government to create more jobs for young people.

items.note: A tách ý rời rạc; B sai cấu trúc (thiếu for).

options.text: With more people moving to cities, housing is becoming more expensive.
With more people move to cities, housing is more expensive.
More people move to cities. So housing expensive.

items.note: B sai dạng động từ sau With; C thiếu động từ và nối câu kém.

options.text: Finding a job in a big city has never been easy for young job seekers.
Finding a job is difficult for young people in cities.
Find a job in big city is difficult for young people.

items.note: B đúng nhưng đơn giản; A tự nhiên và chính xác hơn; C sai ngữ pháp.

options.text: In order to reduce congestion, so the city should invest in public transport.
For reduce congestion, the city should invest public transport.
In order to reduce congestion, the city should invest in public transport.

items.note: A thừa so; B sai For reduce và thiếu in.

options.text: Children should teach to be independent when they are young.
Children should be taught to be independent from a young age.
Children should be taught to be independent from when they are young age.

items.note: A thiếu bị động; C sai cụm from a young age.

options.text: For recent graduates, finding a well-paid job it is not easy.
For recent graduates, it is not easy to find a well-paid job.
Recent graduates, it is not easy for find a job.

items.note: A thừa it; C sai cấu trúc.

options.text: Those who reads regularly they have wider vocabulary.
People read regularly have more vocabulary.
Those who read regularly tend to have a wider vocabulary.

items.note: A sai hòa hợp và thừa they; B thiếu who.

options.text: As the labour market becomes more competitive, so graduates need practical skills.
As the labour market becomes more competitive, graduates need practical skills.
Because labour market competitive, graduates need skill.

items.note: A dùng hai từ nối; C thiếu động từ và mạo từ.

options.text: There is a need for stricter rules on advertising aimed at children.
There is a need of stricter rules about advertising for children.
It needs stricter rules for advertising to children.

items.note: B sai giới từ need of; C dùng It needs không tự nhiên.

options.text: Investing in public transport should be done by the government.
Invest in public transport would reduce traffic.
Investing in public transport would help reduce traffic congestion.

items.note: A là bị động gượng ép; B thiếu V-ing.

options.text: With the availability of online shops, consumers often buy things they do not need.
With online shops are available, consumers buy things they don't need.
Online shops are available, consumers buy unnecessary things.

items.note: B sai cấu trúc With và viết tắt; C là lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy.

options.text: It is essential that children to learn to swim, as it may save their lives.
It is essential for children to learn to swim, as this skill may save their lives.
Children must learn swimming because it can save lives.

items.note: A trộn hai cấu trúc; C đúng nhưng đơn giản và kém chính xác.
A thiếu -ing và sai hòa hợp; B là lỗi dangling.

options.text: Young people should give more job opportunities.
Young people should be gave more job opportunities.
Young people should be given more job opportunities.

items.note: A thiếu bị động; B sai dạng phân từ.

options.text: As many young people struggle to find work, it is essential for the government to create more jobs.
Many young people cannot find work, the government must create jobs.
Because young people struggle find work, government should creating jobs.

items.note: B là lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; C sai nhiều chỗ.

options.text: With housing prices already falling, families have more options than ever.
With housing prices are already falling, families have more options.
Housing prices falling, so families more options.

items.note: B sai cấu trúc With; C thiếu động từ.

options.text: In order to reduce plastic waste, single-use bags should be banned.
In order to reduce plastic waste, single-use bags should ban.
To reduce plastic waste, so single-use bags should be banned.

items.note: B thiếu bị động; C thừa so.

options.text: For many families, pay tuition fees is a heavy burden.
For many families, paying tuition fees is a heavy financial burden.
Many families, paying tuition fees it is a burden.

items.note: A thiếu -ing; C thừa it và thiếu cấu trúc For.

options.text: Being part of a sports team, it helps children learn to cooperate.
Being part of a sports team helps children learn to cooperate.
Be part of a sports team help children cooperate.

items.note: A thừa it; C sai dạng động từ.

options.text: Who reads from a young age will definitely succeed in the future.
Those who get into the habit of reading from a young age are more likely to succeed as adults.
People reading from young age are more success when adult.

items.note: A tuyệt đối hóa (definitely) và thiếu chủ ngữ; C sai từ loại success.

theory.html: Hầu như đoạn thân bài nào trong Task 2 cũng giải thích vì sao một điều xảy ra hoặc nó dẫn đến điều gì. Giám khảo đánh giá cao điều này: ở Band 7, các ý chính được mở rộng và có dẫn chứng; ở Band 6, một số ý có thể chưa được phát triển đầy đủ. Ngôn ngữ nguyên nhân – kết quả là công cụ chính giúp bạn mở rộng ý.
Dùng đa dạng cấu trúc (thay vì lặp lại because và so) cũng giúp tăng độ đa dạng ngữ pháp, còn chọn đúng động từ liên kết (lead to hay result from) giúp người đọc theo dõi lập luận một cách rõ ràng.

Hai nguyên tắc áp dụng cho mọi cấu trúc trong bài này. Nguyên tắc 1: nguyên nhân cần có cơ chế. Hãy nói A tạo ra B như thế nào hoặc vì sao; đừng chỉ đặt A cạnh B. Nguyên tắc 2: mức độ chắc chắn phải tương xứng với bằng chứng. Hầu hết các tác động trong xã hội chỉ là có thể xảy ra, không chắc chắn, nên hãy ưu tiên can, may hoặc often thay vì will (xem Unit 10).

cells: because / since / as + S + V, S + V
Since many parents work long hours, children often eat alone.
because of / due to / owing to + noun phrase
Many students struggle to concentrate because of a lack of sleep.
With the availability of online shops, consumers are often tempted to buy things they do not need.
With the job market becoming increasingly competitive, many graduates struggle to find work.
Given + noun phrase, S + V / Given (the fact) that + S + V, S + V
Given the rising cost of housing, many young adults live with their parents.
Effect. (Much of) this comes down to the fact that + S + V
Many people do not know their neighbours. Much of this comes down to the fact that they work long hours.
Cause + lead to / result in / contribute to / give rise to + noun or V-ing
Air pollution can lead to respiratory illness.
Effect + result from / stem from / be attributed to / be traced back to + noun
Childhood obesity often stems from poor diet and a lack of exercise.
Noun phrase + mean(s) (that) + S + V, or + noun phrase
An increasingly competitive labour market means fewer opportunities for unqualified workers.
X may affect how + adjective/adverb + S + V
The skills children gain at school may affect how successful they are in their careers.
S + V, which means that … / S + V, meaning that …
Many firms are automating production, which means that some manual jobs may disappear.
With + noun phrase + come(s) + noun phrase
With the rise of smartphones comes greater use of social media.

items: With rapidly growing demand for online courses, many universities are investing heavily in digital platforms.
Given the fact that the population is ageing, governments need to put more resources into care for the elderly.
Many young people cannot afford to buy a home. Much of this comes down to the fact that property prices have risen far faster than wages.
An increasingly competitive labour market means that many people without qualifications struggle to find a good job.
The communication skills children gain at school may affect how successful they are in their careers later in life.
Long working hours can lead to stress and, over time, poorer physical health.
The decline of small local shops can largely be attributed to the convenience of online shopping.
With every major industrial project comes the responsibility to minimise its environmental impact.

items.bad: Because of the demand is growing, many factories are hiring. GRA
items.good: Because the demand is growing, many factories are hiring. / Because of the growing demand, many factories are hiring.
items.note: because of đi với cụm danh từ, không bao giờ đi với mệnh đề.

items.bad: This heavy dependence result a large gap between the two economies. GRA
items.good: This heavy dependence resulted in a large gap between the two economies.
items.note: result cần in (nguyên nhân → kết quả) hoặc from (kết quả ← nguyên nhân), và động từ phải hòa hợp với chủ ngữ và thì.

items.bad: Online learning can lead to students feel isolated. GRA
items.good: Online learning can lead to students feeling isolated. / … can lead to feelings of isolation.
items.note: lead to, contribute to và result in đi với danh từ hoặc V-ing, không đi với mệnh đề.

items.bad: The higher population density is, the more pollution there are in metropolises. TR
items.good: The higher the population density, the more pollution is generated, mainly because of heavier traffic and industrial activity.
items.note: Câu nêu mối liên hệ nhưng không nêu cơ chế. Hãy nêu bước trung gian nối nguyên nhân với kết quả. (Động từ are cũng sai: pollution là danh từ không đếm được.)

items.bad: Rapid urbanisation rise the need of new roads. LR
items.good: Rapid urbanisation raises the need for new roads.
items.note: raise (ngoại động từ) = làm cho cái gì tăng lên; rise (nội động từ) = tăng lên. Danh từ need đi với for.

items.bad: Since teenagers spend hours online, so they sleep less. GRA
items.good: Since teenagers spend hours online, they sleep less. / Teenagers spend hours online, so they sleep less.
items.note: Mỗi mối quan hệ chỉ dùng một từ nối: Since … , … hoặc … , so …, không dùng cả hai.

items.html: Nguyên nhân results in kết quả; kết quả results from nguyên nhân. Hãy kiểm tra bằng cách thay động từ bằng causes hoặc is caused by. Careless driving results in accidents. Accidents often result from careless driving. Chiều tương tự áp dụng cho lead to / contribute to (nguyên nhân đứng trước) và stem from / be attributed to (kết quả đứng trước).

because / since / as + mệnh đề; because of / owing to + cụm danh từ. Due to an toàn nhất khi đứng sau be: The delay was due to fog. Tránh due to the fact that: cụm này dài dòng, dùng because sẽ tốt hơn.

With giới thiệu một hoàn cảnh nền, thường là một xu hướng: With prices rising, … Given giới thiệu một sự thật mà bạn dựa vào để đưa ra kết luận: Given the cost, governments should … Cả hai đều theo sau là dấu phẩy và một mệnh đề chính đầy đủ.

Air pollution will cause cancer phóng đại mối liên hệ. Prolonged exposure to air pollution can increase the risk of lung disease thì chính xác. Chỉ dùng will cho những điều gần như chắc chắn (xem Unit 10).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại với cấu trúc cho sẵn
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cấu trúc được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa của câu gốc. Câu ● có gợi ý những từ đầu tiên; câu ●● cho biết tên cấu trúc; câu ●●● có yêu cầu khó hơn.

items.cue: Many young people move to big cities because there are more job opportunities there.
items.hint: With + noun phrase. Bắt đầu: With more job opportunities …
items.answer: With more job opportunities in big cities, many young people choose to move there.
items.alt: With better employment prospects in urban areas, many young people are moving to big cities.

items.cue: Because the cost of living is rising, many families struggle to save money.
items.hint: With + noun + V-ing. Bắt đầu: With the cost of living …
items.answer: With the cost of living rising, many families struggle to save money.
items.alt: With living costs rising steadily, many households find it hard to put money aside.

items.cue: Many students cannot concentrate in class because they do not sleep enough.
items.hint: because of + noun phrase. Dùng: a lack of sleep
items.answer: Many students struggle to concentrate in class because of a lack of sleep.
items.alt: Many students find it hard to focus in class owing to a lack of sleep.

items.cue: Traffic congestion is getting worse because more people own private cars.
items.hint: Since + mệnh đề ở đầu câu. Bắt đầu: Since more people …
items.answer: Since more people now own private cars, traffic congestion is getting worse.
items.alt: As car ownership rises, traffic congestion is becoming more severe.

items.cue: Air pollution in big cities causes breathing problems.
items.hint: lead to. Bắt đầu: Air pollution in big cities can …
items.answer: Air pollution in big cities can lead to breathing problems.
items.alt: Poor air quality in large cities can result in respiratory problems.

items.cue: Many teenagers become overweight because fast food is cheap and easy to buy.
items.hint: result from. Bắt đầu: Weight problems among teenagers …
items.answer: Weight problems among teenagers can result from the easy availability of cheap fast food.
items.alt: Weight problems among teenagers often result from cheap and easily available fast food.

items.cue: Online shopping is convenient, so many local shops are closing.
items.hint: contribute to. Bắt đầu: The convenience of online shopping has …
items.answer: The convenience of online shopping has contributed to the closure of many local shops.
items.alt: The convenience of online shopping has led to the closure of a number of local shops.

items.cue: Because housing prices are high, many young adults continue to live with their parents.
items.answer: Given the high cost of housing, many young adults continue to live with their parents.
items.alt: Given high property prices, many young adults remain in the family home.

items.cue: Many graduates cannot find suitable jobs because the labour market is very competitive.
items.answer: Given the fact that the labour market is highly competitive, many graduates struggle to find suitable jobs.
items.alt: Given that the labour market is so competitive, many graduates find it hard to secure suitable employment.

items.cue: Many people do not know their neighbours. The main reason is that they work very long hours.
items.hint: (Much of) this comes down to the fact that
items.answer: Many people do not know their neighbours. Much of this comes down to the fact that they work long hours.
items.alt: Many people are unfamiliar with their neighbours. This largely comes down to the fact that they work long hours and spend little time at home.

items.cue: The labour market is becoming more competitive, so people without qualifications find it hard to get good jobs.
items.answer: An increasingly competitive labour market means that people without qualifications struggle to find good jobs.
items.alt: An increasingly competitive labour market means fewer good jobs for people without qualifications.

items.cue: If children learn to manage money at school, they will probably be more financially secure as adults.
items.hint: Mệnh đề với how (… may affect how …)
items.answer: The financial skills children learn at school may affect how financially secure they are as adults.
items.alt: Learning to manage money at school may influence how well children handle their finances later in life.

items.cue: More people are working from home. Because of this, demand for office space in city centres is falling.
items.answer: More people are working from home, which means that demand for office space in city centres is falling.
items.alt: More people are working from home, meaning that demand for office space in city centres is declining.

items.cue: Many factories release waste into rivers. Fish populations have declined as a result.
items.answer: The decline in fish populations can largely be attributed to factories releasing waste into rivers.
items.alt: The fall in fish populations can be traced back to industrial waste being released into rivers.

items.cue: Some countries are facing economic difficulties. Therefore, their governments have had to cut public spending.
items.hint: Viết một câu chỉ có một động từ (noun phrase + mean + noun phrase).
items.answer: Harsh economic realities mean spending cuts by governments in some countries.
items.alt: Economic hardship means that governments in some countries have had to cut public spending.

items.cue: Smartphones have become popular. As a result, people use social media more.
items.answer: With the rise of smartphones comes greater use of social media.
items.alt: With the growing popularity of smartphones comes greater use of social media.

items.cue: When a country invests in public transport, fewer people drive, and the air becomes cleaner.
items.answer: Investment in public transport can lead to fewer people driving, which in turn improves air quality.
items.alt: Investing in public transport can reduce car use, thereby improving air quality.

items.cue: Teachers have to manage very large classes, so they cannot give each student enough attention, and weaker students fall behind.
items.hint: Không dùng because hoặc so. Dùng chủ ngữ là cụm danh từ và leave sb unable to.
items.answer: Large class sizes leave teachers unable to give each student enough attention, which means that weaker students often fall behind.
items.alt: Large classes leave teachers unable to give each student enough attention, with the result that weaker students fall behind.

items.cue: A healthy economy depends mainly on giving everyone access to education.
items.answer: The key to a healthier economy lies in making education accessible to all.
items.alt: Making education accessible to everyone is the key to a healthier economy.

items.cue: Many small farms have closed because large supermarkets pay farmers very low prices.
items.hint: Một câu, nêu kết quả trước: can be traced back to + noun phrase
items.answer: The closure of many small farms can be traced back to large supermarkets paying farmers very low prices.
items.alt: Many small farms have closed, largely because supermarket chains pay farmers so little for their produce.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Nhiều sinh viên mới tốt nghiệp gặp khó khăn khi tìm việc vì thiếu kinh nghiệm thực tế.
items.rewriteWith: because of + noun phrase (từ khóa: recent graduates, struggle to find work, a lack of practical experience)
items.translation: Many recent graduates find it hard to get a job because they lack practical experience.
items.answer: Many recent graduates struggle to find work because of a lack of practical experience.
items.alt: Many new graduates have difficulty finding a job owing to their lack of practical experience.

items.cue: Vì giá nhà ở các thành phố lớn quá cao, nhiều người trẻ phải thuê nhà trong nhiều năm.
items.rewriteWith: With + noun phrase (từ khóa: such high housing prices, rent, for years)
items.translation: Because housing prices in big cities are very high, many young people have to rent for many years.
items.answer: With such high housing prices in big cities, many young people have to rent for years.
items.alt: With property prices in major cities so high, many young people are forced to rent for many years.

items.cue: Khi ngày càng nhiều người dùng mạng xã hội, tin giả lan truyền nhanh hơn bao giờ hết.
items.rewriteWith: With + noun + V-ing (từ khóa: more and more people, social media, fake news, spread)
items.translation: As more and more people use social media, fake news spreads faster than ever.
items.answer: With more and more people using social media, fake news is spreading faster than ever.
items.alt: With social media use increasing, false information spreads more quickly than ever before.

items.cue: Ô nhiễm không khí có thể dẫn đến các bệnh về hô hấp, đặc biệt ở trẻ em và người già.
items.rewriteWith: lead to (từ khóa: air pollution, respiratory diseases, especially among)
items.translation: Air pollution can cause respiratory diseases, especially in children and the elderly.
items.answer: Air pollution can lead to respiratory diseases, especially among children and the elderly.
items.alt: Air pollution can result in respiratory illnesses, particularly in young children and older people.

items.cue: Nhiều trẻ em khó tập trung trong lớp vì dành quá nhiều thời gian chơi điện tử.
items.rewriteWith: Since + mệnh đề ở đầu câu (từ khóa: spend too much time, video games, struggle to concentrate)
items.translation: Many children find it hard to concentrate in class because they spend too much time playing video games.
items.answer: Since many children spend too much time playing video games, they struggle to concentrate in class.
items.alt: Since they spend so much time on video games, many children find it hard to focus in class.

items.cue: Tình trạng ùn tắc giao thông chủ yếu là do số lượng xe máy và ô tô cá nhân tăng nhanh.
items.rewriteWith: result from (từ khóa: traffic congestion, mainly, the rapid increase, private cars)
items.translation: Traffic congestion is mainly caused by the rapid increase in the number of motorbikes and private cars.
items.answer: Traffic congestion mainly results from the rapid increase in the number of motorbikes and private cars.
items.alt: Traffic congestion is mainly due to the rapid growth in the number of privately owned motorbikes and cars.

items.cue: Việc học ngoại ngữ từ nhỏ góp phần giúp trẻ tự tin hơn khi giao tiếp.
items.rewriteWith: contribute to + noun phrase (từ khóa: learning a foreign language, from a young age, confidence)
items.translation: Learning a foreign language from a young age helps children become more confident when they communicate.
items.answer: Learning a foreign language from a young age can contribute to children's confidence in communication.
items.alt: Learning a foreign language early in life can contribute to greater confidence when children communicate with others.

items.cue: Xét đến chi phí điều trị y tế ngày càng tăng, nhiều gia đình thu nhập thấp không đủ khả năng mua bảo hiểm y tế.
items.translation: Because medical treatment is becoming more and more expensive, many low-income families cannot afford health insurance.
items.answer: Given the rising cost of medical treatment, many low-income families cannot afford health insurance.
items.alt: Given the soaring cost of healthcare, many low-income households are unable to pay for health insurance.

items.cue: Trước thực tế là dân số đang già đi, chính phủ cần đầu tư nhiều hơn vào dịch vụ chăm sóc người cao tuổi.
items.translation: Because the population is ageing, the government needs to invest more in care services for the elderly.
items.answer: Given the fact that the population is ageing, the government needs to invest more in care services for the elderly.
items.alt: Given that the population is ageing, governments should put more resources into elderly care.

items.cue: Nhiều người không còn đọc báo giấy. Phần lớn điều này xuất phát từ thực tế là tin tức trực tuyến miễn phí và được cập nhật liên tục.
items.rewriteWith: (Much of) this comes down to the fact that
items.translation: Many people no longer read printed newspapers, mainly because online news is free and constantly updated.
items.answer: Many people no longer read printed newspapers. Much of this comes down to the fact that online news is free and constantly updated.
items.alt: Fewer people now read printed newspapers. This largely comes down to the fact that online news is free and updated around the clock.

items.cue: Thị trường lao động cạnh tranh hơn đồng nghĩa với việc người lao động phải liên tục học kỹ năng mới.
items.translation: Because the labour market is more competitive, workers have to keep learning new skills.
items.answer: A more competitive labour market means that workers have to keep learning new skills.
items.alt: Greater competition in the job market means that employees must continually update their skills.

items.cue: Những thói quen ăn uống mà trẻ hình thành ở nhà có thể ảnh hưởng đến mức độ khỏe mạnh của chúng khi trưởng thành.
items.translation: The eating habits children develop at home can affect their health when they grow up.
items.answer: The eating habits children develop at home may affect how healthy they are as adults.
items.alt: The eating habits that children form at home can influence how healthy they are later in life.

items.cue: Nhiều công ty đang chuyển sang tự động hóa, điều đó có nghĩa là một số công việc chân tay có thể biến mất.
items.translation: Many companies are moving towards automation, so some manual jobs may disappear.
items.answer: Many companies are turning to automation, which means that some manual jobs may disappear.
items.alt: A growing number of companies are automating production, meaning that certain manual jobs could disappear.

items.cue: Tỷ lệ tội phạm vị thành niên gia tăng có thể bắt nguồn từ việc thiếu sự giám sát của cha mẹ.
items.translation: The rise in youth crime may be caused by a lack of parental supervision.
items.answer: The rise in youth crime may stem from a lack of parental supervision.
items.alt: The increase in juvenile crime can partly be attributed to inadequate parental supervision.

items.cue: Với việc ngày càng nhiều người làm việc từ xa, nhu cầu thuê văn phòng ở trung tâm thành phố đang giảm.
items.translation: As more and more people work remotely, demand for office space in city centres is falling.
items.answer: With more and more people working remotely, demand for office space in city centres is falling.
items.alt: With remote working becoming increasingly common, demand for city-centre office space is declining.

items.cue: Cùng với sự phát triển của ngành du lịch là áp lực ngày càng lớn lên môi trường địa phương.
items.translation: The growth of tourism puts increasing pressure on the local environment.
items.answer: With the growth of tourism comes increasing pressure on the local environment.
items.alt: The growth of tourism brings mounting pressure on local ecosystems.

items.cue: Sự phụ thuộc quá mức vào công nghệ có thể khiến nhân viên không tự giải quyết được vấn đề, và về lâu dài điều này làm giảm năng suất.
items.rewriteWith: Chủ ngữ là cụm danh từ + leave sb unable to …, which …
items.translation: If employees depend too much on technology, they may not be able to solve problems by themselves, and this can reduce productivity in the long term.
items.answer: Excessive reliance on technology can leave employees unable to solve problems on their own, which may reduce productivity in the long run.
items.alt: Relying too heavily on technology can leave staff unable to work through problems independently, thereby lowering productivity over time.

items.cue: Chìa khóa để giảm nghèo nằm ở việc đảm bảo mọi trẻ em đều được đi học.
items.translation: The most important way to reduce poverty is to make sure that every child can go to school.
items.answer: The key to reducing poverty lies in ensuring that every child has access to schooling.
items.alt: The key to tackling poverty lies in making sure that all children can attend school.

items.cue: Thu nhập cao hơn đồng nghĩa với việc các gia đình có nhiều lựa chọn hơn về giáo dục và chăm sóc sức khỏe.
items.rewriteWith: Câu chỉ có một động từ: noun phrase + mean + noun phrase
items.translation: When families earn more, they have more choice in education and healthcare.
items.answer: Higher incomes mean greater choice in education and healthcare for families.
items.alt: Higher household incomes mean that families have more choice in education and healthcare.

items.cue: Nhiều người cao tuổi cảm thấy cô đơn. Điều này phần lớn là do con cái họ chuyển lên thành phố làm việc và hiếm khi về thăm.
items.rewriteWith: Một câu: … can be traced back to + noun phrase
items.translation: Many elderly people feel lonely, mainly because their children have moved to cities for work and rarely visit.
items.answer: Loneliness among many elderly people can largely be traced back to their children moving to cities for work and rarely visiting.
items.alt: Many older people feel isolated. Much of this comes down to the fact that their children have moved to cities for work and seldom visit.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: In the 1990s, this heavy dependence result a large gap between the two economies.
items.answer: In the 1990s, this heavy dependence result RESULTED IN a large gap between the two economies.
notes: GRA result cần in trước kết quả, và cụm thời gian quá khứ đòi hỏi thì quá khứ.

items.cue: Many people have a tendency to depend too much on technical support, it decrease their ability to solve the problems.
items.answer: Many people have a tendency to depend too much on technical support, it decrease, WHICH DECREASES their ability to solve the problems PROBLEMS.
notes: GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy: hai mệnh đề không thể chỉ nối bằng dấu phẩy. Mệnh đề which thay cho cả câu sẽ sửa được lỗi này, và động từ phải hòa hợp (which … decreases).
GRA Khi nói về vấn đề nói chung thì không dùng mạo từ.

items.cue: Because of the cost of living is rising, many families cannot save money.
items.answer: Because of BECAUSE the cost of living is rising, many families cannot save money.
notes: GRA because of đi với cụm danh từ; đây là một mệnh đề (the cost of living is rising).

items.cue: Air pollution is resulted from heavy traffic and factory emissions.
items.answer: Air pollution is resulted from RESULTS FROM heavy traffic and factory emissions.
notes: GRA result là nội động từ nên không có dạng bị động.

items.cue: Since many parents work long hours, children often spend their evenings alone.
items.answer: ✓ Since many parents work long hours, children often spend their evenings alone.
notes: Đúng: Since + mệnh đề ở đầu câu, dấu phẩy, mệnh đề chính; often giúp nhận định chừng mực.

items.cue: Online learning can lead to students feel isolated from their classmates.
items.answer: Online learning can lead to students feel STUDENTS FEELING isolated from their classmates.
notes: GRA lead to đi với danh từ hoặc V-ing, không đi với mệnh đề. Cũng có thể viết lead to feelings of isolation.

items.cue: Since teenagers spend hours on social media, so they sleep less than they should.
items.answer: Since teenagers spend hours on social media, so, they sleep less than they should.
notes: GRA Dùng hai từ nối cho một quan hệ: Since đã chỉ lý do, nên phải bỏ so.

items.cue: This trend risks widen the gap between the rich and the poor, forcing many families into poverty.
items.answer: This trend risks widen COULD WIDEN the gap between the rich and the poor, forcing many families into poverty PUSHING SOME LOW-INCOME FAMILIES INTO FINANCIAL HARDSHIP.
notes: GRA risk đi với V-ing (risks widening); could widen đơn giản và chừng mực hơn.
TR Chuỗi hệ quả bị tuyệt đối hóa: nhận định nhảy thẳng đến many families và poverty. Hãy thu hẹp đối tượng và giảm nhẹ hệ quả.

items.cue: In the past, the shortage of skilled workers leaded to make a large gap in wages.
items.answer: In the past, the shortage of skilled workers leaded to make LED TO a large gap in wages.
notes: GRA Quá khứ của lead là led, và lead to đi trực tiếp với danh từ (a large gap).

items.cue: Rapid urbanisation, which rise the the need of new roads and housing, puts pressure on city budgets.
items.answer: Rapid urbanisation, which rise RAISES the the THE need of NEED FOR new roads and housing, puts pressure on city budgets.
notes: LR rise (tăng lên) là nội động từ; raise (làm tăng) cần tân ngữ. Động từ cũng phải hòa hợp với urbanisation.
GRA Lặp từ do sơ suất.
LR Giới từ đi kèm: the need for something.

items.cue: Given the rising cost of university tuition, more students are choosing vocational courses.
items.answer: ✓ Given the rising cost of university tuition, more students are choosing vocational courses.
notes: Đúng: Given + cụm danh từ, dấu phẩy, mệnh đề chính.

items.cue: Technology saves workers' time. As a result, they can spend less time on their tasks.
items.answer: Technology saves workers' time. As a result, they can spend less time on their tasks. AS A RESULT, THEY CAN DEVOTE MORE ATTENTION TO TASKS THAT REQUIRE CREATIVITY AND JUDGEMENT.
notes: TR Lặp ý: câu thứ hai nhắc lại câu đầu bằng từ khác. Một kết quả phải thêm một bước mới.

items.cue: Higher fuel prices mean that many commuters are switching to public transport.
items.answer: ✓ Higher fuel prices mean that many commuters are switching to public transport.
notes: Đúng: chủ ngữ là cụm danh từ số nhiều + mean that + mệnh đề.

items.cue: With more people are moving to cities, housing prices have risen sharply.
items.answer: With more people are moving MOVING to cities, housing prices have risen sharply.
notes: GRA With + danh từ + V-ing; With không đi với một mệnh đề đầy đủ.

items.cue: The higher population density is, the more pollution there are in metropolises.
items.answer: The higher population density is THE HIGHER THE POPULATION DENSITY, the more pollution there are in metropolises IS GENERATED, MAINLY BECAUSE OF HEAVIER TRAFFIC AND INDUSTRIAL ACTIVITY.
notes: GRA Trong cấu trúc the + so sánh hơn …, the + so sánh hơn …, danh từ đứng sau the higher the; có thể lược is.
TR Thiếu bước nhân quả: hãy giải thích vì sao mật độ dân số tạo ra ô nhiễm. (pollution không đếm được nên are cũng sai.)

items.cue: Applying the law equally to all citizens is essential. This can reduce crime rates, discourage corruption and increase public trust.
items.answer: Applying the law equally to all citizens is essential. This can reduce crime rates, discourage corruption and increase public trust. WHEN THE LAW APPLIES EQUALLY TO THE RICH AND THE POOR, OFFICIALS HAVE FEWER OPPORTUNITIES TO ABUSE POWER, WHICH IN TURN REDUCES CORRUPTION.
notes: TR Liệt kê ba kết quả nhưng không giải thích kết quả nào. Hãy phát triển đầy đủ một hệ quả, kèm cơ chế của nó.

items.cue: Rents in small towns have risen. Much of this comes down to the fact that remote workers no longer need to live near their offices.
items.answer: ✓ Rents in small towns have risen. Much of this comes down to the fact that remote workers no longer need to live near their offices.
notes: Đúng: nêu kết quả trước, sau đó Much of this comes down to the fact that + mệnh đề nêu nguyên nhân.

items.cue: The government has invested heavily in rural roads. In other words, the services industry in rural areas can be developed.
items.answer: The government has invested heavily in rural roads. In other words, AS A RESULT, the services industry in rural areas can be developed.
notes: CC In other words báo hiệu việc nhắc lại ý cũ; câu này nêu một hệ quả mới nên cần từ nối chỉ kết quả.

items.cue: With the rise of smartphones has come a sharp increase in the time children spend online.
items.answer: ✓ With the rise of smartphones has come a sharp increase in the time children spend online.
notes: Đúng: With + cụm danh từ + has come + chủ ngữ (đảo trật tự sau cụm With).

items.cue: Depending too much on technology can destroy workers's ability to solve problem and communicate well.
items.answer: Depending too much on technology can destroy WEAKEN workers's WORKERS' ability to solve problem SOLVE PROBLEMS and communicate well.
notes: TR Động từ cực đoan, không có cơ chế: destroy phóng đại tác động. Hãy thêm lý do: … as they rarely have to work through problems themselves.
GRA Sở hữu cách của danh từ số nhiều: workers'.
GRA Danh từ đếm được số ít cần mạo từ; ở đây dùng số nhiều chỉ chung là đúng.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) hoặc hai câu (●●●) nêu nguyên nhân, kết quả hoặc lý do liên quan đến đề bài. Dùng cấu trúc được cho.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Students can now find a great deal of information online, so some people believe that libraries are no longer necessary. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: With + noun phrase. Bắt đầu: With the availability of …
items.answer: With the availability of vast amounts of information online, many students now visit libraries far less often than they used to.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Everyone should remain in full-time education until the age of 18. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Many teenagers leave school early because of financial pressure to help support their families.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Advertising is increasingly aimed at children. Some people believe that this has a negative effect and that such advertising should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Advertising aimed at children can lead to unhealthy eating habits, as many of the products promoted are high in sugar and fat.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Modern technology allows many employees to work from home. Some people believe that this benefits workers but not employers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Since + mệnh đề. Bắt đầu: Since employees who work from home …
items.answer: Since employees who work from home do not have to commute, they often start the day less tired and better able to concentrate.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that children should start school as early as possible, while others think they should not begin until the age of seven. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Starting formal education too early may result in stress for children who are not yet ready to sit still and follow instructions.

items.cue: Education · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many children find it difficult to concentrate or pay attention at school. Why does this happen, and what can be done to improve children's concentration?
items.answer: Excessive screen time before bed can contribute to poor sleep, which makes it harder for children to concentrate the next day.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should make healthy food cheaper, while others think that unhealthy food should be taxed. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: With the price of fresh fruit and vegetables rising, many low-income families turn to cheaper processed food.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way to solve the world's environmental problems is to increase the price of fuel. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Given the heavy reliance of many workers on cars and motorbikes, a sharp rise in fuel prices could place a heavy financial burden on low-income commuters.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Research shows that overeating can be as harmful to health as smoking. Therefore, advertisements for certain foods should be banned in the same way as cigarette advertising. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The constant promotion of sugary snacks means that many children develop a taste for unhealthy food from a very early age.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Young people who commit serious crimes should be punished in the same way as adults. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: (Much of) this comes down to the fact that
items.answer: Many young offenders reoffend after their release. Much of this comes down to the fact that adult prisons offer them few opportunities for education or rehabilitation.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that no one should stay in the same job for their whole working life, while others think that remaining in one job can benefit individuals, companies and society. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Staying with one company for many years allows employees to build deep expertise, which means that they often become highly valuable to their employers.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Machines are becoming increasingly complex, and more and more work is being automated. Do the advantages of automation outweigh the disadvantages?
items.answer: Recent gains in factory productivity can largely be attributed to the automation of repetitive assembly tasks.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some countries, many adults continue to live with their parents after graduating from university or finding a job. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
items.answer: Given the fact that rents in many cities are extremely high, living with their parents allows young adults to save for a home of their own.

items.cue: Education · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: More and more people are competing for places at universities. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.answer: The growing competition for university places stems largely from employers' increasing demand for degree-level qualifications.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to create a happier society is to reduce the difference in income between the richest and poorest people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Hai câu: một nhận định và lý do của nó, dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài này.
items.answer: Reducing the gap between the richest and the poorest could make a society happier. This comes down to the fact that people's satisfaction depends partly on how their living standards compare with those around them.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents have the greatest influence on a child's development, while others think factors such as friends and television are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Hai câu: một nhận định và lý do của nó, dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài này.
items.answer: With teenagers spending more time online than with their families, the influence of friends and social media has grown considerably. This means that parents are no longer the only role models in a child's life.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that young people should follow the traditions of their society, while others think they should be free to behave as individuals. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Hai câu: một nhận định và lý do của nó, dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài này.
items.answer: Given the rapid pace of social change, some traditions may no longer suit the way young people live. Insisting on them could therefore lead to conflict between generations.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: An increasing number of people do not know their neighbours. Why is this happening, and what can be done to improve relationships between neighbours?
items.hint: Hai câu: một nhận định và lý do của nó, dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài này.
items.answer: Many people barely know their neighbours. Much of this comes down to long working hours, which leave residents with little time or energy for community life.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: In some countries, more and more people are choosing to live alone. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một nhận định và lý do của nó, dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài này.
items.answer: The rise in single-person households can largely be attributed to higher incomes and later marriage. With more people living alone, demand for small, affordable flats is likely to increase.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Two-part question
items.prompt: Governments in many countries spend large amounts of money improving Internet access. Why do they do this, and do you think this is the best use of public money?
items.hint: Hai câu: một nhận định và lý do của nó, dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài này.
items.answer: Governments invest in Internet access because online connectivity has become essential for education, employment and public services. Without it, rural communities are left unable to compete with cities for investment and jobs.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn phương án đúng
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng trong mỗi câu.

items.cue: Many shops closed ( because / because of ) the pandemic.
items.answer: because of
items.note: because of + cụm danh từ (the pandemic).

items.cue: Traffic accidents often result ( from / in ) careless driving.
items.answer: from
items.note: Kết quả (tai nạn) đứng trước, nên dùng result from + nguyên nhân.

items.cue: Careless driving often results ( from / in ) serious accidents.
items.answer: in
items.note: Nguyên nhân đứng trước, nên dùng result in + kết quả.

items.cue: ( Because of / Since ) house prices are high, many couples delay buying a home.
items.answer: Since
items.note: Theo sau là một mệnh đề (house prices are high), nên dùng Since.

items.cue: A poor diet can lead to ( weight gain / gain weight ).
items.answer: weight gain
items.note: lead to + cụm danh từ.

items.cue: The delay was ( due to / because ) heavy rain.
items.answer: due to
items.note: be due to + cụm danh từ.

items.cue: Climate change ( effects / affects ) crop yields in many regions.
items.answer: affects
items.note: affect là động từ; effect thường là danh từ.

items.cue: ( Given / With ) the population ageing, healthcare costs are rising.
items.answer: With
items.note: With + danh từ + V-ing diễn tả một xu hướng nền; Given thường không đi với danh từ + V-ing.

items.cue: Higher taxes on cigarettes ( means / mean ) fewer young smokers.
items.answer: mean
items.note: Chủ ngữ số nhiều (taxes) → mean.

items.cue: Better public transport contributes to ( reduce / reducing ) car use.
items.answer: reducing
items.note: Trong contribute to, to là giới từ nên theo sau là V-ing.

items.cue: Much of this comes down to ( the fact that / the fact ) many parents work long hours.
items.answer: the fact that
items.note: Theo sau là một mệnh đề nên dùng the fact that.

items.cue: The rise in obesity can be attributed ( to / for ) sedentary lifestyles.
items.answer: to
items.note: be attributed to + nguyên nhân.

items.cue: Unemployment ( raises / rises ) the risk of poverty.
items.answer: raises
items.note: raise cần tân ngữ (the risk).

items.cue: Unemployment has ( risen / raised ) sharply in rural areas.
items.answer: risen
items.note: Không có tân ngữ nên dùng nội động từ rise (risen).

items.cue: The key to a healthier economy lies ( on / in ) education.
items.answer: in
items.note: Cấu trúc cố định: The key to X lies in Y.

items.cue: ( Thanks to / Because ) better vaccines, far fewer children die of measles today.
items.answer: Thanks to
items.note: Theo sau là cụm danh từ và kết quả tích cực → Thanks to; because cần một mệnh đề.

items.cue: ( Owing to / Thanks to ) a sharp fall in demand, the factory had to cut jobs.
items.answer: Owing to
items.note: Kết quả tiêu cực: dùng thanks to ở đây sẽ mang ý mỉa mai.

items.cue: The new policy had a strong ( affect / effect ) on youth employment.
items.answer: effect
items.note: Danh từ đứng sau a strong → effect.

items.cue: Rising rents ( stem from / lead to ) a shortage of housing.
items.answer: stem from
items.note: Sự thiếu hụt là nguyên nhân, và rents đứng trước, nên dùng stem from.

items.cue: A lack of investment has ( left / made ) many rural schools without basic equipment.
items.answer: left
items.note: Cấu trúc đúng là leave sb/sth without / leave sb unable to; make không đi với without.

theory.html: Trong Task 2, bạn liên tục phải nói một hành động nhằm mục đích gì (giải pháp, chính sách) và dẫn đến kết quả gì (tác động, hệ quả). Hai loại thông tin này dễ bị nhầm lẫn: so that chỉ mục đích, còn , so chỉ kết quả; thereby + V-ing chỉ kết quả, còn in order to chỉ mục đích.

Dùng đúng cấu trúc giúp lập luận rõ ràng hơn (TR, CC), và dùng đa dạng cấu trúc giúp tăng điểm ngữ pháp (GRA). Đặc biệt, cụm V-ing ở cuối câu (…, thereby protecting staff) phải diễn tả kết quả hợp lý của cả mệnh đề trước; nếu không, câu sẽ bị lỗi dangling.
Hãy nhớ: mục đích là điều người làm hướng tới; kết quả là điều thực sự xảy ra. Một giải pháp có mục đích tốt không đảm bảo kết quả tốt, nên khi nêu kết quả, hãy dùng mức độ phù hợp (can, may, could).

theory.text: Cấu trúc chỉ mục đích và kết quả

cells: S + V + so that + S + can / could / will + V
Parents work long hours so that their children can attend good schools.
in order to / so as to + V; in order not to + V
Many firms automate production in order to cut costs.
Mục đích (hành động như một phương tiện)
as a way to + V / as a way of + V-ing
The government has launched campaigns as a way to raise awareness of recycling.
aimed at + V-ing; with the aim of + V-ing
A project aimed at reducing congestion is under way.
People should live in a way that is kinder to the environment.
S + V, which means that + S + V
Many people now work from home, which means that offices are emptier.
Robots can be used for welding, thereby protecting staff from injury.
Long hours leave many parents unable to spend time with their children.
so + adj/adv + that …; such + (a) + adj + noun + that …
Rents are so high that many young people cannot leave home.
… . As a result, / Consequently, + S + V
Many factories closed. As a result, thousands of people lost their jobs.

items: Parents work long hours so that their children can attend good schools.
Many students work part-time in order to cover their living costs.
The government has launched campaigns as a way to raise public awareness of environmental issues.
Students should study in a way that suits their abilities and interests.
More people are working remotely, which means that demand for office space is falling.
Factories use robots for dangerous tasks, thereby protecting workers from injury.
Heavy academic pressure leaves many children unable to relax.
It is such an expensive city that many workers have to live in the suburbs.

items.bad: Robots can be deployed for welding, avoiding staff from physical harm. GRA
items.good: Robots can be deployed for welding, thereby protecting staff from physical harm.
items.note: Không có cấu trúc avoid sb from; dùng protect / prevent sb from. thereby cho biết đây là kết quả của cả mệnh đề trước.

items.bad: The policy made India became the only nation use it. GRA
items.good: The policy made India the only nation to use it.
items.note: make + O + danh từ/tính từ; không thêm động từ chia thì. the only … to + V.

items.bad: Many people exercise for reducing stress. GRA
items.good: Many people exercise to reduce stress.
items.note: Mục đích của một hành động dùng to + V, không dùng for + V-ing.

items.bad: Parents work hard so that to support their children. GRA
items.good: Parents work hard so that they can support their children.
items.note: so that + mệnh đề đầy đủ (chủ ngữ + can/could + V).

items.bad: Students should study in order to not fail. GRA
items.good: Students should study in order not to fail.
items.note: Phủ định của in order to là in order not to.

items.bad: Rents are such high that young people cannot leave home. GRA
items.good: Rents are so high that young people cannot leave home.
items.note: so + tính từ; such + (a/an) + tính từ + danh từ.

items.html: so that + mệnh đề = để (mục đích, thường có can/could/will); , so + mệnh đề = vì vậy (kết quả). He saved money so that he could buy a house (mục đích) ≠ He saved money, so he could buy a house (kết quả).
in order to + V khi hai vế có cùng chủ ngữ; so that + mệnh đề khi chủ ngữ khác nhau: Parents work long hours so that their children can attend good schools.
thereby + V-ing chỉ kết quả trực tiếp của hành động vừa nêu, văn phong trang trọng; , which means that + mệnh đề linh hoạt hơn, dùng được cho mọi hệ quả.
so + tính từ/trạng từ (so expensive that); such + (a/an) + tính từ + danh từ (such an expensive city that).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Nối câu bằng cấu trúc mục đích / kết quả
intro: Nối hoặc viết lại các câu bằng cấu trúc được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa.

items.cue: Many people learn English. They want to get better jobs.
items.hint: in order to. Bắt đầu: Many people learn English in order to …
items.answer: Many people learn English in order to get better jobs.
items.alt: Many people learn English so as to improve their job prospects.

items.cue: Parents work long hours. They want their children to go to good schools.
items.answer: Parents work long hours so that their children can attend good schools.
items.alt: Parents work long hours so that their children will be able to go to good schools.

items.cue: The government has launched a campaign. The aim is to encourage recycling.
items.answer: The government has launched a campaign as a way to encourage recycling.
items.alt: The government has launched a campaign aimed at encouraging recycling.

items.cue: Many people now work from home. Offices in city centres are emptier.
items.answer: Many people now work from home, which means that offices in city centres are emptier.
items.alt: Many people now work from home, meaning that city-centre offices are emptier.

items.cue: Rents are very high. Many young people cannot leave home.
items.answer: Rents are so high that many young people cannot leave home.
items.alt: Rents have become so high that many young people cannot afford to move out.

items.cue: Many parents work long hours, so they cannot spend time with their children.
items.hint: leave sb unable to. Bắt đầu: Long working hours leave …
items.answer: Long working hours leave many parents unable to spend time with their children.
items.alt: Long working hours leave many parents unable to spend enough time with their children.

items.cue: The city is building a new metro line. The aim is to reduce congestion.
items.hint: aimed at + V-ing. Bắt đầu: A new metro line aimed at …
items.answer: A new metro line aimed at reducing congestion is being built.
items.alt: The city is building a new metro line with the aim of reducing congestion.

items.cue: Many people eat too much red meat and fried food. This damages their health.
items.answer: Many people eat in a way that damages their health, consuming too much red meat and fried food.
items.alt: By eating too much red meat and fried food, many people eat in a way that harms their health.

items.cue: Factories use robots for dangerous tasks. Workers are protected from injury.
items.answer: Factories use robots for dangerous tasks, thereby protecting workers from injury.
items.alt: Factories use robots for dangerous tasks, thereby keeping workers safe from injury.

items.cue: Students should study hard. They do not want to fail their exams.
items.answer: Students should study hard in order not to fail their exams.
items.alt: Students should study hard so as not to fail their exams.

items.cue: Governments tax sugary drinks. They want people to consume less sugar.
items.answer: Governments tax sugary drinks so that people consume less sugar.
items.alt: Governments tax sugary drinks so that consumers will cut down on sugar.

items.cue: This is a very crowded city. Many workers spend hours commuting.
items.answer: It is such a crowded city that many workers spend hours commuting.
items.alt: The city is so crowded that many workers spend hours commuting.

items.cue: Many shops closed during the pandemic. Many people lost their jobs.
items.answer: Many shops closed during the pandemic. As a result, many people lost their jobs.
items.alt: Many shops closed during the pandemic, which meant that many people lost their jobs.

items.cue: Students should use a learning method that is suitable for them.
items.answer: Students should study in a way that suits their abilities.
items.alt: Students should study in the way that best suits their abilities and interests.

items.cue: Some companies offer flexible hours. They want to keep their staff. Fewer staff leave as a result.
items.hint: Mục đích + kết quả trong một câu (in order to … , thereby …)
items.answer: Some companies offer flexible hours in order to retain their staff, thereby reducing staff turnover.
items.alt: Some companies offer flexible hours in order to keep their employees, thereby lowering staff turnover.

items.cue: The government should ban cars from the city centre. It wants cleaner air and more people walking.
items.hint: with the aim of + hai V-ing
items.answer: The government should ban cars from the city centre with the aim of improving air quality and encouraging people to walk.
items.alt: The government should ban cars from the city centre in order to improve air quality and encourage walking.

items.cue: Robots are used for welding. This protects workers.
items.hint: , thereby + V-ing (không viết avoiding staff from harm)
items.answer: Robots can be used for welding, thereby protecting workers from physical harm.
items.alt: Robots can be used for welding, thereby keeping staff safe from injury.

items.cue: India adopted the new technology early. As a result, it became the only nation using it.
items.answer: India adopted the technology early, making the country the only nation to use it at that time.
items.alt: India's early adoption of the technology made the country the only nation to use it at that time.

items.cue: Children face strong pressure at school. They cannot relax.
items.hint: leave sb unable to (chủ ngữ là cụm danh từ)
items.answer: Heavy academic pressure leaves many children unable to relax.
items.alt: Strong academic pressure leaves many children unable to relax.

items.cue: Parents limit screen time. They want their children to sleep better and concentrate in class.
items.answer: Parents limit screen time so that their children can sleep better and concentrate in class.
items.alt: Parents restrict screen time so that their children will sleep better and focus in class.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Nhiều sinh viên đi làm thêm để trang trải chi phí sinh hoạt.
items.rewriteWith: in order to (từ khóa: part-time, cover living costs)
items.translation: Many students work part-time to pay their living costs.
items.answer: Many students work part-time in order to cover their living costs.
items.alt: Many students take part-time jobs so as to cover their living expenses.

items.cue: Cha mẹ làm việc chăm chỉ để con cái có thể được học ở trường tốt.
items.translation: Parents work hard so their children can study at good schools.
items.answer: Parents work hard so that their children can attend good schools.
items.alt: Parents work hard so that their children will be able to go to good schools.

items.cue: Chính phủ đã phát động nhiều chiến dịch như một cách để nâng cao nhận thức về môi trường.
items.rewriteWith: as a way to (từ khóa: raise public awareness of)
items.translation: The government has started many campaigns to raise awareness about the environment.
items.answer: The government has launched many campaigns as a way to raise public awareness of environmental issues.
items.alt: The government has launched many campaigns aimed at raising public awareness of environmental issues.

items.cue: Ngày càng nhiều người làm việc từ xa, điều đó có nghĩa là nhu cầu thuê văn phòng đang giảm.
items.rewriteWith: , which means that (từ khóa: demand for office space)
items.translation: More and more people are working remotely, so the demand for renting offices is falling.
items.answer: More and more people are working remotely, which means that demand for office space is falling.
items.alt: A growing number of people work remotely, meaning that demand for office space is declining.

items.cue: Giá thuê nhà cao đến mức nhiều người trẻ không thể dọn ra ở riêng.
items.rewriteWith: so + adj + that (từ khóa: afford to live independently)
items.translation: Rents are very high, so many young people cannot move out.
items.answer: Rents are so high that many young people cannot afford to live independently.
items.alt: Rents have become so high that many young adults cannot afford to move out.

items.cue: Giờ làm việc dài khiến nhiều cha mẹ không thể dành thời gian cho con cái.
items.rewriteWith: leave sb unable to (từ khóa: long working hours)
items.translation: Long working hours mean many parents cannot spend time with their children.
items.answer: Long working hours leave many parents unable to spend time with their children.
items.alt: Long working hours leave many parents unable to spend enough time with their children.

items.cue: Một dự án nhằm giảm ùn tắc giao thông đang được triển khai.
items.translation: A project to reduce traffic jams is being carried out.
items.answer: A project aimed at reducing traffic congestion is under way.
items.alt: A scheme with the aim of reducing traffic congestion is under way.

items.cue: Mọi người nên sống theo cách thân thiện hơn với môi trường.
items.translation: People should live in a more environmentally friendly way.
items.answer: People should live in a way that is kinder to the environment.
items.alt: People should live in a way that causes less harm to the environment.

items.cue: Các nhà máy sử dụng robot cho công việc nguy hiểm, nhờ đó bảo vệ công nhân khỏi chấn thương.
items.translation: Factories use robots for dangerous work, which protects workers from injury.
items.answer: Factories use robots for dangerous work, thereby protecting workers from injury.
items.alt: Factories assign dangerous tasks to robots, thereby keeping workers safe from injury.

items.cue: Học sinh nên ôn tập thường xuyên để không bị trượt kỳ thi.
items.translation: Students should revise regularly so they do not fail exams.
items.answer: Students should revise regularly in order not to fail their exams.
items.alt: Students should revise regularly so as not to fail their exams.

items.cue: Chính phủ đánh thuế đồ uống có đường để người dân tiêu thụ ít đường hơn.
items.translation: The government taxes sugary drinks so people consume less sugar.
items.answer: The government taxes sugary drinks so that people consume less sugar.
items.alt: The government taxes sugary drinks so that consumers will reduce their sugar intake.

items.cue: Đó là một thành phố đắt đỏ đến mức nhiều người lao động phải sống ở ngoại ô.
items.translation: It is a very expensive city, so many workers have to live in the suburbs.
items.answer: It is such an expensive city that many workers have to live in the suburbs.
items.alt: The city is so expensive that many workers have to live in the suburbs.

items.cue: Nhiều nhà máy đã đóng cửa. Kết quả là hàng nghìn người mất việc.
items.translation: Many factories have closed, so thousands of people have lost their jobs.
items.answer: Many factories have closed. As a result, thousands of people have lost their jobs.
items.alt: Many factories have closed, which has meant that thousands of people have lost their jobs.

items.cue: Giáo viên nên dạy theo cách phù hợp với năng lực của từng học sinh.
items.translation: Teachers should teach in a way suitable for each student's ability.
items.answer: Teachers should teach in a way that suits each student's abilities.
items.alt: Teachers should adapt their teaching in a way that matches each student's abilities.

items.cue: Một số công ty cho phép làm việc linh hoạt nhằm giữ chân nhân viên, nhờ đó giảm tỷ lệ nghỉ việc.
items.translation: Some companies allow flexible working to keep their staff, which reduces the number of people who quit.
items.answer: Some companies offer flexible working in order to retain staff, thereby reducing staff turnover.
items.alt: Some firms allow flexible working as a way to keep their employees, which lowers staff turnover.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên đầu tư vào năng lượng tái tạo với mục tiêu giảm khí thải carbon.
items.translation: The government should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions.
items.answer: The government should invest in renewable energy with the aim of reducing carbon emissions.
items.alt: Governments should put more resources into renewable energy in order to cut carbon emissions.

items.cue: Áp lực học tập nặng nề khiến nhiều trẻ em không thể thư giãn.
items.translation: Heavy study pressure means many children cannot relax.
items.answer: Heavy academic pressure leaves many children unable to relax.
items.alt: The intense pressure to succeed at school leaves many children unable to relax.

items.cue: Việc Ấn Độ áp dụng sớm công nghệ này đã khiến nước này trở thành quốc gia duy nhất sử dụng nó vào thời điểm đó.
items.translation: India adopted this technology early, so it became the only country using it at that time.
items.answer: India's early adoption of the technology made the country the only nation to use it at that time.
items.alt: India adopted the technology early, making the country the only nation to use it at that time.

items.cue: Nhiều người tập thể dục để giảm căng thẳng chứ không phải để giảm cân.
items.translation: Many people exercise because they want to reduce stress, not because they want to lose weight.
items.answer: Many people exercise to reduce stress rather than to lose weight.
items.alt: Many people exercise in order to relieve stress, not to lose weight.

items.cue: Cha mẹ nên hạn chế thời gian dùng thiết bị điện tử của con để chúng ngủ ngon hơn và tập trung tốt hơn ở lớp.
items.translation: Parents should limit their children's screen time so they sleep better and focus better in class.
items.answer: Parents should limit their children's screen time so that they can sleep better and concentrate in class.
items.alt: Parents should restrict their children's use of devices so that they will sleep better and focus in class.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Many people exercise for reducing stress.
items.answer: Many people exercise for reducing TO REDUCE stress.
notes: GRA Mục đích của hành động dùng to + V.

items.cue: Parents work hard so that to support their children.
items.answer: Parents work hard so that to support SO THAT THEY CAN SUPPORT their children.
notes: GRA so that + mệnh đề đầy đủ.

items.cue: Many students work part-time in order to cover their living costs.
items.answer: ✓ Many students work part-time in order to cover their living costs.
notes: Đúng: in order to + V, hai vế cùng chủ ngữ.

items.cue: Students should study in order to not fail their exams.
items.answer: Students should study in order to not fail IN ORDER NOT TO FAIL their exams.
notes: GRA Phủ định: in order not to + V.

items.cue: Rents are such high that young people cannot leave home.
items.answer: Rents are such high SO HIGH that young people cannot leave home.
notes: GRA so + tính từ; such đi với danh từ.

items.cue: Long hours leave many parents unable spending time with their children.
items.answer: Long hours leave many parents unable spending UNABLE TO SPEND time with their children.
notes: GRA leave sb unable to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: The government launched a campaign as a way for raising awareness.
items.answer: The government launched a campaign as a way for raising AS A WAY TO RAISE awareness.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: as a way to V (hoặc as a way of V-ing).

items.cue: Robots can be deployed for welding, avoiding staff from physical harm.
items.answer: Robots can be deployed for welding, avoiding staff from physical harm THEREBY PROTECTING STAFF FROM PHYSICAL HARM.
notes: GRA Không có avoid sb from; cụm kết quả cần thereby protecting.

items.cue: Many people now work from home, which means that city-centre offices are emptier.
items.answer: ✓ Many people now work from home, which means that city-centre offices are emptier.
notes: Đúng: , which means that + mệnh đề chỉ kết quả.

items.cue: This policy made India became the only nation use the technology.
items.answer: This policy made India became the only nation use MADE INDIA THE ONLY NATION TO USE the technology.
notes: GRA make + O + danh từ; the only … to V.

items.cue: Strict regulations were introduced, making fossil fuel become the least produced energy source.
items.answer: Strict regulations were introduced, making fossil fuel become MAKING FOSSIL FUEL the least produced energy source.
notes: GRA make + O + danh từ: bỏ become.

items.cue: It is such an expensive city that many workers live in the suburbs.
items.answer: ✓ It is such an expensive city that many workers live in the suburbs.
notes: Đúng: such + a/an + tính từ + danh từ + that.

items.cue: Consequently, a child can potentially become discouraged to schools and eventually, fostering an invisible barrier to parents.
items.answer: Consequently, a child can potentially become discouraged to schools and eventually, fostering an invisible barrier to parents. AS A RESULT, THE CHILD MAY LOSE INTEREST IN SCHOOL AND, OVER TIME, STOP SHARING PROBLEMS WITH HIS OR HER PARENTS.
notes: CC Câu chồng chất ý, không rõ trình tự kết quả.
LR discouraged to sai giới từ.
GRA Cụm V-ing (fostering) không có chủ thể rõ ràng.

items.cue: People should live in a way that kinder to the environment.
items.answer: People should live in a way that kinder THAT IS KINDER to the environment.
notes: GRA Mệnh đề that cần động từ is.

items.cue: Factories use robots for dangerous tasks, thereby protect workers from injury.
items.answer: Factories use robots for dangerous tasks, thereby protect THEREBY PROTECTING workers from injury.
notes: GRA Sau thereby dùng V-ing.

items.cue: Governments tax sugary drinks so that people will consume less sugar.
items.answer: ✓ Governments tax sugary drinks so that people will consume less sugar.
notes: Đúng: so that + mệnh đề, chủ ngữ khác nhau.

items.cue: Many people work from home, which mean that demand for office space is falling.
items.answer: Many people work from home, which mean WHICH MEANS that demand for office space is falling.
notes: GRA which thay cho cả mệnh đề trước → động từ số ít means.

items.cue: Some firms automate production in order to cutting costs.
items.answer: Some firms automate production in order to cutting TO CUT costs.
notes: GRA in order to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: A new metro line aimed at reducing congestion is under construction.
items.answer: ✓ A new metro line aimed at reducing congestion is under construction.
notes: Đúng: aimed at + V-ing.

items.cue: Banning cars from the city centre will definitely solve all pollution problems, so that everyone will be healthy.
items.answer: Banning cars from the city centre will definitely solve all pollution problems COULD SIGNIFICANTLY IMPROVE AIR QUALITY, so that everyone will be healthy, WHICH WOULD BENEFIT RESIDENTS' HEALTH.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (definitely, all): một biện pháp không thể giải quyết mọi vấn đề ô nhiễm.
GRA so that chỉ mục đích, không chỉ kết quả; everyone cũng tuyệt đối hóa.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●): một câu nêu mục đích, một câu nêu kết quả.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should spend money on sport and the arts for schoolchildren rather than on professional sports and arts events. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Governments should fund sport in schools in order to encourage children to lead active lives.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that job interviews are not a reliable way to select employees. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Employers could set practical tasks during recruitment so that they can see how candidates actually perform.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that using a mobile phone in public can be as antisocial as smoking and that mobile phones should therefore be banned in certain places. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Many people talk loudly on their phones in public, which means that others cannot enjoy a quiet journey.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that we should return to older and more traditional values in order to create a better world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some communities are reviving traditional festivals as a way to strengthen social bonds.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents should be held responsible and punished when their children behave badly. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Long working hours may leave some parents unable to supervise their children properly.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that environmental problems can only be solved through international cooperation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Richer countries need to share clean technology so that poorer nations can cut their emissions too.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
