items.prompt: A 14-year-old who seriously damaged his school was ordered to clean the streets instead of being sent to prison. Community-based punishment is more appropriate than imprisonment for young offenders who commit serious crimes. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Courts could order young offenders to do community service in order to make them understand the harm they have caused.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that life on Earth may become more difficult in the future and that more money should be spent on research into living on other planets, such as Mars. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some governments fund space research with the aim of finding new places for humans to live.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that educating children at home is best for their development, while others think it is important for children to attend school. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Home-schooled children can learn in a way that suits their individual pace.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that developing countries should encourage foreign companies to invest in their economies, while others think they should support local companies instead. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Foreign investment can create jobs in developing countries, thereby raising living standards.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that environmental problems caused by technology can only be solved if people adopt a simpler way of life, while others think that further technological development can solve these problems. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Some environmental problems are so complex that technology alone cannot solve them.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that more action can be taken to reduce crime and make people feel safe, while others think that little can be done. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Community programmes aimed at keeping teenagers busy after school can help reduce crime.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents should read or tell stories to their children, while others think children should learn to read stories by themselves. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Parents should read aloud to young children so that the children develop a love of stories before they can read independently.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Children today face increasing pressure from school, society and advertising. What are the main causes of this pressure, and what can be done to reduce it?
items.answer: Constant pressure to achieve high grades can leave children unable to enjoy their childhood.

items.cue: Food and health · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: People know that certain activities are good for their health, yet many continue to follow unhealthy habits. Why does this happen, and what can be done to encourage healthier behaviour?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ mục đích, một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ kết quả.
items.answer: Many people know that exercise is good for them, but long working hours leave them unable to find the time. Employers could offer on-site gyms so that staff can exercise during breaks.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some children are taught to compete with their classmates and try to be better than them rather than to work together. Do the advantages of encouraging competition outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ mục đích, một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ kết quả.
items.answer: Competition can motivate pupils to work harder in order to outperform their classmates. However, it may become so intense that weaker students lose confidence.

items.cue: Media and communication · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Advertising has an increasing influence on people's lives. Do the positive effects of advertising outweigh the negative effects?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ mục đích, một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ kết quả.
items.answer: Advertising informs consumers about new products, which means that they can make better-informed choices. However, some adverts are designed to create needs that did not previously exist.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some workplaces try to employ equal numbers of men and women. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ mục đích, một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ kết quả.
items.answer: Some firms hire equal numbers of men and women as a way to ensure fairness. This can widen the range of perspectives in a team, thereby improving decision-making.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Ambition is an important quality for people who want to succeed in life. How important is ambition, and is it a positive or negative characteristic?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ mục đích, một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ kết quả.
items.answer: Ambition drives people to set goals and work hard so that they can achieve them. However, excessive ambition may leave some people unable to enjoy what they already have.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Two-part question
items.prompt: What are the benefits of requiring young people to serve in the armed forces? Should community service be accepted as an alternative?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ mục đích, một câu dùng cấu trúc chỉ kết quả.
items.answer: Military service can teach young people discipline, thereby preparing them for working life. Community service could achieve similar aims in a way that benefits local people directly.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Mục đích hay kết quả?
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng. Xác định câu đang nói về mục đích hay kết quả trước khi chọn.

items.cue: He saved money ( so / so that ) he could buy a house the following year.
items.answer: so that
items.note: Mục đích (dự định trong tương lai) → so that.

items.cue: It rained heavily, ( so that / so ) the match was cancelled.
items.answer: so
items.note: Kết quả, không phải mục đích → , so.

items.cue: Many people learn English ( in order to / so that ) find better jobs.
items.answer: in order to
items.note: Theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu → in order to.

items.cue: Parents work long hours ( so that / in order to ) their children can attend good schools.
items.answer: so that
items.note: Hai vế khác chủ ngữ → so that + mệnh đề.

items.cue: Students should revise ( in order to not / in order not to ) fail.
items.answer: in order not to
items.note: Phủ định đúng: in order not to.

items.cue: The city is ( so / such ) crowded that commuting takes hours.
items.answer: so
items.note: so + tính từ.

items.cue: It is ( so / such ) a crowded city that commuting takes hours.
items.answer: such
items.note: such + a + tính từ + danh từ.

items.cue: Robots are used for heavy lifting, ( thereby reducing / thereby reduce ) injuries.
items.answer: thereby reducing
items.note: Sau thereby dùng V-ing.

items.cue: Many people work from home, ( that means / which means ) that offices are emptier.
items.answer: which means
items.note: Mệnh đề quan hệ thay cho cả câu trước dùng which, sau dấu phẩy.

items.cue: The campaign was launched ( as a way to / as a way for ) encourage recycling.
items.answer: as a way to
items.note: Cụm cố định: as a way to + V.

items.cue: Many people go to the gym ( to reduce / for reducing ) stress.
items.answer: to reduce
items.note: Mục đích của hành động → to + V.

items.cue: This is a scheme aimed at ( reduce / reducing ) youth unemployment.
items.answer: reducing
items.note: Sau aimed at dùng V-ing.

items.cue: We should live ( in the way of / in a way that ) is kinder to the environment.
items.answer: in a way that
items.note: in a way that + động từ.

items.cue: Heavy traffic leaves many commuters ( unable / not able ) to arrive on time.
items.answer: unable
items.note: Cụm cố định: leave sb unable to V.

items.cue: The factory closed. ( As a result, / So that ) hundreds of workers lost their jobs.
items.answer: As a result,
items.note: Mở đầu câu mới chỉ kết quả → As a result,.

items.cue: Some firms offer bonuses ( with the aim of / with the aim to ) retaining staff.
items.answer: with the aim of
items.note: Cụm cố định: with the aim of + V-ing.

items.cue: The new policy made ( cycling become safer / cycling safer ) for commuters.
items.answer: cycling safer
items.note: make + O + tính từ; không thêm become.

items.cue: Governments should invest in education ( so as to / so as ) reduce inequality.
items.answer: so as to
items.note: Cụm đầy đủ: so as to + V.

items.cue: She left early ( in order to / so that ) she would not miss the train.
items.answer: so that
items.note: Theo sau là mệnh đề (she would not …) → so that.

items.cue: Prices rose so sharply ( so that / that ) many families cut their spending.
items.answer: that
items.note: so + trạng từ + that chỉ kết quả; không lặp lại so.

theory.html: Bài viết Task 2 thường phải nói về những điều không xảy ra, khó thực hiện hoặc chỉ đúng một phần: học sinh không đạt mục tiêu, người trẻ khó tìm việc, chính phủ không thể giải quyết mọi vấn đề. Nếu chỉ dùng cannot và difficult, câu văn vừa đơn điệu vừa dễ bị tuyệt đối hóa (Everyone cannot…, People never…).

Các cấu trúc trong bài này giúp bạn diễn đạt chính xác mức độ: not all (một số không), very few (rất ít), little or no (gần như không), struggle to (khó nhưng vẫn có thể), not necessarily (không nhất thiết). Đây chính là cách giám khảo nhận ra một lập luận chừng mực, có kiểm soát ở Band 7 (TR).
Cẩn thận với phủ định kép (There is nothing … anything, Hardly no one) và với các cấu trúc có giới từ cố định (prevent sb from V-ing, fail to V, lack + danh từ).

theory.text: Cấu trúc phủ định, khó khăn và giới hạn

cells: Hầu như không thể làm gì
There is (little or) nothing that + S + can V
There is little or nothing that the government can do to change young people's eating habits.
Many students fail to achieve their study goals.
Poor language skills prevent many students from achieving their goals.
Không phải tất cả / rất ít
not all + N; very few + N (đếm được); very little + N (không đếm được)
Not all students can achieve high scores at school.
Many people have little or no time at all for themselves.
struggle to + V; find it difficult to + V
Many university graduates struggle to find work.
Falling standards leave many children unable to read well.
require considerable effort; there is more effort involved in V-ing than in V-ing
Providing decent healthcare requires considerable effort.
lack + N (động từ); a lack of + N (danh từ)
Many rural schools lack qualified teachers.
Còn xa mới / không còn / không nhất thiết
far from + adj; no longer + V; not necessarily
A degree does not necessarily guarantee a good job.

items: There is little or nothing that the government can do to change people's eating habits overnight.
Many students fail to achieve their study goals due to poor language skills.
Poor language skills prevent many students from achieving their goals.
Not all students can afford private tutors.
Many working adults have little or no time at all for their hobbies.
There is more effort involved in searching for information in a library than on a website.
Online learning is far from perfect, especially for young children.
A university degree does not necessarily guarantee a good job.

items.bad: There is nothing that the government can do anything. GRA
items.good: There is nothing that the government can do.
items.note: Phủ định kép: nothing đã mang nghĩa phủ định, không thêm anything.

items.bad: Poor skills prevent students to achieve their goals. GRA
items.good: Poor skills prevent students from achieving their goals.
items.note: Cấu trúc cố định: prevent sb from + V-ing.

items.bad: Many students fail achieving their goals. GRA
items.good: Many students fail to achieve their goals.
items.note: fail to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.bad: Not all of students can afford private tutors. GRA
items.good: Not all students can afford private tutors.
items.note: all of chỉ dùng trước the / these / my … (not all of the students); khi nói chung, dùng not all students.

items.bad: Many rural schools lack of qualified teachers. LR
items.good: Many rural schools lack qualified teachers.
items.note: lack (động từ) đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ; a lack of chỉ dùng khi lack là danh từ.

items.bad: Everyone has no time for their families because of work. TR
items.good: Many working adults have little time for their families because of work.
items.note: Tuyệt đối hóa: everyone … no time không đúng với thực tế; dùng many và little.

items.h: few hay a few? little hay a little?
items.html: few / little = rất ít (nghĩa tiêu cực); a few / a little = một vài, một chút (nghĩa tích cực). Very few students pass ≠ A few students pass. few đi với danh từ đếm được, little với danh từ không đếm được.
lack (động từ) + tân ngữ trực tiếp: Schools lack teachers. a lack of (danh từ): There is a lack of teachers. Không viết Schools lack of teachers.
cannot là tuyệt đối; struggle to / find it difficult to cho thấy việc đó khó nhưng vẫn có thể. Chỉ dùng cannot khi điều đó thực sự không thể.
Not all students pass = có một số không đậu; No students pass = không ai đậu. Đừng biến not all thành none vì như vậy sẽ thay đổi mức độ của nhận định.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Thay *cannot* và *difficult*
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cấu trúc được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa và mức độ của câu gốc.

items.cue: Many children cannot read or write because the quality of education is falling.
items.hint: struggle to. Bắt đầu: Many children struggle …
items.answer: Many children struggle to read or write because the quality of education is falling.
items.alt: Many children find it difficult to read or write because educational standards are falling.

items.cue: The quality of education is falling, so many children cannot read or write.
items.hint: leave sb unable to. Bắt đầu: The falling quality of education …
items.answer: The falling quality of education leaves many children unable to read or write.
items.alt: Declining educational standards are leaving many children unable to read or write.

items.cue: Many students cannot achieve their study goals because of poor language skills.
items.answer: Many students fail to achieve their study goals due to poor language skills.
items.alt: Many students fail to reach their study goals because their language skills are weak.

items.cue: Poor language skills mean many students cannot achieve their goals.
items.hint: prevent sb from. Bắt đầu: Poor language skills prevent …
items.answer: Poor language skills prevent many students from achieving their goals.
items.alt: Weak language skills prevent many students from reaching their goals.

items.cue: Some students cannot get high scores at school.
items.answer: Not all students can achieve high scores at school.
items.alt: Not every student is able to achieve high grades at school.

items.cue: Many people work too much, so they do not have time for themselves.
items.answer: Many people spend so much time at work that they have little or no time at all for themselves.
items.alt: Many people work such long hours that they have little or no time for themselves.

items.cue: Some people argue that the government cannot do anything to change young people's eating habits.
items.hint: (little or) nothing that. Bắt đầu: It is argued that there is …
items.answer: It is argued that there is little or nothing that the government can do to change young people's eating habits.
items.alt: Some argue that there is little the government can do to change young people's eating habits.

items.cue: It is difficult to provide good healthcare for everyone.
items.answer: Providing good healthcare for everyone requires considerable effort.
items.alt: Ensuring good healthcare for the whole population requires considerable effort.

items.cue: It is harder to find information in a library than on a website.
items.hint: there is more effort involved in … than …
items.answer: There is more effort involved in finding information in a library than on a website.
items.alt: Finding information in a library involves more effort than finding it online.

items.cue: Many rural schools do not have enough qualified teachers.
items.answer: Many rural schools lack qualified teachers.
items.alt: There is a lack of qualified teachers in many rural schools.

items.cue: Online learning is not perfect.
items.answer: Online learning is far from perfect.
items.alt: Online learning is far from ideal.

items.cue: Many young people do not read newspapers any more.
items.answer: Many young people no longer read newspapers.
items.alt: Many young people no longer buy or read newspapers.

items.cue: Having a degree does not always mean you will get a good job.
items.answer: Having a degree does not necessarily guarantee a good job.
items.alt: A degree does not necessarily lead to a good job.

items.cue: Only a small number of people can afford to buy a house in the city centre.
items.answer: Very few people can afford to buy a house in the city centre.
items.alt: Only a small minority can afford a home in the city centre.

items.cue: Many elderly people cannot use smartphones, so they cannot access online services.
items.hint: struggle to + leave sb unable to (một câu)
items.answer: Many elderly people struggle to use smartphones, which leaves them unable to access online services.
items.alt: Many older people find smartphones difficult to use, which prevents them from accessing online services.

items.cue: Governments cannot do much about obesity because people choose what they eat.
items.answer: There is little that governments can do about obesity, since people ultimately choose what they eat.
items.alt: Governments can do little to tackle obesity, as individuals ultimately decide what they eat.

items.cue: Strict parents do not let teenagers make their own decisions, so teenagers cannot solve problems independently later.
items.answer: Overly strict parenting prevents teenagers from making their own decisions, which may leave them unable to solve problems independently later in life.
items.alt: Excessive parental control prevents teenagers from making decisions, which may leave them unable to cope with problems on their own later.

items.cue: Most people do not have the time or money to travel abroad.
items.answer: Only a minority of people have the time and money to travel abroad.
items.alt: Relatively few people have both the time and the money to travel abroad.

items.cue: It is not easy to change people's habits, and it is even harder with older people.
items.hint: require considerable effort + more effort involved
items.answer: Changing people's habits requires considerable effort, and there is even more effort involved in changing those of older people.
items.alt: Changing habits requires considerable effort, particularly among older people.

items.cue: Many people say they will exercise, but they do not do it.
items.answer: Many people intend to exercise regularly but fail to do so.
items.alt: Many people plan to exercise but fail to follow through.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Nhiều sinh viên gặp khó khăn trong việc trả tiền thuê nhà.
items.translation: Many students have difficulty paying their rent.
items.answer: Many students struggle to pay the rent.
items.alt: Many students find it difficult to pay their rent.

items.cue: Chất lượng giáo dục kém khiến nhiều trẻ không thể đọc thông thạo.
items.rewriteWith: leave sb unable to (từ khóa: poor-quality education, fluently)
items.translation: Poor education means many children cannot read fluently.
items.answer: Poor-quality education leaves many children unable to read fluently.
items.alt: Low educational standards leave many children unable to read well.

items.cue: Nhiều người không đạt được mục tiêu học tập vì thiếu động lực.
items.translation: Many people do not reach their learning goals because they lack motivation.
items.answer: Many people fail to achieve their learning goals due to a lack of motivation.
items.alt: Many learners fail to reach their goals because they lack motivation.

items.cue: Chi phí cao ngăn cản nhiều gia đình gửi con đi học đại học.
items.translation: High costs stop many families from sending their children to university.
items.answer: High costs prevent many families from sending their children to university.
items.alt: The high cost of tuition prevents many families from sending their children to university.

items.cue: Không phải học sinh nào cũng có thể học tốt môn toán.
items.translation: Not every student can study maths well.
items.answer: Not all students can do well in mathematics.
items.alt: Not every student is able to excel at mathematics.

items.cue: Nhiều người lao động có rất ít hoặc hoàn toàn không có thời gian nghỉ ngơi.
items.translation: Many workers have very little or no time to rest.
items.answer: Many workers have little or no time at all to rest.
items.alt: Many employees have little or no time for rest.

items.cue: Rất ít người trẻ quan tâm đến tin tức chính trị.
items.translation: Few young people are interested in political news.
items.answer: Very few young people are interested in political news.
items.alt: Only a small number of young people follow political news.

items.cue: Một số người cho rằng chính phủ hầu như không thể làm gì để thay đổi thói quen ăn uống của người dân.
items.translation: Some people think the government can do almost nothing to change people's eating habits.
items.answer: Some argue that there is little or nothing that the government can do to change people's eating habits.
items.alt: Some argue that there is little that the government can do to change people's eating habits.

items.cue: Việc cung cấp dịch vụ y tế tốt cho người dân đòi hỏi nỗ lực rất lớn.
items.translation: Providing good healthcare for people needs a lot of effort.
items.answer: Providing good healthcare for the public requires considerable effort.
items.alt: Ensuring decent healthcare for the population requires considerable effort.

items.cue: Nhiều trường học ở vùng nông thôn thiếu giáo viên có trình độ.
items.translation: Many schools in rural areas do not have qualified teachers.
items.answer: Many rural schools lack qualified teachers.
items.alt: There is a lack of qualified teachers in many rural schools.

items.cue: Học trực tuyến còn lâu mới hoàn hảo.
items.translation: Online learning is not perfect at all.
items.answer: Online learning is far from perfect.
items.alt: Online learning is far from ideal.

items.cue: Nhiều người không còn mua báo giấy nữa.
items.translation: Many people do not buy printed newspapers any more.
items.answer: Many people no longer buy printed newspapers.
items.alt: Printed newspapers are no longer bought by many people.

items.cue: Có bằng đại học không nhất thiết đảm bảo một công việc tốt.
items.translation: Having a university degree does not always guarantee a good job.
items.answer: A university degree does not necessarily guarantee a good job.
items.alt: Having a degree does not necessarily lead to a good job.

items.cue: Tìm thông tin trong thư viện tốn nhiều công sức hơn so với trên mạng.
items.rewriteWith: there is more effort involved in … than …
items.translation: Finding information in a library takes more effort than online.
items.answer: There is more effort involved in finding information in a library than online.
items.alt: Searching for information in a library involves more effort than searching online.

items.cue: Nhiều người cao tuổi gặp khó khăn khi dùng điện thoại thông minh, điều này khiến họ không thể tiếp cận các dịch vụ trực tuyến.
items.translation: Many elderly people have difficulty using smartphones, so they cannot access online services.
items.answer: Many elderly people struggle to use smartphones, which leaves them unable to access online services.
items.alt: Many older people find smartphones hard to use, which prevents them from accessing online services.

items.cue: Việc cha mẹ kiểm soát quá chặt ngăn cản con cái tự đưa ra quyết định.
items.translation: Parents controlling too strictly stops children from making their own decisions.
items.answer: Excessive parental control prevents children from making their own decisions.
items.alt: Overly strict parenting prevents children from making decisions for themselves.

items.cue: Nhiều người dự định tập thể dục thường xuyên nhưng lại không thực hiện được.
items.translation: Many people plan to exercise regularly but they do not do it.
items.answer: Many people intend to exercise regularly but fail to do so.
items.alt: Many people plan to exercise regularly but fail to follow through.

items.cue: Chỉ một số ít người có đủ thời gian và tiền bạc để đi du lịch nước ngoài.
items.translation: Only a few people have enough time and money to travel abroad.
items.answer: Only a minority of people have enough time and money to travel abroad.
items.alt: Relatively few people can afford the time and money to travel abroad.

items.cue: Thay đổi thói quen của người lớn tuổi đòi hỏi nhiều nỗ lực hơn so với người trẻ.
items.rewriteWith: there is more effort involved in … than in …
items.translation: Changing older people's habits needs more effort than changing young people's.
items.answer: There is more effort involved in changing the habits of older people than in changing those of younger people.
items.alt: Changing older people's habits requires more effort than changing those of the young.

items.cue: Không phải mọi công việc đều có thể làm từ xa, đặc biệt là trong ngành y tế và sản xuất.
items.translation: Not every job can be done from home, especially in healthcare and manufacturing.
items.answer: Not all jobs can be done remotely, especially in healthcare and manufacturing.
items.alt: Not every job can be carried out remotely, particularly in healthcare and manufacturing.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: There is nothing that the government can do anything to stop this.
items.answer: There is nothing that the government can do anything CAN DO to stop this.
notes: GRA Phủ định kép: nothing đã mang nghĩa phủ định.

items.cue: Poor language skills prevent many students to achieve their goals.
items.answer: Poor language skills prevent many students to achieve FROM ACHIEVING their goals.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc cố định: prevent sb from + V-ing.

items.cue: Many students fail achieving their study goals.
items.answer: Many students fail achieving FAIL TO ACHIEVE their study goals.
notes: GRA Sau fail dùng to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Many working adults have little or no time for their hobbies.
items.answer: ✓ Many working adults have little or no time for their hobbies.
notes: Đúng: little or no + danh từ không đếm được.

items.cue: Not all of students can afford private tutors.
items.answer: Not all of students NOT ALL STUDENTS can afford private tutors.
notes: GRA Khi nói chung, dùng not all + danh từ (không có of).

items.cue: Many rural schools lack of qualified teachers.
items.answer: Many rural schools lack of LACK qualified teachers.
notes: LR lack (động từ) đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ.

items.cue: Many children struggle with read and write.
items.answer: Many children struggle with read and write STRUGGLE TO READ AND WRITE.
notes: GRA struggle to + V, hoặc struggle with + V-ing.

items.cue: Everyone has no time for their families because of work.
items.answer: Everyone has no time MANY WORKING ADULTS HAVE LITTLE TIME for their families because of work.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa: không phải ai cũng hoàn toàn không có thời gian.

items.cue: Online learning is far from perfect, especially for young children.
items.answer: ✓ Online learning is far from perfect, especially for young children.
notes: Đúng: far from + tính từ.

items.cue: Hardly no one reads printed newspapers these days.
items.answer: Hardly no one HARDLY ANYONE reads printed newspapers these days.
notes: GRA Phủ định kép: hardly đã mang nghĩa phủ định → anyone.

items.cue: There is little or nothing the government can do to stop online piracy.
items.answer: ✓ There is little or nothing the government can do to stop online piracy.
notes: Đúng: There is little or nothing (that) + S + can V; có thể lược that.

items.cue: A degree does not necessary guarantee a good job.
items.answer: A degree does not necessary NECESSARILY guarantee a good job.
notes: LR Từ loại: cần trạng từ necessarily để bổ nghĩa cho động từ.

items.cue: Many people intend to exercise but fail to doing so.
items.answer: Many people intend to exercise but fail to doing so FAIL TO DO SO.
notes: GRA Sau fail to dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Many young people no longer reads newspapers.
items.answer: Many young people no longer reads READ newspapers.
notes: GRA Hòa hợp chủ – vị: young people số nhiều → read.

items.cue: Some parents seem to not educate their children about money.
items.answer: Some parents seem to not educate DO NOT SEEM TO TEACH their children about money.
notes: GRA seem to not educate không sai hẳn nhưng kém tự nhiên; trong văn viết dùng do not seem to + V.
LR teach tự nhiên hơn educate ở đây.

items.cue: Providing decent healthcare for an ageing population requires considerable effort.
items.answer: ✓ Providing decent healthcare for an ageing population requires considerable effort.
notes: Đúng: chủ ngữ V-ing + requires considerable effort.

items.cue: They have to make ends meet and unable to save any money.
items.answer: They have to make ends meet and unable to save AND ARE UNABLE TO SAVE any money.
notes: GRA Thiếu trợ động từ: vế thứ hai cần are.

items.cue: Many families are unable to have a amount of money for emergencies.
items.answer: Many families are unable to have a amount of money UNABLE TO KEEP ENOUGH MONEY for emergencies.
notes: GRA a amount sai mạo từ (an amount).
LR have an amount of money không tự nhiên → keep enough money.

items.cue: Not all jobs can be done remotely, especially in healthcare and manufacturing.
items.answer: ✓ Not all jobs can be done remotely, especially in healthcare and manufacturing.
notes: Đúng: Not all + danh từ số nhiều; mức độ chừng mực.

items.cue: The government cannot do anything about traffic, so people will always be stuck in traffic jams forever.
items.answer: The government cannot do anything about traffic CAN DO LITTLE TO ELIMINATE TRAFFIC CONGESTION ENTIRELY, so people will always be stuck in traffic jams forever MAY CONTINUE TO FACE CONGESTION.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa: chính phủ vẫn có thể làm được một số việc.
TR Phóng đại và lặp ý (always … forever); hãy dùng mức độ phù hợp.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau trong bài. Giữ mức độ nhận định chừng mực.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some children find subjects such as mathematics and philosophy too difficult. Therefore, these subjects should be optional rather than compulsory at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some children struggle to understand abstract subjects such as philosophy without extra support.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: If people could choose between a life without work and a life in which they spent most of their time working, most would choose not to work. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Not all people would choose a life without work, as many find a sense of purpose in their jobs.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that news has little connection with their daily lives and that reading newspapers or watching television news is therefore a waste of time. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Many young people no longer read newspapers, as they get their news from social media instead.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way to learn about other cultures is to work in a multinational organisation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Working in a multinational organisation is far from the only way to learn about other cultures.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Children who grow up in poor families are better prepared for the difficulties of adult life than children raised by wealthy parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Children from wealthy families may fail to develop resilience if they never face financial difficulties.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the most urgent problems in modern society can only be solved through international cooperation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: There is little that a single country can do on its own to stop climate change.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Traditional foods are increasingly being replaced by international fast food, and this has a negative effect on families and societies. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In many cities, very few young people still cook traditional dishes at home.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Society is based on rules and laws. If individuals were free to do whatever they wanted, society could not function. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Laws prevent individuals from harming others in pursuit of their own interests.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should decide which subjects students study at university, while others think students should be free to choose the subjects they prefer. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Subjects chosen by the government do not necessarily match students' interests or abilities.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Good schools and medical facilities are often concentrated in cities. Some people believe newly qualified teachers and doctors should be required to work in rural areas for a few years, while others think they should be free to choose where they work. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Many rural areas lack qualified teachers and doctors.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that radio is the best way to get news, while others think television is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Radio offers little or no visual information, so complex stories can be harder to follow.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: In some cultures, older people are highly valued, while in others, greater value is placed on youth. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Rapid technological change can leave older people unable to keep up with younger colleagues.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that members of the public should be allowed to own guns, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Regulating gun ownership effectively requires considerable effort from lawmakers and the police.

items.cue: Work · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Some businesses find that new employees lack basic interpersonal skills, such as the ability to work well with colleagues. What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.answer: Many new employees struggle to work in teams because they spent most of their school years studying alone.

items.cue: Environment · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Environmental problems are becoming more serious, but international efforts to solve them have had limited success. Why have these efforts achieved so little, and what can be done to improve the situation?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc phủ định / khó khăn / giới hạn khác nhau.
items.answer: International efforts have achieved little, as many countries fail to keep their promises. Not all nations are willing to sacrifice economic growth for environmental goals.

items.cue: Food and health · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that it would be better if people ate only food produced locally. Do the advantages of eating only local food outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc phủ định / khó khăn / giới hạn khác nhau.
items.answer: Eating only local food would leave people in cold countries unable to buy fresh fruit in winter. Very few regions can produce everything their population needs.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Consumer goods are becoming cheaper and more widely available. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc phủ định / khó khăn / giới hạn khác nhau.
items.answer: Cheaper consumer goods mean that low-income families no longer have to go without basic appliances. However, products are often so cheap that people fail to repair them and simply throw them away.

items.cue: Media and communication · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Newspapers have a strong influence on people's ideas and opinions. Why is this the case, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc phủ định / khó khăn / giới hạn khác nhau.
items.answer: Many readers lack the time to check facts themselves, so they accept what newspapers report. This is not necessarily harmful, provided that newspapers report accurately.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: More and more people are becoming interested in finding out about their family history. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc phủ định / khó khăn / giới hạn khác nhau.
items.answer: In the past, few people had easy access to historical records, but online archives have changed this. However, not all the information found online is reliable.

items.cue: Education · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some teachers believe that students learn better in groups, while others think they should study alone. What are the advantages of each approach, and which do you think is more effective?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc phủ định / khó khăn / giới hạn khác nhau.
items.answer: Group work prevents students from relying only on their own ideas. However, there is more effort involved in coordinating a group than in studying alone.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn phiên bản tốt nhất
intro: Mỗi câu có ba phiên bản của cùng một ý. Chọn phiên bản đúng ngữ pháp, đúng mức độ và phù hợp nhất với Band 7.

options.text: Many children struggle to read and write.
Many children are struggle to read and write.
All children cannot read and write.

options.text: Poor skills prevent many students from succeeding.
Poor skills prevent students to succeed.

options.text: Many students fail achieving their goals.
Many students are fail to achieve goals.
Many students fail to achieve their goals.

Not all students can afford private tutors.

options.text: There is little that governments can do to change eating habits.
There is nothing the government can do anything.

items.note: B và C dùng phủ định kép; C còn viết tắt.

options.text: Many rural schools lack of teachers.
Many rural schools lack qualified teachers.
Many rural schools have lack teachers.

items.note: A và C dùng sai lack.

options.text: Online learning is far from perfectly.
Online learning is far from perfect.

items.note: A sai từ loại; B thiếu from.

options.text: Many people have a little or no time for themselves.
Everyone has no time for themselves.
Many people have little or no time for themselves.

items.note: A dùng a little (nghĩa tích cực); B tuyệt đối hóa.

options.text: A degree doesn't guarantee a good job.
A degree never guarantees any job.
A degree does not necessarily guarantee a good job.

items.note: A viết tắt; B tuyệt đối hóa.

options.text: Very few young people read printed newspapers.
Very little young people read printed newspapers.
A few young people don't read newspapers.

items.note: B dùng little với danh từ đếm được; C đổi nghĩa và viết tắt.

options.text: Many young people no longer read newspapers.
Many young people no more read newspapers.
Many young people don't read newspapers any more longer.

items.note: B sai no more; C thừa và viết tắt.

options.text: Providing healthcare requires for considerable effort.

items.note: A thừa for; C sai chủ ngữ và hòa hợp.

options.text: Long hours leave parents unable seeing their children.
Long hours leave parents unable to see their children.
Long hours make parents unable see their children.

items.note: A sai dạng động từ; C thiếu to.

options.text: Hardly no one reads printed newspapers these days.
Hardly anyone reads printed newspapers these days.
Hardly anyone don't read printed newspapers.

items.note: A và C dùng phủ định kép.

options.text: Many people intend to exercise but fail doing it.
Many people intend exercise but they fail.
Many people intend to exercise but fail to do so.

items.note: A sai dạng động từ; B thiếu to và không rõ nghĩa.

options.text: Excessive control prevents children from making decisions.
Excessive control prevents children make decisions.
Excessive control avoids children from making decisions.

items.note: B thiếu from + V-ing; C dùng sai avoid.

options.text: Only minority people can afford travelling abroad.
Only a minority of people can afford to travel abroad.
Nobody can afford to travel abroad.

items.note: A sai cấu trúc; C tuyệt đối hóa.

options.text: There is more effort involving studying in a library than online.
It has more effort to study in a library than online.
There is more effort involved in studying in a library than online.

items.note: A sai involving; B dùng It has không tự nhiên.

options.text: All jobs cannot be done remotely.
Not all jobs can be done remotely.
Not every jobs can be done remotely.

items.note: A mơ hồ (có thể hiểu là không công việc nào); C sai số ít/số nhiều.

options.text: Some parents do not seem to teach their children about money.
Some parents seem to not educate their children about money.
Some parents don't seem teaching children money.

items.note: B (seem to not) kém tự nhiên hơn A trong văn viết; C sai cấu trúc.

theory.html: Giám khảo đánh giá cao một lập luận chừng mực: nhận định mạnh khi có cơ sở, thận trọng khi chỉ là khả năng. Ở Band 6, bài viết thường có những khái quát hóa quá mức (Technology will destroy all jobs); ở Band 7, các ý được trình bày chính xác hơn (Technology could replace some routine jobs). Động từ khuyết thiếu và các cụm giảm nhẹ (hedging) là công cụ chính để làm điều này (TR).

Mỗi động từ khuyết thiếu thể hiện một mức độ chắc chắn khác nhau: will (gần như chắc chắn), can (thường xảy ra), may / might / could (có thể xảy ra), would (kết quả giả định). must / should thể hiện nghĩa vụ hoặc lời khuyên, không phải mức độ chắc chắn.
Giảm nhẹ không có nghĩa là né tránh. Câu nêu quan điểm vẫn phải rõ ràng (I firmly agree…); chỉ các nhận định về nguyên nhân, kết quả và dự đoán mới cần mức độ phù hợp.

theory.text: Mức độ chắc chắn và cách giảm nhẹ

cells: will + V (chỉ khi có cơ sở vững chắc)
The population of many developed countries will continue to age.
Long working hours can lead to stress.
Online learning may replace some lectures.
would + V (nếu điều kiện xảy ra)
Free public transport would reduce car use.
Governments must protect children from harmful online content.
tend to + V; be more likely to + V
Young people tend to adopt new technology quickly.
to a certain extent; in many cases; arguably
To a certain extent, technology has reduced face-to-face communication.
It is likely / unlikely that + S + V
It is unlikely that the traditional classroom will disappear entirely.
many / some / a large proportion of + N (thay cho all, everyone)
A large proportion of students work part-time.

items: Air pollution can increase the risk of respiratory disease.
Online learning may replace some university lectures, but not all of them.
Free public transport would encourage some drivers to leave their cars at home.
Governments must protect endangered species before they disappear.
Children who read every day are more likely to achieve good grades.
Young people tend to adopt new technology more quickly than older people.
It is unlikely that printed books will disappear completely.
Wealth does not necessarily make people happier.

items.bad: Technology will destroy all traditional jobs. TR
items.good: Technology could replace some traditional jobs.
items.note: Tuyệt đối hóa: will + destroy + all là quá mạnh so với bằng chứng.

items.bad: Children can to learn languages quickly. GRA
items.good: Children can learn languages quickly.
items.note: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu dùng V nguyên mẫu không to.

items.bad: Students should studying financial skills. GRA
items.good: Students should study financial skills.
items.note: Sau should dùng V nguyên mẫu.

items.bad: Free public transport will definitely solve congestion. TR
items.good: Free public transport would help reduce congestion.
items.note: Một giải pháp chỉ có thể giúp giảm, không chắc chắn giải quyết; dùng would vì đây là kết quả giả định.

items.bad: People are more likely buy products recommended by friends. GRA
items.good: People are more likely to buy products recommended by friends.
items.note: Cấu trúc: be more likely to + V.

items.bad: Maybe the government should increase school funding. LR
items.good: Perhaps the government should increase school funding.
items.note: Maybe mang tính khẩu ngữ; trong văn viết học thuật dùng Perhaps hoặc một động từ khuyết thiếu.

items.html: will = gần như chắc chắn; can = có khả năng xảy ra (thường đúng nhưng không phải luôn luôn). Viết Air pollution can cause asthma, không viết will cause.
may / might / could = có thể xảy ra trong thực tế; would = kết quả giả định nếu một điều kiện xảy ra: Free transport would reduce car use (nếu được áp dụng).
must = bắt buộc, rất mạnh; should = khuyên, đề xuất. Trong Task 2, should thường phù hợp hơn; chỉ dùng must cho điều thực sự cấp thiết.
Giảm nhẹ giúp nhận định chính xác, nhưng không nên giảm nhẹ mọi câu. Một đoạn văn toàn may, might, perhaps sẽ khiến quan điểm của bạn mờ nhạt.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Điều chỉnh mức độ chắc chắn
intro: Viết lại mỗi nhận định quá tuyệt đối thành một câu có mức độ phù hợp, dùng cấu trúc được cho.

items.cue: Technology will destroy all traditional jobs.
items.answer: Technology could replace some traditional jobs.
items.alt: Technology may make some traditional jobs obsolete.

items.cue: Air pollution will cause cancer.
items.answer: Air pollution can increase the risk of cancer.
items.alt: Long-term exposure to air pollution may raise the risk of cancer.

items.cue: Young people always adopt new technology faster than older people.
items.answer: Young people tend to adopt new technology faster than older people.
items.alt: Younger people generally adopt new technology more quickly than older people.

items.cue: Children who read every day get better grades.
items.answer: Children who read every day are more likely to get better grades.
items.alt: Children who read daily tend to achieve better grades.

items.cue: Online learning will replace universities.
items.answer: Online learning may replace some university courses.
items.alt: Online learning could replace certain university courses.

items.cue: Everyone wants to live in a big city.
items.answer: Many people want to live in a big city.
items.alt: A large number of people want to live in a big city.

items.cue: Free public transport will reduce traffic congestion.
items.answer: Free public transport would help reduce traffic congestion.
items.alt: Making public transport free would ease traffic congestion to some extent.

items.cue: Video games make children violent.
items.answer: In some cases, violent video games can make children more aggressive.
items.alt: Violent video games may increase aggression in some children.

items.cue: Working from home is better for everyone.
items.answer: Working from home can benefit many employees, especially those with long commutes.
items.alt: To a certain extent, working from home is better for employees.

items.cue: The traditional classroom will disappear by 2050.
items.answer: It is unlikely that the traditional classroom will disappear entirely by 2050.
items.alt: The traditional classroom is unlikely to disappear completely by 2050.

items.cue: Endangered species will all disappear soon.
items.answer: Many endangered species may disappear unless they are protected.
items.alt: Without protection, many endangered species could disappear.

items.cue: Students must learn financial skills at school.
items.answer: Students should learn financial skills at school.
items.alt: Schools should teach students financial skills.

items.cue: Rich people are always happier than poor people.
items.answer: Rich people are not necessarily happier than poor people.
items.alt: Wealth does not necessarily make people happier.

items.cue: Social media causes depression in teenagers.
items.answer: Excessive use of social media may contribute to depression in some teenagers.
items.alt: Heavy social media use can contribute to depression among some teenagers.

items.cue: If the government bans cars from city centres, the air will be cleaner and everyone will be healthier.
items.answer: If the government banned cars from city centres, air quality would improve, which could benefit residents' health.
items.alt: Banning cars from city centres would improve air quality and could benefit many residents' health.

items.cue: Tourism destroys local culture.
items.hint: In some cases, … can + lý do
items.answer: In some cases, mass tourism can weaken local traditions, as performances are adapted to suit visitors.
items.alt: Mass tourism may weaken local traditions when they are turned into shows for visitors.

items.cue: Learning English guarantees a good job.
items.answer: Learning English does not necessarily guarantee a good job, but it makes graduates more likely to find one.
items.alt: English skills do not necessarily lead to a good job, although they improve graduates' chances.

items.cue: All teenagers spend too much time online.
items.answer: A large proportion of teenagers spend more time online than is healthy.
items.alt: Many teenagers spend an unhealthy amount of time online.

items.cue: Raising taxes on petrol will stop people from driving.
items.answer: Raising taxes on petrol would discourage some people from driving, especially for short journeys.
items.alt: Higher fuel taxes could deter some people from driving short distances.

items.cue: Older people cannot learn to use new technology.
items.answer: Older people tend to need more time to learn new technology, but many can master it with support.
items.alt: Older people may find new technology harder to learn, although many succeed with support.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Ô nhiễm không khí có thể làm tăng nguy cơ mắc bệnh hô hấp.
items.rewriteWith: can + increase the risk of (từ khóa: respiratory disease)
items.translation: Air pollution can make the risk of respiratory disease higher.
items.answer: Air pollution can increase the risk of respiratory disease.
items.alt: Air pollution may raise the risk of respiratory illness.

items.cue: Người trẻ có xu hướng mua sắm trực tuyến nhiều hơn người lớn tuổi.
items.translation: Young people usually shop online more than older people.
items.answer: Young people tend to shop online more than older people.
items.alt: Younger people are more likely to shop online than older people.

items.cue: Trẻ em đọc sách mỗi ngày có nhiều khả năng đạt kết quả học tập tốt hơn.
items.translation: Children who read every day have more chance of getting better results.
items.answer: Children who read every day are more likely to achieve better academic results.
items.alt: Children who read daily tend to achieve better results at school.

items.cue: Học trực tuyến có thể thay thế một số khóa học truyền thống.
items.translation: Online learning can replace some traditional courses.
items.answer: Online learning may replace some traditional courses.
items.alt: Online learning could replace certain traditional courses.

items.cue: Phương tiện công cộng miễn phí sẽ giúp giảm ùn tắc giao thông.
items.translation: Free public transport will help reduce traffic jams.
items.answer: Free public transport would help reduce traffic congestion.
items.alt: Making public transport free would ease congestion.

items.cue: Chính phủ phải bảo vệ trẻ em khỏi những nội dung độc hại trên mạng.
items.translation: The government has to protect children from harmful content online.
items.answer: Governments must protect children from harmful online content.
items.alt: The authorities must shield children from harmful content on the Internet.

items.cue: Nhà trường nên dạy học sinh kỹ năng quản lý tài chính.
items.translation: Schools should teach students how to manage money.
items.answer: Schools should teach students financial management skills.
items.alt: Financial management should be taught in schools.

items.cue: Khó có khả năng lớp học truyền thống sẽ hoàn toàn biến mất.
items.translation: The traditional classroom will probably not disappear completely.
items.answer: It is unlikely that the traditional classroom will disappear completely.
items.alt: The traditional classroom is unlikely to disappear entirely.

items.cue: Ở một mức độ nhất định, công nghệ đã khiến con người ít giao tiếp trực tiếp hơn.
items.translation: To some degree, technology has made people talk face to face less.
items.answer: To a certain extent, technology has made people communicate face to face less often.
items.alt: Technology has, to a certain extent, reduced face-to-face communication.

items.cue: Trong nhiều trường hợp, trò chơi điện tử có thể giúp trẻ phát triển kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề.
items.translation: Video games can often help children develop the ability to solve problems.
items.answer: In many cases, video games can help children develop problem-solving skills.
items.alt: Video games can often help children improve their problem-solving skills.

items.cue: Giàu có không nhất thiết khiến con người hạnh phúc hơn.
items.translation: Being rich does not always make people happier.
items.answer: Wealth does not necessarily make people happier.
items.alt: Being wealthy does not necessarily lead to greater happiness.

items.cue: Việc sử dụng mạng xã hội quá mức có thể góp phần gây ra trầm cảm ở một số thanh thiếu niên.
items.translation: Using social media too much can cause depression in some teenagers.
items.answer: Excessive use of social media may contribute to depression in some teenagers.
items.alt: Heavy social media use can contribute to depression among some teenagers.

items.cue: Nhiều khả năng dân số già sẽ gây áp lực lớn lên hệ thống y tế.
items.translation: An ageing population will probably put great pressure on the healthcare system.
items.answer: It is likely that an ageing population will put considerable pressure on the healthcare system.
items.alt: An ageing population is likely to place heavy demands on healthcare services.

items.cue: Một tỷ lệ lớn sinh viên làm thêm để trang trải chi phí.
items.translation: Many students work part-time to pay their costs.
items.answer: A large proportion of students work part-time to cover their expenses.
items.alt: A significant proportion of students take part-time jobs to cover their costs.

items.cue: Nếu chính phủ cấm ô tô ở trung tâm thành phố, chất lượng không khí sẽ được cải thiện.
items.translation: If the government bans cars in the city centre, the air quality will improve.
items.answer: If the government banned cars from the city centre, air quality would improve.
items.alt: Banning cars from the city centre would improve air quality.

items.cue: Du lịch đại trà, trong một số trường hợp, có thể làm suy yếu các truyền thống địa phương.
items.translation: Mass tourism can sometimes weaken local traditions.
items.answer: In some cases, mass tourism can weaken local traditions.
items.alt: Mass tourism may, in some cases, undermine local traditions.

items.cue: Học tiếng Anh không đảm bảo có việc làm tốt, nhưng giúp sinh viên có nhiều khả năng tìm được việc hơn.
items.translation: Learning English does not guarantee a good job, but it helps students find jobs more easily.
items.answer: Learning English does not necessarily guarantee a good job, but it makes graduates more likely to find one.
items.alt: English skills do not necessarily lead to a good job, although they improve graduates' chances.

items.cue: Người cao tuổi thường cần nhiều thời gian hơn để học công nghệ mới.
items.translation: Old people usually need more time to learn new technology.
items.answer: Older people tend to need more time to learn new technology.
items.alt: Older people generally take longer to learn new technology.

items.cue: Tăng thuế xăng có thể khiến một số người hạn chế lái xe cho những quãng đường ngắn.
items.translation: Increasing petrol tax can make some people drive less for short trips.
items.answer: Raising fuel taxes could discourage some people from driving short distances.
items.alt: Higher fuel taxes may deter some people from using their cars for short journeys.

items.cue: Có thể lập luận rằng các vận động viên chuyên nghiệp được trả lương quá cao.
items.translation: We can argue that professional athletes are paid too much.
items.answer: Professional athletes are arguably overpaid.
items.alt: It could be argued that professional athletes are overpaid.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Technology will destroy all traditional jobs in the future.
items.answer: Technology will destroy all traditional jobs COULD REPLACE SOME TRADITIONAL JOBS in the future.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa: dùng could và some để nhận định chừng mực.

items.cue: Children can to learn languages faster than adults.
items.answer: Children can to learn CAN LEARN languages faster than adults.
notes: GRA Sau động từ khuyết thiếu dùng V nguyên mẫu không to.

items.cue: Students should studying financial skills at school.
items.answer: Students should studying SHOULD STUDY financial skills at school.
notes: GRA Sau should dùng V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Young people tend to adopt new technology more quickly than older people.
items.answer: ✓ Young people tend to adopt new technology more quickly than older people.
notes: Đúng: tend to thể hiện xu hướng, không tuyệt đối.

items.cue: People are more likely buy products recommended by influencers.
items.answer: People are more likely buy MORE LIKELY TO BUY products recommended by influencers.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc: be more likely to + V.

items.cue: Free public transport will definitely solve the problem of congestion.
items.answer: Free public transport will definitely solve the problem of congestion WOULD HELP REDUCE CONGESTION.
notes: TR Phóng đại hiệu quả của giải pháp; đây là kết quả giả định nên dùng would.

items.cue: Maybe the government should increase funding for schools.
items.answer: Maybe PERHAPS the government should increase funding for schools.
notes: LR Maybe mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: It is unlikely that printed books will disappear completely.
items.answer: ✓ It is unlikely that printed books will disappear completely.
notes: Đúng: It is unlikely that + mệnh đề.

items.cue: Everyone who plays video games becomes violent.
items.answer: Everyone who plays video games becomes violent. VIOLENT VIDEO GAMES MAY INCREASE AGGRESSION IN SOME CHILDREN.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa: không phải ai chơi game cũng trở nên bạo lực.

items.cue: Governments must to protect endangered species.
items.answer: Governments must to protect MUST PROTECT endangered species.
notes: GRA Sau must dùng V nguyên mẫu không to.

items.cue: Social media always causes depression among teenagers.
items.answer: Social media always causes depression among teenagers MAY CONTRIBUTE TO DEPRESSION AMONG SOME TEENAGERS.
notes: TR always tuyệt đối hóa một mối liên hệ chỉ có thể xảy ra.

items.cue: To a certain extent, working from home improves employees' well-being.
items.answer: ✓ To a certain extent, working from home improves employees' well-being.
notes: Đúng: To a certain extent giảm nhẹ nhận định một cách hợp lý.

items.cue: If the government banned cars, the air will be cleaner.
items.answer: If the government banned cars, the air will be WOULD BE cleaner.
notes: GRA Câu điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, … would + V.

items.cue: Rich people are definitely happier than poor people.
items.answer: Rich people are definitely happier than ARE NOT NECESSARILY HAPPIER THAN poor people.
notes: TR Không có cơ sở cho nhận định definitely.

items.cue: Air pollution will cause cancer for all city residents.
items.answer: Air pollution will cause cancer for all city residents CAN INCREASE THE RISK OF CANCER AMONG CITY RESIDENTS.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa cả mức độ (will) lẫn phạm vi (all).

items.cue: Raising fuel taxes would discourage some people from driving short distances.
items.answer: ✓ Raising fuel taxes would discourage some people from driving short distances.
notes: Đúng: would cho kết quả giả định; some giới hạn phạm vi.

items.cue: Older people never can use smartphones.
items.answer: Older people never can use MAY STRUGGLE TO USE smartphones.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (never) và sai trật tự từ; dùng may struggle to.

items.cue: It is likely that the population will continued to age.
items.answer: It is likely that the population will continued WILL CONTINUE to age.
notes: GRA Sau will dùng V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: A large proportion of students work part-time to cover their living costs.
items.answer: ✓ A large proportion of students work part-time to cover their living costs.
notes: Đúng: a large proportion of thay cho all students.

items.cue: Learning English will guarantee everyone a good job, so all students must study it.
items.answer: Learning English will guarantee everyone a good job CAN IMPROVE GRADUATES' JOB PROSPECTS, so all students must study it SO SCHOOLS SHOULD GIVE IT PRIORITY.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa kết quả (guarantee, everyone).
TR Kết luận quá mạnh (all, must); dùng should cho lời đề xuất.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp. Không tuyệt đối hóa.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The traditional classroom, in which a teacher teaches a group of students, will no longer exist by the year 2050. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is unlikely that the traditional classroom will disappear entirely by 2050, as young children need direct supervision.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: With the increasing use of mobile phones and computers, the traditional skill of writing letters may disappear. To what extent do you agree or disagree, and how important is letter writing today?
items.answer: Letter writing may become less common, but it is unlikely to disappear completely.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Leaders and directors of organisations are often older people. Some people believe that younger people can be equally effective leaders. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Younger people can be effective leaders, especially in fast-changing industries such as technology.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The spread of English as a global language will bring more advantages than disadvantages. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Countries where English is widely spoken tend to attract more international business.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way to reduce poverty in developing countries is to provide all children with six years of free education so that they can read, write and use numbers. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Six years of free education would give many children the basic literacy they need to find work.

items.cue: Traffic · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way for governments to reduce traffic congestion in cities is to provide free public transport 24 hours a day, seven days a week. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Free public transport would encourage some drivers to leave their cars at home.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People work for many different reasons. Some people believe that money is the most important reason. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Many people work mainly for money, but others value job satisfaction just as highly.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The news media focus more on problems and emergencies than on positive developments, and this is harmful to individuals and society. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Constant reports of disasters can make some viewers anxious about the world.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that computers and the Internet are more important than schools and teachers in children's education, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Children who learn with a teacher are more likely to stay motivated than those who study only online.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that playing computer games is harmful to children, while others think that it can have positive effects. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: In some cases, computer games can improve children's problem-solving skills.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that hosting international sporting events such as the Olympic Games is beneficial, while others think it is a waste of money. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Hosting the Olympic Games could boost tourism, but the costs may outweigh the benefits for smaller economies.

items.cue: Ethics · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that using animals in scientific experiments is cruel, while others think it is necessary for scientific progress. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: If animals are used in experiments, scientists must keep their suffering to a minimum.

items.cue: City development · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that living in large cities is becoming more difficult, while others think it is becoming easier. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: To a certain extent, technology has made city life easier, although housing has become less affordable.

items.cue: Environment · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Natural resources such as oil, forests and fresh water are being consumed at an alarming rate. What problems does this cause, and what measures can be taken to solve them?
items.answer: It is likely that fresh water shortages will become more common if current consumption continues.

items.cue: Population · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In some countries, an increasing proportion of the population is aged 15 or younger. What are the current and future effects of this trend on these countries?
items.hint: Hai câu: một lợi ích và một hạn chế, mỗi câu có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp.
items.answer: A young population may provide a large future workforce. However, it could also put pressure on schools if governments fail to invest in education.

items.cue: Media and communication · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: The use of mobile phones can create social, medical and technical problems. Do these problems outweigh the benefits of mobile phones?
items.hint: Hai câu: một lợi ích và một hạn chế, mỗi câu có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp.
items.answer: Excessive phone use can disrupt sleep, especially among teenagers. Nevertheless, these problems are unlikely to outweigh the benefits of instant communication.

items.cue: Environment · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: The growing global demand for oil and gas has led to exploration in remote and previously untouched natural areas. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: một lợi ích và một hạn chế, mỗi câu có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp.
items.answer: Oil exploration in remote areas may create jobs and lower fuel prices. However, it could cause irreversible damage to fragile ecosystems.

items.cue: Population · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: In the future, the proportion of older people is expected to be higher than the proportion of young people in many countries. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một lợi ích và một hạn chế, mỗi câu có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp.
items.answer: An ageing population is likely to increase healthcare costs. However, older people who remain active can contribute to society for longer.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: It has become easier and more affordable for people to travel to other countries. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một lợi ích và một hạn chế, mỗi câu có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp.
items.answer: Cheaper travel tends to make people more open to other cultures. However, it may also increase carbon emissions considerably.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Two-part question
items.prompt: As economies develop, people in some developing countries become happier, while people in some developed countries become less happy. Why might this happen, and what lessons can be learned from it?
items.hint: Hai câu: một nguyên nhân và một bài học rút ra, mỗi câu có mức độ chắc chắn phù hợp.
items.answer: People in developing countries may become happier as their basic needs are met. In wealthier countries, however, further income growth tends to bring smaller gains in happiness, which suggests that governments should not rely on economic growth alone.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn mức độ phù hợp
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng ngữ pháp và đúng mức độ chắc chắn.

items.cue: Air pollution ( can / will ) increase the risk of asthma.
items.answer: can
items.note: Đây là khả năng thường gặp, không chắc chắn với mọi người → can.

items.cue: Children ( tend to / tend ) learn languages more easily than adults.
items.answer: tend to
items.note: Cấu trúc: tend to + V.

items.cue: If public transport were free, more people ( would / will ) use it.
items.answer: would
items.note: Câu điều kiện giả định → would.

items.cue: Students ( should to / should ) revise regularly.
items.answer: should
items.note: Sau should dùng V nguyên mẫu không to.

items.cue: Online courses ( maybe / may ) replace some lectures.
items.answer: may
items.note: may là động từ khuyết thiếu; maybe là trạng từ khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: People who exercise are ( more likely to / more likely ) live longer.
items.answer: more likely to
items.note: Cấu trúc: be more likely to + V.

items.cue: ( Many / All ) teenagers spend several hours online every day.
items.answer: Many
items.note: All tuyệt đối hóa; Many đúng mức độ.

items.cue: It is ( unlikely / unlikelihood ) that printed books will disappear.
items.answer: unlikely
items.note: Sau It is cần tính từ.

items.cue: Governments ( must to / must ) act quickly to protect endangered species.
items.answer: must
items.note: Sau must dùng V nguyên mẫu không to.

items.cue: Wealth does not ( necessarily / necessary ) bring happiness.
items.answer: necessarily
items.note: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ.

items.cue: If the government banned cars, the air ( will be / would be ) cleaner.
items.answer: would be
items.note: Câu điều kiện loại 2 → would.

items.cue: Social media ( contributes definitely / may contribute ) to anxiety among some teenagers.
items.answer: may contribute
items.note: Mối liên hệ chỉ có thể xảy ra → may.

items.cue: ( Absolutely, / To a certain extent, ) technology has reduced face-to-face communication.
items.answer: To a certain extent,
items.note: Giảm nhẹ hợp lý; Absolutely mang tính khẩu ngữ và tuyệt đối.

items.cue: ( It is likely / It is likely that ) the population will continue to age.
items.answer: It is likely that
items.note: Cấu trúc: It is likely that + mệnh đề.

items.cue: Smoking ( will always / can ) damage the lungs.
items.answer: can
items.note: will always tuyệt đối hóa.

items.cue: A ( large amount / large proportion ) of students work part-time.
items.answer: large proportion
items.note: amount dùng với danh từ không đếm được; với người dùng proportion / number.

items.cue: ( Perhaps / Maybe ) the most effective solution is education.
items.answer: Perhaps
items.note: Maybe mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Video games ( can improve / always improve ) problem-solving skills.
items.answer: can improve
items.note: always tuyệt đối hóa.

items.cue: Professional athletes are ( arguable / arguably ) overpaid.
items.answer: arguably
items.note: Cần trạng từ arguably.

items.cue: As birth rates remain low, the populations of many developed countries ( will / might not ) continue to age in the coming decades.
items.answer: will
items.note: Xu hướng có cơ sở vững chắc; might not trái với dữ kiện.

theory.html: Rất nhiều đề Task 2 nói về sự thay đổi theo thời gian: điều gì đã từng như thế nào, hiện nay ra sao, và tương lai có thể thế nào. Để mô tả chính xác, bạn cần ba nhóm công cụ: cụm từ chỉ thời gian (quá khứ, hiện tại, tương lai), thì động từ phù hợp (đặc biệt là hiện tại hoàn thành với in recent years), và động từ chỉ sự thay đổi (transform, have a profound impact on).
Lỗi phổ biến nhất của người Việt là dùng nowadays như tính từ (the nowadays young people) và dùng quá khứ đơn với in recent years. Cả hai đều làm giảm điểm GRA và LR.
Khi nói về thay đổi, hãy tránh tuyệt đối hóa: Technology has changed everything completely yếu hơn nhiều so với Technology has transformed many aspects of daily life.

theory.text: Thời gian và sự thay đổi

cells: Children who learn to cook will benefit later in life.
in years to come; in the coming decades
In years to come, AI may replace many office jobs.
traditionally; historically; in the past; used to + V
Traditionally, several generations lived under one roof.
throughout history; throughout the history of + N
Throughout history, people have used animals for transport.
nowadays; these days; today; today's + N
Today's children spend more time online.
in recent years; over the past few decades + hiện tại hoàn thành
In recent years, house prices have risen sharply.
Young people are becoming increasingly independent.
transform; revolutionise; have a profound impact on; alter
The Internet has transformed the way we work.
Sự xuất hiện của cái mới
With the advent of smartphones, communication has changed dramatically.
Không còn / đang diễn ra / đi kèm
no longer + V; be under way; With + N + come(s) + N
With the growth of tourism comes greater pressure on the environment.

items: Today's children are more familiar with technology than their parents were.
In recent years, the number of cars on the roads has increased significantly.
Traditionally, families ate together every evening.
People no longer write letters; they send emails instead.
With the advent of smartphones, the way people communicate has changed dramatically.
Technology has had a profound impact on the way young people learn.
Children who read widely are more likely to be successful as adults.
In the coming decades, automation may eliminate many jobs while creating new ones.

items.bad: The nowadays young people spend hours online. LR
items.good: Today's young people spend hours online.
items.note: nowadays là trạng từ, không đứng trước danh từ; dùng today's + danh từ.

items.bad: In recent years, the number of cars increased. GRA
items.good: In recent years, the number of cars has increased.
items.note: In recent years / over the past few decades đi với thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.bad: People used to living in extended families. GRA
items.good: People used to live in extended families.
items.note: used to + V nguyên mẫu (thói quen trong quá khứ).

items.bad: Children are more and more become independent. GRA
items.good: Children are becoming increasingly independent.
items.note: Cấu trúc xu hướng: be becoming increasingly + tính từ.

items.bad: Construction of the new airport is on the way. LR
items.good: Construction of the new airport is under way.
items.note: under way = đang được tiến hành; on the way = đang trên đường đến.

items.bad: Technology has changed everything in our life completely. TR
items.good: Technology has transformed many aspects of daily life.
items.note: Tuyệt đối hóa (everything, completely); hãy nói rõ phạm vi thay đổi.

items.html: nowadays, these days, today là trạng từ, đứng đầu hoặc cuối câu: Nowadays, many people …. Khi cần đứng trước danh từ, dùng today's: today's children. Không viết the nowadays children.

items.h: Hiện tại hoàn thành hay quá khứ đơn?
items.html: In recent years / over the past few decades / since 2000 + hiện tại hoàn thành (has increased). In 1990 / in the past / ten years ago + quá khứ đơn (increased).

items.h: used to V hay be used to V-ing?
items.html: used to + V = thói quen trong quá khứ (People used to write letters); be used to + V-ing = đã quen với (Young people are used to using smartphones).
Trong cấu trúc đảo With + N + come(s) + N, động từ hòa hợp với danh từ đứng sau nó: With tourism comes pressure (số ít); With technology come new concerns (số nhiều).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại với cụm từ chỉ thời gian và thay đổi
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cụm từ hoặc cấu trúc được cho. Chú ý chọn thì động từ phù hợp.

items.cue: Nowadays children spend more time online.
items.answer: Today's children spend more time online.
items.alt: Children today spend more time online.

items.cue: People used to write letters. Now they send emails.
items.answer: People no longer write letters; they send emails instead.
