items.alt: People no longer send letters; they email instead.

items.cue: The number of cars on the roads went up a lot recently.
items.hint: In recent years + hiện tại hoàn thành
items.answer: In recent years, the number of cars on the roads has increased significantly.
items.alt: Over the past few years, the number of cars on the roads has risen considerably.

items.cue: Children who learn to cook will benefit when they are adults.
items.answer: Children who learn to cook will benefit later in life.
items.alt: Children who learn to cook will benefit as adults.

items.cue: In the past, families ate together every evening.
items.answer: Traditionally, families ate together every evening.
items.alt: Families traditionally ate together every evening.

items.cue: The Internet changed the way we work a lot.
items.answer: The Internet has transformed the way we work.
items.alt: The Internet has revolutionised the way we work.

items.cue: Smartphones appeared, and people started to communicate differently.
items.answer: With the advent of smartphones, the way people communicate has changed dramatically.
items.alt: The advent of smartphones has transformed the way people communicate.

items.cue: Many people now work from home.
items.answer: These days, many people work from home.
items.alt: Many people work from home these days.

items.cue: Young people are becoming more independent.
items.answer: Young people are becoming increasingly independent.
items.alt: Young people are growing increasingly independent.

items.cue: Climate change may cause more serious problems in the future.
items.answer: Climate change may cause more serious problems in years to come.
items.alt: In years to come, climate change may cause more serious problems.

items.cue: The government is now building a new airport.
items.answer: Construction of a new airport is under way.
items.alt: Work on a new airport is currently under way.

items.cue: Over many centuries, people have used animals for transport.
items.answer: Throughout history, people have used animals for transport.
items.alt: Throughout the history of humankind, animals have been used for transport.

items.cue: Tourism has grown, and pressure on the environment has grown too.
items.answer: With the growth of tourism comes greater pressure on the environment.
items.alt: With the growth of tourism come increasing pressures on the environment.

items.cue: Technology has changed the way young people learn very deeply.
items.answer: Technology has had a profound impact on the way young people learn.
items.alt: Technology has transformed the way young people learn.

items.cue: In the past, people wrote letters by hand. Now most people type messages on their phones.
items.answer: Whereas people traditionally wrote letters by hand, most now type messages on their phones.
items.alt: People used to write letters by hand, but most now type messages on their phones.

items.cue: Over the last thirty years, cities grew very fast, and many green spaces disappeared.
items.hint: Over the past few decades + hiện tại hoàn thành
items.answer: Over the past few decades, cities have grown rapidly, and many green spaces have disappeared.
items.alt: In recent decades, rapid urban growth has led to the loss of many green spaces.

items.cue: When children grow up, those who read a lot are usually more successful.
items.answer: Children who read widely are more likely to be successful as adults.
items.alt: Children who read a great deal tend to be more successful later in life.

items.cue: The way people shop is changing completely because of online stores.
items.answer: Online stores are revolutionising the way people shop.
items.alt: Online retail is transforming the way people shop.

items.cue: People do not need cash as much now because mobile payment exists.
items.hint: With the advent of + no longer
items.answer: With the advent of mobile payment, many people no longer need to carry cash.
items.alt: The advent of mobile payment means that many people no longer carry cash.

items.cue: In the future, many jobs may disappear because of automation, and new jobs may appear.
items.answer: In the coming decades, automation may eliminate many jobs while creating new ones.
items.alt: In years to come, automation may replace many jobs but also create new types of work.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Trẻ em ngày nay dành nhiều thời gian trước màn hình hơn.
items.translation: Children nowadays spend more time in front of screens.
items.answer: Today's children spend more time in front of screens.
items.alt: Children today spend more time in front of screens.

items.cue: Mọi người không còn viết thư tay nữa.
items.translation: People do not write letters by hand any more.
items.answer: People no longer write letters by hand.
items.alt: Letters are no longer written by hand.

items.cue: Trong những năm gần đây, giá nhà đã tăng mạnh.
items.rewriteWith: In recent years + hiện tại hoàn thành (từ khóa: sharply)
items.translation: House prices have gone up a lot recently.
items.answer: In recent years, house prices have risen sharply.
items.alt: House prices have risen sharply in recent years.

items.cue: Kỹ năng nấu ăn sẽ có ích cho trẻ khi chúng trưởng thành.
items.translation: Cooking skills will be useful for children when they grow up.
items.answer: Cooking skills will benefit children later in life.
items.alt: Children with cooking skills will benefit as adults.

items.cue: Theo truyền thống, nhiều thế hệ sống chung dưới một mái nhà.
items.translation: In the past, many generations lived together in one house.
items.answer: Traditionally, several generations lived under one roof.
items.alt: Several generations traditionally lived together in one household.

items.cue: Internet đã thay đổi hoàn toàn cách chúng ta học tập.
items.translation: The Internet has completely changed the way we study.
items.answer: The Internet has transformed the way we learn.
items.alt: The Internet has revolutionised the way we learn.

items.cue: Ngày nay, nhiều người làm việc tại nhà.
items.translation: Today, many people work at home.
items.answer: These days, many people work from home.
items.alt: Nowadays, many people work from home.

items.cue: Người trẻ ngày càng trở nên độc lập hơn về tài chính.
items.translation: Young people are more and more financially independent.
items.answer: Young people are becoming increasingly financially independent.
items.alt: Young people are increasingly able to support themselves financially.

items.cue: Trong nhiều thập kỷ qua, các thành phố đã mở rộng nhanh chóng.
items.translation: Cities have grown quickly in the last few decades.
items.answer: Over the past few decades, cities have expanded rapidly.
items.alt: Cities have grown rapidly in recent decades.

items.cue: Với sự ra đời của điện thoại thông minh, cách chúng ta giao tiếp đã thay đổi đáng kể.
items.translation: Because smartphones appeared, the way we communicate has changed a lot.
items.answer: With the advent of smartphones, the way we communicate has changed considerably.
items.alt: The advent of smartphones has considerably changed the way we communicate.

items.cue: Trong những năm tới, trí tuệ nhân tạo có thể thay thế nhiều công việc văn phòng.
items.translation: Artificial intelligence may replace many office jobs in the future.
items.answer: In years to come, artificial intelligence may replace many office jobs.
items.alt: In the coming years, AI could take over many office jobs.

items.cue: Trước đây, mọi người thường đi bộ hoặc đạp xe đến chỗ làm.
items.translation: In the past, people often walked or cycled to work.
items.answer: People used to walk or cycle to work.
items.alt: Traditionally, people walked or cycled to work.

items.cue: Một dự án cải tạo các tòa nhà cổ đang được tiến hành.
items.translation: A project to renovate old buildings is being carried out.
items.answer: A project to restore old buildings is under way.
items.alt: Work to restore historic buildings is under way.

items.cue: Cùng với sự phát triển của công nghệ là những mối lo ngại mới về quyền riêng tư.
items.translation: Together with the development of technology, there are new concerns about privacy.
items.answer: With the development of technology come new concerns about privacy.
items.alt: The development of technology has brought new concerns about privacy.

items.cue: Trong suốt lịch sử loài người, con người đã sử dụng động vật làm thức ăn và quần áo.
items.translation: During human history, people have used animals for food and clothes.
items.answer: Throughout the history of humankind, people have used animals for food and clothing.
items.alt: Throughout history, animals have been used for food and clothing.

items.cue: Trong khi trước đây người ta mua sắm ở chợ, ngày nay nhiều người mua hàng trực tuyến.
items.translation: In the past people shopped at markets, but today many people buy things online.
items.answer: Whereas people traditionally shopped at markets, many now buy goods online.
items.alt: People used to shop at markets, but many now buy goods online.

items.cue: Mạng xã hội đã có tác động sâu sắc đến cách giới trẻ nhìn nhận bản thân.
items.translation: Social media has deeply affected how young people see themselves.
items.answer: Social media has had a profound impact on how young people see themselves.
items.alt: Social media has transformed the way young people see themselves.

items.cue: Những đứa trẻ được khuyến khích đọc sách có nhiều khả năng thành công hơn khi trưởng thành.
items.translation: Children who are encouraged to read are more likely to succeed when they grow up.
items.answer: Children who are encouraged to read are more likely to succeed as adults.
items.alt: Children encouraged to read tend to be more successful later in life.

items.cue: Với sự ra đời của thanh toán di động, nhiều người không còn mang theo tiền mặt.
items.translation: Because of mobile payment, many people do not carry cash any more.
items.answer: With the advent of mobile payment, many people no longer carry cash.
items.alt: Since mobile payment became available, many people have stopped carrying cash.

items.cue: Trong những thập kỷ tới, dân số già có thể tạo áp lực lớn lên hệ thống lương hưu.
items.translation: In the next decades, the ageing population may put a lot of pressure on pension systems.
items.answer: In the coming decades, an ageing population may put heavy pressure on pension systems.
items.alt: In years to come, an ageing population could place a heavy burden on pension systems.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: The nowadays young people spend hours on social media.
items.answer: The nowadays young people TODAY'S YOUNG PEOPLE spend hours on social media.
notes: LR nowadays là trạng từ, không đứng trước danh từ.

items.cue: In recent years, the number of cars increased sharply.
items.answer: In recent years, the number of cars increased HAS INCREASED sharply.
notes: GRA In recent years đi với thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: People used to living in extended families.
items.answer: People used to living USED TO LIVE in extended families.
notes: GRA used to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Today's children are more familiar with technology than their parents were.
items.answer: ✓ Today's children are more familiar with technology than their parents were.
notes: Đúng: today's + danh từ.

items.cue: Children are more and more become independent.
items.answer: Children are more and more become independent ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY INDEPENDENT.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc xu hướng: be becoming increasingly + tính từ.

items.cue: Nowadays, people are no longer write letters by hand.
items.answer: Nowadays, people are no longer write NO LONGER WRITE letters by hand.
notes: GRA no longer + động từ thường; thừa are.

items.cue: Cooking skills will help children later of life.
items.answer: Cooking skills will help children later of life LATER IN LIFE.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: later in life.

items.cue: Over the past few decades, technology changes our lives.
items.answer: Over the past few decades, technology changes HAS CHANGED our lives.
notes: GRA Over the past few decades đi với hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: With the advent of smartphones, the way people communicate has changed dramatically.
items.answer: ✓ With the advent of smartphones, the way people communicate has changed dramatically.
notes: Đúng: With the advent of + danh từ; hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: Technology has changed everything in our life completely.
items.answer: Technology has changed everything in our life completely HAS TRANSFORMED MANY ASPECTS OF DAILY LIFE.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (everything, completely).

items.cue: Young people today are used to shop online.
items.answer: Young people today are used to shop ARE USED TO SHOPPING online.
notes: GRA be used to + V-ing (đã quen với).

items.cue: Traditionally, people lived in villages and worked on farms.
items.answer: ✓ Traditionally, people lived in villages and worked on farms.
notes: Đúng: Traditionally + quá khứ đơn.

items.cue: Construction of the new airport is on the way.
items.answer: Construction of the new airport is on the way UNDER WAY.
notes: LR under way = đang được tiến hành.

items.cue: The Internet has had a profound impact to the way we learn.
items.answer: The Internet has had a profound impact to IMPACT ON the way we learn.
notes: LR Giới từ đi kèm: an impact on sth.

items.cue: With the growth of tourism come greater pressure on the environment.
items.answer: With the growth of tourism come COMES greater pressure on the environment.
notes: GRA Động từ hòa hợp với danh từ đứng sau (greater pressure, số ít).

items.cue: In years to come, artificial intelligence may replace many routine office jobs.
items.answer: ✓ In years to come, artificial intelligence may replace many routine office jobs.
notes: Đúng: In years to come + may cho dự đoán chừng mực.

items.cue: In the past, families eat together every evening, but now they rarely do.
items.answer: In the past, families eat ATE together every evening, but now they rarely do.
notes: GRA In the past đi với quá khứ đơn.

items.cue: Throughout the history, people have used animals for transport.
items.answer: Throughout the history, THROUGHOUT HISTORY, people have used animals for transport.
notes: GRA history nói chung không dùng the (trừ khi có of: the history of …).

items.cue: Over the past few decades, cities have expanded rapidly, and many green spaces have disappeared.
items.answer: ✓ Over the past few decades, cities have expanded rapidly, and many green spaces have disappeared.
notes: Đúng: hiện tại hoàn thành với over the past few decades.

items.cue: In the future, all jobs will be done by robots and humans will no longer need to work.
items.answer: In the future, all jobs will be done by robots and humans will no longer need to work MANY ROUTINE JOBS MAY BE AUTOMATED, WHILE NEW TYPES OF WORK EMERGE.
notes: TR Dự đoán tuyệt đối hóa; dùng many và may.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cụm từ được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) mô tả sự thay đổi theo thời gian. Chú ý thì động từ.

items.cue: Art and museums · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Advances in technology have made television and other screens so realistic that people no longer need to attend live performances. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Many people no longer attend concerts in person, as they can watch high-quality recordings at home.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: More and more people are using computers and other electronic devices to access information. Therefore, printed books, magazines and newspapers are no longer necessary. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: These days, many people read news on their phones rather than in printed newspapers.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: More and more people use mobile phones and the Internet to communicate, and some people believe this is reducing their ability to communicate face to face. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: In recent years + hiện tại hoàn thành
items.answer: In recent years, messaging apps have replaced many face-to-face conversations.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People's shopping habits are influenced more by their age than by any other factor. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Today's older shoppers are increasingly comfortable buying goods online.

items.cue: Ethics · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: In the modern world, it is no longer necessary to use animals for food, clothing or medicine. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Traditionally, animals were essential for food, clothing and transport.

items.cue: Climate · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The international community must take immediate action to ensure that all countries reduce their use of fossil fuels such as oil and gas. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In the coming decades, countries that rely on fossil fuels may face serious energy shortages.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Governments should spend more money on building new homes and roads than on restoring old buildings. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Historically, old buildings have been central to a city's identity.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: University students spend most of their time studying, but they should also take part in other activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Students who take part in clubs and voluntary work often benefit from these experiences later in life.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Scientific and technological advances have greatly changed the range and quality of the food we eat. Some people see this as an improvement, while others believe these changes are harmful. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Scientific advances have had a profound impact on the variety of food available in supermarkets.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Shops and products are becoming increasingly similar in different parts of the world. Some people see this as a positive development, while others see it as a negative one. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: With the advent of global brands, shopping streets in different countries now look very similar.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that studying history has little value, while others think that learning about the past helps us understand the present. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: People used to learn about history mainly from books, but many now learn from documentaries and online videos.

items.cue: City development · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that cities should develop vertically, with people living and working in tall buildings, while others think cities should develop horizontally, with fewer high-rise buildings. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Land in city centres is becoming increasingly expensive, which encourages developers to build upwards.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that tourism can destroy local cultural traditions, while others think that tourism is the only way to preserve these traditions. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: With the growth of tourism comes a greater risk that traditions will be turned into commercial performances.

items.cue: Food and health · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Health experts say that walking is one of the best forms of exercise, yet people are walking less than in the past. Why is this happening, and what can be done to encourage people to walk more?
items.answer: Over the past few decades, car ownership has risen, and people have started walking less.

items.cue: Traffic · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many places, fewer people are using bicycles as their main form of transport. Why is this happening, and what can be done to encourage more people to cycle?
items.hint: Hai câu mô tả sự thay đổi: dùng ít nhất một cụm từ chỉ thời gian và một động từ chỉ thay đổi.
items.answer: Over the past few decades, many cities have been redesigned around cars, making cycling less safe. In years to come, more cycle lanes could encourage people to return to bicycles.

items.cue: Food and health · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: People can now buy food from many different parts of the world, and as a result they often eat imported food instead of locally produced food. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu mô tả sự thay đổi: dùng ít nhất một cụm từ chỉ thời gian và một động từ chỉ thay đổi.
items.answer: Thanks to modern transport, consumers today can buy fresh produce from all over the world. However, this has had a profound impact on local farmers, who struggle to compete.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some countries, university students move away from home to study in another city. Do the disadvantages of living away from home outweigh the advantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: dùng ít nhất một cụm từ chỉ thời gian (later in life, these days, nowadays …).
items.answer: Students who live away from home learn to manage money and time, skills that benefit them later in life. Nowadays, however, the high cost of rent makes this option less affordable.

items.cue: Language · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Fewer people today write by hand than in the past. Why is this the case, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu mô tả sự thay đổi: dùng ít nhất một cụm từ chỉ thời gian và một động từ chỉ thay đổi.
items.answer: With the advent of computers and smartphones, fewer people now write by hand. This is not necessarily negative, but children may no longer develop neat handwriting.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Many children today spend more time playing computer games and less time doing sports. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu mô tả sự thay đổi: dùng ít nhất một cụm từ chỉ thời gian và một động từ chỉ thay đổi.
items.answer: Today's children spend more of their free time on computer games than previous generations did. In the long term, this may lead to health problems.

items.cue: Traffic · Two-part question
items.prompt: In some cities, people are choosing cars instead of bicycles, while in others, bicycles are replacing cars. Why are these different trends occurring, and which development do you think is better?
items.hint: Hai câu mô tả sự thay đổi: dùng ít nhất một cụm từ chỉ thời gian và một động từ chỉ thay đổi.
items.answer: In fast-growing cities, rising incomes have allowed more people to buy cars. By contrast, some wealthy cities have built cycle lanes in recent years, encouraging residents to return to bicycles.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn cụm từ thời gian đúng
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng.

items.cue: ( Today's / The nowadays ) children spend hours online.
items.answer: Today's
items.note: nowadays là trạng từ, không đứng trước danh từ.

items.cue: ( The these days / These days, ) many people work from home.
items.answer: These days,
items.note: These days là trạng từ, không có the.

items.cue: Many young people ( no longer / no more ) read newspapers.
items.answer: no longer
items.note: no longer + động từ = không còn làm gì nữa.

items.cue: In recent years, house prices ( have risen / rose ) sharply.
items.answer: have risen
items.note: In recent years + hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: In 1990, few people ( owned / have owned ) a mobile phone.
items.answer: owned
items.note: Mốc thời gian quá khứ cụ thể → quá khứ đơn.

items.cue: People ( used to writing / used to write ) letters by hand.
items.answer: used to write
items.note: used to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Young people are used to ( use / using ) smartphones.
items.answer: using
items.note: Cấu trúc: be used to + V-ing (đã quen với).

items.cue: Children who read widely benefit ( later of life / later in life ).
items.answer: later in life
items.note: Cụm cố định: later in life.

items.cue: ( Traditionally, / Traditional, ) families ate together every evening.
items.answer: Traditionally,
items.note: Đầu câu cần trạng từ.

items.cue: The Internet has ( transformed / transformed to ) the way we work.
items.answer: transformed
items.note: transform + tân ngữ trực tiếp.

items.cue: ( With the advent / With the advent of ) smartphones, communication has changed.
items.answer: With the advent of
items.note: Cụm đầy đủ: with the advent of + danh từ.

items.cue: Construction of a new metro line is ( on the way / under way ).
items.answer: under way
items.note: under way = đang được tiến hành.

items.cue: Young people are becoming ( increasingly / increasing ) independent.
items.answer: increasingly
items.note: Trước tính từ cần trạng từ.

items.cue: Over the past few decades, cities ( grow / have grown ) rapidly.
items.answer: have grown
items.note: Over the past few decades + hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: With the growth of tourism ( come / comes ) greater pressure on the environment.
items.answer: comes
items.note: Hòa hợp với greater pressure (số ít).

items.cue: With the development of technology ( come / comes ) new concerns about privacy.
items.answer: come
items.note: Hòa hợp với new concerns (số nhiều).

items.cue: ( Throughout the history, / Throughout history, ) people have used animals for transport.
items.answer: Throughout history,
items.note: history nói chung không dùng the.

items.cue: Technology has had a profound impact ( on / in ) education.
items.answer: on
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: impact on.

items.cue: ( In the coming of decades, / In the coming decades, ) automation may eliminate many jobs.
items.answer: In the coming decades,
items.note: Cụm cố định: in the coming decades.

items.cue: ( Today's / Nowadays' ) technology allows people to work from anywhere.
items.answer: Today's
items.note: nowadays không có dạng sở hữu.

theory.html: Câu dài không đồng nghĩa với câu hay. Nhiều bài band 5.5–6.0 có những câu chồng chất 4–5 mệnh đề (… in order to … if … as long as …), vừa khó hiểu (CC) vừa dễ sai ngữ pháp (GRA). Ở Band 7, giám khảo đánh giá cao những câu cô đọng, chính xác, trong đó một ý phức tạp được diễn đạt bằng một cụm danh từ thay vì cả một mệnh đề.

Kỹ thuật cốt lõi là giảm số động từ chia trong câu: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ, biến mệnh đề thành cụm danh từ hoặc cụm giới từ, bỏ các cụm từ thừa (due to the fact that, the reason why is because, in my personal opinion, I think).
Đừng rút gọn đến mức mất ý. Nếu câu rút gọn làm mất mối quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả hoặc khiến người đọc phải đoán, hãy giữ câu đầy đủ.

cells: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (chủ động)
students who live far from campus → students living far from campus
Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (bị động)
N + which is/are + V3 → N + V3
products which are made locally → locally made products
Many students struggle to find work after graduation.
the fact that people are spending more on clothes → rising spending on clothing
Rising spending on clothing is harming the environment.
S + V + O, which means that … → cụm danh từ + mean (that) …
An increasingly competitive labour market means that unqualified people struggle to find work.
cụm danh từ + mean that + mệnh đề → cụm danh từ + mean + cụm danh từ
An increasingly competitive labour market means fewer opportunities for unqualified people.
people who vote / buy … → we as voters / consumers
We as voters should support politicians who protect the environment.
due to the fact that → because; the reason why is because → this is because; in my personal opinion, I think → in my opinion
Many people do not cycle because the roads are dangerous.
4–5 mệnh đề nối liền → một ý chính + một mệnh đề phụ
Open communication allows teams to reassign tasks quickly when someone falls behind, which boosts productivity.

items: Students living far from campus often spend hours commuting.
Locally made products are often fresher.
Many students struggle to find work after graduation.
Rising spending on clothing is harming the environment.
An increasingly competitive labour market means fewer opportunities for people without qualifications.
Heavy spending on roads means less money for public transport.
We as voters should support politicians who are committed to protecting the environment.
An ageing population means higher public healthcare spending.

items.bad: Team members can communicate openly in order to reassign tasks if someone falls behind schedule as long as it helps with the productivity of the team. CC
items.good: Open communication allows teams to reassign tasks quickly when someone falls behind, which boosts productivity.
items.note: Bốn mệnh đề chồng chất (in order to … if … as long as …) khiến người đọc không rõ ý chính. Hãy chọn một ý chính và một mệnh đề phụ.

items.bad: Due to the fact that prices are rising, families spend less. LR
items.good: Because prices are rising, families spend less.
items.note: due to the fact that dài dòng; dùng because hoặc With prices rising, ….

items.bad: The reason why is because people are too busy. GRA
items.good: This is because people are too busy.
items.note: reason và because lặp nghĩa; dùng This is because … hoặc The reason is that ….

items.bad: Students who they live far from campus often arrive late. GRA
items.good: Students living far from campus often arrive late.
items.note: Thừa they; rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động thành V-ing.

items.bad: Products making in Vietnam are exported worldwide. GRA
items.good: Products made in Vietnam are exported worldwide.
items.note: Sản phẩm được làm ra (bị động) → V3 made.

items.bad: In my personal opinion, I think that university should be free. LR
items.good: In my opinion, university should be free.
items.note: Lặp nghĩa ba lần (my, personal, I think).

items.html: Rút gọn khi câu có từ thừa hoặc nhiều mệnh đề nối tiếp. Không rút gọn đến mức mất ý hoặc mất mối quan hệ logic (nguyên nhân, điều kiện, đối lập).

items.h: which means that hay cụm danh từ + mean?
items.html: S + V, which means that … rõ ràng, an toàn; cụm danh từ + mean (that) … ngắn gọn hơn; cụm danh từ + mean + cụm danh từ ngắn nhất nhưng chỉ dùng khi ý đơn giản.
Chủ động → V-ing (students living far away = students who live far away); bị động → V3 (products made in Vietnam = products which are made in Vietnam).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết gọn câu
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu gọn hơn bằng kỹ thuật được cho. Giữ nguyên ý chính và các mối quan hệ logic.

items.cue: Students who live far from campus often spend hours commuting.
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (V-ing)
items.answer: Students living far from campus often spend hours commuting.
items.alt: Students who commute from far away often spend hours travelling.

items.cue: Products that are made locally are often fresher.
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (V3)
items.answer: Locally made products are often fresher.
items.alt: Products made locally are often fresher.

items.cue: Due to the fact that prices are rising, many families are cutting back.
items.hint: bỏ cụm thừa → because hoặc With + N + V-ing
items.answer: Because prices are rising, many families are cutting back.
items.alt: With prices rising, many families are cutting back.

items.cue: Many students find it hard to get a job after they graduate.
items.answer: Many students find it hard to get a job after graduation.
items.alt: Many students struggle to find work after graduation.

items.cue: People who vote should put pressure on the government.
items.answer: We as voters should put pressure on the government.
items.alt: As voters, we should put pressure on the government.

items.cue: There are many people who believe that exams are unfair.
items.answer: Many people believe that exams are unfair.
items.alt: Many consider examinations unfair.

items.cue: The government should take action. The action should reduce pollution.
items.answer: The government should take action to reduce pollution.
items.alt: The government should act to cut pollution.

items.cue: The labour market is becoming more competitive, which means that people without qualifications struggle to find work.
items.hint: Bước 2: cụm danh từ + mean that
items.answer: An increasingly competitive labour market means that people without qualifications struggle to find work.
items.alt: A more competitive labour market means that unqualified people find it hard to get work.

items.cue: An increasingly competitive labour market means that people without qualifications struggle to find work.
items.hint: Bước 3: câu chỉ có một động từ
items.answer: An increasingly competitive labour market means fewer opportunities for people without qualifications.
items.alt: A more competitive labour market means fewer jobs for unqualified people.

items.cue: Some countries are facing harsh economic realities, which means that their governments have to cut spending.
items.hint: cụm danh từ + mean + cụm danh từ
items.answer: Harsh economic realities mean spending cuts in some countries.
items.alt: Harsh economic conditions mean public spending cuts in some countries.

items.cue: The fact that people are spending more on clothes is harming the environment.
items.answer: Rising spending on clothing is harming the environment.
items.alt: Growing consumer spending on clothes is harming the environment.

items.cue: In my personal opinion, I think that the government should act.
items.answer: In my opinion, the government should act.
items.alt: I believe the government should act.

items.cue: Many young people move to cities. They want to find better jobs. This puts pressure on housing.
items.answer: The migration of young people to cities in search of better jobs puts pressure on housing.
items.alt: Young people moving to cities in search of better jobs are putting pressure on housing.

items.cue: The reason why many people do not cycle is because the roads are dangerous.
items.answer: Many people do not cycle because the roads are dangerous.
items.alt: The main reason many people do not cycle is that the roads are dangerous.

items.cue: Team members can communicate openly in order to reassign tasks if someone falls behind schedule as long as it helps with the productivity of the team.
items.hint: tách chuỗi mệnh đề chồng chất; giữ một ý chính
items.answer: Open communication allows teams to reassign tasks quickly when someone falls behind, which boosts productivity.
items.alt: When team members communicate openly, they can reassign tasks quickly if someone falls behind, which improves productivity.

items.cue: Many people buy fast food because they are busy and they do not have time to cook, and this is bad for their health.
items.hint: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ
items.answer: Busy lifestyles leave many people little time to cook, which encourages unhealthy fast-food consumption.
items.alt: A lack of time to cook leads many busy people to rely on unhealthy fast food.

items.cue: The government spends a lot of money on roads. This means that there is less money for public transport.
items.hint: câu chỉ có một động từ
items.answer: Heavy spending on roads means less money for public transport.
items.alt: High road spending leaves less money for public transport.

items.cue: Children who spend a lot of time playing video games often do not sleep enough, and this affects how well they do at school.
items.hint: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ + which
items.answer: Excessive gaming can deprive children of sleep, which affects how well they perform at school.
items.alt: Spending too long on video games can cost children sleep and harm their school performance.

items.cue: There are many tourists who visit the old town every year, and they cause a lot of damage to the buildings that are historic.
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ + cụm danh từ
items.answer: The large number of tourists visiting the old town each year is damaging its historic buildings.
items.alt: Large numbers of visitors are damaging the old town's historic buildings.

items.cue: It is a fact that the population is ageing, and this means that the government will have to spend more money on healthcare in the future.
items.hint: câu chỉ có một động từ
items.answer: An ageing population means higher public healthcare spending in the future.
items.alt: An ageing population will mean greater government spending on healthcare.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Sinh viên sống xa trường thường mất nhiều giờ đi lại.
items.rewriteWith: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (từ khóa: living far from campus)
items.translation: Students who live far from school often spend many hours travelling.
items.answer: Students living far from campus often spend hours commuting.
items.alt: Students who live far from campus often spend hours commuting.

items.cue: Thực phẩm được sản xuất trong nước thường tươi hơn.
items.translation: Food which is produced in the country is often fresher.
items.answer: Locally produced food is often fresher.
items.alt: Food produced locally is often fresher.

items.cue: Vì giá cả tăng, nhiều gia đình cắt giảm chi tiêu.
items.rewriteWith: With + N + V-ing (không dùng due to the fact that)
items.translation: Because prices are increasing, many families are cutting their spending.
items.answer: With prices rising, many families are cutting their spending.
items.alt: Because prices are rising, many families are spending less.

items.cue: Nhiều sinh viên khó tìm việc sau khi tốt nghiệp.
items.translation: Many students find it difficult to find jobs after they graduate.
items.answer: Many students struggle to find work after graduation.
items.alt: Many graduates find it hard to get a job after graduation.

items.cue: Với tư cách là người tiêu dùng, chúng ta có thể giảm rác thải nhựa.
items.translation: As people who buy things, we can reduce plastic waste.
items.answer: We as consumers can reduce plastic waste.
items.alt: As consumers, we can help reduce plastic waste.

items.cue: Nhiều người tin rằng thi cử là không công bằng.
items.translation: There are many people who believe that exams are not fair.
items.answer: Many people believe that examinations are unfair.
items.alt: Many consider examinations unfair.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên hành động để giảm ô nhiễm.
items.translation: The government should take action in order to make pollution lower.
items.answer: The government should act to reduce pollution.
items.alt: The government should take action to cut pollution.

items.cue: Thị trường lao động ngày càng cạnh tranh đồng nghĩa với việc người không có bằng cấp khó tìm việc.
items.translation: The labour market is more competitive, which means that people without qualifications find it hard to find work.
items.answer: An increasingly competitive labour market means that people without qualifications struggle to find work.
items.alt: A more competitive job market means that unqualified people find it harder to get work.

items.cue: Thị trường lao động ngày càng cạnh tranh đồng nghĩa với ít cơ hội hơn cho người không có bằng cấp.
items.translation: The labour market is more competitive, so there are fewer chances for people without qualifications.
items.answer: An increasingly competitive labour market means fewer opportunities for people without qualifications.
items.alt: A more competitive labour market means fewer jobs for unqualified people.

items.cue: Chi tiêu ngày càng nhiều cho quần áo đang gây hại cho môi trường.
items.translation: People spend more and more on clothes, and this is harming the environment.
items.answer: Rising spending on clothing is harming the environment.
items.alt: Growing expenditure on clothes is harming the environment.

items.cue: Việc người trẻ di cư lên thành phố để tìm việc tốt hơn gây áp lực lên nhà ở.
items.translation: Young people move to cities to find better jobs, and this puts pressure on housing.
items.answer: The migration of young people to cities in search of better jobs puts pressure on housing.
items.alt: Young people moving to cities for better jobs are putting pressure on housing.

items.cue: Nhiều người không đạp xe vì đường sá nguy hiểm.
items.rewriteWith: câu ngắn (không dùng The reason why … is because)
items.translation: Many people do not ride bicycles, as the roads are dangerous.
items.answer: Many people do not cycle because the roads are dangerous.
items.alt: The main reason many people avoid cycling is that the roads are dangerous.

items.cue: Dân số già đồng nghĩa với chi tiêu y tế công cao hơn.
items.translation: The population is getting older, which means public healthcare spending is higher.
items.answer: An ageing population means higher public healthcare spending.
items.alt: An ageing population means greater government spending on healthcare.

items.answer: Heavy spending on roads means less money for public transport.
items.alt: High spending on roads leaves less money for public transport.

items.answer: Open communication allows teams to reassign tasks quickly when someone falls behind, which boosts productivity.
items.alt: Open communication enables teams to redistribute work quickly when someone falls behind, thereby raising productivity.

items.cue: Lối sống bận rộn khiến nhiều người có ít thời gian nấu ăn, dẫn đến việc tiêu thụ đồ ăn nhanh không lành mạnh.

items.answer: Busy lifestyles leave many people little time to cook, which encourages unhealthy fast-food consumption.
items.alt: A lack of time to cook leads many busy people to rely on unhealthy fast food.

items.answer: Excessive gaming can deprive children of sleep, which affects their performance at school.
items.alt: Too much gaming can cost children sleep and harm their school results.

items.translation: As people who vote, we should support politicians who promise to protect the environment.
items.answer: We as voters should support politicians who are committed to protecting the environment.
items.alt: As voters, we should back politicians committed to environmental protection.

items.cue: Những điều kiện kinh tế khắc nghiệt đồng nghĩa với việc cắt giảm chi tiêu công ở một số quốc gia.
items.translation: Some countries have harsh economic conditions, so they have to cut public spending.
items.answer: Harsh economic conditions mean public spending cuts in some countries.
items.alt: Economic hardship means cuts in public spending in some countries.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Students who they live far from campus often arrive late.
items.answer: Students who they live LIVING far from campus often arrive late.
notes: GRA Thừa they; rút gọn thành V-ing.

items.cue: Due to the fact that prices are rising, families spend less.
items.answer: Due to the fact that BECAUSE prices are rising, families spend less.
notes: LR Cụm từ dài dòng; dùng because.

items.cue: The reason why is because people are too busy.
items.answer: The reason why is because THIS IS BECAUSE people are too busy.
notes: GRA reason và because lặp nghĩa.

items.cue: Locally made products are often fresher and cheaper.
items.answer: ✓ Locally made products are often fresher and cheaper.
notes: Đúng: rút gọn bị động (made) đứng trước danh từ.

items.cue: Products making in Vietnam are exported worldwide.
items.answer: Products making MADE in Vietnam are exported worldwide.
notes: GRA Nghĩa bị động → V3 made.

items.cue: In my personal opinion, I think that university should be free.
items.answer: In my personal opinion, I think that IN MY OPINION, university should be free.
notes: LR Lặp nghĩa; chỉ giữ một cụm.

items.cue: An increasingly competitive labour market mean fewer jobs for unqualified people.
items.answer: An increasingly competitive labour market mean MEANS fewer jobs for unqualified people.
notes: GRA Chủ ngữ số ít (market) → means.

items.cue: Heavy spending on roads means less money for public transport.
items.answer: ✓ Heavy spending on roads means less money for public transport.
notes: Đúng: câu một động từ với cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ.

items.cue: There are many people who they believe exams are unfair.
items.answer: There are many people who they believe MANY PEOPLE BELIEVE exams are unfair.
notes: GRA Thừa they; viết gọn thành Many people believe.

items.cue: Team members can communicate openly in order to reassign tasks if someone falls behind schedule as long as it helps with the productivity of the team.
items.answer: Team members can communicate openly in order to reassign tasks if someone falls behind schedule as long as it helps with the productivity of the team. OPEN COMMUNICATION ALLOWS TEAMS TO REASSIGN TASKS QUICKLY WHEN SOMEONE FALLS BEHIND, WHICH BOOSTS PRODUCTIVITY.
notes: CC Bốn mệnh đề chồng chất khiến ý chính không rõ.

items.cue: Rising of spending on clothing harms the environment.
items.answer: Rising of spending RISING SPENDING on clothing harms the environment.
notes: GRA rising là tính từ đứng trước danh từ; không thêm of.

items.cue: We as voters should support politicians who protect the environment.
items.answer: ✓ We as voters should support politicians who protect the environment.
notes: Đúng: we as voters + should.

items.cue: Many students find it hard to get a job after their graduation from university when they finish their studies.
items.answer: Many students find it hard to get a job after their graduation from university when they finish their studies AFTER GRADUATION.
notes: LR Lặp ý ba lần; chỉ cần after graduation.

items.cue: The migration of young people to cities in search of better jobs put pressure on housing.
items.answer: The migration of young people to cities in search of better jobs put PUTS pressure on housing.
notes: GRA Chủ ngữ là The migration (số ít) → puts.

items.cue: Rents have risen faster than wages. This results in the disparity between the average income and the expenditure on essential services, lots of urban inhabitants cannot cover their expenses.
items.answer: Rents have risen faster than wages. This results in the disparity between the average income and the expenditure on essential services, lots of urban inhabitants cannot cover their expenses., MEANING THAT MANY URBAN RESIDENTS CANNOT COVER THEIR EXPENSES.
notes: CC Thiếu từ nối chỉ kết quả.
GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy.
LR lots of mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: An ageing population means higher healthcare spending in the future.
items.answer: ✓ An ageing population means higher healthcare spending in the future.
notes: Đúng: câu một động từ.

items.cue: Many people buy fast food because they are busy and they do not have time to cook and this is bad for their health and it also costs a lot.
items.answer: Many people buy fast food because they are busy and they do not have time to cook and this is bad for their health and it also costs a lot. BUSY LIFESTYLES PUSH MANY PEOPLE TOWARDS FAST FOOD, WHICH IS BOTH UNHEALTHY AND EXPENSIVE.
notes: CC Chuỗi and … and … and nối máy móc; gom ý bằng cụm danh từ và which.

items.cue: Children spending too much time on games, which affects their sleep.
items.answer: Children spending too much time on games, which affects their sleep. CHILDREN WHO SPEND TOO MUCH TIME ON GAMES MAY NOT SLEEP ENOUGH.
notes: GRA Câu thiếu động từ chính (fragment).

items.cue: Excessive gaming can deprive children of sleep, which affects their performance at school.
items.answer: ✓ Excessive gaming can deprive children of sleep, which affects their performance at school.
notes: Đúng: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ + mệnh đề which.

items.cue: It is a fact that the population is ageing and this means that the government will have to spend more money.
items.answer: It is a fact that the population is ageing and this means that the government will have to spend more money. AN AGEING POPULATION MEANS HIGHER GOVERNMENT SPENDING.
notes: LR Cụm mở đầu thừa (It is a fact that) và hai mệnh đề có thể gộp thành câu một động từ.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu gọn (●, ●●) dùng kỹ thuật được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu gọn (●●●). Mỗi câu không quá hai động từ chia.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Once children start school, teachers have more influence on their development than their parents do. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
items.answer: Teachers working with children every day can strongly influence their social development.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: It is more important to plant trees in towns and cities than to build more housing. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ
items.answer: Tree planting in cities improves air quality and residents' well-being.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Rich countries should not recruit skilled workers from poorer countries because those countries need these workers more. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: cụm danh từ + mean + cụm danh từ
items.answer: The loss of skilled workers means weaker healthcare systems in poorer countries.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: A shortage of housing in large cities can cause serious social problems. Some people believe that only government action can solve this problem. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: A shortage of affordable housing means that many young workers cannot live near their jobs.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that rich countries should help poorer countries in ways other than giving them financial aid. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ
items.answer: Technical training for local workers can help poorer countries more than direct financial aid.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that sports competitions can cause emotional stress for young people and that children and teenagers should therefore be banned from taking part. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ
items.answer: Children taking part in competitive sports may feel intense pressure to win.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones has a negative effect on people's reading and writing skills. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Constant use of spell-checkers means that many young people no longer learn to spell correctly.

items.cue: Animals · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Too much attention and too many resources are being used to protect wild animals and birds. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: câu chỉ có một động từ
items.answer: The protection of endangered species means healthier ecosystems for future generations.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: In developing countries, children in rural areas often have less access to education. Some people believe the best solution is to provide more schools and teachers, while others think computers and Internet access are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ
items.answer: A shortage of qualified teachers is the main barrier to education in many rural areas.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should provide financial support to artists, while others think that this is a waste of public money. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ (V3)
items.answer: Art funded by the state can be enjoyed by people who could not otherwise afford it.

items.cue: Traffic · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should build more rail and underground lines to reduce traffic congestion, while others think they should build more and wider roads. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Wider roads mean that more drivers soon fill the extra space.

items.cue: Language · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should spend money to protect languages with very few speakers, while others think this is a waste of public funds. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: câu ngắn, không có cụm thừa

theory.html: Mệnh đề quan hệ giúp bạn thu hẹp phạm vi của một nhận định (Students who work part-time have less time to study, không phải mọi sinh viên), bổ sung thông tin mà không cần câu mới (Vietnam, which has a young population, …) và nêu hệ quả của cả một ý (…, which means that …). Đây là một trong những cấu trúc phức được giám khảo chú ý nhất khi chấm GRA.

Dấu phẩy làm thay đổi nghĩa. Mệnh đề xác định (không có phẩy) cho biết đối tượng nào; mệnh đề không xác định (có phẩy) chỉ thêm thông tin về một đối tượng đã rõ. Students who work part-time… nói về một nhóm sinh viên; Students, who work part-time, … ngụ ý mọi sinh viên đều đi làm thêm, tức là một nhận định tuyệt đối hóa (TR).

Lỗi thường gặp của người Việt: thừa đại từ (who they live), dùng that sau dấu phẩy, dùng those thay cho whose, quên đại từ quan hệ (the countries relied mainly on coal), và chia sai động từ sau which khi which thay cho cả một mệnh đề.

theory.text: Các loại mệnh đề quan hệ

cells: Students who work part-time often have less time to study.
Không xác định (có phẩy, không dùng that)
Vietnam, which has a young population, needs millions of new jobs.
Manual workers whose roles can be automated may lose their jobs.
N + in / through / on / from + which; with whom
The ways in which children learn have changed.
S + V, which + V (số ít) / which means that …
Many people work from home, which reduces traffic.
many / most / some of whom / which
The country has many universities, most of which are state-funded.
Countries relying mainly on coal produce the most emissions.
Products made locally are often fresher.
The skills students learn at school prepare them for work.
In cities where public transport is cheap, people drive less.

items: Students who work part-time often have less time to study.
Vietnam, which has a young population, needs to create millions of jobs.
Manual workers whose roles can be automated may lose their jobs.
The ways in which children learn have changed with technology.
Many people now work from home, which reduces traffic congestion.
The city has many elderly residents, many of whom live alone.
Factories pollute rivers on which local people depend for water.
In cities where public transport is cheap, people drive less.

items.bad: Automation threatens manual workers those roles are highly vulnerable. GRA
items.good: Automation threatens manual workers whose roles are highly vulnerable.
items.note: Quan hệ sở hữu dùng whose, không dùng those; không có dấu phẩy vì chỉ một nhóm công nhân.

items.bad: The two countries relied mainly on coal had high emissions. GRA
items.good: The two countries that relied mainly on coal had high emissions.
items.note: Thiếu đại từ quan hệ: câu có hai động từ chia (relied, had) cần that; hoặc rút gọn thành relying.

items.bad: Vietnam, that has a young population, needs more jobs. GRA
items.good: Vietnam, which has a young population, needs more jobs.
items.note: Mệnh đề không xác định (sau dấu phẩy) không dùng that.

items.bad: Students who they work part-time have less time. GRA
items.good: Students who work part-time have less time.
items.note: who đã là chủ ngữ của mệnh đề; thêm they là thừa.

items.bad: Many people work from home, which mean less traffic. GRA
items.good: Many people work from home, which means less traffic.
items.note: which thay cho cả mệnh đề trước → động từ số ít.

items.bad: The city in that I live is very crowded. GRA
items.good: The city in which I live is very crowded.
items.note: Sau giới từ chỉ dùng which / whom, không dùng that.

items.html: Students who work part-time have less time to study = chỉ những sinh viên đi làm thêm. Students, who work part-time, have less time to study = mọi sinh viên đều đi làm thêm. Chọn sai dấu phẩy có thể biến một nhận định chính xác thành nhận định tuyệt đối hóa.
that chỉ dùng trong mệnh đề xác định (không phẩy). Sau dấu phẩy hoặc sau giới từ, phải dùng which (vật) hoặc who / whom (người).
who làm chủ ngữ; whom đứng sau giới từ (with whom, many of whom). Trong văn viết học thuật, dùng whom sau giới từ.
Many people work from home, which reduces traffic: which = việc nhiều người làm việc tại nhà, nên động từ chia số ít. Cấu trúc này rất hữu ích để nêu kết quả (xem Unit 7–8).

items.answer: The city in that IN WHICH I live is very crowded.
notes: GRA Sau giới từ dùng which.

items.cue: Children make new friends through socialising, which broaden their understanding of others.
items.answer: Children make new friends through socialising, which broaden WHICH BROADENS their understanding of others.
notes: GRA which thay cho cả hoạt động (việc giao lưu) → động từ số ít.

items.cue: The country has many universities, most of which are state-funded.
items.answer: ✓ The country has many universities, most of which are state-funded.
notes: Đúng: most of which sau dấu phẩy.

items.cue: The city has many elderly residents, many of them live alone.
items.answer: The city has many elderly residents, many of them live alone, MANY OF WHOM LIVE ALONE.
notes: GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; dùng many of whom.

items.cue: Children which parents rarely talk to them may struggle at school.
items.answer: Children which parents rarely talk to them WHOSE PARENTS RARELY TALK TO THEM may struggle at school.
notes: GRA Quan hệ sở hữu dùng whose.

items.cue: Products who are made locally are often fresher.
items.answer: Products who THAT are made locally are often fresher.
notes: GRA who chỉ dùng cho người; với vật dùng that / which.

items.cue: Factories pollute rivers on which local people depend for water.
items.answer: ✓ Factories pollute rivers on which local people depend for water.
notes: Đúng: giới từ + which.

items.cue: Teachers, who has a strong influence on students, should be paid more.
items.answer: Teachers, who has WHO HAVE a strong influence on students, should be paid more.
notes: GRA who thay cho Teachers (số nhiều) → have.

items.cue: The skills that students learn them at school prepare them for work.
items.answer: The skills that students learn them at school LEARN AT SCHOOL prepare them for work.
notes: GRA Thừa tân ngữ them: that đã là tân ngữ của learn.

items.cue: Young people who have grown up with smartphones find online learning natural.
items.answer: ✓ Young people who have grown up with smartphones find online learning natural.
notes: Đúng: mệnh đề xác định với hiện tại hoàn thành.

items.cue: Countries rely mainly on coal produce the most emissions.
items.answer: Countries rely mainly COUNTRIES RELYING MAINLY on coal produce the most emissions.
notes: GRA Hai động từ chia trong một mệnh đề; rút gọn thành V-ing hoặc thêm that.

items.cue: In cities which public transport is cheap, people drive less.
items.answer: In cities which public transport is cheap WHERE PUBLIC TRANSPORT IS CHEAP, people drive less.
notes: GRA Chỉ nơi chốn và mệnh đề đã có chủ ngữ riêng → where.

items.cue: The old town attracts many tourists, most of whom stay for only one day.
items.answer: ✓ The old town attracts many tourists, most of whom stay for only one day.
notes: Đúng: most of whom cho người.

items.cue: Students, who work part-time, have less time to study.
items.answer: Students, who work part-time, have STUDENTS WHO WORK PART-TIME HAVE less time to study.
notes: TR Dấu phẩy biến mệnh đề thành không xác định, ngụ ý mọi sinh viên đều đi làm thêm (tuyệt đối hóa).

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng loại mệnh đề quan hệ được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Students at schools and universities learn more from their teachers than from other sources of information. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Students who have access to online resources can learn a great deal outside the classroom.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the main purpose of public libraries is to provide books and that they should not provide modern technology such as computers and digital media. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Public libraries, which are free to use, can give low-income families access to computers.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Intelligence is the most important quality a leader can have. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Leaders whose decisions affect millions need emotional intelligence as well as intellect.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: To learn a language well, people should also learn about the country, culture and lifestyle of those who speak it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Learners who spend time in a country where the language is spoken tend to understand its culture better.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Team activities teach people more useful life skills than activities that are done alone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: People who play team sports learn to cooperate with others.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Advertising discourages people from being different by encouraging everyone to buy similar products. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Advertisers promote the same products to millions of people, which means that many consumers end up owning similar things.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Professional workers such as doctors, nurses and teachers should be paid more than people who work in sports and entertainment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Professionals who save lives every day deserve higher salaries than most entertainers.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that tourists should take social and environmental responsibility for the places they visit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Tourists visiting fragile environments should follow rules that protect local wildlife.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that studying literature is important for developing a person's character, while others think it is a waste of time. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Literature is one of the main ways through which young people learn to understand others.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that music plays an important role in society, while others think it is simply a form of entertainment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Music connects millions of people, many of whom do not share a common language.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that visitors to another country should follow local customs and behaviour, while others think host countries should accept cultural differences. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Visitors should respect the customs of the countries in which they are guests.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Human activities are having negative effects on plant and animal species. Some people think it is too late to solve this problem, while others believe effective action can still be taken. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Thousands of species are endangered, most of which could still be saved through habitat protection.

items.cue: Language · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that language students learn better in small classes, while others think class size makes little difference. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: In classes where there are fewer students, teachers can correct each learner's mistakes.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many countries, older people are not treated with enough respect. Why is this happening, and what problems can it cause?
items.answer: Older people whose knowledge is no longer valued may feel isolated from society.

items.cue: Food and health · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many countries, people buy imported food rather than food produced locally. Why is this happening, and how can people be encouraged to buy more locally produced food?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.
items.answer: Imported food, which is often cheaper, attracts shoppers on a budget. Local farmers, whose produce is fresher, could compete by selling directly at markets.

items.cue: City development · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some cities, there are few restrictions on the design and construction of homes and office buildings, and owners can choose the style they prefer. Do the advantages of this approach outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.
items.answer: Cities in which there are few building rules may end up with a chaotic skyline. However, owners who can choose their own style may produce more creative designs.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote natural environments, such as the South Pole. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.
items.answer: Tourists visiting the South Pole can damage an environment that took thousands of years to form. Scientists, whose research helps us understand climate change, have a stronger case for being there.

items.cue: Language · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some languages are becoming more widely spoken around the world, while others are declining in use. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.
items.answer: English, which is now spoken worldwide, makes international communication easier. However, many minority languages, most of which have few young speakers, are disappearing.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Family structures and the roles of family members have changed in recent years. Why has this happened, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.
items.answer: Families in which both parents work now share household tasks more equally. This is a positive change, which gives children more balanced role models.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Two-part question
items.prompt: The number of multinational companies operating around the world has increased greatly. To what extent should these companies be responsible for the local communities in which they operate?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại mệnh đề quan hệ khác nhau.
items.answer: Multinational companies, which often earn huge profits, should invest in the communities where they operate. Workers whose jobs depend on these firms deserve fair wages.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Đại từ quan hệ và dấu phẩy
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng. Chú ý mệnh đề xác định hay không xác định.

items.cue: Vietnam( that / , which ) has a young population, needs millions of new jobs.
items.answer: , which
items.note: Tên riêng đã xác định → mệnh đề không xác định: dấu phẩy + which.

items.cue: Students ( which / who ) work part-time often have less time to study.
items.answer: who
items.note: Chỉ người → who.

items.cue: Products ( that / who ) are made locally are often fresher.
items.answer: that
items.note: Chỉ vật → that / which.

items.cue: Many people work from home( , which / , that ) reduces traffic.
items.answer: , which
items.note: which thay cho cả mệnh đề; không dùng that sau dấu phẩy.

items.cue: Children ( whose / who's ) parents read to them often enjoy books.
items.answer: whose
items.note: Sở hữu → whose; who's = who is.

items.cue: In cities ( where / which ) public transport is cheap, people drive less.
items.answer: where
items.note: Nơi chốn, mệnh đề có chủ ngữ riêng → where.

items.cue: The city ( in which / in that ) I live is very crowded.
items.answer: in which
items.note: Sau giới từ dùng which.

items.cue: The city has many elderly residents, many of ( whom / them ) live alone.
items.answer: whom
items.note: Lượng từ + of whom để nối mệnh đề.

items.cue: The country has many universities, most of ( which / them ) are state-funded.
items.answer: which
items.note: Lượng từ + of which để nối mệnh đề.

items.cue: Teachers, ( who / that ) have a strong influence on students, deserve higher pay.
items.answer: who
items.note: Mệnh đề không xác định (có phẩy) → không dùng that.

items.cue: The time ( which / when ) most people lived in villages has passed.
items.answer: when
items.note: Chỉ thời gian, mệnh đề có chủ ngữ riêng → when.

items.cue: Taxation is the means ( through that / through which ) governments fund public services.
items.answer: through which
items.note: Sau giới từ dùng which.

items.cue: Many people work from home, which ( mean / means ) less traffic.
items.answer: means
items.note: which thay cho cả mệnh đề → số ít.

items.cue: The skills students learn ( them at school / at school ) prepare them for work.
items.answer: at school
items.note: Không thêm tân ngữ them vì đại từ quan hệ (đã lược) là tân ngữ.

items.cue: Countries ( relying / relied ) mainly on coal produce the most emissions.
items.answer: relying
items.note: Rút gọn chủ động → V-ing.

items.cue: The experts ( with who / with whom ) we spoke disagreed.
items.answer: with whom
items.note: Sau giới từ dùng whom.

items.cue: My father( who lives in Hanoi / , who lives in Hanoi, ) works as a doctor.
items.answer: , who lives in Hanoi,
items.note: Mỗi người chỉ có một người cha → thông tin bổ sung → có dấu phẩy.

items.cue: Students ( , who / who ) cheat in exams should be punished.
items.answer: who
items.note: Chỉ những sinh viên gian lận (xác định) → không có dấu phẩy.

items.cue: Older workers have experience ( from which / which from ) companies can benefit.
items.answer: from which
items.note: Giới từ đứng trước which.

items.cue: Factories pollute rivers ( on that / on which ) local people depend.
items.answer: on which
items.note: Sau giới từ dùng which.

theory.html: Cụm phân từ (Living in a big city, …, Having finished university, …, Designed for beginners, …) giúp bạn gộp hai câu thành một mà không cần liên từ, làm câu văn gọn và mang tính học thuật hơn. Cụm V-ing ở cuối câu (…, causing high unemployment) là cách ngắn gọn để nêu kết quả.

Quy tắc quan trọng nhất: chủ ngữ của mệnh đề chính phải là người/vật thực hiện hành động trong cụm phân từ. Living in a big city, the cost of housing is high là sai, vì the cost of housing không thể sống ở thành phố. Lỗi này gọi là dangling participle và rất phổ biến ở band 5.5–6.5.

Chọn đúng dạng: V-ing (chủ động, cùng lúc), Having + V3 (xảy ra trước), V3 (bị động). Cụm độc lập (All things considered, …; Other things being equal, …; With prices rising, …) có chủ ngữ riêng hoặc là cụm cố định, nên không gặp lỗi dangling.

theory.text: Cụm phân từ và cụm độc lập

cells: V-ing mở đầu (chủ động, đồng thời)
Living in big cities, young people face high rents.
Having finished university, many graduates move abroad.
Designed for beginners, the app makes grammar enjoyable.
When / While / After / Before + V-ing; When + V3
While studying abroad, students learn to be independent.
Not knowing the risks, many teenagers share personal data online.
Being + tính từ / danh từ (lý do)
Being cheap and convenient, fast food is popular among students.
Many factories closed, causing high unemployment.
V-ing cuối câu (đồng thời / mục đích)
S + V …, hoping / trying / aiming to …
Many students work part-time, hoping to save money.
Robots are used for welding, thereby protecting workers from injury.
All things considered, …; Other things being equal, …; With + N + V-ing, …
All things considered, the benefits of tourism outweigh the costs.

items: Living in big cities, young people face high rents.
Having finished university, many graduates move abroad.
Designed for beginners, the app makes learning grammar enjoyable.
While studying abroad, students learn to be independent.
Many factories closed, causing high unemployment.
The government has introduced a sugar tax, hoping to reduce obesity.
Faced with a housing shortage, the city has built more affordable flats.
Other things being equal, students who sleep well perform better.

items.bad: Living in a big city, the cost of housing is high. GRA
items.good: Living in a big city, young people face high housing costs.
items.note: Dangling: the cost of housing không thể sống ở thành phố. Chủ ngữ chính phải là người thực hiện hành động.

items.bad: Robots can be deployed for welding, avoiding staff from physical harm. GRA
items.good: Robots can be deployed for welding, thereby protecting staff from physical harm.
items.note: avoid sb from không tồn tại; cụm kết quả cần thereby protecting, diễn tả kết quả của cả mệnh đề trước.

items.bad: Having finish university, many graduates move abroad. GRA
items.good: Having finished university, many graduates move abroad.
items.note: Sau Having dùng V3 (quá khứ phân từ).

items.bad: Designing for children, the app makes grammar fun. GRA
items.good: Designed for children, the app makes grammar fun.
items.note: Ứng dụng được thiết kế (bị động) → V3.

items.bad: Many factories closed, caused unemployment. GRA
items.good: Many factories closed, causing unemployment.
items.note: Cụm kết quả ở cuối câu dùng V-ing.

items.bad: After graduated, many students go abroad. GRA
items.good: After graduating, many students go abroad.
items.note: Sau after / before / while dùng V-ing.

items.html: Chủ ngữ chính thực hiện hành động → V-ing (Living in cities, young people …); chủ ngữ chính chịu hành động → V3 (Built in 1900, the museum …).
Hai hành động xảy ra cùng lúc → V-ing; hành động trong cụm phân từ xảy ra trước → Having + V3 (Having grown up in poverty, some leaders …).
Hỏi: Ai/cái gì thực hiện hành động V-ing? Câu trả lời phải là chủ ngữ của mệnh đề chính. Nếu không, hãy đổi chủ ngữ hoặc viết lại bằng mệnh đề đầy đủ (For people living in a big city, …).
…, causing unemployment gọn hơn và dùng khi kết quả xảy ra trực tiếp. Nếu kết quả phức tạp hoặc cần chủ ngữ rõ, dùng , which means that ….

items.alt: Many people feel lonely after retiring.

items.cue: Trước khi chọn trường đại học, học sinh nên cân nhắc triển vọng nghề nghiệp.
items.translation: Before they choose a university, students should think about their career prospects.
items.answer: Before choosing a university, students should consider their career prospects.
items.alt: Students should consider their career prospects before choosing a university.

items.cue: Xét mọi mặt, lợi ích của du lịch lớn hơn tác hại.
items.translation: Considering everything, tourism has more benefits than harms.
items.answer: All things considered, the benefits of tourism outweigh its drawbacks.
items.alt: On balance, the benefits of tourism outweigh the drawbacks.

items.cue: Vì rẻ và tiện lợi, đồ ăn nhanh trở nên phổ biến trong sinh viên.
items.translation: Because fast food is cheap and convenient, it is popular among students.
items.answer: Being cheap and convenient, fast food has become popular among students.
items.alt: Cheap and convenient, fast food has become popular among students.

items.cue: Chính phủ đã áp thuế đường với hy vọng giảm tỷ lệ béo phì.
items.translation: The government has introduced a sugar tax because it hopes to reduce obesity.
items.answer: The government has introduced a sugar tax, hoping to reduce obesity.
items.alt: Hoping to reduce obesity, the government has introduced a sugar tax.

items.cue: Khi giá cả tăng mạnh, nhiều gia đình cắt giảm chi tiêu.
items.translation: As prices rise sharply, many families cut their spending.
items.answer: With prices rising sharply, many families are cutting their spending.

items.cue: Được xây dựng năm 1900, bảo tàng thu hút hàng nghìn du khách mỗi năm, thúc đẩy kinh tế địa phương.
items.translation: The museum was built in 1900 and attracts thousands of visitors every year, which boosts the local economy.

items.cue: Lớn lên trong nghèo khó, một số nhà lãnh đạo hiểu rõ nhu cầu của người dân bình thường.
items.translation: Because they grew up in poverty, some leaders understand the needs of ordinary people well.
items.answer: Having grown up in poverty, some leaders understand the needs of ordinary people.
items.alt: Some leaders, having grown up in poverty, understand ordinary people's needs.

items.cue: Nếu các yếu tố khác như nhau, học sinh ngủ đủ giấc sẽ học tốt hơn.

items.alt: All else being equal, well-rested students perform better.

items.alt: Many teenagers spend hours online, neglecting their studies and causing their grades to fall.

items.cue: Đối mặt với tình trạng thiếu nhà ở, chính quyền thành phố đã xây dựng nhiều căn hộ giá rẻ.
items.translation: Because there is a housing shortage, the city government has built many cheap flats.
items.answer: Faced with a housing shortage, the city authorities have built more affordable flats.
items.alt: Confronted with a housing shortage, the city has built more affordable homes.

items.cue: Khi được sử dụng hợp lý, mạng xã hội có thể giúp người trẻ học hỏi.
items.translation: If social media is used properly, it can help young people learn.
items.answer: When used responsibly, social media can help young people learn.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Living in a big city, the cost of housing is high.
items.answer: Living in a big city, the cost of housing is high. LIVING IN A BIG CITY, YOUNG PEOPLE FACE HIGH HOUSING COSTS.

items.cue: Designing for children, the app makes grammar fun.
