items.cue: While studying abroad, students learn to be independent.
items.answer: ✓ While studying abroad, students learn to be independent.

items.cue: Not know the risks, many teenagers share personal data online.
items.answer: Not know NOT KNOWING the risks, many teenagers share personal data online.
notes: GRA Phủ định của cụm phân từ: Not + V-ing.

items.cue: Built in 1900, tourists love the old museum.

notes: GRA Dangling: du khách không được xây dựng năm 1900.

items.cue: Many students work part-time, hope to save money.
items.answer: Many students work part-time, hope HOPING to save money.
notes: GRA Cụm đồng thời cuối câu dùng V-ing.

items.cue: All things considered, the benefits of tourism outweigh the costs.
items.answer: ✓ All things considered, the benefits of tourism outweigh the costs.
notes: Đúng: cụm độc lập cố định.

items.cue: With prices rise sharply, families are cutting back.
items.answer: With prices rise RISING sharply, families are cutting back.
notes: GRA With + danh từ + V-ing.

items.cue: Before choose a university, students should consider job prospects.

notes: GRA Sau before dùng V-ing.

items.cue: Having grown up in poverty, the needs of ordinary people are understood by some leaders.

notes: GRA Dangling: người lớn lên trong nghèo khó là some leaders, nên họ phải là chủ ngữ.

items.cue: Faced with a housing shortage, the city has built more affordable flats.
items.answer: ✓ Faced with a housing shortage, the city has built more affordable flats.
notes: Đúng: the city là đối tượng faced with sự thiếu hụt.

notes: GRA Dangling: rẻ và tiện lợi là fast food, không phải students.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai loại cụm phân từ khác nhau. Kiểm tra lỗi dangling.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: In many countries, women can join the armed forces in the same way as men. Some people believe that only men should serve in the army, navy or air force. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Serving alongside men, many women have proved equally capable in the armed forces.

items.cue: Animals · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that only animals that are useful to humans should be protected from extinction. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The loss of a single species can disrupt an entire ecosystem, harming species that are useful to humans.

items.cue: Art and museums · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should spend money on public works of art, such as paintings and statues, in order to make towns and cities better places to live. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Placed in busy squares, public sculptures can make cities more attractive to residents and tourists.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that new buildings should be designed in a traditional style in order to preserve a country's cultural identity. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some cities require new buildings to follow traditional designs, hoping to preserve their cultural identity.

items.cue: Climate · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that instead of trying to prevent climate change, we should learn how to live with it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Having failed to cut emissions quickly enough, some countries are now focusing on adapting to climate change.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that former prisoners are the best people to talk to school students about the dangers of crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Speaking from personal experience, former prisoners can show students the real consequences of crime.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should spend less money on education and more on leisure activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Investing in education raises workers' skills, thereby boosting economic growth.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Although the leisure industry is growing, some people believe that modern technology has made people less creative in the way they entertain themselves. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Relying on screens for entertainment, many young people rarely make things themselves.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that anyone can learn to create art, while others think that artistic ability is something people are born with. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: When given proper training, most people can learn to draw or paint reasonably well.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some students take a year off before university. Some choose to work during this time, while others choose to travel. Discuss both options and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While working during a gap year, students can save money and gain practical experience.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that online materials are the best way for children to learn to read, while others think printed materials are better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Printed on paper, stories allow young readers to focus without the distractions of a screen.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that students should be allowed to evaluate and criticise their teachers, while others think this could lead to a loss of respect and discipline in the classroom. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Having completed a course, students are well placed to judge how clearly it was taught.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many people today do not feel safe either at home or when they are outside. What are the reasons for this, and what can be done to make people feel safer?
items.answer: Faced with frequent news of crime, many people feel unsafe even in quiet neighbourhoods.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: More and more people are shopping online. Why is this happening, and what effects does online shopping have on local shops and communities?
items.answer: Many local shops have closed, leaving some town centres almost empty.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Rote learning is still used in many education systems. Do the advantages of rote learning outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại cụm phân từ hoặc cụm độc lập khác nhau.
items.answer: Having memorised key facts, students can recall them quickly in exams. Relying only on memorisation, however, they may struggle to apply knowledge to new problems.

items.cue: Language · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that a new language should be created for international communication. Do the advantages of introducing a new international language outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại cụm phân từ hoặc cụm độc lập khác nhau.
items.answer: Designed to be easy to learn, a new international language could make communication fairer. Viewed realistically, however, teaching it worldwide would be enormously expensive.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Many children today spend more time playing computer games and less time doing sports. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại cụm phân từ hoặc cụm độc lập khác nhau.
items.answer: Spending hours on computer games, many children are less active than previous generations. Taken together with poor diets, this trend could lead to serious health problems.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some workplaces try to employ equal numbers of men and women. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại cụm phân từ hoặc cụm độc lập khác nhau.
items.answer: Hiring equal numbers of men and women, some companies have created more diverse teams. Other things being equal, such teams tend to make better decisions.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some people believe that the characteristics we are born with have a greater influence on our personality and development than the experiences we have in life. Which of these do you think has the greater influence?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại cụm phân từ hoặc cụm độc lập khác nhau.
items.answer: Born with certain traits, children may be naturally shy or outgoing. Shaped by their upbringing, however, these traits can change considerably over time.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that sports and games play an important role in society, while others think they should be regarded simply as leisure activities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại cụm phân từ hoặc cụm độc lập khác nhau.
items.answer: Playing in a team, children learn to cooperate and to cope with defeat. Viewed in this way, sport is far more than a leisure activity.

theory.html: Câu điều kiện là công cụ chính để đề xuất giải pháp và dự đoán kết quả trong Task 2: If public transport were free, more people would use it. Chúng cũng giúp bạn giới hạn phạm vi của một nhận định (Online learning works well, provided that students are motivated), tránh tuyệt đối hóa (TR).

Chọn loại câu điều kiện theo mức độ chắc chắn (xem Unit 10): loại 0 cho sự thật chung, loại 1 cho điều có khả năng thực tế, loại 2 cho giải pháp giả định hoặc ít khả năng xảy ra, loại 3 cho điều đã không xảy ra trong quá khứ, và câu hỗn hợp cho một nguyên nhân trong quá khứ dẫn đến kết quả hiện tại.
Lỗi thường gặp: dùng will sau if, trộn lẫn các loại câu điều kiện, dùng phủ định sau unless (unless … not), và thiếu dấu chấm phẩy trước otherwise.

theory.text: Câu điều kiện và liên từ điều kiện

cells: If + hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn
If people exercise regularly, they sleep better.
If + hiện tại đơn, will / can / may + V
If the government taxes sugary drinks, consumption may fall.
If + quá khứ đơn (were), would / could / might + V
If public transport were free, more people would use it.
If + had V3, would / could have + V3
If the city had invested earlier, congestion would not have become so severe.
If I had learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.
If + S + were to + V, … would + V
If the government were to ban cars, air quality would improve.
Unless we act now, pollution will get worse.
provided that / as long as / on condition that + mệnh đề
Online learning works well, provided that students are motivated.
Governments must act now; otherwise, the problem will grow.
S + V + in case + mệnh đề
Schools should keep first-aid kits in case accidents happen.

items: If the government taxes sugary drinks, consumption may fall.
If public transport were free, more people would use it.
If the city had invested in a metro earlier, congestion would not have become so severe.
If the government had regulated social media earlier, misinformation would not be so widespread today.
Unless action is taken soon, many species will become extinct.
Online learning works well, provided that students are motivated.
Governments must act now; otherwise, the problem will grow.
If university education were to become free, more students would apply.

items.bad: If the government will tax sugar, consumption will fall. GRA
items.good: If the government taxes sugar, consumption will fall.
items.note: Không dùng will trong mệnh đề if (loại 1).

items.bad: If public transport was free, more people will use it. GRA
items.good: If public transport were free, more people would use it.
items.note: Loại 2: If + quá khứ, would + V. Trong văn viết trang trọng, dùng were cho mọi ngôi.

items.bad: If the city invested earlier, congestion would have been less severe. GRA
items.good: If the city had invested earlier, congestion would have been less severe.
items.note: Loại 3: If + had V3, would have + V3.

items.bad: Unless the government does not act, pollution will rise. GRA
items.good: Unless the government acts, pollution will rise.
items.note: unless đã mang nghĩa if … not; không thêm phủ định.

items.bad: If everyone recycled, pollution would disappear completely. TR
items.good: If everyone recycled, pollution would fall considerably.
items.note: Ngay cả trong câu giả định, kết quả cũng phải hợp lý; disappear completely là tuyệt đối hóa.

items.bad: Provided that students motivated, online learning works well. GRA
items.good: Provided that students are motivated, online learning works well.
items.note: provided that + mệnh đề đầy đủ (có động từ).

items.html: Loại 1 khi giải pháp có khả năng thực tế (If the government taxes sugar, …); loại 2 khi giải pháp mang tính giả định hoặc bạn muốn đề xuất một cách thận trọng (If public transport were free, …). Cả hai đều đúng; chọn theo mức độ chắc chắn bạn muốn thể hiện.
If it was chấp nhận trong văn nói; trong bài viết học thuật, dùng If it were (và If I were).
Unless we act now = If we do not act now. Không viết Unless we do not act.

items.h: provided that / as long as / on condition that
items.html: Cả ba nhấn mạnh rằng điều kiện là bắt buộc. on condition that trang trọng nhất; as long as ít trang trọng hơn.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại bằng câu điều kiện
intro: Viết lại mỗi tình huống bằng loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ được cho.

items.cue: People exercise regularly. They sleep better.
items.answer: If people exercise regularly, they sleep better.
items.alt: If people take regular exercise, they sleep better.

items.cue: The government may tax sugary drinks. Then consumption may fall.
items.answer: If the government taxes sugary drinks, consumption may fall.
items.alt: If sugary drinks are taxed, consumption may fall.

items.cue: Public transport is not free, so many people drive.
items.answer: If public transport were free, more people would use it.
items.alt: If public transport were free, fewer people would drive.

items.cue: The city did not invest in a metro early. Congestion became severe.
items.answer: If the city had invested in a metro earlier, congestion would not have become so severe.
items.alt: Congestion would have been less severe if the city had invested in a metro earlier.

items.cue: If we do not act now, pollution will get worse.
items.answer: Unless we act now, pollution will get worse.
items.alt: Pollution will get worse unless we act now.

items.cue: Online learning works well, but only if students are motivated.
items.answer: Online learning works well, provided that students are motivated.
items.alt: Provided that students are motivated, online learning works well.

items.cue: Governments must act now. If they do not, the problem will grow.
items.answer: Governments must act now; otherwise, the problem will grow.
items.alt: Governments must take action now; otherwise, the problem will grow.

items.cue: I did not learn English as a child, so I am not confident now.
items.answer: If I had learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.
items.alt: Had I learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.

items.cue: The government might ban cars from the city centre. Air quality would improve.
items.answer: If the government were to ban cars from the city centre, air quality would improve.
items.alt: If the authorities were to ban cars from the city centre, air quality would improve.

items.cue: Students can use phones in class if they do not disturb others.
items.answer: Students can use phones in class as long as they do not disturb others.
items.alt: As long as they do not disturb others, students can use phones in class.

items.cue: Young offenders may do community service instead of prison if they agree to attend counselling.
items.answer: Young offenders may do community service instead of prison on condition that they attend counselling.
items.alt: Young offenders may avoid prison on condition that they attend counselling.

items.cue: Schools should have first-aid kits because accidents may happen.
items.answer: Schools should keep first-aid kits in case accidents happen.
items.alt: Schools should keep first-aid kits in case of accidents.

items.cue: Many people do not cycle because the roads are dangerous.
items.answer: If the roads were safer, more people would cycle.
items.alt: More people would cycle if the roads were safer.

items.cue: Farmers did not receive subsidies, so many left the countryside.
items.answer: If farmers had received subsidies, fewer of them would have left the countryside.
items.alt: Fewer farmers would have left the countryside if they had received subsidies.

items.cue: If everyone recycled, pollution would disappear completely.
items.answer: If everyone recycled, pollution would fall considerably.
items.alt: If everyone recycled, pollution levels would drop significantly.

items.cue: The government did not regulate social media earlier, so misinformation is widespread today.
items.answer: If the government had regulated social media earlier, misinformation would not be so widespread today.
items.alt: Misinformation would be less widespread today if social media had been regulated earlier.

items.cue: Parents should read to their children. If they do not, children may lose interest in books.
items.answer: Parents should read to their children; otherwise, they may lose interest in books.
items.alt: Parents should read to their children; otherwise, the children may lose interest in books.

items.cue: Tourists should pay higher fees, but only if the money is spent on conservation.
items.answer: Tourists should pay higher fees, provided that the money is spent on conservation.
items.alt: Higher fees for tourists are fair, provided that the money funds conservation.

items.cue: The city did not plant trees decades ago, so summers are hotter now.
items.answer: If the city had planted more trees decades ago, summers would be cooler now.
items.alt: Summers would be cooler today if the city had planted more trees decades ago.

items.cue: Free university education may be introduced. More students would apply, but quality might fall.
items.answer: If university education were to become free, more students would apply, but teaching quality might fall.
items.alt: If tuition fees were abolished, more students would apply, although teaching quality might suffer.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Nếu mọi người tập thể dục đều đặn, họ ngủ ngon hơn.
items.translation: If people do exercise regularly, they sleep better.
items.answer: If people exercise regularly, they sleep better.
items.alt: People who exercise regularly sleep better.

items.cue: Nếu chính phủ đánh thuế đồ uống có đường, lượng tiêu thụ có thể giảm.
items.translation: If the government puts tax on sugary drinks, the consumption can decrease.
items.answer: If the government taxes sugary drinks, consumption may fall.
items.alt: If sugary drinks are taxed, consumption may fall.

items.cue: Nếu phương tiện công cộng miễn phí, nhiều người sẽ sử dụng hơn.
items.translation: If public transport is free, more people will use it.
items.answer: If public transport were free, more people would use it.
items.alt: More people would use public transport if it were free.

items.cue: Nếu thành phố đầu tư vào tàu điện ngầm sớm hơn, tình trạng ùn tắc đã không nghiêm trọng như vậy.
items.translation: The city did not invest in a metro early, so traffic congestion became very serious.
items.answer: If the city had invested in a metro earlier, congestion would not have become so severe.
items.alt: Congestion would have been less severe if the city had built a metro earlier.

items.cue: Trừ khi chúng ta hành động ngay, ô nhiễm sẽ trở nên tồi tệ hơn.
items.translation: If we do not act now, pollution will get worse.
items.answer: Unless we act now, pollution will get worse.
items.alt: Pollution will worsen unless we take action now.

items.cue: Học trực tuyến hiệu quả, miễn là học sinh có động lực.
items.translation: Online learning is effective if students have motivation.
items.answer: Online learning is effective, provided that students are motivated.
items.alt: As long as students are motivated, online learning is effective.

items.cue: Chính phủ phải hành động ngay; nếu không, vấn đề sẽ ngày càng nghiêm trọng.
items.translation: The government must act now. If it does not, the problem will become more serious.
items.answer: Governments must act now; otherwise, the problem will become more serious.
items.alt: Unless governments act now, the problem will become more serious.

items.cue: Nếu tôi học tiếng Anh từ nhỏ, bây giờ tôi đã tự tin hơn.
items.translation: I did not learn English as a child, so I am not confident now.
items.answer: If I had learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.
items.alt: Had I learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.

items.cue: Nếu chính phủ cấm ô tô ở trung tâm thành phố, chất lượng không khí sẽ được cải thiện.
items.translation: If the government bans cars in the city centre, the air quality will be better.
items.answer: If the government were to ban cars from the city centre, air quality would improve.
items.alt: If cars were banned from the city centre, air quality would improve.

items.cue: Học sinh có thể dùng điện thoại trong lớp, miễn là không làm phiền người khác.
items.translation: Students can use phones in class if they do not disturb other people.
items.answer: Students can use phones in class as long as they do not disturb others.
items.alt: Provided that they do not disturb others, students can use phones in class.

items.cue: Nhà trường nên chuẩn bị bộ sơ cứu phòng khi có tai nạn.
items.translation: Schools should prepare first-aid kits if there are accidents.
items.answer: Schools should keep first-aid kits in case accidents happen.
items.alt: Schools should keep first-aid kits in case of accidents.

items.cue: Nếu đường sá an toàn hơn, nhiều người sẽ đạp xe.
items.translation: If roads are safer, more people will cycle.
items.answer: If the roads were safer, more people would cycle.
items.alt: More people would cycle if the roads were safer.

items.cue: Nếu nông dân được trợ cấp, đã có ít người rời bỏ nông thôn hơn.
items.translation: Farmers did not receive subsidies, so many people left the countryside.
items.answer: If farmers had received subsidies, fewer of them would have left the countryside.
items.alt: Fewer farmers would have left rural areas if they had been given subsidies.

items.cue: Người phạm tội trẻ tuổi có thể làm lao động công ích thay vì ngồi tù, với điều kiện họ tham gia tư vấn tâm lý.
items.translation: Young criminals can do community work instead of prison if they join counselling.
items.answer: Young offenders may do community service instead of going to prison on condition that they attend counselling.
items.alt: Young offenders may avoid prison on condition that they attend counselling.

items.cue: Nếu mọi người đều tái chế, ô nhiễm sẽ giảm đáng kể.
items.translation: If everyone recycles, pollution will decrease a lot.
items.answer: If everyone recycled, pollution would fall considerably.
items.alt: Pollution would drop significantly if everyone recycled.

items.cue: Nếu chính phủ quản lý mạng xã hội sớm hơn, thông tin sai lệch bây giờ đã không lan rộng như vậy.
items.translation: The government did not regulate social media early, so false information is widespread now.
items.answer: If the government had regulated social media earlier, misinformation would not be so widespread today.
items.alt: Misinformation would be less widespread today if social media had been regulated earlier.

items.cue: Du khách nên trả phí cao hơn, miễn là số tiền đó được dùng cho công tác bảo tồn.
items.translation: Tourists should pay higher fees if the money is used for conservation.
items.answer: Tourists should pay higher fees, provided that the money is spent on conservation.
items.alt: Higher fees for tourists are fair as long as the money funds conservation.

items.cue: Nếu thành phố trồng nhiều cây hơn từ nhiều thập kỷ trước, mùa hè bây giờ đã mát hơn.
items.translation: The city did not plant enough trees decades ago, so summers are hotter now.
items.answer: If the city had planted more trees decades ago, summers would be cooler now.
items.alt: Summers would be cooler today if more trees had been planted decades ago.

items.cue: Nếu giáo dục đại học trở nên miễn phí, nhiều sinh viên hơn sẽ đăng ký, nhưng chất lượng giảng dạy có thể giảm.
items.translation: If university education becomes free, more students will apply, but teaching quality may go down.
items.answer: If university education were to become free, more students would apply, but teaching quality might fall.
items.alt: If tuition fees were abolished, more students would apply, although teaching quality might suffer.

items.cue: Cha mẹ nên đọc sách cho con; nếu không, trẻ có thể mất hứng thú với sách.
items.translation: Parents should read books to their children. If they do not, the children may lose interest in books.
items.answer: Parents should read to their children; otherwise, they may lose interest in books.
items.alt: Unless parents read to their children, the children may lose interest in books.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: If the government will tax sugar, consumption will fall.
items.answer: If the government will tax TAXES sugar, consumption will fall.
notes: GRA Không dùng will trong mệnh đề if.

items.cue: If public transport was free, more people will use it.
items.answer: If public transport was free, more people will use WOULD USE it.
notes: GRA Loại 2: would + V.

items.cue: If the city invested earlier, congestion would have been less severe.
items.answer: If the city invested HAD INVESTED earlier, congestion would have been less severe.
notes: GRA Loại 3: If + had V3.

items.cue: If people exercise regularly, they sleep better.
items.answer: ✓ If people exercise regularly, they sleep better.
notes: Đúng: loại 0 cho sự thật chung.

items.cue: Unless the government does not act, pollution will rise.
items.answer: Unless the government does not act ACTS, pollution will rise.
notes: GRA unless đã mang nghĩa phủ định.

items.cue: Provided that students motivated, online learning works well.
items.answer: Provided that students motivated STUDENTS ARE MOTIVATED, online learning works well.
notes: GRA provided that + mệnh đề đầy đủ.

items.cue: If I had learned English as a child, I would have been more confident now.
items.answer: If I had learned English as a child, I would have been WOULD BE more confident now.
notes: GRA Câu hỗn hợp: kết quả ở hiện tại (now) → would + V.

items.cue: If the roads were safer, more people would cycle.
items.answer: ✓ If the roads were safer, more people would cycle.
notes: Đúng: loại 2 với were.

items.cue: Governments must act now, otherwise the problem will grow.
items.answer: Governments must act now, otherwise ; OTHERWISE, the problem will grow.
notes: GRA otherwise nối hai mệnh đề độc lập: dùng dấu chấm phẩy trước và dấu phẩy sau.

items.cue: If farmers had received subsidies in the 1990s, fewer would leave the countryside during that decade.
items.answer: If farmers had received subsidies in the 1990s, fewer would leave WOULD HAVE LEFT the countryside during that decade.
notes: GRA Mốc thời gian quá khứ (in the 1990s, during that decade) → loại 3: would have + V3.

items.cue: If the government would ban cars, the air would be cleaner.
items.answer: If the government would ban BANNED cars, the air would be cleaner.
notes: GRA Không dùng would trong mệnh đề if; dùng quá khứ đơn hoặc were to ban.

items.cue: Schools should keep first-aid kits in case accidents happen.
items.answer: ✓ Schools should keep first-aid kits in case accidents happen.
notes: Đúng: in case + hiện tại đơn.

items.cue: Students can use phones as long as they won't disturb others.
items.answer: Students can use phones as long as they won't disturb DO NOT DISTURB others.
notes: GRA Sau as long as dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng will; tránh viết tắt.

items.cue: If everyone recycled, pollution would disappear completely.
items.answer: If everyone recycled, pollution would disappear completely WOULD FALL CONSIDERABLY.
notes: TR Kết quả giả định bị tuyệt đối hóa.

items.cue: If the government were to banned cars, air quality would improve.
items.answer: If the government were to banned WERE TO BAN cars, air quality would improve.
notes: GRA were to + V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: Unless action is taken soon, many species will become extinct.
items.answer: ✓ Unless action is taken soon, many species will become extinct.
notes: Đúng: unless + khẳng định.

items.cue: In case of it rains, the event will move indoors.
items.answer: In case of it rains IF IT RAINS, the event will move indoors.
notes: GRA Đây là điều kiện (nếu trời mưa), nên dùng If. in case + mệnh đề = phòng khi (chuẩn bị trước); in case of + danh từ (In case of rain, …) cũng đúng.

items.cue: If young people would have more job opportunities, fewer would emigrate.
items.answer: If young people would have HAD more job opportunities, fewer would emigrate.
notes: GRA Mệnh đề if loại 2 dùng quá khứ đơn.

items.cue: If the city had planted more trees decades ago, summers would be cooler now.
items.answer: ✓ If the city had planted more trees decades ago, summers would be cooler now.
notes: Đúng: câu hỗn hợp (quá khứ → hiện tại).

items.cue: If the government bans fast food, everyone will become healthy and obesity will be solved forever.
items.answer: If the government bans fast food, everyone will become healthy PUBLIC HEALTH MAY IMPROVE and obesity will be solved forever OBESITY RATES COULD FALL.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (everyone); dùng may.
TR Phóng đại kết quả (solved forever).

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng loại câu điều kiện được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai loại câu điều kiện / liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that male leaders are more likely to cause violence and conflict, while female leaders would create a more peaceful world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: If more women held leadership positions, decision-making might become more inclusive.

items.cue: Art and museums · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Many people regard film as a less important form of art than literature or painting. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: If a film tells a powerful story, it can move audiences as deeply as a great novel.

items.cue: Art and museums · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should spend money on new public buildings, such as libraries and museums, rather than on renovating old buildings. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: If governments renovate old buildings, they can preserve a city's history while saving on construction materials.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: When new towns are built, it is more important to provide public parks and sports facilities than shopping centres. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: If new towns had more parks, residents would be healthier and more active.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: University students should study a range of subjects rather than focusing on only one subject. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Studying several subjects broadens students' knowledge, provided that they still develop expertise in one area.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: School students should focus on academic subjects and examinations, while practical skills such as cooking, sewing and woodwork can be learned from family and friends. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Unless schools teach practical skills, some students will leave without knowing how to cook a simple meal.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should ban dangerous sports such as skydiving and rock climbing. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Dangerous sports should remain legal as long as participants are properly trained and equipped.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Young adults who take part in work that benefits their local communities should be paid for this work rather than do it voluntarily. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: If young volunteers were to be paid, more of them might take part in community work.

items.cue: Animals · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that preventing animal species from becoming extinct should be a priority, while others think that human problems are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Governments must protect endangered species now; otherwise, entire ecosystems may collapse.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that courses in the performing arts, such as music, dance and drama, should be funded by governments, while others think they should be paid for by businesses or families. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: If governments funded performing arts courses, talented students from poor families would have a fairer chance.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that students should study more practical subjects, such as computing, while others think they should focus more on academic subjects, such as geography and mathematics. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: If students study computing, they will be better prepared for the modern job market.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that students benefit from attending private secondary schools, while others think private schools can have a negative effect on society as a whole. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Private schools could receive public funding on condition that they offer places to low-income students.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that physical strength and fitness are the main reasons individuals and teams succeed in sport, while others think mental attitude is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: If a player has strong mental focus, physical weaknesses matter less.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Violent behaviour among football supporters is a problem in many places. What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?
items.answer: Unless clubs punish violent supporters, the problem is likely to continue.

items.cue: Work · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many countries, older people who are looking for work have to compete with younger people. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.
items.answer: If employers valued experience more, older jobseekers would find work more easily. Governments could offer tax incentives, provided that firms hire workers over fifty.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Many goods are transported over long distances before they reach consumers. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.
items.answer: If goods were produced closer to consumers, transport emissions would fall. However, if countries relied only on local products, consumer choice would be very limited.

items.cue: Food and health · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that it would be better if people ate only food produced locally. Do the advantages of eating only local food outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.
items.answer: If people ate only local food, farmers in their region would benefit. Unless they lived in a fertile area, however, their diet might become less varied.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Differences between countries are becoming less noticeable because people increasingly wear similar clothes and watch the same television programmes. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.
items.answer: If every country watched the same programmes, local cultures might gradually disappear. Unless governments support local media, this trend is likely to continue.

items.cue: Environment · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Fossil fuels such as coal, oil and natural gas remain the main sources of energy in many countries, while some countries are encouraging the use of renewable energy such as wind and solar power. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.
items.answer: If more countries had invested in renewable energy earlier, global emissions would be lower today. Fossil fuels can still play a role, provided that their use declines steadily.

items.cue: Traffic · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some countries are spending large amounts of money to make cycling easier and safer. Why are they doing this, and is encouraging cycling the best solution to transport problems?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một loại câu điều kiện hoặc liên từ điều kiện khác nhau.
items.answer: If cycling were safer, more people would leave their cars at home. However, cycling alone cannot solve congestion unless public transport is also improved.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn dạng câu điều kiện phù hợp
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng với loại câu điều kiện và mức độ chắc chắn.

items.cue: If people exercise regularly, they ( would sleep / sleep ) better.
items.answer: sleep
items.note: Sự thật chung → loại 0.

items.cue: If the government taxes sugary drinks, consumption ( may fall / would have fallen ).
items.answer: may fall
items.note: Loại 1: kết quả có thể xảy ra trong tương lai.

items.cue: If public transport ( were / is ) free, more people would use it.
items.answer: were
items.note: Loại 2: If + quá khứ (were).

items.cue: If the city ( invested / had invested ) earlier, congestion would not have become so severe.
items.answer: had invested
items.note: Loại 3: If + had V3.

items.cue: ( If / Unless ) we act now, pollution will get worse.
items.answer: Unless
items.note: Unless có nghĩa là if … not (nếu không).

items.cue: If I had learned English as a child, I ( will be / would be ) more confident now.
items.answer: would be
items.note: Câu hỗn hợp: kết quả ở hiện tại.

items.cue: Online learning works well, ( unless / provided that ) students are motivated.
items.answer: provided that
items.note: Điều kiện bắt buộc → provided that.

items.cue: Governments must act now; ( otherwise / unless ), the problem will grow.
items.answer: otherwise
items.note: otherwise = nếu không thì; đứng sau dấu chấm phẩy.

items.cue: Schools should keep first-aid kits ( in case / if ) accidents happen.
items.answer: in case
items.note: Chuẩn bị trước, phòng khi → in case.

items.cue: If the government ( will / were to ) ban cars, air quality would improve.
items.answer: were to
items.note: Giả định trang trọng: If … were to + V.

items.cue: Students can use phones ( as long as / unless ) they do not disturb others.
items.answer: as long as
items.note: Điều kiện bắt buộc → as long as.

items.cue: If farmers had received subsidies in the 1990s, fewer ( would have left / would leave ) the countryside during that decade.
items.answer: would have left
items.note: Kết quả trong quá khứ (during that decade) → loại 3.

items.cue: If the roads ( would be / were ) safer, more people would cycle.
items.answer: were
items.note: Không dùng would trong mệnh đề if.

items.cue: If it ( will rain / rains ) tomorrow, the match will be cancelled.
items.answer: rains
items.note: Loại 1: mệnh đề if dùng hiện tại đơn.

items.cue: If everyone recycled, pollution ( would fall considerably / would disappear completely ).
items.answer: would fall considerably
items.note: Kết quả phải hợp lý, không tuyệt đối hóa.

items.cue: Unless action ( is / is not ) taken soon, many species will disappear.
items.answer: is
items.note: Không thêm phủ định sau unless.

items.cue: If young people ( would have / had ) more job opportunities, fewer would emigrate.
items.answer: had
items.note: Loại 2: mệnh đề if dùng quá khứ đơn.

items.cue: Tourists should pay higher fees, ( provided that / in case ) the money funds conservation.
items.answer: provided that
items.note: Điều kiện bắt buộc → provided that.

items.cue: If the city had planted more trees decades ago, summers ( would have been / would be ) cooler now.
items.answer: would be
items.note: Câu hỗn hợp: now → would + V.

items.cue: Private schools could receive funding ( on condition that / otherwise ) they accept low-income students.
items.answer: on condition that
items.note: Điều kiện bắt buộc, trang trọng → on condition that.

theory.html: Đảo ngữ đưa một trạng từ phủ định hoặc giới hạn (Rarely, Never before, Only by, Not until…) lên đầu câu, sau đó đảo trợ động từ lên trước chủ ngữ. Cấu trúc này giúp bạn nhấn mạnh ý quan trọng nhất của đoạn văn và thể hiện ngữ pháp đa dạng, trang trọng (GRA).
Đảo ngữ chỉ hiệu quả khi dùng ít và đúng chỗ: tối đa một câu đảo ngữ trong một đoạn văn, thường là câu nêu ý chính hoặc câu kết. Một đoạn văn có ba câu đảo ngữ liên tiếp nghe gượng ép và dễ sai.

Lỗi thường gặp: quên trợ động từ (Rarely young people read), đảo sai mệnh đề sau Only when / Only if (chỉ đảo ở mệnh đề chính), dùng when sau No sooner, và vi phạm cấu trúc song song trong not only … but also.

cells: Not only + aux + S + V, but S + also + V
Not only does automation cut costs, but it also improves safety.
Rarely do young people read printed newspapers.
Never before has information been so easy to access.
Little do many consumers realise how much data they share.
Only when / if + mệnh đề, aux + S + V
Only when public transport improves will people leave their cars at home.
Only by + V-ing / Only after + N, aux + S + V
Only by investing in education can poverty be reduced.
Not until + mốc thời gian / mệnh đề + did + S + V
Not until the 1990s did most people have access to the Internet.
Under no circumstances / In no way
Under no circumstances + aux + S + V
Under no circumstances should children be left unsupervised online.
No sooner + had + S + V3 + than …; Hardly + had + S + V3 + when …
No sooner had the congestion charge been introduced than traffic fell.
So + adj + be + N + that …; Such + be + N + that …
So severe is the housing shortage that many young workers live far from their jobs.

items: Not only does automation cut costs, but it also improves safety.
Rarely do young people read printed newspapers.
Never before has information been so easy to access.
Only by investing in education can poverty be reduced.
Not until the 1990s did most people have access to the Internet.
Under no circumstances should children be left unsupervised online.
So severe is the housing shortage that many young workers live far from their jobs.
Such is the popularity of smartphones that few people can imagine life without them.

items.bad: Hosting the Olympics not only consumes huge resources but also increasing the number of tourists. GRA
items.good: Hosting the Olympics not only consumes huge resources but also increases the number of tourists.
items.note: Cấu trúc song song: hai vế sau not only và but also phải cùng dạng (consumes … increases).

items.html: Dùng để nhấn mạnh ý quan trọng nhất của đoạn, tối đa một lần mỗi đoạn. Không dùng đảo ngữ cho câu nêu quan điểm ở mở bài nếu nó làm câu khó hiểu.

items.h: Not only … but also: đảo ở đâu?
items.html: Chỉ đảo ngữ ở vế đầu khi Not only đứng đầu câu; vế sau giữ trật tự bình thường: …, but it also improves safety. Nếu not only đứng giữa câu, không đảo ngữ nhưng hai vế phải song song.

items.h: Only when / Only if: đảo ở mệnh đề nào?
items.html: Đảo ở mệnh đề chính, không đảo trong mệnh đề only: Only when public transport improves (không đảo) will people leave their cars (đảo).
So + tính từ + be + danh từ + that (So severe is the shortage that …); Such + be + danh từ + that (Such is the popularity of smartphones that …).

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc đảo ngữ được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: It is more important for a building to be practical than to be beautiful, so architects should not treat buildings as works of art. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Not only does a beautiful building attract visitors, but it also improves the quality of life of those who use it.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: It is more important for schoolchildren to learn about local history than world history. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Only by learning about world history can children understand how their own country fits into the wider world.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The main purpose of schools is to prepare children to become good citizens and workers rather than to benefit them as individuals. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Not only should schools prepare children for work, but they should also help them develop as individuals.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that not all children have a natural ability to learn a foreign language and that it is therefore wrong to make every child study one at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Rarely do children who lack confidence in languages enjoy compulsory lessons.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Parents should encourage their children to spend less time studying and more time taking part in sports and physical activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Only when children balance study with exercise do they stay healthy and focused.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The popularity of fashions in clothes and other consumer goods shows that people tend to copy one another. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Seldom do young people choose clothes that their friends would consider unfashionable.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Although more people now read news online, newspapers still have an important role to play. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Never before has so much unreliable information been available online, which is why newspapers remain important.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that foreign visitors should pay higher entrance fees than local people at tourist attractions. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Rarely do higher entrance fees stop foreign tourists from visiting major attractions, so a modest surcharge seems reasonable.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that museums should be free to enter, while others think visitors should pay an admission fee. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Only if museums are free will many low-income families visit them.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that secondary school students should study international news as a school subject, while others think this would waste valuable school time. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Little do many teenagers know about events outside their own country.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that computers and the Internet are more important than schools and teachers in children's education, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Not until children learn to judge online sources critically can the Internet replace a good teacher.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that economic growth is necessary to reduce poverty, while others argue that economic growth should be limited because it damages the environment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Such is the scale of environmental damage in some regions that economic growth there must be carefully controlled.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to reduce crime is to give criminals longer prison sentences, while others think that alternative methods are more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Only by addressing the causes of crime can governments reduce reoffending.

items.cue: Art and museums · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many places, museums and historical sites are visited mainly by tourists rather than local people. Why is this the case, and what can be done to attract more local visitors?
items.answer: So high are admission prices at some museums that local families rarely visit them.

items.cue: Education · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many people leave school with a negative attitude towards learning. Why does this happen, and what can be done to encourage a more positive attitude?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.
items.answer: Rarely do students enjoy learning when lessons focus only on exams. Only by making lessons relevant to real life can teachers change this attitude.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Machines are becoming increasingly complex, and more and more work is being automated. Do the advantages of automation outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.
items.answer: Not only does automation increase productivity, but it also removes workers from dangerous tasks. Only if workers are retrained, however, will its benefits be shared fairly.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some countries, criminal trials are shown on television so that members of the public can watch them. Do the advantages of broadcasting court cases outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.
items.answer: Not only would televised trials make justice more transparent, but they would also educate the public about the law. Under no circumstances, however, should victims' identities be revealed.

items.cue: Media and communication · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Many young people admire media and sports stars who do not always set a good example. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.
items.answer: Seldom do young fans distinguish between a star's talent and his or her behaviour. Only when the media highlight positive role models will this begin to change.

items.cue: Traffic · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some cities have introduced congestion charges during busy periods in order to reduce traffic. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.
items.answer: Not only do congestion charges reduce traffic, but they also raise money for public transport. Only if the money is reinvested, however, will drivers accept them.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some people believe that the human race is steadily improving in every area of life. In which areas have we made the most important progress, and in which areas do we still need to make further progress?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc đảo ngữ khác nhau.
items.answer: Never before has medical science saved so many lives. Rarely, however, have we made similar progress in reducing inequality.

theory.html: Câu điều kiện đảo bỏ if và đưa Should / Were / Had lên đầu câu: Had the city invested earlier, … = If the city had invested earlier, …. Cấu trúc này mang văn phong trang trọng, học thuật, rất phù hợp để nêu giải pháp giả định hoặc đánh giá một quyết định trong quá khứ.

Mỗi dạng đảo tương ứng với một loại câu điều kiện ở Unit 15: Should ≈ loại 1 (ít khả năng hơn), Were … to / Were it not for ≈ loại 2, Had / Had it not been for ≈ loại 3 hoặc câu hỗn hợp. But for + danh từ dùng được cho cả loại 2 và loại 3.

Lỗi thường gặp: giữ if trước trợ động từ (If had the city…), dùng động từ chia sau Were (Were the government bans…), viết tắt phủ định (Hadn't the government acted…) và đặt not sai vị trí. Như mọi cấu trúc nhấn mạnh, chỉ nên dùng một lần trong một đoạn văn.

cells: If + S + V (hiện tại), … will / may
Should any problems arise, the school will contact parents.
If + S + were to + V, … would
Were the government to raise fuel taxes, people would drive less.
If + S + were + N / adj, … would
Were public transport free, more people would use it.
If it were not for + N, … would
Were it not for + N, … would
Were it not for tourism, many villages would be empty.
If + S + had + V3, … would have + V3
Had + S + V3, … would have + V3
Had the city invested earlier, congestion would have been less severe.
If it had not been for + N, … would have + V3
Had it not been for + N, …
Had it not been for vaccines, millions more people would have died.
If + S + had + V3, … would + V (bây giờ)
Had + S + V3, … would + V (hỗn hợp)
Had I learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.
Without + N / If it were not for + N
But for international aid, the disaster would have been far worse.
If + S + did not / had not …
Were + S + not to + V; Had + S + not + V3; Should + S + not + V
Had the factory not closed, the town would have kept its jobs.

items: Should any problems arise, the school will contact parents.
Were the government to raise fuel taxes, people would drive less.
Were it not for tourism, many villages would be empty.
Had the city invested earlier, congestion would have been less severe.
Had it not been for vaccines, millions more people would have died.
Had I learned English as a child, I would be more confident now.
But for international aid, the disaster would have been far worse.
Had the factory not closed, the town would have kept its jobs.

items.html: Should = điều có thể xảy ra (loại 1, thận trọng hơn); Were … to / Were it not for = giả định ở hiện tại/tương lai (loại 2); Had / Had it not been for = giả định trong quá khứ (loại 3 hoặc hỗn hợp).

items.h: Were it not for hay Had it not been for?
items.html: Were it not for tourism, many villages would be empty (hiện tại); Had it not been for vaccines, millions more would have died (quá khứ).
Sau chủ ngữ: Had the factory not closed, Were schools not to teach, Should the plan not succeed. Không viết Hadn't the factory closed.
Dùng để tạo văn phong trang trọng hoặc nhấn mạnh một giải pháp/bài học, tối đa một lần mỗi đoạn. Câu if thông thường vẫn luôn đúng và rõ ràng.

items.prompt: Unemployment is becoming increasingly serious in many countries. Some people believe that primary education is enough for students, while others think secondary education is necessary. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Were it not for secondary education, many young people would lack the skills employers require.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that schools should stop using books because children find them boring and should use films, television and computers instead. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Were schools to stop using books, children might lose the ability to concentrate on long texts.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: In some education systems, governments decide what subjects and lesson content students should study. Some people believe teachers should make these decisions instead. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Should teachers decide lesson content, lessons could be better adapted to students' needs.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The traditional lifestyles of local people in developing countries can attract tourists, but tourism may prevent these communities from adopting more modern ways of life. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Were it not for tourism, some traditional crafts would already have disappeared.

items.cue: Art and museums · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Governments should spend more money on public services than on the arts, such as music and painting. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: But for public funding, many orchestras and theatres would have to close.

items.cue: Environment · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that air travel should be restricted because it causes pollution and uses large amounts of the world's fuel resources. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Were air travel to be restricted, millions of people would lose access to affordable international travel.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should provide free public libraries in every town, while others think this is a waste of money because people can access information online. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Were it not for free public libraries, many low-income families would have no access to books or computers.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that rich countries should give aid to all poorer countries, while others think that aid should not be given to countries where corruption is common. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Should aid be given to corrupt governments, much of it may never reach those in need.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that job satisfaction is more important than job security, while others think having a secure, permanent job is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Had more people chosen jobs they enjoy rather than secure ones, they might feel more fulfilled today.

items.cue: Food and health · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people prefer to use gyms and health clubs to stay healthy, while others think everyday activities such as walking and climbing stairs are more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Were people to walk or cycle to work, they would not need expensive gym memberships.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that the amount of noise people make should be strictly controlled, while others think people should be free to make as much noise as they want. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: But for noise regulations, residents near busy roads would struggle to sleep.

items.cue: Media and communication · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Studies show that children spend more time watching television than in the past and less time doing active or creative activities. Why is this happening, and what can be done to encourage children to be more active and creative?
items.answer: Had it not been for the rise of streaming services, children might still spend more time playing outdoors.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: International travel can sometimes make people more prejudiced rather than more open-minded. Why might this happen, and what can be done to reduce this problem?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một dạng câu điều kiện đảo khác nhau.
items.answer: Were travellers to learn about local customs before visiting, misunderstandings would be less likely. Should they stay only in tourist resorts, however, their prejudices may remain unchallenged.

items.cue: City development · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some governments encourage businesses to move from cities to rural areas. Do the advantages of this policy outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một dạng câu điều kiện đảo khác nhau.
items.answer: Were more businesses to move to rural areas, young people would not need to leave their villages for work. Had such policies been introduced earlier, many rural communities might not be in decline today.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: It has become easy for people to obtain credit cards, but some users have difficulty repaying their debts. Do the advantages of easy access to credit cards outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một dạng câu điều kiện đảo khác nhau.
items.answer: Were it not for credit cards, many people would struggle to cover unexpected expenses. Should users borrow more than they can repay, however, they may fall into serious debt.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: It has become easier and more affordable for people to travel to other countries. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một dạng câu điều kiện đảo khác nhau.
items.answer: Had travel not become so affordable, few young people would have the chance to experience other cultures. Were airlines to pay the full cost of their emissions, however, flights would be far more expensive.

items.cue: Work · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: In some countries, it is illegal for employers to reject job applicants because of their age. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một dạng câu điều kiện đảo khác nhau.
items.answer: Were it not for age discrimination laws, many older applicants would be rejected without consideration. Should employers have to justify every decision, however, hiring could become slower.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Two-part question
items.prompt: In schools and universities, girls often choose arts subjects while boys are more likely to choose science subjects. Why does this happen, and should this trend be changed?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một dạng câu điều kiện đảo khác nhau.
items.answer: Were girls to receive more encouragement in science, the gender gap in these subjects would narrow. Had schools challenged these stereotypes earlier, more women might be working as engineers today.

theory.html: Câu chẻ (cleft sentence) tách một câu thành hai phần để làm nổi bật một thành phần: It is education that offers the best route out of poverty nhấn mạnh education; What young people need most is practical experience đưa ý chính xuống cuối câu, nơi người đọc chú ý nhất. Đây là cách tự nhiên để nhấn mạnh luận điểm chính trong câu chủ đề hoặc câu kết đoạn.

Các cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác: The reason why … is that …, The + so sánh hơn …, the + so sánh hơn …, It is not A but B that … và trợ động từ nhấn mạnh (Technology does have drawbacks, but …). Cấu trúc cuối rất hữu ích khi bạn thừa nhận một quan điểm đối lập trước khi phản bác.

Lỗi thường gặp: thêm the trong What is the most striking, dùng because sau The reason why … is, quên the ở vế sau của cấu trúc the more … the more, và dùng what thay cho that trong câu chẻ It is …. Mỗi đoạn văn chỉ nên có một câu chẻ.

theory.text: Câu chẻ và cấu trúc nhấn mạnh

cells: It is / was + thành phần nhấn mạnh + that / who + mệnh đề
It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
What + S + V + is / was + N / to V / that-clause
What young people need most is practical experience.
What is most striking is that older people are now the fastest-growing group of Internet users.
All (that) + S + V + is + N / to V
All that many students want is a stable job.
The reason why + mệnh đề + is that + mệnh đề
The reason why many people do not cycle is that the roads are dangerous.
The thing that … is …; The main problem is that …
The main problem is that rents have risen faster than wages.
The + so sánh hơn (+ N) + S + V, the + so sánh hơn (+ N) + S + V
The higher the population density, the more pollution is generated.
It is not A but B that …; What matters is not A but B
It is not money but job satisfaction that keeps many people motivated.
Technology does have drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.

items: It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
What young people need most is practical experience.
What is most striking is that older people are now the fastest-growing group of Internet users.
The reason why many people do not cycle is that the roads are dangerous.
The higher the population density, the more pollution is generated.
It is not money but job satisfaction that keeps many people motivated.
Technology does have drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.
What matters is not how long students study but how effectively they study.

items.bad: What is the most striking is that young people read less. GRA
items.good: What is most striking is that young people read less.
items.note: Trong cấu trúc What is + adj + is that, không dùng the trước tính từ so sánh nhất.

items.bad: The higher population density is, the more pollution there are. GRA
items.good: The higher the population density, the more pollution there is.
items.note: Danh từ đứng ngay sau the higher the; pollution không đếm được → there is.

items.bad: The reason why people cycle less is because roads are dangerous. GRA
items.good: The reason why people cycle less is that roads are dangerous.
items.note: reason đã mang nghĩa because; dùng is that.

items.bad: It is education what offers the best route out of poverty. GRA
items.good: It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
items.note: Câu chẻ It is … that; không dùng what.

items.bad: What young people need most are practical experience. GRA
items.good: What young people need most is practical experience.
items.note: Mệnh đề What … làm chủ ngữ số ít → is.

items.bad: The more people drive, more pollution there is. GRA
items.good: The more people drive, the more pollution there is.
items.note: Cả hai vế đều cần the.

items.html: It is X that … nhấn mạnh một thành phần, thường để đối lập (It is parents, not teachers, who …). What … is X đưa ý chính xuống cuối câu, tạo sự chú ý (What young people need most is …).
Viết The reason why … is that … hoặc This is because …. Không viết The reason why … is because ….
Giữ the ở cả hai vế; danh từ đứng ngay sau tính từ so sánh (the more pollution); động từ be thường có thể lược (The higher the density, the more …). Không đảo ngữ ở vế sau.
Technology does have drawbacks = thừa nhận mạnh mẽ một ý trước khi phản bác. Sau do / does / did dùng V nguyên mẫu (does have, không does has).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại bằng câu chẻ / cấu trúc nhấn mạnh
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cấu trúc được cho để nhấn mạnh phần quan trọng nhất.

items.cue: Education offers the best route out of poverty.
items.answer: It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
items.alt: It is through education that people can best escape poverty.

items.cue: Young people need practical experience most.
items.answer: What young people need most is practical experience.
items.alt: What young people most need is practical experience.

items.cue: Many people do not cycle because the roads are dangerous.
items.answer: The reason why many people do not cycle is that the roads are dangerous.
items.alt: The main reason many people do not cycle is that the roads are unsafe.

items.cue: Many students only want a stable job.

items.cue: Rents have risen faster than wages. This is the main problem.
items.answer: The main problem is that rents have risen faster than wages.
items.alt: The main problem is that wages have not kept pace with rents.

items.cue: When population density increases, more pollution is generated.

items.cue: Job satisfaction, not money, keeps many people motivated.
items.answer: It is not money but job satisfaction that keeps many people motivated.

items.hint: What is most striking is that

items.cue: Parents, rather than teachers, have the greatest influence on young children.
items.answer: It is parents, rather than teachers, who have the greatest influence on young children.
items.alt: It is parents, not teachers, who most influence young children.

items.cue: Technology has drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.
items.answer: Technology does have drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.
items.alt: Admittedly, technology does have drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.

items.cue: How effectively students study matters, not how long they study.
items.answer: What matters is not how long students study but how effectively they do so.
items.alt: It is not how long students study but how effectively they study that matters.

items.cue: If people earn more, they tend to spend more.
items.answer: The more people earn, the more they tend to spend.
items.alt: The higher people's incomes, the more they tend to spend.

items.cue: Governments should invest in prevention.
items.answer: What governments should do is invest in prevention.
items.alt: What governments need to do is invest in prevention.

items.cue: The cost of housing worries young people most.
items.answer: The thing that worries young people most is the cost of housing.
items.alt: What worries young people most is the cost of housing.

items.cue: In the 1990s, the Internet began to transform education.
items.answer: It was in the 1990s that the Internet began to transform education.
items.alt: It was during the 1990s that the Internet started to change education.

items.cue: Many people buy brands because they want social status.
items.answer: The reason why many people buy brands is that they want social status.
items.alt: What many people seek when they buy brands is social status.

items.cue: When children spend more time online, they spend less time outdoors.
items.answer: The more time children spend online, the less time they spend outdoors.
items.alt: The longer children spend online, the less time they spend outside.

items.cue: What is the most striking is that young people read less.
items.answer: What is most striking is that young people read less.
items.alt: What is most noticeable is that young people read less.

items.cue: The higher population density is, the more pollution there are in metropolises.
items.answer: The higher the population density, the more pollution there is in large cities.
items.alt: The denser the population, the more pollution large cities suffer.

items.cue: Leaders need empathy as well as intelligence.
items.hint: What … is not only … but also
items.answer: What leaders need is not only intelligence but also empathy.
items.alt: What leaders need is empathy as well as intelligence.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Chính giáo dục mới là con đường tốt nhất để thoát nghèo.
items.translation: Education is the best way to escape poverty.
items.answer: It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
items.alt: It is through education that people can best escape poverty.

items.cue: Điều người trẻ cần nhất là kinh nghiệm thực tế.
items.translation: Young people need practical experience most.
items.answer: What young people need most is practical experience.
items.alt: What young people most need is practical experience.

items.cue: Lý do nhiều người không đạp xe là vì đường sá nguy hiểm.
items.translation: Many people do not cycle because the roads are dangerous.
items.answer: The reason why many people do not cycle is that the roads are dangerous.
items.alt: The main reason many people avoid cycling is that the roads are unsafe.

items.cue: Tất cả những gì nhiều sinh viên mong muốn là một công việc ổn định.
items.translation: Many students only want a stable job.
items.answer: All that many students want is a stable job.
items.alt: All many students want is a secure job.

items.cue: Vấn đề chính là giá thuê nhà tăng nhanh hơn tiền lương.
items.translation: Rents are increasing faster than salaries, and this is the main problem.
items.answer: The main problem is that rents have risen faster than wages.
items.alt: The main problem is that wages have not kept pace with rents.

items.cue: Mật độ dân số càng cao thì ô nhiễm càng nhiều.
items.translation: When population density is higher, there is more pollution.
items.answer: The higher the population density, the more pollution is generated.
items.alt: The denser the population, the more pollution there is.

items.cue: Không phải tiền bạc mà chính sự hài lòng trong công việc mới giữ cho nhiều người có động lực.
items.translation: Job satisfaction, not money, keeps many people motivated.
items.answer: It is not money but job satisfaction that keeps many people motivated.
items.alt: What keeps many people motivated is not money but job satisfaction.

items.cue: Điều đáng chú ý nhất là người cao tuổi hiện là nhóm sử dụng Internet tăng nhanh nhất.
items.translation: The most noticeable thing is that old people are now the fastest-growing Internet users.
items.answer: What is most striking is that older people are now the fastest-growing group of Internet users.
items.alt: The most striking fact is that older people are now the fastest-growing group of Internet users.

items.cue: Chính cha mẹ, chứ không phải giáo viên, là người ảnh hưởng lớn nhất đến trẻ nhỏ.
items.translation: Parents, not teachers, have the biggest influence on young children.
items.answer: It is parents, rather than teachers, who have the greatest influence on young children.
items.alt: It is parents, not teachers, who most influence young children.

items.cue: Công nghệ quả thực có những hạn chế, nhưng lợi ích của nó lớn hơn.
items.translation: Technology really has some limitations, but its benefits are bigger.
items.answer: Technology does have drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.
items.alt: Admittedly, technology does have drawbacks, but its benefits outweigh them.

items.cue: Điều quan trọng không phải là học sinh học bao lâu mà là học hiệu quả như thế nào.
items.translation: How long students study is not important; what is important is how effectively they study.
items.answer: What matters is not how long students study but how effectively they study.
items.alt: It is not how long but how effectively students study that matters.

items.cue: Người ta càng kiếm được nhiều tiền thì càng có xu hướng chi tiêu nhiều.
items.translation: When people earn more money, they tend to spend more.
items.answer: The more people earn, the more they tend to spend.
items.alt: The higher people's incomes, the more they tend to spend.

items.cue: Điều chính phủ nên làm là đầu tư vào phòng ngừa.
items.translation: The government should invest in prevention.
items.answer: What governments should do is invest in prevention.
items.alt: What the government needs to do is invest in prevention.

items.cue: Điều khiến người trẻ lo lắng nhất là chi phí nhà ở.
items.translation: The cost of housing worries young people the most.
items.answer: The thing that worries young people most is the cost of housing.
items.alt: What worries young people most is the cost of housing.

items.cue: Chính vào những năm 1990, Internet bắt đầu thay đổi giáo dục.
items.translation: In the 1990s, the Internet started to change education.
items.answer: It was in the 1990s that the Internet began to transform education.
items.alt: It was during the 1990s that the Internet started to change education.

items.cue: Trẻ dành càng nhiều thời gian trên mạng thì càng ít thời gian ở ngoài trời.
items.translation: If children spend more time online, they spend less time outdoors.
items.answer: The more time children spend online, the less time they spend outdoors.
items.alt: The longer children spend online, the less time they spend outside.

items.cue: Điều nhà lãnh đạo cần không chỉ là trí thông minh mà còn là sự thấu cảm.
items.translation: Leaders need not only intelligence but also empathy.
items.answer: What leaders need is not only intelligence but also empathy.
items.alt: What leaders need is empathy as well as intelligence.

items.cue: Chính những bữa ăn chung mới giúp các thành viên trong gia đình gắn kết.
items.translation: Shared meals help family members stay close.
items.answer: It is shared meals that help family members stay close.
items.alt: It is eating together that keeps family members close.

items.answer: The reason why many people live alone is that they earn more and marry later.
items.alt: The main reason more people live alone is that they have higher incomes and marry later.

items.cue: Điều đáng lo ngại nhất không phải là dân số già đi mà là thiếu sự chuẩn bị cho điều đó.
