items.answer: What is most worrying is not the ageing population itself but the lack of preparation for it.
items.alt: It is not the ageing population but the lack of preparation for it that is most worrying.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: What is the most striking is that young people read less.
items.answer: What is the most striking WHAT IS MOST STRIKING is that young people read less.
notes: GRA Không dùng the trong cấu trúc What is + adj + is that.

items.cue: The higher population density is, the more pollution there are in metropolises.
items.answer: The higher population density is THE HIGHER THE POPULATION DENSITY, the more pollution there are THERE IS in metropolises.
notes: GRA Danh từ đứng ngay sau the higher the; có thể lược is.
GRA pollution không đếm được → there is.

items.cue: The reason why people cycle less is because roads are dangerous.
items.answer: The reason why people cycle less is because IS THAT roads are dangerous.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đúng: The reason why … is that … (không dùng because).

items.cue: It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
items.answer: ✓ It is education that offers the best route out of poverty.
notes: Đúng: câu chẻ It is … that.

items.cue: What young people need most are practical experience.

notes: GRA Mệnh đề What … làm chủ ngữ số ít → is.

items.cue: The more people drive, more pollution there is.
items.answer: The more people drive, more pollution there is THE MORE POLLUTION THERE IS.
notes: GRA Cả hai vế đều cần the.

items.cue: What matters is not how long students study but how effectively they study.
items.answer: ✓ What matters is not how long students study but how effectively they study.
notes: Đúng: What matters is not A but B.

items.cue: All what many students want is a stable job.
items.answer: All what ALL THAT many students want is a stable job.
notes: GRA All (that) + mệnh đề; không dùng what.

items.cue: It is parents who has the greatest influence on young children.
items.answer: It is parents who has WHO HAVE the greatest influence on young children.
notes: GRA who thay cho parents (số nhiều) → have.

items.cue: Technology does has drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.
items.answer: Technology does has DOES HAVE drawbacks, but its benefits are greater.
notes: GRA Sau trợ động từ nhấn mạnh dùng V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: The more people earn, the more they tend to spend.
items.answer: ✓ The more people earn, the more they tend to spend.
notes: Đúng: so sánh kép với the ở cả hai vế.

items.cue: The main problem are that rents have risen faster than wages.
items.answer: The main problem are IS that rents have risen faster than wages.
notes: GRA Chủ ngữ problem số ít → is.

items.cue: What governments should do is investing in prevention.
items.answer: What governments should do is investing INVEST in prevention.
notes: GRA Sau What … do is dùng V nguyên mẫu.

items.cue: It was in the 1990s which the Internet began to transform education.
items.answer: It was in the 1990s which THAT the Internet began to transform education.
notes: GRA Câu chẻ It was … that, kể cả khi nhấn mạnh thời gian.

items.cue: It is not money but job satisfaction that keeps many people motivated.
items.answer: ✓ It is not money but job satisfaction that keeps many people motivated.
notes: Đúng: It is not A but B that ….

items.cue: The more time children spend online, the less time do they spend outdoors.
items.answer: The more time children spend online, the less time do they spend THE LESS TIME THEY SPEND outdoors.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc nhấn mạnh được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Choosing a career is the most important decision that young people have to make. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is the choice of career that shapes much of a young person's adult life.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People work for many different reasons. Some people believe that money is the most important reason. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: What motivates many people most is not money but a sense of purpose.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Intelligence is the most important quality a leader can have. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: What … need is not only … but also
items.answer: What leaders need is not only intelligence but also the ability to listen.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Social skills are as important as good qualifications for success in a job. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is often social skills, rather than qualifications, that help employees win promotion.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the most important benefit of being wealthy is the ability to help other people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The main benefit of wealth is that it gives people the freedom to help others.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Eating meals together is an important social activity for families and communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view in relation to your own country?
items.answer: It is shared meals that give busy families a chance to talk to one another.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that everyone should become vegetarian because people do not need to eat meat to have a healthy diet. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The reason why many people eat less meat is that they are concerned about animal welfare.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that reading stories from books is better for children than watching television or playing computer games. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The more children read, the richer their vocabulary becomes.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that a university education is necessary for success in life, while others think it is possible to succeed without going to university. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: What matters is not only … but also
items.answer: What matters for success is not only a degree but also the willingness to keep learning.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that personal happiness depends mainly on economic success, while others think it depends on many different factors. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: What makes many people happy is having close relationships, not simply earning more.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that companies should give the greatest importance to their employees, while others think customers should come first. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: It is employees who ultimately determine how customers are treated.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: The number of television programmes is increasing. Some people think this gives viewers more choice, while others believe it lowers the overall quality of television. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: The more channels there are, the harder it is for each one to fund high-quality programmes.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: In some cultures, older people are highly valued, while in others, greater value is placed on youth. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: What is most striking is that
items.answer: What is most striking is that cultures which respect older people often have stronger family ties.

items.cue: Media and communication · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: A report has shown that many children aged 7 to 11 spend too much time watching television and playing video games. How can this affect children, their families and society, and what measures can be taken to reduce the problem?
items.answer: The main problem is that children who spend hours on screens get too little physical exercise.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many charities and organisations promote special awareness days, such as National Children's Day or No Smoking Day, in order to publicise their work. Why has this become common, and what effects does it have?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau (câu chẻ, The reason why, so sánh kép …).
items.answer: What awareness days do best is draw public attention to issues that are usually ignored. The more often such days are held, however, the less impact each one may have.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that all young adults should spend a period of time doing unpaid work in their local community. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau (câu chẻ, The reason why, so sánh kép …).
items.answer: It is through unpaid community work that many young adults first learn responsibility. The main drawback, however, is that it may prevent those from poorer families from earning money.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some students take a year off between finishing school and starting university. Do the advantages of taking a gap year outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau (câu chẻ, The reason why, so sánh kép …).
items.answer: What a gap year offers is time to mature before university. The reason why some students struggle afterwards, however, is that they lose the habit of studying.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: In some countries, more and more people are choosing to live alone. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau (câu chẻ, The reason why, so sánh kép …).
items.answer: The reason why more people live alone is that they have higher incomes and marry later. What concerns some experts is that this may increase loneliness in old age.

items.cue: Population · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: In the future, the proportion of older people is expected to be higher than the proportion of young people in many countries. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau (câu chẻ, The reason why, so sánh kép …).
items.answer: It is not the ageing population itself but the lack of preparation that poses the greatest risk. The longer governments delay pension reform, the more difficult it will become.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Two-part question
items.prompt: How important is it for individuals and countries to plan for the future rather than focus mainly on the present?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc nhấn mạnh khác nhau (câu chẻ, The reason why, so sánh kép …).
items.answer: What individuals need is a balance between enjoying the present and preparing for the future. It is governments, however, that most need long-term plans, especially for climate change.

units.name: Passives, Reporting Structures and Noun Clauses

theory.html: Câu bị động giúp bạn tập trung vào hành động hoặc kết quả khi người thực hiện không quan trọng, không rõ hoặc hiển nhiên (Many factory jobs are being replaced). Cấu trúc tường thuật (It is believed that …, X is expected to …) cho phép bạn trình bày một quan điểm mà không khẳng định đó là quan điểm của mình, rất hữu ích ở mở bài và khi nêu quan điểm đối lập.

Mệnh đề danh từ (Whether …, What …, How …, The fact that …) có thể làm chủ ngữ hoặc tân ngữ, giúp diễn đạt các ý phức tạp một cách gọn gàng. Chủ ngữ là V-ing hoặc mệnh đề danh từ luôn đi với động từ số ít: Organising international events brings …, Whether tourism helps depends on ….

Đừng lạm dụng bị động. Khi người thực hiện là trọng tâm của lập luận, câu chủ động rõ ràng hơn: Governments should invest more tốt hơn More should be invested. Lỗi thường gặp: chia sai động từ với chủ ngữ dài, dùng bị động cho động từ không có tân ngữ, và nhầm be expected to V với be expected V-ing.

theory.text: Bị động, tường thuật và mệnh đề danh từ

cells: Many factory jobs are being replaced by machines.
Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu
It is said / believed / argued / widely accepted that + mệnh đề
It is widely accepted that sleep affects learning.
S + is thought / said / expected / reported + to V
Global temperatures are expected to rise.
S + is thought + to have + V3
The Internet is thought to have changed education more than any other invention.
Many people now have their groceries delivered.
Organising an international event brings many benefits.
Mệnh đề danh từ làm chủ ngữ
Whether / What / How / The fact that + mệnh đề + V (số ít)
Whether tourism benefits local people depends on how it is managed.
Mệnh đề danh từ làm tân ngữ
S + V + whether / what / how / that + mệnh đề
It is unclear whether online learning is as effective as classroom learning.
Danh từ + of + N làm chủ ngữ
Động từ hòa hợp với danh từ chính
The influence of peers on teenagers is strong.

items: Many factory jobs are being replaced by machines.
Plastic bags should be banned in all supermarkets.
It is widely accepted that sleep affects learning.
Global temperatures are expected to rise in the coming decades.
The Internet is thought to have changed education more than any other invention.
Many people now have their groceries delivered.
Organising an international event brings many benefits to the host country.
Whether tourism benefits local people depends on how it is managed.

items.bad: The birth rate of the Philippines was recorded a steady decline. GRA
items.good: The Philippines recorded a steady decline in its birth rate.
items.note: Bị động sai: record đã có tân ngữ (a steady decline) nên câu cần dạng chủ động, với chủ ngữ là quốc gia.

items.bad: Organising an international sports event bring many benefits. GRA
items.good: Organising an international sports event brings many benefits.
items.note: Chủ ngữ V-ing → động từ số ít.

items.bad: The influence from peers are very strong. GRA
items.good: The influence of peers is very strong.
items.note: Động từ hòa hợp với danh từ chính influence (số ít); giới từ đúng là of.

items.bad: It is believe that exercise improves mood. GRA
items.good: It is believed that exercise improves mood.
items.note: Bị động tường thuật cần V3.

items.bad: Global temperatures are expected rising. GRA
items.good: Global temperatures are expected to rise.
items.note: Cấu trúc đúng: be expected / thought / said + to V.

items.bad: Whether online learning is effective depend on the student. GRA
items.good: Whether online learning is effective depends on the student.
items.note: Mệnh đề danh từ làm chủ ngữ → động từ số ít.

items.html: Khi người thực hiện không quan trọng, không rõ hoặc hiển nhiên (The bridge was built in 2010), hoặc khi muốn giữ văn phong khách quan. Khi muốn nói rõ ai phải chịu trách nhiệm (Governments should …), hãy dùng chủ động.

items.h: It is said that hay S is said to?
items.html: It is said that tourism damages culture = Tourism is said to damage culture. Cách thứ hai ngắn hơn. Với sự việc trong quá khứ, dùng to have + V3 (is thought to have changed).

items.h: Chủ ngữ dài: hòa hợp với từ nào?
items.html: Tìm danh từ chính: The influence of peers → influence (số ít); The proportion of students → proportion (số ít). Chủ ngữ là V-ing hoặc mệnh đề danh từ → số ít.
Many people have their groceries delivered = người khác giao hàng cho họ. Trật tự: have + tân ngữ + V3 (không viết have delivered their groceries).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết lại bằng bị động / tường thuật / mệnh đề danh từ
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cấu trúc được cho. Kiểm tra hòa hợp chủ – vị.

items.cue: People believed that the new law would reduce crime, but it did not.

intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.
