notes: GRA Danh từ chính influence (số ít); giới từ đúng là of.

items.cue: It is widely accepted that sleep affects learning.
items.answer: ✓ It is widely accepted that sleep affects learning.
notes: Đúng: cấu trúc tường thuật It is widely accepted that.

items.cue: Whether online learning is effective depend on the student.
items.answer: Whether online learning is effective depend DEPENDS on the student.
notes: GRA Mệnh đề danh từ làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

items.cue: The birth rate of the Philippines was recorded a steady decline.
items.answer: The birth rate of the Philippines was recorded a steady decline THE PHILIPPINES RECORDED A STEADY DECLINE IN ITS BIRTH RATE.
notes: GRA Bị động sai: record đã có tân ngữ nên câu cần chủ động.

items.cue: The Internet is thought to change education more than any other invention.
items.answer: The Internet is thought to change TO HAVE CHANGED education more than any other invention.
notes: GRA Sự việc đã xảy ra → to have + V3.

items.cue: Whether tourism benefits local people depends on how it is managed.
items.answer: ✓ Whether tourism benefits local people depends on how it is managed.
notes: Đúng: mệnh đề Whether làm chủ ngữ + động từ số ít.

items.cue: Many people now have delivered their groceries.
items.answer: Many people now have delivered their groceries HAVE THEIR GROCERIES DELIVERED.
notes: GRA Trật tự: have + tân ngữ + V3.

items.cue: The proportion of participations who supported the plan were low.
items.answer: The proportion of participations PARTICIPANTS who supported the plan were WAS low.
notes: LR Từ loại: người tham gia là participants.
GRA Danh từ chính proportion (số ít).

items.cue: What children watch on television affects their behaviour.
items.answer: ✓ What children watch on television affects their behaviour.
notes: Đúng: mệnh đề What làm chủ ngữ + động từ số ít.

items.cue: What children need are more time to play.
items.answer: What children need are IS more time to play.
notes: GRA Mệnh đề What làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

items.cue: The new law was believed would reduce crime.
items.answer: The new law was believed would reduce WAS EXPECTED TO REDUCE crime.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc: S + was believed/expected + to V.

items.cue: How public money is spent is a matter of concern to all citizens.
items.answer: ✓ How public money is spent is a matter of concern to all citizens.
notes: Đúng: mệnh đề How làm chủ ngữ.

items.cue: It is proven that video games make all children violent.
items.answer: It is proven that IT HAS BEEN SUGGESTED THAT video games make all children violent MAY INCREASE AGGRESSION IN SOME CHILDREN.
notes: TR Không có bằng chứng chắc chắn; dùng cấu trúc tường thuật thận trọng hơn.
TR Tuyệt đối hóa (all).

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cấu trúc khác nhau (bị động, tường thuật, mệnh đề danh từ).

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: In many countries, women can join the armed forces in the same way as men. Some people believe that only men should serve in the army, navy or air force. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is sometimes argued that combat roles should be reserved for men, but this view is increasingly being challenged.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People's shopping habits are influenced more by their age than by any other factor. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Shopping habits are influenced by many factors, including income and culture, not only age.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that children today have too much freedom. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is often said that today's children are given too much freedom, especially online.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: In some countries, a small number of people earn extremely high salaries. Some people believe that governments should place limits on how much people can earn. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Extremely high salaries should be taxed more heavily rather than legally capped.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The spread of multinational companies and increasing globalisation have positive effects on everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is widely accepted that globalisation has created jobs, but its benefits have not been shared equally.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: As well as making money, businesses also have social responsibilities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Supporting local communities helps businesses build trust with their customers.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Young people who commit serious crimes should be punished in the same way as adults. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Whether a young offender can be rehabilitated depends largely on the support he or she receives.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that former prisoners are the best people to talk to school students about the dangers of crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Hearing from former prisoners is thought to have a stronger effect on students than warnings from teachers.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that members of the public should be allowed to own guns, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: In my view, gun ownership should be strictly limited to licensed hunters and sports shooters.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that sports and games play an important role in society, while others think they should be regarded simply as leisure activities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: What sport teaches young people is how to cooperate and cope with defeat.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that playing computer games is harmful to children, while others think that it can have positive effects. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: It has been suggested that some computer games can improve children's problem-solving skills.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that physical strength and fitness are the main reasons individuals and teams succeed in sport, while others think mental attitude is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: The fact that many talented athletes fail under pressure shows that mental attitude is crucial.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that the main benefit of international cooperation is protecting the environment, while others think its main benefit is promoting global business. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: It is widely believed that international cooperation is essential for tackling climate change.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many countries believe that international tourism can have harmful effects. Why can tourism cause problems, and what can be done to reduce these negative effects?
items.answer: Local cultures can be damaged when traditions are turned into performances for tourists.

items.cue: Media and communication · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Studies show that children spend more time watching television than in the past and less time doing active or creative activities. Why is this happening, and what can be done to encourage children to be more active and creative?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu bị động hoặc tường thuật, một câu có mệnh đề danh từ.
items.answer: Children are increasingly entertained by screens rather than by creative play. It is widely recommended that screen time be limited and outdoor activities encouraged.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: More and more people are using the Internet to carry out tasks that they used to do in person. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu bị động hoặc tường thuật, một câu có mệnh đề danh từ.
items.answer: Many everyday tasks, such as banking and shopping, can now be done online. Whether this is beneficial depends on how well vulnerable groups are supported.

items.cue: Media and communication · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: The use of mobile phones can create social, medical and technical problems. Do these problems outweigh the benefits of mobile phones?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu bị động hoặc tường thuật, một câu có mệnh đề danh từ.
items.answer: It is often claimed that mobile phones damage people's health. What is clearer, however, is that excessive use can disrupt sleep and concentration.

items.cue: Media and communication · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: The news media play an important role in modern society. Why are they so important, and is their influence generally positive or negative?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu bị động hoặc tường thuật, một câu có mệnh đề danh từ.
items.answer: It is widely accepted that the news media help to hold governments to account. How accurately they report events, however, varies considerably.

items.cue: Education · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some fast-food restaurants and supermarkets provide money to schools in order to promote their products. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu bị động hoặc tường thuật, một câu có mệnh đề danh từ.
items.answer: Schools that are funded by fast-food companies may be pressured to promote unhealthy products. Whether such sponsorship benefits pupils is therefore highly questionable.

items.cue: Art and museums · Two-part question
items.prompt: In many countries, people watch more foreign films than films made in their own country. Why is this the case, and should governments provide financial support to local film industries?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu bị động hoặc tường thuật, một câu có mệnh đề danh từ.
items.answer: Foreign films are often watched because they are backed by huge marketing budgets. It is argued that local film industries should be supported so that national culture is preserved.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chủ động hay bị động?
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng.

items.cue: Many jobs ( are replacing / are being replaced ) by machines.
items.answer: are being replaced
items.note: Công việc bị thay thế → bị động.

items.cue: Plastic bags ( should be banned / should ban ).
items.answer: should be banned
items.note: Túi ni lông bị cấm → bị động.

items.cue: It ( believes / is believed ) that exercise improves mood.
items.answer: is believed
items.note: Cấu trúc tường thuật bị động.

items.cue: Global temperatures are expected ( rising / to rise ).
items.answer: to rise
items.note: Cấu trúc đúng: be expected + to V.

items.cue: Organising international events ( brings / bring ) benefits.
items.answer: brings
items.note: Chủ ngữ V-ing → số ít.

items.cue: The influence of peers ( is / are ) strong.
items.answer: is
items.note: Danh từ chính influence (số ít).

items.cue: Many people now have their groceries ( deliver / delivered ).
items.answer: delivered
items.note: have + tân ngữ + V3.

items.cue: Whether online learning works ( depends / depend ) on the student.
items.answer: depends
items.note: Mệnh đề danh từ làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

items.cue: The Internet is thought ( to have changed / to change ) education more than any other invention.
items.answer: to have changed
items.note: Sự việc đã xảy ra → to have + V3.

items.cue: The Philippines ( recorded / was recorded ) a steady decline in its birth rate.
items.answer: recorded
items.note: Câu đã có tân ngữ (a steady decline) → chủ động.

items.cue: What children need ( are / is ) more time to play.
items.answer: is
items.note: Mệnh đề What làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

items.cue: Governments ( should be invested / should invest ) more in public transport.
items.answer: should invest
items.note: Chính phủ là người thực hiện và là trọng tâm → chủ động.

items.cue: The new bridge ( was built / built ) in 2010.
items.answer: was built
items.note: Cây cầu được xây → bị động.

items.cue: Air pollution is reported ( causing / to cause ) thousands of deaths.
items.answer: to cause
items.note: Cấu trúc đúng: be reported + to V.

items.cue: How public money is spent ( are / is ) a concern to all citizens.
items.answer: is
items.note: Mệnh đề How làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

items.cue: The decision ( has been made / has made ) to close the factory.
items.answer: has been made
items.note: Quyết định được đưa ra → bị động.

items.cue: Factories must have their emissions ( checked / check ) regularly.
items.answer: checked
items.note: have + tân ngữ + V3.

items.cue: The proportion of students who passed ( were / was ) high.
items.answer: was
items.note: Danh từ chính proportion (số ít).

items.cue: It ( widely accepts / is widely accepted ) that sleep affects learning.
items.answer: is widely accepted
items.note: Cấu trúc tường thuật bị động.

items.cue: Many new jobs ( have been created / have created ) by the tourism industry.
items.answer: have been created
items.note: Việc làm được tạo ra → bị động.

theory.html: Lập luận Band 7 thường thừa nhận quan điểm đối lập trước khi phản bác (Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but …) và so sánh chính xác hai đối tượng (far cheaper than, not as engaging as). Các cấu trúc tương phản và nhượng bộ giúp bài viết cân bằng (TR) và mạch lạc (CC).

Mỗi từ nối có ngữ pháp riêng: although / even though / while / whereas + mệnh đề; despite / in spite of + danh từ, V-ing hoặc the fact that + mệnh đề; however / nevertheless nối hai câu (sau dấu chấm hoặc dấu chấm phẩy). Dùng sai loại từ là lỗi GRA rất phổ biến (Despite hydro power had…).
Chọn từ nối theo ý nghĩa: By contrast chỉ dùng khi có sự đối lập thật sự giữa hai đối tượng; Meanwhile dùng cho hai tình huống song song, cùng lúc. Dùng By contrast khi không có đối lập là lỗi CC.

theory.text: Tương phản, nhượng bộ và so sánh

cells: While / Whereas (so sánh hai đối tượng)
While / Whereas + mệnh đề, mệnh đề
While some people prefer city life, others enjoy the countryside.
Although + mệnh đề, mệnh đề (không thêm but)
Although online learning is convenient, it lacks social interaction.
Despite + danh từ / V-ing / the fact that + mệnh đề
Despite the high cost, many families choose private schools.
Exams are stressful. Nevertheless, they remain the fairest way to assess students.
Đối lập thật sự giữa hai đối tượng
Cities offer many jobs. By contrast, rural areas offer a quieter way of life.
Hai tình huống xảy ra cùng lúc (nhấn mạnh tính đồng thời)
Spending on food rose. Meanwhile, spending on clothes remained stable.
Hai đối tượng có xu hướng hoặc đặc điểm giống nhau
Spending on food remained stable. Similarly, spending on clothes did not change.
Admittedly, + mệnh đề, but + mệnh đề
Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but it can damage local culture.
far / much / considerably + so sánh hơn + than
Public transport is far cheaper than driving.
not so much A as B
S + be + not so much A as B
The problem is not so much a lack of jobs as a lack of skills.
V + A rather than B (A và B cùng dạng)
Governments should invest in prevention rather than treatment.
Online courses are not as engaging as classroom lessons.

items: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks social interaction.
Despite the high cost, many families send their children to private schools.
While some people prefer city life, others enjoy the peace of the countryside.
Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but it can damage local culture.
Cities offer many job opportunities. By contrast, rural areas offer a quieter way of life.
Public transport is far cheaper than driving.
The problem is not so much a lack of jobs as a lack of skills.
Governments should invest in prevention rather than treatment.

items.bad: Despite hydro power had a primary usage, coal remained important. GRA
items.good: Although hydro power was the main source, coal remained important.
items.note: Despite không đi với mệnh đề; dùng Although + mệnh đề, hoặc Despite + danh từ / V-ing.

items.bad: Spending on food remained stable. Spending on clothes, by contrast, remained unchanged. CC
items.good: Spending on food remained stable. Similarly, spending on clothes remained unchanged.
items.note: Hai xu hướng giống nhau, không có đối lập → dùng Similarly / Likewise, không dùng by contrast.

items.bad: Although online learning is convenient, but it lacks interaction. GRA
items.good: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks interaction.
items.note: Although và but không dùng cùng nhau trong một câu.

items.bad: Despite of the high cost, many families choose private schools. GRA
items.good: Despite the high cost, many families choose private schools.
items.note: Despite không có of; In spite of thì có.

items.bad: Public transport is more cheaper than driving. GRA
items.good: Public transport is far cheaper than driving.
items.note: Không dùng more với tính từ ngắn đã có -er; nhấn mạnh bằng far / much.

items.bad: However online learning is convenient, it lacks interaction. CC
items.good: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks interaction.
items.note: However nối hai câu, không mở đầu mệnh đề phụ.

items.html: Although + mệnh đề (Although it is expensive, …); Despite / In spite of + danh từ hoặc V-ing (Despite the cost / Despite being expensive, …). Muốn dùng mệnh đề sau Despite, viết Despite the fact that ….
However nối hai câu: Exams are stressful. However, they are fair. Although nối hai mệnh đề trong một câu: Although exams are stressful, they are fair.

By contrast = khác biệt rõ rệt giữa hai đối tượng (Cities are noisy. By contrast, villages are quiet.). Meanwhile = hai việc xảy ra cùng lúc (Food prices rose. Meanwhile, wages stayed the same. — nếu muốn nhấn mạnh sự khác biệt, By contrast cũng đúng). Similarly = hai xu hướng giống nhau.
Cách hiệu quả để thừa nhận điểm mạnh của quan điểm đối lập rồi phản bác, giúp lập luận cân bằng mà vẫn giữ rõ quan điểm của bạn.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Nối câu bằng cấu trúc tương phản / so sánh
intro: Nối hoặc viết lại các câu bằng cấu trúc được cho.

items.cue: Online learning is convenient. It lacks social interaction.
items.answer: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks social interaction.
items.alt: Online learning is convenient; however, it lacks social interaction.

items.cue: The cost is high. Many families send their children to private schools.
items.answer: Despite the high cost, many families send their children to private schools.
items.alt: In spite of the high fees, many families choose private schools.

items.cue: Some people prefer city life. Others enjoy living in the countryside.
items.answer: While some people prefer city life, others enjoy living in the countryside.
items.alt: Some people prefer city life, whereas others enjoy living in the countryside.

items.cue: Tourism creates jobs. It can damage local culture.
items.answer: Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but it can damage local culture.
items.alt: Although tourism creates jobs, it can damage local culture.

items.cue: Driving is expensive. Public transport costs much less.
items.answer: Public transport is far cheaper than driving.
items.alt: Using public transport is much cheaper than driving.

items.cue: Governments should invest in prevention. They should not focus on treatment.
items.answer: Governments should invest in prevention rather than treatment.
items.alt: Governments should focus on prevention rather than on treatment.

items.cue: Online courses are less engaging than classroom lessons.
items.answer: Online courses are not as engaging as classroom lessons.
items.alt: Online courses are less engaging than lessons in a classroom.

items.cue: Hydro power was the main source. Coal remained important.
items.answer: Although hydro power was the main source, coal remained important.
items.alt: Despite hydro power being the main source, coal remained important.

items.cue: Spending on food rose. At the same time, spending on clothes stayed the same.
items.answer: Spending on food rose. Meanwhile, spending on clothes remained stable.
items.alt: Spending on food rose, while spending on clothes remained stable.

items.cue: Cities offer many job opportunities. Rural areas offer a quieter life.
items.answer: Cities offer many job opportunities. By contrast, rural areas offer a quieter way of life.
items.alt: Whereas cities offer many job opportunities, rural areas offer a quieter way of life.

items.cue: Many people know smoking is harmful. They continue to smoke.
items.answer: Despite the fact that smoking is known to be harmful, many people continue to smoke.
items.alt: Even though smoking is known to be harmful, many people still smoke.

items.cue: The problem is mainly a lack of skills, not a lack of jobs.
items.answer: The problem is not so much a lack of jobs as a lack of skills.
items.alt: The real problem is a lack of skills rather than a lack of jobs.

items.cue: Wealthy countries produce a lot of waste per person. Poorer countries produce much less.
items.answer: Whereas wealthy countries produce large amounts of waste per person, poorer countries produce far less.
items.alt: Whereas wealthy countries generate a lot of waste per person, poorer countries generate far less.

items.cue: Exams are stressful. They remain the fairest way to assess students.
items.answer: Exams are stressful. Nevertheless, they remain the fairest way to assess students.
items.alt: Although exams are stressful, they remain the fairest way to assess students.

items.cue: Some argue that zoos protect animals. I believe they mainly entertain visitors.
items.answer: While some argue that zoos protect endangered species, I believe they mainly exist to entertain visitors.
items.alt: Although some argue that zoos protect animals, I believe their main purpose is entertainment.

items.cue: Electric cars are cleaner. They are more expensive than petrol cars.
items.answer: Although electric cars are cleaner, they are considerably more expensive than petrol cars.
items.alt: Electric cars are cleaner but considerably more expensive than petrol cars.

items.cue: The real issue is how long people work, not where they work.
items.answer: The real issue is not so much where people work as how long they work.
items.alt: What matters is how long people work rather than where they work.

items.cue: Some young people earn a lot. Many still cannot afford a home.
items.answer: Even though some young people earn high salaries, many still cannot afford a home.
items.alt: Despite earning high salaries, many young people still cannot afford a home.

items.cue: Living costs in cities are rising quickly. Wages have hardly changed.
items.answer: Living costs in cities are rising quickly, while wages have barely changed.
items.alt: Whereas living costs in cities are rising quickly, wages have barely changed.

items.cue: Admittedly technology helps students. However teachers are still essential.
items.hint: Admittedly, …, but … (sửa dấu câu và từ nối)
items.answer: Admittedly, technology helps students learn, but teachers remain essential.
items.alt: Although technology helps students learn, teachers remain essential.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Mặc dù học trực tuyến tiện lợi, nó thiếu sự tương tác xã hội.
items.translation: Online learning is convenient, but it lacks social interaction.
items.answer: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks social interaction.
items.alt: Online learning is convenient; however, it lacks social interaction.

items.cue: Bất chấp chi phí cao, nhiều gia đình vẫn cho con học trường tư.
items.translation: Although the cost is high, many families still let their children study at private schools.
items.answer: Despite the high cost, many families send their children to private schools.
items.alt: In spite of the high fees, many families choose private schools.

items.cue: Trong khi một số người thích sống ở thành phố, những người khác lại thích nông thôn.
items.translation: Some people like living in the city, but others like the countryside.
items.answer: While some people prefer city life, others prefer the countryside.
items.alt: Some people prefer city life, whereas others prefer the countryside.

items.cue: Phải thừa nhận rằng du lịch tạo việc làm, nhưng nó có thể gây hại cho văn hóa địa phương.
items.translation: It must be admitted that tourism creates jobs, but it can harm local culture.
items.answer: Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but it can harm local culture.
items.alt: Although tourism creates jobs, it can damage local culture.

items.cue: Phương tiện công cộng rẻ hơn nhiều so với việc lái xe.
items.translation: Taking public transport costs much less than driving.
items.answer: Public transport is far cheaper than driving.
items.alt: Using public transport is much cheaper than driving.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên đầu tư vào phòng bệnh thay vì chữa bệnh.
items.translation: The government should invest in preventing disease instead of curing disease.
items.answer: Governments should invest in prevention rather than treatment.
items.alt: Governments should focus on prevention rather than on treatment.

items.cue: Các khóa học trực tuyến không hấp dẫn bằng các buổi học trên lớp.
items.translation: Online courses are less attractive than classroom lessons.
items.answer: Online courses are not as engaging as classroom lessons.
items.alt: Online courses are less engaging than classroom lessons.

items.cue: Mặc dù thủy điện là nguồn năng lượng chính, than đá vẫn quan trọng.
items.translation: Hydro power was the main energy source, but coal was still important.
items.answer: Although hydro power was the main source of energy, coal remained important.
items.alt: Despite hydro power being the main source of energy, coal remained important.

items.cue: Chi tiêu cho thực phẩm tăng. Trong khi đó, chi tiêu cho quần áo vẫn ổn định.
items.translation: Spending on food increased. At the same time, spending on clothes stayed stable.
items.answer: Spending on food rose. Meanwhile, spending on clothes remained stable.
items.alt: Spending on food rose, while spending on clothes remained stable.

items.cue: Thành phố mang lại nhiều cơ hội việc làm. Ngược lại, nông thôn mang lại cuộc sống yên bình hơn.
items.translation: Cities provide many job opportunities, but the countryside offers a more peaceful life.
items.answer: Cities offer many job opportunities. By contrast, rural areas offer a quieter way of life.
items.alt: Whereas cities offer many job opportunities, rural areas offer a quieter way of life.

items.cue: Mặc dù biết hút thuốc có hại, nhiều người vẫn tiếp tục hút.
items.translation: Although people know smoking is harmful, many still smoke.
items.answer: Despite the fact that smoking is harmful, many people continue to smoke.
items.alt: Even though smoking is known to be harmful, many people still smoke.

items.cue: Vấn đề không hẳn là thiếu việc làm mà là thiếu kỹ năng.
items.translation: The problem is not lack of jobs but lack of skills.
items.answer: The problem is not so much a lack of jobs as a lack of skills.
items.alt: The real problem is a lack of skills rather than a lack of jobs.

items.cue: Trong khi các nước giàu thải ra nhiều rác trên mỗi người, các nước nghèo thải ra ít hơn nhiều.
items.translation: Rich countries produce a lot of waste per person, but poor countries produce much less.
items.answer: Whereas wealthy countries produce large amounts of waste per person, poorer countries produce far less.
items.alt: Wealthy countries produce far more waste per person than poorer countries do.

items.cue: Thi cử gây căng thẳng. Tuy vậy, đó vẫn là cách đánh giá công bằng nhất.
items.translation: Exams are stressful, but they are still the fairest way to assess students.
items.answer: Exams are stressful. Nevertheless, they remain the fairest way to assess students.
items.alt: Although exams are stressful, they remain the fairest way to assess students.

items.cue: Trong khi một số người cho rằng sở thú bảo vệ động vật, tôi tin rằng chúng chủ yếu phục vụ việc giải trí.
items.translation: Some people think zoos protect animals, but I think they are mainly for entertainment.
items.answer: While some argue that zoos protect animals, I believe they mainly serve to entertain visitors.
items.alt: Although some argue that zoos protect animals, I believe their main purpose is entertainment.

items.cue: Mặc dù xe điện sạch hơn, chúng đắt hơn đáng kể so với xe chạy xăng.
items.translation: Although electric cars are cleaner, they are much more expensive than petrol cars.
items.answer: Although electric cars are cleaner, they are considerably more expensive than petrol cars.
items.alt: Electric cars are cleaner but considerably more expensive than petrol cars.

items.cue: Dù một số người trẻ có thu nhập cao, nhiều người vẫn không đủ khả năng mua nhà.
items.translation: Although some young people have high income, many still cannot buy a house.
items.answer: Even though some young people earn high salaries, many still cannot afford a home.
items.alt: Despite earning high salaries, many young people still cannot afford a home.

items.cue: Chi phí sinh hoạt ở thành phố tăng nhanh, trong khi tiền lương hầu như không thay đổi.
items.translation: The cost of living in cities increases fast, but salaries almost do not change.
items.answer: Living costs in cities are rising quickly, while wages have barely changed.
items.alt: Whereas living costs in cities are rising quickly, wages have barely changed.

items.cue: Thay vì xây thêm đường, thành phố nên đầu tư vào giao thông công cộng.
items.translation: Instead of building more roads, the city should invest in public transport.
items.answer: Rather than building more roads, the city should invest in public transport.
items.alt: The city should invest in public transport rather than build more roads.

items.cue: Phải thừa nhận rằng công nghệ giúp học sinh học tập, nhưng giáo viên vẫn không thể thiếu.
items.translation: It is true that technology helps students study, but teachers are still necessary.
items.answer: Admittedly, technology helps students learn, but teachers remain essential.
items.alt: Although technology helps students learn, teachers remain indispensable.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Despite hydro power had a primary usage, coal remained important.
items.answer: Despite hydro power had a primary usage ALTHOUGH HYDRO POWER WAS THE MAIN SOURCE, coal remained important.
notes: GRA Despite không đi với mệnh đề.

items.cue: Although online learning is convenient, but it lacks interaction.
items.answer: Although online learning is convenient, but it, IT lacks interaction.
notes: GRA Không dùng Although và but trong cùng một câu.

items.cue: Despite of the high cost, many families choose private schools.
items.answer: Despite of DESPITE the high cost, many families choose private schools.
notes: GRA Despite không có of.

items.cue: While some people prefer city life, others enjoy the countryside.
items.answer: ✓ While some people prefer city life, others enjoy the countryside.
notes: Đúng: While so sánh hai nhóm.

items.cue: Public transport is more cheaper than driving.
items.answer: Public transport is more cheaper FAR CHEAPER than driving.
notes: GRA Không dùng more với cheaper; nhấn mạnh bằng far / much.

items.cue: However online learning is convenient, it lacks interaction.
items.answer: However online learning is convenient ALTHOUGH ONLINE LEARNING IS CONVENIENT, it lacks interaction.
notes: CC However nối hai câu; trong một câu dùng Although.

items.cue: Online courses are not as engaging than classroom lessons.
items.answer: Online courses are not as engaging than AS classroom lessons.
notes: GRA Cặp cố định: not as … as.

items.cue: Spending on food remained stable. Spending on clothes, by contrast, remained unchanged.
items.answer: Spending on food remained stable. Spending on clothes, by contrast SIMILARLY, remained unchanged.
notes: CC Hai xu hướng giống nhau, không có đối lập → Similarly.

items.cue: Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but it can damage local culture.
items.answer: ✓ Admittedly, tourism creates jobs, but it can damage local culture.
notes: Đúng: thừa nhận rồi phản bác.

items.cue: Despite the fact smoking is harmful, many people still smoke.
items.answer: Despite the fact smoking DESPITE THE FACT THAT SMOKING is harmful, many people still smoke.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đầy đủ: Despite the fact that + mệnh đề.

items.cue: Governments should invest in prevention rather than treating.
items.answer: Governments should invest in prevention rather than treating TREATMENT.
notes: GRA Hai vế của rather than phải song song (prevention … treatment).

items.cue: Whereas cities offer jobs, but rural areas offer peace.
items.answer: Whereas cities offer jobs, but rural areas, RURAL AREAS offer peace.
notes: GRA Không dùng Whereas và but cùng nhau.

items.cue: The problem is not so much a lack of jobs as a lack of skills.
items.answer: ✓ The problem is not so much a lack of jobs as a lack of skills.
notes: Đúng: not so much A as B.

items.cue: Exams are stressful, nevertheless they remain fair.
items.answer: Exams are stressful, nevertheless they ; NEVERTHELESS, THEY remain fair.
notes: GRA nevertheless nối hai mệnh đề độc lập: dùng dấu chấm phẩy trước và dấu phẩy sau.

items.cue: Even though some young people earn high salaries. Many still cannot afford a home.
items.answer: Even though some young people earn high salaries. Many HIGH SALARIES, MANY still cannot afford a home.
notes: GRA Mệnh đề Even though không thể đứng một mình (fragment).

items.cue: Living costs in cities are rising quickly, while wages have barely changed.
items.answer: ✓ Living costs in cities are rising quickly, while wages have barely changed.
notes: Đúng: while nối hai ý tương phản.

items.cue: Electric cars are considerable more expensive than petrol cars.
items.answer: Electric cars are considerable more CONSIDERABLY MORE expensive than petrol cars.
notes: LR Từ loại: cần trạng từ considerably.

items.cue: In spite of they are expensive, electric cars are popular.
items.answer: In spite of they are expensive IN SPITE OF BEING EXPENSIVE, electric cars are popular.
notes: GRA In spite of + V-ing hoặc danh từ, không đi với mệnh đề.

items.cue: Rather than building more roads, the city should invest in public transport.
items.answer: ✓ Rather than building more roads, the city should invest in public transport.
notes: Đúng: Rather than + V-ing.

items.cue: Technology is useful for learning. On the contrary, teachers are essential. In contrast, students need both.
items.answer: Technology is useful for learning. On the contrary, HOWEVER, teachers are essential. In contrast, students need both. IDEALLY, STUDENTS NEED BOTH.
notes: CC On the contrary dùng để bác bỏ ý vừa nêu, không chỉ sự tương phản nhẹ.
CC Không có đối lập ở đây; In contrast dùng sai chức năng.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng cấu trúc được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng hai cấu trúc tương phản / so sánh khác nhau.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Men hold most senior positions in many organisations. Governments should require a certain proportion of these jobs to be reserved for women. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Although quotas could increase the number of women in senior roles, they may lead some to question whether appointments are based on merit.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that male leaders are more likely to cause violence and conflict, while female leaders would create a more peaceful world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: While some female leaders have promoted peace, others have led their countries into war.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Older generations often have traditional ideas that are not useful to younger people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Admittedly, some traditional ideas are outdated, but many older people offer valuable practical wisdom.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to create a happier society is to reduce the difference in income between the richest and poorest people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Despite rising average incomes, many societies remain deeply unequal.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that individuals should be allowed to keep all the money they earn and should not have to pay taxes to the government. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Taxes allow governments to fund services for everyone rather than only for those who can pay.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way to reduce crime is to educate prisoners so that they can find work after they are released. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The key to reducing crime is not so much punishment as giving offenders a realistic chance of employment.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Society is based on rules and laws. If individuals were free to do whatever they wanted, society could not function. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Although rules limit personal freedom, they allow people to live together safely.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: A 14-year-old who seriously damaged his school was ordered to clean the streets instead of being sent to prison. Community-based punishment is more appropriate than imprisonment for young offenders who commit serious crimes. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Community service is often far more effective than prison in changing young offenders' behaviour.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that developing countries should encourage foreign companies to invest in their economies, while others think they should support local companies instead. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Whereas foreign companies bring capital and technology, local firms are more likely to keep profits in the country.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents should organise their children's free-time activities, while others think children should be free to decide how to spend their own free time. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: While organised activities develop specific skills, unstructured free time encourages children's creativity.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that hosting international sporting events such as the Olympic Games is beneficial, while others think it is a waste of money. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Despite the fact that the Olympics attract tourists, many host cities are left with expensive unused stadiums.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that politicians have the greatest influence on the world, while others think scientists have a greater influence. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Politicians shape laws within national borders. By contrast, scientists can change lives across the world through their discoveries.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should give the highest priority to healthcare, while others think that other areas are equally or more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Healthcare is clearly vital. Nevertheless, education and housing also have a major impact on public health.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Violent behaviour among football supporters is a problem in many places. What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?
items.answer: Violence among football fans is not as common as the media suggest, but it remains a serious problem.

items.cue: Education · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many people leave school with a negative attitude towards learning. Why does this happen, and what can be done to encourage a more positive attitude?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc tương phản, nhượng bộ hoặc so sánh khác nhau.
items.answer: Although many students start school eager to learn, constant testing can make them lose interest. Rather than focusing on exams, teachers could relate lessons to students' real interests.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that international student exchange programmes would benefit all school students. Do the advantages of these programmes outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc tương phản, nhượng bộ hoặc so sánh khác nhau.
items.answer: Exchange programmes are far more valuable than classroom lessons for understanding other cultures. Nevertheless, their cost means that not all students can take part.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some children are taught to compete with their classmates and try to be better than them rather than to work together. Do the advantages of encouraging competition outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc tương phản, nhượng bộ hoặc so sánh khác nhau.
items.answer: Admittedly, competition can motivate some students, but it can leave weaker classmates feeling discouraged. Cooperation, by contrast, allows every student to contribute.

items.cue: Language · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Fewer people today write by hand than in the past. Why is this the case, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc tương phản, nhượng bộ hoặc so sánh khác nhau.
items.answer: Whereas handwriting was once essential, most people now type on phones and computers. Despite this, writing by hand may still help children remember what they learn.

items.cue: Language · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some languages are becoming more widely spoken around the world, while others are declining in use. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc tương phản, nhượng bộ hoặc so sánh khác nhau.
items.answer: While the spread of English makes international communication easier, many minority languages are disappearing. This is not so much a natural process as the result of economic pressure.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Two-part question
items.prompt: People have long tried to create an ideal society, but these attempts have often failed. What do you think an ideal society would be like, and how could such a society be created?
items.hint: Hai câu, mỗi câu dùng một cấu trúc tương phản, nhượng bộ hoặc so sánh khác nhau.
items.answer: Although no society can be perfect, an ideal one would offer equal opportunities to all. Rather than relying on laws alone, it would depend on education and a strong sense of community.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn từ nối đúng
intro: Khoanh vào từ nối đúng về ngữ pháp và ý nghĩa.

items.cue: ( Despite / Although ) online learning is convenient, it lacks interaction.
items.answer: Although
items.note: Theo sau là mệnh đề → Although.

items.cue: ( Despite / Although ) the high cost, many families choose private schools.
items.answer: Despite
items.note: Theo sau là cụm danh từ → Despite.

items.cue: Exams are stressful. ( However, / Although ) they remain fair.
items.answer: However,
items.note: Nối hai câu → However,.

items.cue: ( Despite / While ) some people prefer cities, others prefer the countryside.
items.answer: While
items.note: So sánh hai nhóm, theo sau là mệnh đề → While.

items.cue: Spending on food remained stable. ( Similarly, / By contrast, ) spending on clothes did not change.
items.answer: Similarly,
items.note: Hai xu hướng giống nhau → Similarly.

items.cue: Cities are noisy. ( Meanwhile, / By contrast, ) rural areas are peaceful.
items.answer: By contrast,
items.note: Đối lập rõ rệt → By contrast.

items.cue: Public transport is ( very / far ) cheaper than driving.
items.answer: far
items.note: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn bằng far / much, không dùng very.

items.cue: Governments should invest in prevention rather than ( treating / treatment ).
items.answer: treatment
items.note: Hai vế song song (danh từ – danh từ).

items.cue: Online courses are not as engaging ( than / as ) classroom lessons.
items.answer: as
items.note: Cặp cố định: not as … as.

items.cue: ( Despite / In spite ) the fact that smoking is harmful, many people smoke.
items.answer: Despite
items.note: Despite the fact that; In spite cần of.

items.cue: ( Although / Admittedly ), tourism creates jobs, but it damages culture.
items.answer: Admittedly
items.note: Admittedly, …, but …; Although không đi với but.

items.cue: The problem is not so much a lack of jobs ( as / but ) a lack of skills.
items.answer: as
items.note: Cặp cố định: not so much … as ….

items.cue: Electric cars are ( considerable / considerably ) more expensive.
items.answer: considerably
items.note: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho so sánh hơn.

items.cue: ( Although / In spite of ) being expensive, electric cars are popular.
items.answer: In spite of
items.note: Theo sau là V-ing → In spite of.

items.cue: ( Even though / Even ) wages are high, many people cannot afford a home.
items.answer: Even though
items.note: Even though + mệnh đề; even là trạng từ.

items.cue: ( However / Whereas ) wealthy countries produce a lot of waste, poorer countries produce less.
items.answer: Whereas
items.note: Hai mệnh đề trong một câu → Whereas.

items.cue: Exams are stressful( ; nevertheless, / , nevertheless ) they remain fair.
items.answer: ; nevertheless,
items.note: Dấu chấm phẩy trước, dấu phẩy sau nevertheless.

items.cue: Rather than ( building / build ) more roads, cities should improve public transport.
items.answer: building
items.note: Rather than ở đầu câu + V-ing.

items.cue: Technology helps students. ( Nevertheless, / On the contrary, ) teachers remain essential.
items.answer: Nevertheless,
items.note: Thừa nhận rồi đưa ý ngược lại → Nevertheless.

items.cue: Living costs are rising, ( while / despite ) wages have barely changed.
items.answer: while
items.note: Theo sau là mệnh đề → while.

units.name: Position, Topic, Support and Example Sentences

theory.html: Mỗi câu trong bài Task 2 có một nhiệm vụ: câu nêu quan điểm (mở bài, xem Unit 2), câu chủ đề (nêu ý chính của đoạn), câu hỗ trợ (giải thích vì sao), câu ví dụ (chứng minh) và câu kết đoạn. Band 7 yêu cầu các ý chính được mở rộng và có dẫn chứng; câu chủ đề rõ ràng và ví dụ phù hợp chính là cách đáp ứng yêu cầu đó (TR, CC).

Câu chủ đề chỉ nêu một ý chính, không quá chung chung (There are many advantages) và không đi vào chi tiết ngay. Câu hỗ trợ giải thích cơ chế: tại sao, như thế nào, xét từ góc độ nào. Câu ví dụ phải chứng minh trực tiếp luận điểm: nói rõ ai, làm gì, và kết quả ra sao.

Đừng bịa số liệu (95% of people…). Một ví dụ giả định cụ thể (a student who studies abroad must manage his or her own budget) thuyết phục hơn một con số không có nguồn. Lỗi nặng nhất là ví dụ không liên quan đến luận điểm, và câu kết luận không khớp với thân bài.

theory.text: Câu theo chức năng trong đoạn văn

cells: There are several benefits associated with + N
There are several benefits associated with learning a foreign language.
One major drawback of + N is that …
One major drawback of online learning is that students may feel isolated.
The main reason why … is that …
The main reason why young people move to cities is that they offer better jobs.
One effective way to + V is to + V
One effective way to reduce congestion is to improve public transport.
Câu chủ đề: báo trước hai ý
N is largely the result of two factors: A and B
Childhood obesity is largely the result of two factors: unhealthy diets and a lack of exercise.
From an economic / environmental / social perspective, …
From an economic perspective, tourism creates jobs for local people.
On a personal level, … / On a societal level, …
On a personal level, bilingual people have a wider range of career options.
A good example of this is + N (, which / whose / where …)
A good example of this is Singapore, whose public transport system is highly efficient.
Câu ví dụ: nhóm cụ thể
This is particularly the case for / with + N
This is particularly the case for students from rural areas.
These could range from A to B; These could include A, B and C
These could range from small bookshops to large department stores.
For instance, + ai + làm gì + kết quả
For instance, a student who studies abroad must manage his or her own budget, which builds independence.
For these reasons, investment in public transport should be a priority.

items: There are several benefits associated with teaching arts subjects at school.
One major drawback of working from home is that the boundary between work and private life becomes blurred.
From an economic perspective, tourism creates jobs for local people.
On a societal level, higher youth employment can lead to lower crime rates.
A good example of this is Finland, where children start formal schooling at the age of seven.
This is particularly the case for students from low-income families.
For instance, a student who studies abroad must manage his or her own budget, which builds independence.
For these reasons, investment in public transport should be a priority for city governments.

items.bad: Traditional skills are disappearing. For instance, VTV has switched to AI-Native system. TR
items.good: Traditional skills are disappearing. For instance, factory workers lose manual dexterity once robotic arms take over assembly tasks.
items.note: Ví dụ không chứng minh luận điểm: việc một đài truyền hình dùng AI không cho thấy kỹ năng truyền thống bị mai một.

items.bad: Many poor people can have a chance for better education and a job. TR
items.good: Many people from disadvantaged backgrounds can gain access to better education and employment, for example through scholarships and tuition waivers.
items.note: Ý chưa được phát triển: cần nêu rõ cơ chế hoặc ví dụ cụ thể.

items.bad: Peer pressure can lead teenagers to behave badly. For example, homeless people are more likely to be misbehave. TR
items.good: Peer pressure can lead teenagers to behave badly. For example, a pupil whose friends skip classes may start doing the same in order to be accepted.
items.note: Ví dụ không liên quan (người vô gia cư không phải là ví dụ về áp lực bạn bè); be misbehave cũng sai ngữ pháp.

items.bad: In conclusion, although saving money may have several advantages for people, it still has some disadvantageous aspects. TR
items.good: In conclusion, while saving money clearly offers advantages, it is not always realistic for those on a limited income.
items.note: Câu kết luận không khớp với thân bài (thân bài bàn về tính khả thi, không bàn về bất lợi).

items.bad: There are several benefits of the provision of arts-based subjects within a school environment. LR
items.good: There are several benefits associated with teaching arts subjects at school.
items.note: Dài dòng, không làm câu "học thuật" hơn. Câu chủ đề nên ngắn gọn và rõ ràng.

items.bad: A good example of this is Singapore, its public transport is excellent. GRA
items.good: A good example of this is Singapore, whose public transport is excellent.
items.note: Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; dùng mệnh đề quan hệ whose.

items.h: Ví dụ có chứng minh được luận điểm không?
items.html: Kiểm tra bằng câu hỏi: Nếu người đọc chỉ đọc ví dụ, họ có thấy luận điểm đúng không? Ví dụ tốt nêu rõ ai – làm gì – kết quả, và kết quả đó chính là điều câu chủ đề khẳng định.
Không bịa số liệu hay tên nghiên cứu. Dùng ví dụ giả định cụ thể (a nurse who works night shifts …) hoặc kiến thức phổ biến, đã được kiểm chứng (Finland, where children start school at seven).

items.h: Câu chủ đề: chung đến mức nào?
items.html: Quá chung: Technology has many advantages. Quá chi tiết: Video calls let grandparents see their grandchildren. Vừa đủ: One major benefit of technology is that it helps families stay in touch.
Câu kết luận phải nhắc lại đúng quan điểm ở mở bài và tóm tắt đúng các ý ở thân bài, không thêm ý mới.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Viết câu theo chức năng
intro: Viết một câu (hoặc sửa câu) theo chức năng và khung câu được cho.

items.cue: Topic: the benefits of learning a foreign language.
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: There are several benefits associated with
items.answer: There are several benefits associated with learning a foreign language.
items.alt: Learning a foreign language offers several important benefits.

items.cue: Topic: a drawback of online learning (students feel isolated).
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: One major drawback of … is that
items.answer: One major drawback of online learning is that students may feel isolated.
items.alt: A major drawback of online learning is the sense of isolation some students feel.

items.cue: Topic: why young people move to cities (better jobs).
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: The main reason why … is that
items.answer: The main reason why young people move to cities is that they offer better job opportunities.
items.alt: Young people move to cities mainly because they offer better job opportunities.

items.cue: Topic: a solution to congestion (better public transport).
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: One effective way to … is to
items.answer: One effective way to reduce traffic congestion is to improve public transport.
items.alt: Improving public transport is one of the most effective ways to reduce congestion.

items.cue: Support: tourism creates jobs (economic view).
items.hint: Câu hỗ trợ: From an economic perspective
items.answer: From an economic perspective, tourism creates jobs for local people.
items.alt: Economically, tourism provides employment for local people.

items.cue: Support: bilingual people have more career options (individual level).
items.hint: Câu hỗ trợ: On a personal level
items.answer: On a personal level, bilingual people have a wider range of career options.
items.alt: For individuals, speaking two languages opens up more career options.

items.cue: Example: Singapore's public transport.
items.hint: Câu ví dụ: A good example of this is + whose
items.answer: A good example of this is Singapore, whose efficient public transport system has reduced car use.
items.alt: A case in point is Singapore, where efficient public transport has reduced car use.

items.cue: Claim: scholarships help poor students. Group: students from rural areas.
items.hint: Câu ví dụ: This is particularly the case for
items.answer: This is particularly the case for students from rural areas, who often cannot afford university fees.
items.alt: This is especially true of students from rural areas, who often cannot afford tuition fees.

items.cue: Example range: businesses affected by online shopping (small bookshops → large department stores).
items.hint: Câu ví dụ: These could range from … to …
items.answer: These could range from small bookshops to large department stores.
items.alt: Affected businesses range from small bookshops to large department stores.

items.cue: Example list: skills learned in team sports (cooperation, leadership, coping with defeat).
items.answer: These could include cooperation, leadership and the ability to cope with defeat.
items.alt: Such skills include cooperation, leadership and resilience in the face of defeat.

items.cue: Extended example: a student studying abroad manages money → independence.
items.hint: Ví dụ mở rộng: For instance, + ai + làm gì + kết quả
items.answer: For instance, a student who studies abroad must manage his or her own budget, which builds independence.
items.alt: For example, international students have to manage their own finances, which makes them more independent.

items.cue: Support: on society, fewer crimes when young people have jobs.
items.hint: Câu hỗ trợ: On a societal level
items.answer: On a societal level, higher youth employment can lead to lower crime rates.
items.alt: For society as a whole, more jobs for young people can mean less crime.

items.cue: Concluding sentence for a paragraph on the benefits of public transport.
items.answer: For these reasons, investment in public transport should be a priority for city governments.
items.alt: Therefore, city governments should make public transport investment a priority.

items.cue: Topic: two causes of childhood obesity (diet, inactivity).
items.hint: Câu chủ đề báo trước hai ý bằng cụm danh từ
items.answer: Childhood obesity is largely the result of two factors: unhealthy diets and a lack of physical activity.
items.alt: Two main factors lie behind childhood obesity: poor diets and insufficient exercise.

items.cue: Many poor people can have a chance for better education and a job.
items.hint: Phát triển ý + ví dụ cụ thể
items.answer: Many people from disadvantaged backgrounds can gain access to better education and employment, for example through scholarships and tuition waivers.
items.alt: Scholarships and tuition waivers allow many people from low-income families to access better education and, in turn, better jobs.

items.cue: Traditional skills are disappearing. For instance, a television channel has switched to an AI-based system.
items.hint: Thay ví dụ không chứng minh được luận điểm
items.answer: Traditional skills are being eroded: factory workers, for instance, lose manual dexterity once robotic arms take over assembly tasks.
items.alt: Traditional skills are disappearing; for example, few young people now learn hand-weaving because machine-made fabric is cheaper.

items.cue: (Body: saving is difficult on a low income) In conclusion, although saving money may have several advantages for people, it still has some disadvantageous aspects.
items.hint: Viết lại câu kết cho khớp với thân bài
items.answer: In conclusion, while saving money clearly offers advantages, it is not always realistic for those on a limited income.
items.alt: In conclusion, saving money is beneficial, but it is not a realistic option for everyone, particularly those on low incomes.

items.cue: There are several benefits of the provision of arts-based subjects within a school environment.
items.hint: Viết lại câu chủ đề cho gọn
items.answer: There are several benefits associated with teaching arts subjects at school.
items.alt: Teaching arts subjects at school brings several benefits.

items.cue: Prompt: Some people think university should be free. (Your view: largely disagree.)
items.answer: It is argued by some that university education should be free. While acknowledging the benefits of this, I largely disagree, as it would place a heavy burden on taxpayers.
items.alt: One school of thought holds that higher education should be free. I largely disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the reasons for it.

items.cue: Peer pressure can lead teenagers to behave badly. For example, homeless people are more likely to be misbehave.
items.hint: Thay ví dụ không liên quan
items.answer: Peer pressure can lead teenagers to behave badly. For example, a pupil whose friends skip classes may start doing the same in order to be accepted.
items.alt: Peer pressure can lead teenagers to behave badly; for instance, a pupil may begin smoking because the rest of his or her friendship group does.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Có nhiều lợi ích gắn liền với việc học ngoại ngữ.
items.translation: Learning a foreign language has many benefits.
items.answer: There are several benefits associated with learning a foreign language.
items.alt: Learning a foreign language offers several important benefits.

items.cue: Một hạn chế lớn của học trực tuyến là học sinh có thể cảm thấy bị cô lập.
items.translation: A big disadvantage of online learning is that students can feel isolated.
items.answer: One major drawback of online learning is that students may feel isolated.
items.alt: A major disadvantage of online learning is that students may feel cut off from others.

items.cue: Lý do chính khiến người trẻ chuyển đến thành phố là vì ở đó có nhiều cơ hội việc làm tốt hơn.
items.translation: Young people move to cities mainly because there are better jobs there.
items.answer: The main reason why young people move to cities is that they offer better job opportunities.
items.alt: Young people move to cities mainly because they offer better job opportunities.

items.cue: Một cách hiệu quả để giảm ùn tắc là cải thiện giao thông công cộng.
items.translation: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic jams.
items.answer: One effective way to reduce traffic congestion is to improve public transport.
items.alt: Improving public transport is one of the most effective ways to reduce congestion.

items.cue: Xét về mặt kinh tế, du lịch tạo ra việc làm cho người dân địa phương.
items.translation: In terms of the economy, tourism creates jobs for local people.
items.answer: From an economic perspective, tourism creates jobs for local people.
items.alt: Economically, tourism provides employment for local residents.

items.cue: Ở cấp độ cá nhân, người biết hai ngôn ngữ có nhiều lựa chọn nghề nghiệp hơn.
items.translation: For each person, people who know two languages have more career choices.
items.answer: On a personal level, bilingual people have a wider range of career options.
items.alt: For individuals, speaking two languages opens up more career options.

items.cue: Một ví dụ điển hình là Singapore, nơi có hệ thống giao thông công cộng hiệu quả.
items.rewriteWith: A good example of this is + which
items.translation: A typical example is Singapore, which has an effective public transport system.
items.answer: A good example of this is Singapore, which has an efficient public transport system.
items.alt: A case in point is Singapore, whose public transport system is highly efficient.

items.cue: Điều này đặc biệt đúng với sinh viên đến từ nông thôn.
items.translation: This is especially true with students from the countryside.
items.answer: This is particularly the case for students from rural areas.
items.alt: This is especially true of students from rural areas.

items.cue: Những doanh nghiệp này có thể từ các hiệu sách nhỏ đến các trung tâm thương mại lớn.
items.translation: These businesses can be from small bookshops to big shopping centres.
items.answer: These could range from small bookshops to large department stores.
items.alt: Such businesses range from small bookshops to large department stores.

items.cue: Những kỹ năng này có thể bao gồm khả năng hợp tác, lãnh đạo và chấp nhận thất bại.
items.translation: These skills can include cooperation, leadership and accepting failure.
items.answer: These could include cooperation, leadership and the ability to accept defeat.
items.alt: Such skills include cooperation, leadership and resilience in the face of defeat.

items.cue: Chẳng hạn, một sinh viên du học phải tự quản lý chi tiêu, điều này giúp rèn luyện tính tự lập.
items.rewriteWith: For instance, + ai + làm gì + kết quả
items.translation: For example, a student studying abroad must manage spending by themselves, and this trains independence.
items.answer: For instance, a student who studies abroad must manage his or her own budget, which builds independence.
items.alt: For example, international students have to manage their own finances, which makes them more independent.

items.cue: Ở cấp độ xã hội, tỷ lệ việc làm cao hơn ở người trẻ có thể giúp giảm tội phạm.
items.translation: For society, a higher employment rate among young people can help reduce crime.
items.answer: On a societal level, higher youth employment can lead to lower crime rates.
items.alt: For society as a whole, more jobs for young people can mean less crime.

items.cue: Vì những lý do này, đầu tư vào giao thông công cộng nên là ưu tiên của chính quyền thành phố.
items.translation: Because of these reasons, investing in public transport should be the priority of the city government.
items.answer: For these reasons, investment in public transport should be a priority for city governments.
items.alt: Therefore, city governments should make public transport a priority.

items.cue: Béo phì ở trẻ em chủ yếu do hai yếu tố: chế độ ăn không lành mạnh và thiếu vận động.
items.rewriteWith: Câu chủ đề báo trước hai ý
items.translation: Obesity in children is mainly caused by two factors: unhealthy diets and lack of exercise.
items.answer: Childhood obesity is largely the result of two factors: unhealthy diets and a lack of physical activity.
items.alt: Two main factors lie behind childhood obesity: poor diets and insufficient exercise.

items.cue: Xét về mặt môi trường, việc giảm sử dụng ô tô sẽ cải thiện chất lượng không khí ở các thành phố lớn.
items.translation: In terms of the environment, using cars less will improve the air quality in big cities.
items.answer: From an environmental perspective, reducing car use would improve air quality in large cities.
items.alt: Environmentally, less car use would mean cleaner air in major cities.

items.cue: Nhiều người từ hoàn cảnh khó khăn có thể tiếp cận giáo dục và việc làm tốt hơn, chẳng hạn thông qua học bổng và miễn học phí.
items.translation: Many poor people can have better education and jobs, for example through scholarships and free tuition.
items.answer: Many people from disadvantaged backgrounds can gain access to better education and employment, for example through scholarships and tuition waivers.
items.alt: Scholarships and tuition waivers allow many people from low-income families to access better education and employment.

items.cue: Tóm lại, dù tiết kiệm tiền có nhiều lợi ích, điều này không phải lúc nào cũng thực tế với những người có thu nhập hạn chế.
items.translation: In conclusion, although saving money has many benefits, it is not always realistic for people with low income.
items.answer: In conclusion, while saving money clearly offers advantages, it is not always realistic for those on a limited income.
items.alt: In conclusion, saving money is beneficial, but it is not a realistic option for everyone, particularly those on low incomes.

items.cue: Một hạn chế lớn của việc làm việc tại nhà là ranh giới giữa công việc và cuộc sống cá nhân trở nên mờ nhạt.
items.translation: A big disadvantage of working at home is the boundary between work and personal life becomes unclear.
items.answer: One major drawback of working from home is that the boundary between work and private life becomes blurred.
items.alt: A major disadvantage of remote working is that work and private life become harder to separate.

items.cue: Ví dụ, một học sinh có bạn bè thường trốn học có thể bắt chước để được nhóm chấp nhận.
items.translation: For example, a student whose friends often skip school may copy them to be accepted by the group.
items.answer: For example, a pupil whose friends skip classes may start doing the same in order to be accepted.
items.alt: For instance, a pupil may start skipping classes because his or her friends do.

items.cue: Một ví dụ điển hình là Phần Lan, nơi trẻ em bắt đầu đi học chính thức từ năm bảy tuổi.
items.rewriteWith: A good example of this is + where
items.translation: A typical example is Finland, where children start school at seven.
items.answer: A good example of this is Finland, where children start formal schooling at the age of seven.
items.alt: A case in point is Finland, whose children begin formal schooling at seven.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Traditional skills are disappearing. For instance, VTV has switched to AI-Native system.

items.answer: Peer pressure can lead teenagers to behave badly. For example, homeless people are more likely to be misbehave A PUPIL WHOSE FRIENDS SKIP CLASSES MAY START DOING THE SAME IN ORDER TO BE ACCEPTED.
