exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) theo chức năng và khung câu được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●): một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ hoặc câu hỗ trợ.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Children who grow up in poor families are better prepared for the difficulties of adult life than children raised by wealthy parents. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: One major drawback of … is that
items.answer: One major drawback of growing up in a wealthy family is that children may never learn to manage money carefully.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Caring for children is an important responsibility. Some people believe that all parents should be required to take childcare training courses. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: There are several benefits associated with
items.answer: There are several benefits associated with childcare training, particularly for first-time parents.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Leaders and directors of organisations are often older people. Some people believe that younger people can be equally effective leaders. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu ví dụ: A good example of this is
items.answer: Younger people can lead successfully in fast-moving industries; a good example of this is the many young founders of technology companies.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Prison is the most common way to deal with crime in many countries. Some people believe that providing better education would be a more effective solution. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: One effective way to … is to
items.answer: One effective way to reduce reoffending is to give prisoners vocational training.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that allowing police officers to carry guns can lead to higher levels of violence. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: The main reason why … is that
items.answer: The main reason why some countries do not arm their police is that guns can escalate dangerous situations.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Good relationships between countries are becoming increasingly important for solving global problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu hỗ trợ: From an environmental perspective
items.answer: From an environmental perspective, close cooperation between countries is essential, as pollution does not respect national borders.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that rich countries should help poorer countries in ways other than giving them financial aid. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Rich countries can help in many ways other than money. These could include sharing medical expertise, training teachers and transferring clean technology.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should not provide international aid while there are disadvantaged people, such as the unemployed and homeless, in their own countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu ví dụ: This is particularly the case for
items.answer: Poverty at home deserves urgent attention. This is particularly the case for homeless families with young children.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Shops and products are becoming increasingly similar in different parts of the world. Some people see this as a positive development, while others see it as a negative one. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Câu ví dụ: These could range from … to …
items.answer: Global brands now dominate shopping streets everywhere. These could range from fast-food chains to fashion retailers.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that more action can be taken to reduce crime and make people feel safe, while others think that little can be done. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Ví dụ mở rộng: For instance, + ai + làm gì + kết quả
items.answer: Better street lighting can make people feel safer. For instance, residents who walk home from work at night are less likely to be targeted on well-lit streets.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that students should be allowed to evaluate and criticise their teachers, while others think this could lead to a loss of respect and discipline in the classroom. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Câu hỗ trợ: On a personal level
items.answer: On a personal level, students who give feedback on their teachers learn to express opinions respectfully.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that secondary school students should study international news as a school subject, while others think this would waste valuable school time. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: There are several benefits associated with
items.answer: There are several benefits associated with studying international news, including a better understanding of global issues.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that students benefit from attending private secondary schools, while others think private schools can have a negative effect on society as a whole. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Câu hỗ trợ: On a societal level
items.answer: On a societal level, private schools may widen the gap between rich and poor families.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: The gap between rich and poor people is becoming wider in many countries. What problems can this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
items.hint: Câu chủ đề: One effective way to … is to
items.answer: One effective way to reduce income inequality is to make taxation more progressive.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: More and more people are shopping online. Why is this happening, and what effects does online shopping have on local shops and communities?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ mở rộng (ai – làm gì – kết quả).
items.answer: One major effect of online shopping is the decline of local high streets. For instance, many small bookshops have closed because they cannot match the prices offered by large online retailers.

items.cue: Media and communication · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Advertising has an increasing influence on people's lives. Do the positive effects of advertising outweigh the negative effects?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ mở rộng (ai – làm gì – kết quả).
items.answer: There are several benefits associated with advertising. A good example of this is public health campaigns, which have encouraged many people to stop smoking.

items.cue: City development · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some cities, there are few restrictions on the design and construction of homes and office buildings, and owners can choose the style they prefer. Do the advantages of this approach outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ mở rộng (ai – làm gì – kết quả).
items.answer: One major drawback of having few building restrictions is that cities can lose their visual character. This is particularly the case in historic districts, where modern towers may sit awkwardly beside traditional houses.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Sport is becoming increasingly commercial, with more professional organisations and large companies becoming involved in sporting events. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ mở rộng (ai – làm gì – kết quả).
items.answer: From an economic perspective, commercial sponsorship has brought large sums of money into sport. This funding could range from investment in grassroots clubs to better training facilities for elite athletes.

items.cue: Media and communication · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Newspapers have a strong influence on people's ideas and opinions. Why is this the case, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ mở rộng (ai – làm gì – kết quả).
items.answer: The main reason why newspapers influence opinion is that many readers trust established publications. For instance, a reader who sees the same story repeated in several papers is likely to accept it as fact.

items.cue: Media and communication · Two-part question
items.prompt: People receive a great deal of information from the news, but they are often unsure whether it is accurate. To what extent should people trust journalists, and what qualities should a good journalist have?
items.hint: Hai câu: một câu chủ đề và một câu ví dụ mở rộng (ai – làm gì – kết quả).
items.answer: Good journalists should, above all, check their facts carefully. A good example of this is reporters who confirm information with several independent sources before publishing.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Mở rộng ví dụ
intro: Mỗi luận điểm đi kèm một ví dụ quá chung chung. Viết lại thành một câu ví dụ mở rộng: ai – làm gì – kết quả. Không bịa số liệu.

items.cue: Claim: Learning to cook saves money. → Weak example: For example, cooking is cheap.
items.hint: Bắt đầu: For example, a student who …
items.answer: For example, a student who cooks at home instead of eating out can save a significant amount each month.
items.alt: For instance, families who cook their own meals spend far less than those who eat out regularly.

items.cue: Claim: Public transport reduces pollution. → Weak example: For example, buses are good.
items.hint: Bắt đầu: For example, a single full bus …
items.answer: For example, a single full bus can replace dozens of cars, greatly reducing emissions during rush hour.
items.alt: For instance, one crowded bus takes many cars off the road, which cuts emissions considerably.

items.cue: Claim: Working from home saves time. → Weak example: For instance, people do not travel.
items.hint: Bắt đầu: For instance, an employee who …
items.answer: For instance, an employee who used to commute for two hours a day can use that time to exercise or rest.
items.alt: For example, someone who no longer commutes can spend the extra time with family.

items.cue: Claim: Team sports teach cooperation. → Weak example: For example, football.
items.answer: For example, footballers must coordinate their movements, so each player learns to rely on others.
items.alt: For instance, a basketball team can only score if players pass to one another, which teaches cooperation.

items.cue: Claim: Technology helps elderly people. → Weak example: For example, phones.
items.answer: For example, video calls allow grandparents who live alone to see their grandchildren regularly.
items.alt: For instance, older people living alone can use video calls to stay in touch with their families.

items.cue: Claim: Tourism can damage local culture. → Weak example: For example, traditions change.
items.hint: Bắt đầu: For example, a traditional festival …
items.answer: For example, a traditional festival may be shortened and staged daily to suit visitors' schedules.
items.alt: For instance, sacred ceremonies are sometimes turned into paid performances for tourists.

items.cue: Claim: Volunteering builds skills. → Weak example: For example, volunteering is useful.
items.hint: Bắt đầu: For example, a student who organises …
items.answer: For example, a student who organises a charity event learns to manage a budget and lead a team.
items.alt: For instance, young volunteers who run community projects develop leadership and planning skills.

items.cue: Claim: Advertising can harm children. → Weak example: For example, children see ads.
items.answer: For example, a child who sees frequent adverts for sugary snacks may pester his or her parents to buy them.
items.alt: For instance, children exposed to junk-food adverts often ask their parents for unhealthy snacks.

items.cue: Claim: Strict laws reduce drink-driving. → Weak example: For example, fines.
items.answer: For example, when heavy fines and licence bans are introduced, many drivers start using taxis after drinking.
items.alt: For instance, the risk of losing a licence persuades many drivers to arrange a lift home after drinking.

items.cue: Claim: Studying abroad builds independence. → Weak example: For instance, students live abroad.
items.answer: For instance, an international student must open a bank account, find accommodation and solve everyday problems alone.
items.alt: For example, students abroad must handle rent, bills and daily problems without their parents' help.

items.cue: Claim: Online learning suits working adults. → Weak example: For instance, it is flexible.
items.answer: For instance, a nurse who works night shifts can watch recorded lectures whenever she has free time.
items.alt: For example, a parent with a full-time job can study late in the evening once the children are asleep.

items.cue: Claim: Recycling saves resources. → Weak example: For example, recycling is good.
items.hint: Ai / cái gì? Như thế nào? Kết quả?
items.answer: For example, recycling aluminium cans uses far less energy than producing new aluminium from raw materials.
items.alt: For instance, recycled paper reduces the number of trees that need to be cut down.

items.cue: Claim: Social media spreads misinformation. → Weak example: For example, fake news.
items.hint: Ai / cái gì? Như thế nào? Kết quả?
items.answer: For example, a false health claim can be shared thousands of times before experts have a chance to correct it.
items.alt: For instance, a misleading post about a medicine can go viral within hours, before doctors can respond.

items.cue: Claim: Older workers bring valuable experience. → Weak example: For instance, they are experienced.
items.answer: For instance, an experienced engineer can spot design problems that younger colleagues might overlook.
items.alt: For example, a senior nurse can recognise warning signs that a newly qualified colleague might miss.

items.cue: Claim: Automation erodes traditional skills. → Weak example: For instance, a TV channel uses AI.
items.hint: Thay ví dụ không chứng minh luận điểm
items.answer: For instance, factory workers lose manual dexterity once robotic arms take over assembly tasks.
items.alt: For example, few young people now learn hand-weaving because machine-made fabric is cheaper.

items.cue: Claim: Peer pressure affects teenagers' behaviour. → Weak example: For example, homeless people misbehave.
items.hint: Thay ví dụ không liên quan
items.answer: For example, a teenager whose friends skip classes may start doing the same in order to be accepted.
items.alt: For instance, a pupil may begin smoking because the rest of his friendship group does.

items.cue: Claim: Congestion charges reduce traffic. → Weak example: For instance, drivers pay.
items.answer: For instance, when drivers must pay a daily fee to enter the city centre, many switch to buses or trains for regular journeys.
items.alt: For example, commuters faced with a daily charge often decide that public transport is the cheaper option.

items.cue: Claim: Scholarships improve access to education. → Weak example: For example, scholarships help.
items.answer: For example, a talented student from a poor rural family can attend university without placing a financial burden on her parents.
items.alt: For instance, scholarships allow gifted students from low-income families to study at top universities.

items.cue: Claim: Free museums attract local visitors. → Weak example: For example, free entry.
items.answer: For example, families who could not otherwise afford tickets may visit regularly and develop an interest in history.
items.alt: For instance, free entry encourages local schools to organise more trips to museums.

items.cue: Claim: Long working hours harm family life. → Weak example: For instance, parents work.
items.answer: For instance, parents who regularly work until late evening may rarely eat dinner with their children.
items.alt: For example, a father who works twelve-hour days may hardly see his children during the week.

theory.html: Task Response không chỉ là trả lời đúng đề. Ở cấp độ câu, giám khảo kiểm tra xem mỗi nhận định có hợp lý, được giải thích và có giới hạn phù hợp hay không. Band 6 thường có các ý chưa phát triển, khái quát hóa quá mức hoặc ví dụ không liên quan; Band 7 có các ý được mở rộng, hỗ trợ và nhất quán.

Bài này tổng hợp 12 lỗi lập luận thường gặp nhất trong bài viết của học viên. Mỗi lỗi có một dấu hiệu nhận biết và một cách sửa cụ thể: thu hẹp phạm vi, thêm bước trung gian, thay ví dụ, giữ lập trường nhất quán.

Hãy tự kiểm tra từng câu trong đoạn thân bài bằng ba câu hỏi: (1) Nhận định này có đúng với mọi trường hợp không? (2) Tôi đã giải thích vì sao A dẫn đến B chưa? (3) Ví dụ của tôi có chứng minh đúng điều tôi nói không?

theory.text: 12 lỗi lập luận ở cấp độ câu

cells: Thu hẹp phạm vi; dùng many, some, can, may
Video games make all teenagers violent. → Violent games may increase aggression in some teenagers.
High density means more pollution. → … mainly because of heavier traffic.
Kết quả nhắc lại nguyên nhân bằng từ khác
Technology saves time, so people spend less time on tasks. → … so they can focus on creative work.
Chuỗi hệ quả ngày càng nghiêm trọng, không có chứng minh
Giữ một bước có cơ sở; dùng may
Phones in class → failure → crime. → Phones may distract some students.
Bóp méo quan điểm đối lập để dễ phản bác
Trình bày đúng lập luận mạnh nhất của phía đối lập
Opponents simply do not care about the poor. → Opponents argue that free tuition is costly.
Kết luận không suy ra được từ tiền đề
Đổi kết luận cho khớp với tiền đề
Unemployment makes companies less creative. → Unemployment reduces household incomes.
Ví dụ không liên quan / không chứng minh
Ví dụ nói về đối tượng hoặc ý khác
Thay bằng ví dụ ai – làm gì – kết quả
Peer pressure … e.g. homeless people misbehave. → … e.g. a pupil copies friends who skip class.
Liệt kê nhiều kết quả, không giải thích kết quả nào
Chọn một ý, giải thích cơ chế
This reduces crime, corruption and distrust. → When the law applies equally, officials have fewer chances to abuse power.
Giải pháp không khớp nguyên nhân
Nguyên nhân lớn, giải pháp nhỏ (hoặc ngược lại)
Chọn đối tượng có quyền lực tương xứng
Gangs run much cybercrime, so people should use strong passwords. → … governments should cooperate.
Nêu rõ quan điểm / biện pháp
There are some relative measures. → This essay will suggest two practical measures.
Kết luận không khớp thân bài
Kết luận nói điều thân bài không bàn đến
Tóm tắt đúng quan điểm và các ý đã viết
… it has some disadvantageous aspects. → … it is not always realistic for those on a limited income.
Đoạn sau phủ nhận đoạn trước
Giữ một lập trường; thừa nhận hạn chế có kiểm soát
Friends at work raise productivity … they reduce productivity. → … occasional tension rarely outweighs the benefits.

items: Violent video games may increase aggression in some children.
High population density leads to more pollution, mainly because of heavier traffic.
Technology saves workers time, which allows them to focus on tasks that require creativity.
Opponents of free tuition argue that it would place a heavy burden on taxpayers.
When the law applies equally to the rich and the poor, officials have fewer opportunities to abuse power, which in turn reduces corruption.
Since much cybercrime is run by international gangs, governments need to cooperate to dismantle these networks.
For example, a pupil whose friends skip classes may start doing the same in order to be accepted.
In conclusion, while saving money clearly offers advantages, it is not always realistic for those on a limited income.

items.bad: This trend risks widen the gap between the rich and the poor, forcing many families into poverty. TR
items.good: This trend could widen the gap between the rich and the poor, pushing some low-income families into financial hardship.
items.note: Tuyệt đối hóa chuỗi hệ quả (many families, poverty); giảm nhẹ mức độ (could, some, financial hardship). (risks widen cũng sai: risk + V-ing.)

items.bad: This can reduce crime rates, discourage corruption and increase public trust. TR
items.good: When the law applies equally to the rich and the poor, officials have fewer opportunities to abuse power, which in turn reduces corruption.
items.note: Ý chưa phát triển: ba kết quả được liệt kê nhưng không kết quả nào được giải thích.

items.bad: Technology saves workers' time. As a result, they can spend less time on their tasks. TR
items.good: Technology saves workers' time. As a result, they can devote more attention to tasks that require creativity.
items.note: Lặp ý: câu thứ hai chỉ nhắc lại câu thứ nhất.

items.bad: Unemployment increased. As a result, companies lacked creativity in their tasks. TR
items.good: Unemployment increased. As a result, household incomes in the region fell.
items.note: Lập luận không hợp lý: thất nghiệp không dẫn đến việc công ty thiếu sáng tạo.

items.bad: If students use phones in class, they will fail exams, drop out and end up unemployed. TR
items.good: If students use phones in class, they may find it harder to concentrate, which could lower their grades.
items.note: Dốc trượt: mỗi bước trong chuỗi đều chưa được chứng minh.

items.bad: In this essay, there are some relative measures which should be carried out. TR
items.good: In this essay, I will suggest two practical measures to tackle the problem.
items.note: Quan điểm mơ hồ (và relative phải là relevant).

items.h: Thu hẹp phạm vi hay giảm mức độ?
items.html: Có hai cách sửa tuyệt đối hóa: thu hẹp ai (all teenagers → some teenagers who play for hours) hoặc giảm mức độ (will destroy → may weaken). Thường nên làm cả hai.
Khi viết A leads to B, hãy tự hỏi bằng cách nào? Câu trả lời chính là bước trung gian cần viết ra: …, mainly because …, …, which means that ….

items.h: Ví dụ: ai – làm gì – kết quả
items.html: Một ví dụ tốt nêu rõ đối tượng, hành động và kết quả, và kết quả đó chính là điều câu chủ đề khẳng định. Ví dụ cá nhân (my cousin …) hoặc số liệu bịa đặt đều không thuyết phục.
Bạn có thể thừa nhận hạn chế của quan điểm mình (Admittedly, …, but …), nhưng không được khẳng định hai điều trái ngược. Câu kết luận phải khớp với câu nêu quan điểm ở mở bài.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Mỗi câu tiếng Việt dưới đây có một lỗi lập luận. Dịch sát nghĩa sang tiếng Anh, sau đó viết lại để sửa lỗi theo gợi ý. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cách sửa.

items.cue: Trò chơi điện tử khiến mọi trẻ em trở nên bạo lực.
items.translation: Video games make all children violent.
items.answer: Violent video games may increase aggression in some children.

items.cue: Công nghệ giúp người lao động tiết kiệm thời gian, vì vậy họ dành ít thời gian hơn cho công việc.
items.translation: Technology saves workers time, so they spend less time on their tasks.
items.answer: Technology saves workers time, which allows them to focus on tasks that require creativity.

items.cue: Mật độ dân số cao đồng nghĩa với nhiều ô nhiễm hơn.
items.translation: High population density means more pollution.
items.answer: High population density leads to more pollution, mainly because of heavier traffic.

items.cue: Áp dụng luật pháp công bằng giúp giảm tội phạm, giảm tham nhũng và tăng niềm tin của người dân.
items.translation: Applying the law equally reduces crime, reduces corruption and increases public trust.
items.answer: When the law applies equally to everyone, officials have fewer opportunities to abuse their power, which in turn reduces corruption.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Mỗi đề đi kèm một nhận định có lỗi lập luận. Viết lại thành một câu (●, ●●) hoặc hai câu (●●●) hợp lý, có giới hạn và có giải thích.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents should be held responsible and punished when their children behave badly. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: All bad children have bad parents.
items.answer: Children's behaviour is shaped partly by their parents, so parents should bear some responsibility, although peers and school also play a role.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that sports competitions can cause emotional stress for young people and that children and teenagers should therefore be banned from taking part. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Sports competitions destroy every teenager's mental health.
items.answer: Highly competitive sport can cause stress for some teenagers, especially when adults put too much pressure on them to win.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Although the leisure industry is growing, some people believe that modern technology has made people less creative in the way they entertain themselves. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Technology has made everyone completely uncreative.
items.answer: Ready-made digital entertainment may leave some people less inclined to create things themselves.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Parents should encourage their children to spend less time studying and more time taking part in sports and physical activities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: If children study more than they exercise, they will become obese, depressed and unemployed.
items.answer: Children who spend most of their free time studying may get too little exercise, which can affect their physical health.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should pay for healthcare and education, while others think these are the responsibility of individuals. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: People who oppose free healthcare simply do not care about the sick.
items.answer: Opponents of state-funded healthcare usually argue that it is expensive and may be used inefficiently.

items.cue: Government, politics and diplomacy · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the most urgent problems in modern society can only be solved through international cooperation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Climate change is caused by many countries, so individuals should recycle more.
items.answer: Since climate change is driven by emissions from many countries, international agreements are needed to cut them.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that nuclear energy is the best way to meet the world's growing demand for energy. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Nuclear energy is the best because it is the best source of energy.
items.answer: Nuclear energy is attractive because it produces large amounts of electricity with very low carbon emissions.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that life on Earth may become more difficult in the future and that more money should be spent on research into living on other planets, such as Mars. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Mars research will definitely save humanity.
items.answer: Research into living on other planets could produce technologies that help us adapt to environmental change on Earth.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents should read or tell stories to their children, while others think children should learn to read stories by themselves. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Reading stories to children improves vocabulary, creativity, bonding and grades.
items.answer: Reading aloud to young children exposes them to words they would not hear in everyday conversation, which helps to build their vocabulary.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: In many families, both parents work. Some people believe that grandparents are the best people to look after young children, while others think childcare centres are better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Grandparents are better carers. For example, my grandmother cooks well.
items.answer: Grandparents often provide more personal care; for instance, they can adapt routines to a child's needs in a way that busy nurseries cannot.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that studying literature is important for developing a person's character, while others think it is a waste of time. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Literature develops character because it makes people's characters better.
items.answer: Literature can develop character by encouraging readers to see situations from other people's points of view.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others think it is more important to reward students who make the greatest improvement. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Rewarding top students makes weak students give up school and turn to crime.
items.answer: Rewarding only top students may discourage weaker learners, who see little chance of being recognised.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that teenagers should study all school subjects, while others think they should focus only on the subjects they are good at or interested in. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Students who study all subjects become experts in everything.
items.answer: Studying a broad range of subjects gives teenagers basic knowledge in many areas before they choose a specialism.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many people today do not feel safe either at home or when they are outside. What are the reasons for this, and what can be done to make people feel safer?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: People feel unsafe, so the government should ban all television.
items.answer: People often feel unsafe because the media focus heavily on violent crime, so more balanced reporting could reduce unnecessary fear.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Crimes committed by teenagers are increasing in many places. What are the reasons for this, and what measures can be taken to reduce teenage crime?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Teenage crime is increasing because teenagers are criminals.
items.answer: One reason for rising teenage crime is a lack of supervision when both parents work long hours. Community programmes that keep teenagers busy after school could help address this.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Consumer goods are becoming cheaper and more widely available. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Cheap goods are good because they are cheap.
items.answer: Cheaper consumer goods allow low-income families to afford appliances that make daily life easier. However, they also encourage people to replace items rather than repair them, which increases waste.

items.cue: Food and health · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: People can now buy food from many different parts of the world, and as a result they often eat imported food instead of locally produced food. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Imported food destroys all local farms.
items.answer: Imported food can put pressure on local farmers who cannot compete on price. Nevertheless, it also gives consumers access to a more varied diet throughout the year.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: People's lifestyles are becoming increasingly similar around the world. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Similar lifestyles are bad. In conclusion, they have advantages and disadvantages.
items.answer: The spread of similar lifestyles may weaken local traditions. In my view, therefore, this is a largely negative development, despite its benefits for international communication.

items.cue: Work · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Some countries have introduced laws that limit the number of hours employees can work. Why have these laws been introduced, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Working-hour laws will make every worker happy and healthy forever.
items.answer: Laws limiting working hours can reduce stress-related illness among employees. This is a positive development, provided that workers do not lose income as a result.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some people believe that economic progress is the only way to measure a country's success, while others think other factors should also be considered. What other factors should be used to measure success, and which do you think is the most important?
items.hint: Sửa nhận định: Economic progress is the only measure, so happiness does not matter.
items.answer: Economic growth matters, but it does not show whether citizens are healthy or satisfied with their lives. In my view, the most important additional measure is citizens' well-being.

theory.html: Coherence and Cohesion đánh giá việc các câu nối với nhau có logic không. Ở Band 6, người viết thường dùng từ nối một cách máy móc hoặc sai nghĩa, và quy chiếu (it, they, this) không rõ ràng. Ở Band 7, các ý được sắp xếp logic, từ nối được dùng chính xác và linh hoạt, và người viết dùng quy chiếu và thay thế thay vì lặp từ.

Ba nhóm lỗi chính: (1) từ nối sai nghĩa (Otherwise khi muốn bổ sung ý, In other words khi nêu hệ quả mới, By contrast khi không có đối lập); (2) chuỗi từ nối máy móc (In addition … Moreover … Also …) thay vì nối ý bằng quy chiếu; (3) quy chiếu mơ hồ và câu chồng chất mệnh đề khiến người đọc không theo kịp.

Nguyên tắc thông tin cũ → thông tin mới: mỗi câu nên bắt đầu bằng điều người đọc đã biết (thường là một danh từ tóm tắt câu trước: This trend, Such regulations, These measures) và kết thúc bằng thông tin mới. Đây là cách nối câu tự nhiên nhất, không cần từ nối.

items.note: Chuỗi từ nối máy móc; nối ý bằng danh từ tóm tắt This growing dependence.

items.html: Moreover / Furthermore / In addition bổ sung một ý cùng hướng, phù hợp văn viết học thuật. Besides ít trang trọng hơn và thường dùng để thêm một lý do ("ngoài ra"); không dùng Besides để chuyển sang một đối tượng khác — khi đó dùng As for.
Otherwise = nếu không thì (Governments must act now; otherwise, the problem will grow). In other words = nói cách khác, chỉ dùng khi diễn đạt lại cùng một ý.
this trend, this problem, this change, this approach, such measures, such policies, these regulations, this growing dependence, this rise. Chọn danh từ khớp chính xác với ý câu trước.
Khi câu sau bắt đầu bằng danh từ tóm tắt câu trước (This rise …), mối liên kết đã rõ ràng. Không phải câu nào cũng cần Moreover hay In addition.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Sửa từ nối và quy chiếu
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu hoặc đoạn ngắn: sửa từ nối sai, quy chiếu mơ hồ hoặc lặp từ theo gợi ý.

items.cue: Technology makes work faster. Even more, it reduces costs.
items.answer: Technology makes work faster. Moreover, it reduces costs.
items.alt: Technology makes work faster. Furthermore, it reduces costs.

items.cue: Close friendships at work can create tension. Otherwise, comparisons between colleagues can cause jealousy.
items.answer: Close friendships at work can create tension. Moreover, comparisons between colleagues can cause jealousy.
items.alt: Close friendships at work can create tension. In addition, comparisons between colleagues can cause jealousy.

items.cue: The government invested in rural roads. In other words, rural businesses grew.
items.answer: The government invested in rural roads. As a result, rural businesses grew.
items.alt: The government invested in rural roads, which helped rural businesses to grow.

items.cue: Traditional universities have existed for centuries. Besides, online courses are a much more recent development.
items.answer: Traditional universities have existed for centuries. As for online courses, these are a much more recent development.
items.alt: Traditional universities have existed for centuries, whereas online courses are a much more recent development.

items.cue: Governments should regulate online content for children. If this method is effective, they can help children avoid harmful content.
items.answer: Governments should regulate online content for children. If effective, such regulations can help children avoid harmful content.
items.alt: Governments should regulate online content for children, as such rules can help protect them from harmful material.

items.cue: AI is spreading quickly. One prominent advantage is that it can replace human repetitive tasks.
items.answer: AI is spreading quickly. One prominent advantage is that AI can take over repetitive tasks.
items.alt: AI is spreading quickly, and one prominent advantage is that such systems can take over repetitive tasks.

items.cue: Spending on food remained stable. By contrast, spending on clothes remained unchanged.
items.answer: Spending on food remained stable. Similarly, spending on clothes remained unchanged.
items.alt: Spending on food remained stable, and spending on clothes was also unchanged.

items.cue: Many people rely on technology. In addition, they use apps for everything. Moreover, they cannot remember phone numbers. Also, they rarely read maps.
items.hint: thay chuỗi từ nối bằng quy chiếu
items.answer: Many people rely heavily on technology, using apps for almost everything. This growing dependence means that many can no longer remember phone numbers or read maps.
items.alt: Many people now use apps for almost everything. As a result of this dependence, many can no longer remember phone numbers or read maps.

items.cue: Tourism creates jobs. Tourism also brings foreign currency. Tourism also funds conservation.
items.answer: Tourism creates jobs and brings in foreign currency. In addition, the revenue it generates can fund conservation.
items.alt: Tourism creates jobs and earns foreign currency, some of which can be used to fund conservation.

items.cue: The number of cars has increased. This has made it worse.
items.hint: danh từ tóm tắt rõ ràng
items.answer: The number of cars has increased. This rise has made congestion worse.
items.alt: The rising number of cars has made congestion worse.

items.cue: Many young people move to cities. They find jobs, but they face high rents, and they live in small flats, and they feel lonely.
items.answer: Many young people move to cities to find work. However, high rents force many of them into small flats, where they may feel isolated.
items.alt: Young people who move to cities for work often end up in small, expensive flats, where they may feel isolated.

items.cue: Some schools ban phones. This is good. It helps students. They concentrate better.
items.answer: Some schools ban mobile phones, a policy that helps students concentrate better.
items.alt: Some schools ban mobile phones, which helps students to concentrate.

items.cue: Exams are stressful. On the contrary, they are the fairest way to assess students.
items.answer: Exams are stressful. Nevertheless, they remain the fairest way to assess students.
items.alt: Although exams are stressful, they remain the fairest way to assess students.

items.cue: Governments should tax sugary drinks. Furthermore, sugar causes obesity.
items.answer: Governments should tax sugary drinks, as high sugar consumption contributes to obesity.
items.alt: Since high sugar consumption contributes to obesity, governments should tax sugary drinks.

items.cue: Consequently, a child can potentially become discouraged to schools and eventually, fostering an invisible barrier to parents.
items.hint: viết lại theo trình tự kết quả rõ ràng
items.answer: As a result, the child may lose interest in school and, over time, stop sharing problems with his or her parents.
items.alt: As a result, the child may become disengaged from school and gradually stop confiding in his or her parents.

items.cue: Team members can communicate openly in order to reassign tasks if someone falls behind schedule as long as it helps with the productivity of the team.
items.hint: một ý chính + một mệnh đề phụ
items.answer: Open communication allows teams to reassign tasks quickly when someone falls behind, which boosts productivity.
items.alt: When team members communicate openly, tasks can be reassigned quickly if someone falls behind, improving productivity.

items.cue: Rents have risen faster than wages. This results in the disparity between the average income and the expenditure on essential services, lots of urban inhabitants cannot cover their expenses.
items.hint: sửa nối câu bằng dấu phẩy + từ nối kết quả
items.answer: Rents have risen faster than wages, meaning that many urban residents cannot cover their essential expenses.
items.alt: Rents have risen faster than wages. As a result, many urban residents cannot afford essential services.

items.cue: Many people work long hours. This leads to stress. Stress leads to health problems. Health problems cost the government money.
items.hint: thông tin cũ → mới, gộp chuỗi
items.answer: Long working hours often lead to stress, which in turn can cause health problems that place a burden on public healthcare.
items.alt: Long working hours cause stress, and the resulting health problems place a burden on public healthcare.

items.cue: Air pollution is a problem in cities. Cars cause it. The government should reduce them.
items.answer: Air pollution in cities is caused largely by cars, so the government should reduce traffic in urban areas.
items.alt: As cars are the main source of urban air pollution, the government should reduce traffic in cities.

items.cue: Students should learn financial skills. For example, budgeting. In conclusion, schools should teach it.
items.hint: sửa câu thiếu thành phần + từ nối
items.answer: Students should learn financial skills such as budgeting. For this reason, schools should include money management in the curriculum.
items.alt: Financial skills such as budgeting are essential, so schools should teach money management.
