items.answer: Governments should tax sugary drinks. Furthermore, sugar causes obesity., AS HIGH SUGAR CONSUMPTION CONTRIBUTES TO OBESITY.
notes: CC Furthermore bổ sung ý mới; ở đây là lý do cho đề xuất.

items.cue: Consequently, a child can potentially become discouraged to schools and eventually, fostering an invisible barrier to parents.
items.answer: Consequently, a child can potentially become discouraged to schools and eventually, fostering an invisible barrier to parents. AS A RESULT, THE CHILD MAY LOSE INTEREST IN SCHOOL AND, OVER TIME, STOP SHARING PROBLEMS WITH HIS OR HER PARENTS.
notes: CC Câu chồng chất, không rõ trình tự kết quả.
LR discouraged to sai giới từ.
GRA Cụm V-ing không có chủ thể rõ ràng.

items.cue: Cities should cut car use and plant more trees. These measures not only reduce pollution but also improve public health.
items.answer: ✓ Cities should cut car use and plant more trees. These measures not only reduce pollution but also improve public health.
notes: Đúng: These measures quy chiếu rõ ràng.

items.cue: Air pollution is a problem in cities. Cars cause it. The government should reduce them.
items.answer: Air pollution is a problem in cities. Cars cause it. The government should reduce them. THE GOVERNMENT SHOULD THEREFORE REDUCE TRAFFIC IN URBAN AREAS.
notes: CC them không rõ chỉ gì.

items.cue: Many young people move to cities, they find jobs, but they face high rents.
items.answer: Many young people move to cities, they find jobs, but they face high rents. TO FIND WORK, BUT MANY THEN FACE HIGH RENTS.
notes: GRA Lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; gom hai ý bằng to + V.

items.cue: Long working hours often lead to stress, which in turn can cause health problems.
items.answer: ✓ Long working hours often lead to stress, which in turn can cause health problems.
notes: Đúng: which in turn nối chuỗi nhân quả.

items.cue: In conclusion, firstly, technology has advantages. Secondly, it has disadvantages. Lastly, people should use it.
items.answer: In conclusion, firstly, technology has advantages. Secondly, it has disadvantages. Lastly, people should use it. WHILE TECHNOLOGY BRINGS CLEAR ADVANTAGES, IT SHOULD BE USED IN MODERATION TO AVOID ITS DRAWBACKS.
notes: CC Kết luận liệt kê máy móc, không tổng hợp ý.

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết hai câu liên kết chặt chẽ. Câu ●, ●● dùng từ nối hoặc danh từ tóm tắt được gợi ý; câu ●●● tự chọn cách liên kết (ưu tiên danh từ tóm tắt).

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should ban dangerous sports such as skydiving and rock climbing. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Câu 2 mở đầu bằng Such a ban
items.answer: Some governments have considered banning dangerous sports such as skydiving. Such a ban, however, would restrict personal freedom.

items.cue: Leisure, sports and hobbies · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Team activities teach people more useful life skills than activities that are done alone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Team activities teach people to cooperate. Moreover, they help people learn to accept responsibility for shared results.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: When humans first landed on the Moon, it was described as a great achievement for humankind. Some people, however, believe that space exploration has little effect on our daily lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Space research has produced technologies such as satellite navigation. As a result, it affects our daily lives more than many people realise.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Government funding for postgraduate research is limited. Some people believe that this money should be spent only on scientific research rather than on other subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Some governments fund only scientific research. This approach may neglect subjects such as history, which help society understand itself.

items.cue: Science, technology and innovation · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The rapid development of communication technology, such as smartphones and other mobile devices, has more disadvantages than advantages. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Smartphones can distract people and disrupt sleep. Nevertheless, their benefits for communication and safety are considerable.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Unemployment is becoming increasingly serious in many countries. Some people believe that primary education is enough for students, while others think secondary education is necessary. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Many employers now require at least a secondary school certificate. This trend means that primary education alone is rarely enough to find a stable job.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that it is no longer necessary to teach children handwriting skills. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Handwriting helps young children develop fine motor skills. In addition, it can help them remember what they learn.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Everyone should remain in full-time education until the age of 18. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Staying in education until 18 gives young people more qualifications. However, not every student benefits from academic study.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that children should obey rules and do what their parents and teachers tell them, while others think that children who are controlled too much may be unable to deal with problems independently. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Some parents control every decision their children make. Such strict control may leave children unable to solve problems independently.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that women should have the same opportunities as men to work in the police and armed forces, while others think women are not suitable for these jobs. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Women have proved effective as police officers in many countries. Similarly, many serve successfully in the armed forces.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that parents have the greatest influence on a child's development, while others think factors such as friends and television are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Parents shape young children's values at home. By contrast, friends and social media tend to have a stronger influence during adolescence.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that music plays an important role in society, while others think it is simply a form of entertainment. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Music brings people together at festivals and national events. This role goes far beyond simple entertainment.

items.cue: Art and museums · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that anyone can learn to create art, while others think that artistic ability is something people are born with. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Drawing and painting depend largely on observation and technique. Since these skills can be practised, most people can improve with training.

items.cue: Art and museums · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many places, museums and historical sites are visited mainly by tourists rather than local people. Why is this the case, and what can be done to attract more local visitors?
items.answer: Tourists often visit museums as part of a holiday. As for local residents, many assume they can visit at any time and therefore never go.

items.cue: Environment · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: The amount of household waste, such as food packaging, is increasing in many countries. What are the causes of this problem, and how can it be solved?
items.hint: Hai câu liên kết bằng danh từ tóm tắt hoặc từ nối phù hợp; không dùng chuỗi In addition … Moreover.
items.answer: Much household waste comes from excessive food packaging. To reduce this problem, governments could require manufacturers to use less packaging.

items.cue: Environment · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: The growing global demand for oil and gas has led to exploration in remote and previously untouched natural areas. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu liên kết bằng danh từ tóm tắt hoặc từ nối phù hợp; không dùng chuỗi In addition … Moreover.
items.answer: Oil exploration in remote areas can create jobs and lower fuel prices. These benefits, however, come at the cost of damage to fragile ecosystems.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: It is now possible for scientists and tourists to travel to remote natural environments, such as the South Pole. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu liên kết bằng danh từ tóm tắt hoặc từ nối phù hợp; không dùng chuỗi In addition … Moreover.
items.answer: Scientific research in Antarctica helps us understand climate change. Tourism there, by contrast, offers few benefits but adds to pollution.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Many people want to buy well-known brands of clothes, cars and other consumer goods. Why is this the case, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu liên kết bằng danh từ tóm tắt hoặc từ nối phù hợp; không dùng chuỗi In addition … Moreover.
items.answer: Many people buy well-known brands because they associate them with quality and status. This tendency can lead some consumers into debt.

items.cue: Lifestyle · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Ambition is an important quality for people who want to succeed in life. How important is ambition, and is it a positive or negative characteristic?
items.hint: Hai câu liên kết bằng danh từ tóm tắt hoặc từ nối phù hợp; không dùng chuỗi In addition … Moreover.
items.answer: Ambition motivates people to set goals and work hard. When it becomes excessive, however, it can damage relationships and health.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Two-part question
items.prompt: As economies develop, people in some developing countries become happier, while people in some developed countries become less happy. Why might this happen, and what lessons can be learned from it?
items.hint: Hai câu liên kết bằng danh từ tóm tắt hoặc từ nối phù hợp; không dùng chuỗi In addition … Moreover.
items.answer: In developing countries, rising incomes allow people to meet their basic needs, which greatly improves well-being. In wealthier countries, by contrast, further income growth tends to bring little extra happiness.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Gỡ câu chồng chất
intro: Mỗi câu gốc có quá nhiều mệnh đề nối liền. Viết lại thành một hoặc hai câu rõ ràng: một ý chính, ít mệnh đề phụ, trình tự logic.

items.cue: Many students who live in dormitories which are far from the campus where they study have to wake up early because the buses that go there are slow.
items.hint: một câu, tối đa một mệnh đề phụ
items.answer: Many students in distant dormitories have to get up early because the buses to campus are slow.
items.alt: Slow buses force many students living in distant dormitories to get up early.

items.cue: The government should build more parks in order to help people who live in cities to relax when they finish work if they feel stressed.
items.hint: một câu, một mệnh đề phụ
items.answer: The government should build more urban parks where residents can relax after work.
items.alt: More urban parks would give city residents a place to relax after work.

items.cue: Tourism is good because it creates jobs which help local people who are poor to earn money so that they can send their children to school.
items.answer: Tourism creates jobs for low-income local people, allowing them to pay for their children's education.
items.alt: By creating jobs for poorer residents, tourism helps them afford their children's education.

items.cue: Because of the fact that many people use cars which produce emissions that pollute the air, which causes health problems, cities are unhealthy.
items.hint: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ
items.answer: Emissions from the large number of cars in cities pollute the air and cause health problems.
items.alt: Car emissions make city air unhealthy to breathe.

items.cue: Children who play video games for hours every day which are often violent may become aggressive and this affects their friends who play with them.
items.hint: một câu, chủ ngữ là cụm V-ing
items.answer: Spending hours every day on violent video games may make some children more aggressive towards their friends.
items.alt: Children who play violent games for hours each day may become more aggressive towards their friends.

items.cue: Online learning is convenient for students who have jobs because they can study whenever they want and wherever they are as long as they have the Internet.
items.answer: Online learning suits working students, as they can study at any time and in any place with Internet access.
items.alt: Working students benefit from online learning because they can study anywhere with an Internet connection.

items.cue: Older people who live alone in the countryside where there are few services often feel lonely because their children have moved to cities to work.
items.answer: Many older people in rural areas live alone and feel lonely, as their children have moved to cities for work.
items.alt: With their children working in cities, many older people in the countryside live alone and feel isolated.

items.cue: The government should invest in public transport so that people will use it instead of cars which cause congestion and pollution which make cities unpleasant.
items.hint: một câu + cụm V-ing kết quả
items.answer: Investing in public transport would encourage people to leave their cars at home, reducing congestion and pollution.
items.alt: Better public transport would persuade more people to stop driving, which would ease congestion and pollution.

items.cue: Students should learn a foreign language because it is useful for their future career and also it helps them to understand other cultures when they travel abroad.
items.hint: một câu, hai lợi ích song song
items.answer: Learning a foreign language improves students' career prospects and helps them understand other cultures.
items.alt: A foreign language opens up career opportunities and deepens students' understanding of other cultures.

items.cue: Advertising that is aimed at children who cannot understand that it is trying to persuade them should be banned because it makes them want unhealthy food.
items.hint: một câu + lý do rõ ràng
items.answer: Advertising aimed at young children should be banned, as they cannot recognise persuasion and are easily drawn to unhealthy food.
items.alt: Since young children cannot recognise persuasive techniques, adverts targeting them, especially for junk food, should be banned.

items.cue: People who work long hours which are often more than ten hours a day may suffer from stress which can lead to illness which costs money to treat.
items.answer: Working more than ten hours a day can cause stress-related illness, which is costly to treat.
items.alt: Very long working days can lead to stress-related illness that is expensive to treat.

items.cue: Recycling is important because the waste that we produce which ends up in landfill sites takes many years to decompose and it pollutes the soil.
items.answer: Recycling matters because landfill waste takes years to decompose and pollutes the soil.
items.alt: Recycling is important, as waste in landfill sites decomposes slowly and contaminates the soil.

items.cue: Teachers should be paid more because they have an important role in society since they educate children who will become the workers of the future.
items.answer: Teachers deserve higher pay, as they educate the future workforce.
items.alt: Because teachers educate the next generation of workers, they deserve higher salaries.

items.cue: Many young people cannot buy houses because prices which have risen quickly in recent years are much higher than the salaries that they earn.
items.hint: một câu với cụm V-ing kết quả
items.answer: House prices have risen far faster than young people's salaries, putting home ownership out of reach for many.
items.alt: Rapidly rising house prices have left many young people unable to buy a home on their salaries.

items.cue: Team members can communicate openly in order to reassign tasks if someone falls behind schedule as long as it helps with the productivity of the team.
items.hint: một ý chính + một mệnh đề phụ
items.answer: Open communication allows teams to reassign tasks quickly when someone falls behind, which boosts productivity.
items.alt: When team members communicate openly, tasks can be reassigned quickly if someone falls behind, improving productivity.

items.cue: Consequently, a child can potentially become discouraged to schools and eventually, fostering an invisible barrier to parents.
items.hint: trình tự kết quả rõ ràng
items.answer: As a result, the child may lose interest in school and, over time, stop sharing problems with his or her parents.
items.alt: As a result, the child may become disengaged from school and gradually stop confiding in his or her parents.

items.cue: Social media, which many teenagers use for several hours every day, which can affect their sleep, can make them feel anxious because they compare themselves to others who seem to have perfect lives.
items.answer: Many teenagers spend hours on social media every day. This can disrupt their sleep and make them anxious, as they compare themselves with others who appear to have perfect lives.
items.alt: Heavy social media use can disrupt teenagers' sleep. It may also make them anxious when they compare themselves with others who seem to have perfect lives.

items.cue: International events, which are expensive to host, which require new stadiums that are often not used afterwards, can bring tourists who spend money if they are well organised.
items.answer: Although international events are expensive to host, they can attract free-spending tourists if well organised. However, the new stadiums they require are often unused afterwards.
items.alt: Well-organised international events can bring in tourist spending. However, they are expensive, and the stadiums built for them are often left empty.

items.cue: The gap between rich and poor, which has widened in many countries where wages have not risen as fast as profits, can cause social problems such as crime which makes people feel unsafe.
items.answer: In many countries, wages have not kept pace with profits, widening the gap between rich and poor. This inequality can lead to social problems such as crime.
items.alt: As profits have outpaced wages in many countries, inequality has grown. This can fuel social problems such as crime.

items.cue: Free university education, which would cost governments a lot of money that comes from taxes which everyone pays, would help students from poor families who cannot afford fees.
items.hint: tách thành hai câu tương phản
items.answer: Free university education would help students from poor families who cannot afford fees. However, it would be costly for taxpayers.
items.alt: Abolishing tuition fees would benefit students from low-income families, but the cost would fall on taxpayers.

theory.html: Lexical Resource không chỉ là dùng từ "khó". Ở Band 6, giám khảo chấp nhận một số lỗi chính tả và chọn từ nếu chúng không gây khó hiểu; ở Band 7, người viết dùng từ ít phổ biến một cách chính xác, với kết hợp từ (collocation) đúng và rất ít lỗi chính tả, từ loại. Một từ sai nghĩa (truth thay cho trust) có thể làm người đọc hiểu sai cả câu.

Bài này tổng hợp sáu nhóm lỗi từ bài viết thật của học viên: chính tả; từ dễ nhầm; kết hợp từ và giới từ đi kèm; danh từ đếm được / không đếm được; từ loại; và văn phong. Mỗi nhóm có cách kiểm tra riêng.

Cách tự kiểm tra hiệu quả nhất: khi viết xong, đọc lại chỉ để tìm lỗi từ vựng: kiểm tra chính tả các từ dài, giới từ sau động từ / danh từ, đuôi -s của danh từ không đếm được, và từ loại (danh từ / tính từ / trạng từ) ở mỗi vị trí.

cells: dutis → duties; backdraws → drawbacks; erose → erode; whild → while
Đọc lại các từ dài; chú ý -ies, âm câm và thứ tự chữ cái.
Một số từ ghép viết liền; correspondence (thư từ) thường không đếm được.
overwhelm → outweigh; truth → trust; relative → relevant; experiences → advantages
Kiểm tra nghĩa trong từ điển Anh – Anh, không chỉ dựa vào bản dịch.
rise → raise (+ tân ngữ); effect → affect (động từ); economical → economic
raise / affect là ngoại động từ; economic = thuộc về kinh tế.
minimal wage → minimum wage; acknowledge their child → guide their children
Học cả cụm, không dịch từng từ.
Kết hợp từ và giới từ
a threat for → a threat to; an essential part for → part of; invest for → invest in; require for → require
Học danh từ / động từ kèm giới từ đi sau.
in an early age → at an early age; the hardship they against → the hardship they face; affecting negatively to → negatively affecting
Không thêm giới từ không cần thiết; face hardship, at an early age.
tourisms → tourists; wastes → waste; investments → investment; childrens → children
waste, advice, information, equipment không thêm s; investment (vốn đầu tư nói chung) thường không đếm được (nhưng an investment / investments = khoản đầu tư cụ thể).
mass migrating → mass migration; heavily dependence → heavy dependence; participations → participants
Danh từ đi với tính từ; trạng từ đi với động từ.
kids, a lot of, things, huge, get rid of → children, many, factors, considerable, abolish
Tránh từ khẩu ngữ, mơ hồ, phóng đại.

items: The advantages of remote working outweigh its disadvantages.
Close colleagues build trust, closeness and cohesion.
The government should take relevant measures to reduce pollution.
Many factory workers earn only the minimum wage.
Children learn languages more easily at an early age.
Mass tourism is negatively affecting local residents' lives.
This approach requires less investment to operate efficiently.
Parents should guide their children to develop good manners.

items.bad: Close colleagues build truth, closeness and cohesion. LR
items.good: Close colleagues build trust, closeness and cohesion.
items.note: truth = sự thật; trust = sự tin tưởng.

items.bad: Living abroad may bring several experiences, such as independence. LR
items.good: Living abroad may bring several advantages, such as independence.
items.note: experiences = trải nghiệm; ý người viết là lợi ích (advantages / benefits).

items.bad: Parents should acknowledge their child to behave politely. LR
items.good: Parents should guide their children to behave politely.
items.note: acknowledge = thừa nhận; muốn nói hướng dẫn thì dùng guide / teach.

items.bad: Schools should teach children a great sense of behaving. LR
items.good: Schools should teach children good manners.
items.note: Dịch từng từ tạo ra cụm không tự nhiên; cụm đúng là good manners.

items.bad: Mass tourism is affecting negatively to local residents' life. LR
items.good: Mass tourism is negatively affecting local residents' lives.
items.note: affect là ngoại động từ (không có to); trạng từ thường đứng trước; lives số nhiều.

items.bad: This model requires less investments to work effectively. LR
items.good: This model requires less investment to operate efficiently.
items.note: investment (vốn đầu tư nói chung) không đếm được; với hệ thống / mô hình, dùng operate efficiently.

items.html: affect là động từ (Pollution affects health); effect thường là danh từ (a positive effect on).
economic = thuộc về kinh tế (economic growth); economical = tiết kiệm (an economical car).
trust = sự tin tưởng (build trust between colleagues); truth = sự thật (tell the truth).
relevant = liên quan, phù hợp (relevant measures); relative = tương đối, hoặc người thân (relatively cheap, my relatives).

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Từ dễ nhầm và kết hợp từ
intro: Khoanh vào từ hoặc cụm từ đúng.

items.cue: The advantages ( outweigh / overwhelm ) the disadvantages.
items.answer: outweigh
items.note: So sánh lợi – hại → outweigh.

items.cue: Close colleagues build ( truth / trust ) and cohesion.
items.answer: trust
items.note: trust = sự tin tưởng.

items.cue: The government should take ( relevant / relative ) measures.
items.answer: relevant
items.note: relevant = phù hợp, liên quan.

items.cue: Unemployment ( rises / raises ) the risk of poverty.
items.answer: raises
items.note: Có tân ngữ (the risk) → raise.

items.cue: Pollution can ( effect / affect ) children's health.
items.answer: affect
items.note: Động từ → affect.

items.cue: The policy had a positive ( effect / affect ) on employment.
items.answer: effect
items.note: Danh từ sau a positive → effect.

items.cue: The country's ( economic / economical ) growth has been rapid.
items.answer: economic
items.note: Thuộc về kinh tế → economic.

items.cue: Many workers earn only the ( minimal / minimum ) wage.
items.answer: minimum
items.note: Thuật ngữ cố định: the minimum wage.

items.cue: Cybercrime is a growing threat ( for / to ) businesses.
items.answer: to
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: a threat to sb/sth.

items.cue: Communication is an essential part ( of / for ) teamwork.
items.answer: of
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: part of sth.

items.cue: Data centres ( require for / require ) huge amounts of energy.
items.answer: require
items.note: require + tân ngữ trực tiếp.

items.cue: Governments should invest ( for / in ) renewable energy.
items.answer: in
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: invest in sth.

items.cue: Children learn languages more easily ( at / in ) an early age.
items.answer: at
items.note: Cụm cố định: at an early age.

items.cue: Many families struggle with the hardship they ( against / face ).
items.answer: face
items.note: face hardship; against là giới từ, không phải động từ.

items.cue: Parents should ( guide / acknowledge ) their children's behaviour.
items.answer: guide
items.note: guide = hướng dẫn; acknowledge = thừa nhận.

items.cue: Teachers should help children develop good ( manners / sense of behaving ).
items.answer: manners
items.note: Cụm cố định: good manners.

items.cue: Young children need close ( observation / supervision ) when they go online.
items.answer: supervision
items.note: Sự giám sát của cha mẹ → supervision.

items.cue: Students should know the difference between a formal and an informal ( tone / talking ).
items.answer: tone
items.note: Văn phong trang trọng / thân mật → tone.

items.cue: Many employees have a close relationship ( with / to ) their colleagues.
items.answer: with
items.note: Giới từ đi kèm: a relationship with sb.

items.cue: This approach requires less ( investments / investment ) to operate efficiently.
items.answer: investment
items.note: investment (nói chung) không đếm được.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Lợi ích của việc làm việc từ xa lớn hơn những bất lợi của nó.
items.translation: The benefits of working remotely are greater than its disadvantages.
items.answer: The advantages of remote working outweigh its disadvantages.
items.alt: The benefits of working from home outweigh the drawbacks.

items.cue: Sự tin tưởng giữa các đồng nghiệp giúp nhóm làm việc hiệu quả hơn.
items.translation: Trust between colleagues helps teams work better.
items.answer: Trust between colleagues helps teams work more effectively.
items.alt: When colleagues trust one another, teams work more effectively.

items.cue: Chính phủ nên áp dụng các biện pháp phù hợp để giảm ô nhiễm.
items.translation: The government should apply suitable measures to reduce pollution.
items.answer: The government should take relevant measures to reduce pollution.
items.alt: The government should introduce appropriate measures to cut pollution.

items.cue: Nhiều công nhân chỉ được trả mức lương tối thiểu.
items.translation: Many workers receive only the lowest legal wage.
items.answer: Many workers are paid only the minimum wage.
items.alt: Many workers earn no more than the minimum wage.

items.cue: Trẻ học ngoại ngữ dễ hơn khi còn nhỏ tuổi.
items.translation: Children learn foreign languages more easily when they are young.
items.answer: Children learn foreign languages more easily at an early age.
items.alt: Foreign languages are easier to learn at an early age.

items.cue: Cha mẹ nên hướng dẫn con cái cách cư xử lễ phép.
items.translation: Parents should teach their children how to behave politely.
items.answer: Parents should guide their children to develop good manners.
items.alt: Parents should teach their children good manners.

items.cue: Trẻ nhỏ cần được giám sát chặt chẽ khi sử dụng Internet.
items.translation: Young children need to be watched closely when they use the Internet.
items.answer: Young children need close supervision when using the Internet.
items.alt: Young children should be closely supervised online.

items.cue: Du lịch đại trà đang ảnh hưởng tiêu cực đến cuộc sống của người dân địa phương.
items.translation: Mass tourism is having a negative impact on local people's lives.
items.answer: Mass tourism is negatively affecting local residents' lives.
items.alt: Mass tourism is having a negative effect on local residents' lives.

items.cue: Nhiều gia đình nghèo phải đối mặt với khó khăn về tài chính.
items.translation: Many poor families have financial difficulties.
items.answer: Many poor families face financial hardship.
items.alt: Many low-income families experience financial hardship.

items.cue: Nhiều nhân viên có mối quan hệ gắn bó với đồng nghiệp.
items.translation: Many employees are very attached to their colleagues.
items.answer: Many employees have a close relationship with their colleagues.
items.alt: Many employees are close to their colleagues.

items.cue: Mô hình này đòi hỏi ít vốn đầu tư hơn để vận hành hiệu quả.
items.translation: This model needs less capital to run effectively.
items.answer: This model requires less investment to operate efficiently.
items.alt: This model can operate efficiently with less investment.

items.cue: Hậu quả của biến đổi khí hậu rất nghiêm trọng.
items.translation: The effects of climate change are very serious.
items.answer: The consequences of climate change are very serious.
items.alt: Climate change has very serious consequences.

items.cue: Học sinh cần hiểu sự khác biệt giữa giọng văn trang trọng và thân mật.
items.translation: Students need to understand the difference between formal and informal language.
items.answer: Students need to understand the difference between a formal and an informal tone.
items.alt: Students need to know how a formal tone differs from an informal one.

items.cue: Một số thanh thiếu niên cư xử thiếu tôn trọng với giáo viên.
items.translation: Some teenagers do not respect their teachers.
items.answer: Some teenagers are disrespectful towards their teachers.
items.alt: Some teenagers show a lack of respect for their teachers.

items.cue: Thiếu sự giáo dục đạo đức từ gia đình có thể khiến trẻ dễ vi phạm pháp luật.
items.rewriteWith: a lack of moral guidance at home
items.translation: A lack of moral education in the family can make children more likely to break the law.
items.answer: A lack of moral guidance at home may make children more likely to break the law.
items.alt: Inadequate parenting may make children more likely to break the law.

items.cue: Người lao động nên dành ưu tiên cho các mối quan hệ ngoài nơi làm việc.
items.translation: Workers should give priority to relationships outside work.
items.answer: Workers should prioritise relationships outside the workplace.
items.alt: Employees should make time for relationships beyond work.

items.cue: Mực nước biển dâng có thể làm xói mòn bờ biển.
items.translation: Rising sea levels may wear away the coast.
items.answer: Rising sea levels may erode the coastline.
items.alt: The coastline may be eroded by rising sea levels.

items.cue: Sinh viên thường phải xử lý nhiều giấy tờ khi nhập học.
items.translation: Students often have to handle a lot of documents when they enrol.
items.answer: Students often have to deal with a lot of paperwork when they enrol.
items.alt: Enrolling at university usually involves a great deal of paperwork.

items.cue: Việc làm việc từ xa mang lại một số lợi ích, chẳng hạn như tiết kiệm thời gian đi lại.
items.translation: Working remotely has some benefits, such as saving travel time.
items.answer: Remote working brings several advantages, such as saving commuting time.
items.alt: Working from home has several benefits, including shorter commuting times.

items.cue: Lợi nhuận của các nhà bán lẻ nhỏ đang bị thu hẹp do cạnh tranh trực tuyến.
items.translation: Small retailers' profits are being reduced because of online competition.
items.answer: Small retailers' profit margins are shrinking because of online competition.
items.alt: Online competition is squeezing small retailers' profit margins.

exercises.title: Bài tập 3 — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Employees should understand their dutis, and small shops should watch their profit marfins.
items.answer: Employees should understand their dutis DUTIES, and small shops should watch their profit marfins MARGINS.
notes: LR Chính tả: duty → duties.
LR Chính tả.

items.cue: There are several backdraws to handling correspondances by email.
items.answer: There are several backdraws DRAWBACKS to handling correspondances CORRESPONDENCE by email.
notes: LR Chính tả / sai thứ tự chữ.
LR Chính tả; correspondence (thư từ) thường không đếm được.

items.cue: Some students are disrespectul towards teachers who do a lot of paper work.
items.answer: Some students are disrespectul DISRESPECTFUL towards teachers who do a lot of paper work PAPERWORK.
notes: LR Chính tả: thiếu f.
LR Từ ghép viết liền.

items.cue: The advantages of remote working outweigh its disadvantages.
items.answer: ✓ The advantages of remote working outweigh its disadvantages.
notes: Đúng: outweigh dùng chính xác.

items.cue: Rising sea levels may erose the coastline, whild governments do nothing.
items.answer: Rising sea levels may erose ERODE the coastline, whild WHILE governments do nothing.
notes: LR Chính tả.
LR Chính tả.

items.cue: Profit margins in small shops are shrinking.
items.answer: ✓ Profit margins in small shops are shrinking.
notes: Đúng: profit margins viết và dùng chính xác.

items.cue: Close colleagues build truth, closeness and cohesion.
items.answer: Close colleagues build truth TRUST, closeness and cohesion.
notes: LR truth = sự thật; cần trust = sự tin tưởng.

items.cue: Living abroad may bring several experiences, such as independence and language skills.
items.answer: Living abroad may bring several experiences ADVANTAGES, such as independence and language skills.
notes: LR Ý người viết là lợi ích.

items.cue: Parents should acknowledge their child to behave politely.
items.answer: Parents should acknowledge their child GUIDE THEIR CHILDREN to behave politely.
notes: LR acknowledge = thừa nhận; cần guide.

items.cue: Many families face financial hardship when prices rise.
items.answer: ✓ Many families face financial hardship when prices rise.
notes: Đúng: face hardship.

items.cue: Many factory workers earn only the minimal wage.
items.answer: Many factory workers earn only the minimal wage MINIMUM WAGE.
notes: LR Thuật ngữ cố định: the minimum wage.

items.cue: Students must learn the difference between formal and casual talking.
items.answer: Students must learn the difference between formal and casual talking A FORMAL AND AN INFORMAL TONE.
notes: LR Cụm tự nhiên: a formal and an informal tone.

items.cue: Schools should teach children a great sense of behaving.
items.answer: Schools should teach children a great sense of behaving GOOD MANNERS.
notes: LR Dịch từng từ; cụm đúng là good manners.

items.cue: Many employees are close-knit with their colleagues, so they prioritise relationships over the workplace.
items.answer: Many employees are close-knit with ARE CLOSE TO their colleagues, so they prioritise relationships over the workplace RELATIONSHIPS OUTSIDE THE WORKPLACE.
notes: LR close-knit dùng cho tập thể (a close-knit team / community), không đi với with; dùng be close to / have a close relationship with.
LR Ý người viết là các mối quan hệ ngoài nơi làm việc.

items.cue: Young children need close supervision when they use the Internet.
items.answer: ✓ Young children need close supervision when they use the Internet.
notes: Đúng: supervision = sự giám sát.

items.cue: Mass tourism is affecting negatively to local residents' life, and the hardship they against is growing.
items.answer: Mass tourism is affecting negatively to local residents' life NEGATIVELY AFFECTING LOCAL RESIDENTS' LIVES, and the hardship they against THE HARDSHIP THEY FACE is growing.
notes: LR affect không có to; lives số nhiều.
LR Thiếu động từ: face hardship.

items.cue: This approach requires less investment to operate efficiently.
items.answer: ✓ This approach requires less investment to operate efficiently.
notes: Đúng: investment không đếm được.

items.cue: This model requires less investments to work effectively, but their consequence is unclear.
items.answer: This model requires less investments to work effectively LESS INVESTMENT TO OPERATE EFFICIENTLY, but their consequence is THE CONSEQUENCES ARE unclear.
notes: LR investment không đếm được; operate efficiently với mô hình / hệ thống.
LR Nói về hệ quả nói chung → the consequences (số nhiều).

items.cue: Children start using phones in an early age, so obsevation by parents is essential.
items.answer: Children start using phones in an early age AT AN EARLY AGE, so obsevation SUPERVISION by parents is essential.
notes: LR Cụm cố định: at an early age.
LR Sai chính tả và sai từ: sự kiểm soát của cha mẹ là supervision.

items.cue: Lack of education from parents can lead teenagers to commit crimes.
items.answer: Lack of education from parents A LACK OF MORAL GUIDANCE AT HOME can lead teenagers to commit crimes.
notes: LR Ý người viết là giáo dục đạo đức trong gia đình, không phải education (học vấn).

exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng đúng từ / cụm từ được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) dùng ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bài này.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Multicultural societies, in which people from different ethnic groups live together, bring more benefits than drawbacks. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: In my view, the benefits of multicultural societies clearly outweigh the drawbacks.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that public money should be spent on promoting healthy lifestyles rather than on treating people who are ill. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Governments should invest in preventing illness rather than only treating it.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Traditional foods are increasingly being replaced by international fast food, and this has a negative effect on families and societies. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: The decline of traditional meals can negatively affect family relationships.

items.cue: Food and health · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Research shows that overeating can be as harmful to health as smoking. Therefore, advertisements for certain foods should be banned in the same way as cigarette advertising. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Overeating poses a threat to public health comparable to that of smoking.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: It is more important to plant trees in towns and cities than to build more housing. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Planting trees instead of building homes has drawbacks, as housing shortages may worsen.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: It is important for every town and city to have large public spaces such as squares and parks. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: City planners should consider the needs of all relevant groups, including children and older people, when designing public spaces.

items.cue: City development · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: When new towns are built, it is more important to provide public parks and sports facilities than shopping centres. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Planners should consider the consequences of building shopping centres instead of parks.

items.cue: Language · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: To learn a language well, people should also learn about the country, culture and lifestyle of those who speak it. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Learners who encounter a culture at an early age often find its language easier to master.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: An increasing amount of advertising is aimed at children and encourages them to buy products such as toys and snacks. Many parents are concerned, while advertisers argue that such advertising provides useful information. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Parents should guide their children to understand how adverts try to persuade them.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that radio is the best way to get news, while others think television is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Many listeners trust radio news because it tends to be less sensational than television.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that celebrities can draw attention to important problems by supporting international aid organisations, while others think that celebrity involvement makes these problems seem less serious. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Celebrities can draw attention to communities that face severe hardship.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that charities should help people in their own country, while others think they should help people in need wherever they live. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Charities working in poorer countries can encourage investment in local businesses, which creates lasting jobs.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that individuals in modern society are becoming more dependent on one another, while others think they are becoming more independent. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: In rural areas, many people still have a close relationship with their neighbours.

items.cue: Education · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Many children find it difficult to concentrate or pay attention at school. Why does this happen, and what can be done to improve children's concentration?
items.answer: Without parental supervision, children may stay up late on screens and struggle to concentrate.

items.cue: Education · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: In many countries, not enough university students choose to study science subjects. What are the causes of this problem, and what effects does it have on society?
items.hint: Hai câu, dùng chính xác ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bảng lỗi của bài này.
items.answer: Science courses are often seen as demanding, and their heavy workloads are a major drawback for many students. The consequences of this shortage of science graduates could include slower technological progress.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In some countries, many adults continue to live with their parents after graduating from university or finding a job. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, dùng chính xác ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bảng lỗi của bài này.
items.answer: Living with parents allows young adults to save money, which is a clear advantage. However, it may delay their independence, including learning to handle paperwork such as bills and contracts.

items.cue: Education · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Rote learning is still used in many education systems. Do the advantages of rote learning outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu, dùng chính xác ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bảng lỗi của bài này.
items.answer: Rote learning can help students memorise key facts at an early age. Its main drawback, however, is that it may not develop critical thinking.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: More and more people are becoming interested in finding out about their family history. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, dùng chính xác ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bảng lỗi của bài này.
items.answer: Interest in family history has grown as old records and correspondence have become available online. This is a positive trend, as it strengthens people's sense of identity.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Children today have more freedom than children had in the past. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu, dùng chính xác ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bảng lỗi của bài này.
items.answer: Children's greater freedom can help them become independent. Without adequate supervision, however, it may expose them to online risks.

items.cue: Economy, money and trade · Two-part question
items.prompt: Some people believe that economic progress is the only way to measure a country's success, while others think other factors should also be considered. What other factors should be used to measure success, and which do you think is the most important?
items.hint: Hai câu, dùng chính xác ít nhất hai từ / cụm từ trong bảng lỗi của bài này.
items.answer: Economic growth is important, but it says little about whether citizens trust their institutions or enjoy good health. In my view, well-being is the most relevant additional measure.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Chọn đúng từ loại
intro: Khoanh vào từ loại đúng.

items.cue: Mass ( migrating / migration ) to cities puts pressure on housing.
items.answer: migration
items.note: Chủ ngữ cần danh từ.

items.cue: Many countries have a ( heavy / heavily ) dependence on oil.
items.answer: heavy
items.note: Trước danh từ cần tính từ.

items.cue: Radio has lost listeners because of its ( declining / less ) popularity.
items.answer: declining
items.note: less không bổ nghĩa cho danh từ theo cách này; dùng tính từ declining.

items.cue: Children need a ( balanced / balance ) use of technology.
items.answer: balanced
items.note: Trước danh từ cần tính từ.

items.cue: The proportion of ( participants / participations ) was low.
items.answer: participants
items.note: Người tham gia → participants.

items.cue: The ( urbanisation / urbanities ) rate has risen sharply.
items.answer: urbanisation
items.note: Quá trình đô thị hóa → urbanisation.

items.cue: AI can work with greater ( accuracy / accurate ) than humans.
items.answer: accuracy
items.note: Sau greater cần danh từ.

items.cue: Some students are ( disrespect / disrespectful ) to teachers.
items.answer: disrespectful
items.note: Sau are cần tính từ.

items.cue: Rising sea levels may ( erode / erosion ) the coastline.
items.answer: erode
items.note: Sau may cần động từ.

items.cue: Many young people are ( financially / financial ) dependent on their parents.
items.answer: financially
items.note: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ dependent → trạng từ.

items.cue: Technology has made life more ( convenience / convenient ).
items.answer: convenient
items.note: Sau more cần tính từ.

items.cue: The ( reliable / reliability ) of online information is a concern.
items.answer: reliability
items.note: Chủ ngữ cần danh từ.

items.cue: Parents play a ( significant / significance ) role in education.
items.answer: significant
items.note: Trước danh từ role cần tính từ.

items.cue: ( Polluted / Pollution ) levels in cities are rising.
items.answer: Pollution
items.note: Danh từ ghép: pollution levels.

items.cue: Many people are ( unemployment / unemployed ) in rural areas.
items.answer: unemployed
items.note: Sau are cần tính từ.

items.cue: The ( consequence / consequences ) of climate change are serious.
items.answer: consequences
items.note: Động từ are → danh từ số nhiều.

items.cue: Exercise has a ( benefit / beneficial ) effect on mental health.
items.answer: beneficial
items.note: Trước danh từ effect cần tính từ.

items.cue: There is a ( tendency / tend ) for young people to rent rather than buy.
items.answer: tendency
items.note: Sau a cần danh từ.

items.cue: Governments must act ( responsible / responsibly ).
items.answer: responsibly
items.note: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ act → trạng từ.

items.cue: The ( economic / economy ) of Vietnam has grown rapidly.
items.answer: economy
items.note: Chủ ngữ cần danh từ.

exercises.title: Bài tập 6 — Chọn văn phong học thuật
intro: Khoanh vào phương án phù hợp với văn phong học thuật.

items.cue: ( Children / Kids ) need clear rules at home and at school.
items.answer: Children
items.note: kids mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: The government should ( get rid of / abolish ) the tax.
items.answer: abolish
items.note: Cụm động từ get rid of mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: This policy is ( a really good idea / highly beneficial ).
items.answer: highly beneficial
items.note: a really good idea mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: ( Loads of / A large number of ) people use public transport.
items.answer: A large number of
items.note: Loads of mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Social media has ( a huge / a considerable ) influence on teenagers.
items.answer: a considerable
items.note: huge mang tính phóng đại.

items.cue: Many young people ( can't / cannot ) afford a home.
items.answer: cannot
items.note: Không viết tắt trong văn viết học thuật.

items.cue: Pollution is a ( terrible / serious ) problem in many cities.
items.answer: serious
items.note: terrible mang tính cảm tính.

items.cue: Online learning has ( several / lots of ) advantages.
items.answer: several
items.note: lots of mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: The number of tourists ( increased / went up ) sharply.
items.answer: increased
items.note: Cụm động từ went up ít trang trọng hơn.

items.cue: There are many ( things / factors ) that affect health.
items.answer: factors
items.note: things quá chung chung.

items.cue: This level of pollution is not ( acceptable / OK ).
items.answer: acceptable
items.note: OK là khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Governments should ( investigate / check out ) the causes of crime.
items.answer: investigate
items.note: check out mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: ( Essentially, / Basically, ) the problem is a lack of funding.
items.answer: Essentially,
items.note: Basically mang tính khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Fast food is ( super / highly ) popular among teenagers.
items.answer: highly
items.note: super là khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Many students ( waste time / mess around ) on their phones.
items.answer: waste time
items.note: mess around là khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: The new policy will ( help / help out ) many families.
items.answer: help
items.note: help out là khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: ( To sum up, / So yeah, ) education is vital.
items.answer: To sum up,
items.note: So yeah là khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Parents should ( keep an eye on / monitor ) their children's screen time.
items.answer: monitor
items.note: Thành ngữ keep an eye on ít trang trọng.

items.cue: This is ( a big deal / a significant issue ) for local communities.
items.answer: a significant issue
items.note: a big deal là khẩu ngữ.

items.cue: Many workers ( experience stress / feel stressed out ) at work.
items.answer: experience stress
items.note: stressed out là khẩu ngữ.

theory.html: Để đạt Band 7 về GRA, bạn cần nhiều câu không có lỗi và dùng đa dạng cấu trúc phức. Ở Band 6, lỗi ngữ pháp xuất hiện thường xuyên dù hiếm khi gây khó hiểu; ở Band 5, lỗi có thể làm người đọc khó theo dõi. Phần lớn lỗi của học viên Việt Nam tập trung vào một số nhóm quen thuộc: hòa hợp chủ – vị, mẫu động từ, câu thiếu thành phần và nối câu bằng dấu phẩy.
Bài này tổng hợp mười hai nhóm lỗi từ bài viết thật của học viên. Nhiều cấu trúc đã được học chi tiết ở Phần B và C; bài này giúp bạn tự phát hiện và sửa lỗi khi đọc lại bài viết của mình.

Thói quen tự kiểm tra: với mỗi câu, xác định chủ ngữ chính và động từ chính (chúng có hòa hợp không?), đếm số mệnh đề (có đủ từ nối không?), và kiểm tra động từ sau make, risk, lead to, despite, which.

theory.text: Mười hai nhóm lỗi ngữ pháp

cells: When AI replace → replaces; Addressing this problem demand → demands; the proportion of … were → was
Chủ ngữ V-ing, mệnh đề danh từ, the proportion / influence of → số ít.
…, which make it depends → which makes it depend
which thay cho cả mệnh đề → số ít; make + O + V nguyên mẫu.
risks widen → risks widening; leaded to make → led to; result a gap → resulted in
making India became the only nation use it → making India the only nation to use it
make + O + N / adj; the only … to V.
manual workers those roles → manual workers whose roles
Sở hữu → whose; không thừa đại từ.
Danh từ số nhiều có -s → chỉ thêm dấu nháy.
not only consumes … but also increasing → increases; gain … or having → or have
Các vế nối bằng and / or / not only … but also phải cùng dạng.
While one school of thought holds that … (hết câu)
Mệnh đề While / Although / Because cần mệnh đề chính.
…, it decrease their ability → …, which decreases …
Hai mệnh đề độc lập: dấu chấm, chấm phẩy, từ nối hoặc which.
Mạo từ và trợ động từ
a amount → an amount; and unable to save → and are unable to save
an trước nguyên âm; vế thứ hai cần đủ động từ.
…, avoiding staff from harm → thereby protecting staff; Despite hydro power had → Although hydro power was
Cụm V-ing phải có chủ thể hợp lý; despite + N / V-ing.
the the need; these plights like these → plights like these
Đọc lại từng câu, chú ý từ lặp.

items: When AI replaces human workers, companies can cut costs.
Addressing this problem demands international cooperation.
This trend risks widening the income gap.
The policy made India the only nation to use the technology.
We must protect workers' rights.
Hosting the Olympics not only consumes resources but also increases tourism.
Many people depend on technical support, which decreases their ability to solve problems.
Plights like these affect millions of families.

items.bad: When AI replace human workers, companies save money. GRA
items.good: When AI replaces human workers, companies save money.
items.note: AI là chủ ngữ số ít → replaces.

items.bad: AI also make more profit for companies. GRA
items.good: AI also makes more profit for companies.
items.note: AI số ít → makes.

items.bad: This rule restricts borrowing, which make it depends on family support. GRA
items.good: This rule restricts borrowing, which makes it depend on family support.
items.note: which (cả mệnh đề) → makes; make + O + V nguyên mẫu (depend).

items.bad: Students can gain work experience or having fun abroad. GRA
items.good: Students can gain work experience or have fun abroad.
items.note: Cấu trúc song song: can gain … or have.

items.bad: Urbanisation rise the the need of transport. GRA
items.good: Urbanisation raises the need for transport.
items.note: raise (có tân ngữ) + hòa hợp; lặp the the; need for.

items.bad: These plights like these affect millions of families. GRA
items.good: Plights like these affect millions of families.
items.note: Lặp ý these … these; chỉ giữ một.

items.html: Trong The influence of peers on teenagers is strong, chủ ngữ chính là influence (số ít). Bỏ qua các cụm of …, on …, which … khi kiểm tra hòa hợp.
make / let + O + V nguyên mẫu (makes it depend); make + O + danh từ / tính từ (made India the only nation); help + O + (to) V.
Mỗi câu cần ít nhất một mệnh đề chính có chủ ngữ và động từ chia. Because …, Although …, While …, Such as …, For example, students who … đứng một mình là câu thiếu thành phần.
Hai mệnh đề độc lập không thể nối chỉ bằng dấu phẩy. Dùng dấu chấm, dấu chấm phẩy, từ nối (and, but, so), dấu hai chấm (khi vế sau giải thích vế trước) hoặc mệnh đề which.

exercises.title: Bài tập 1 — Hòa hợp, mẫu động từ và mạo từ
intro: Khoanh vào phương án đúng ngữ pháp.

items.cue: When AI ( replaces / replace ) human workers, costs fall.
items.answer: replaces
items.note: AI số ít → replaces.

items.cue: AI ( makes / make ) more profit for companies.
items.answer: makes
items.note: AI số ít → makes.

items.cue: This rule restricts borrowing, which ( make / makes ) it harder for young people to buy homes.
items.answer: makes
items.note: which thay cho cả mệnh đề → số ít.

items.cue: The proportion of participants ( were / was ) low.
items.answer: was
items.note: Danh từ chính proportion số ít.

items.cue: Addressing this problem ( demands / demand ) investment.
items.answer: demands
items.note: Chủ ngữ V-ing → số ít.

items.cue: This trend risks ( widen / widening ) the gap.
items.answer: widening
items.note: Sau risk dùng V-ing.

items.cue: The policy made India ( the only nation / became the only nation ) to use the technology.
items.answer: the only nation
items.note: make + O + danh từ; không thêm động từ chia.

items.cue: The shortage ( led to / leaded to ) higher wages.
items.answer: led to
items.note: Quá khứ của lead là led.

items.cue: This dependence ( resulted in / resulted ) a large gap.
items.answer: resulted in
items.note: result in + danh từ.

items.cue: Urbanisation ( raises / rises ) the need for transport.
items.answer: raises
items.note: Có tân ngữ → raise.

items.cue: Some parents ( do not seem to teach / do not seem teach ) their children about money.
items.answer: do not seem to teach
items.note: Cấu trúc đúng: seem + to V.

items.cue: Workers ( must / must to ) follow safety rules.
items.answer: must
items.note: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu không dùng to.

items.cue: They have to make ends meet and ( unable / are unable ) to save money.
items.answer: are unable
items.note: Vế thứ hai cần động từ are.

items.cue: Many families do not have ( a / an ) emergency fund.
items.answer: an
items.note: an trước âm nguyên âm (emergency).

items.cue: We must protect ( workers's / workers' ) rights.
items.answer: workers'
items.note: Sở hữu cách của danh từ số nhiều.

items.cue: Students can gain experience or ( having / have ) fun.
items.answer: have
items.note: Song song với gain.

items.cue: ( Despite / Although ) hydro power was the main source, coal remained important.
items.answer: Although
items.note: Theo sau là mệnh đề → Although.

items.cue: Robots can be used for welding, ( avoiding / thereby protecting ) staff from harm.
items.answer: thereby protecting
items.note: avoid sb from không tồn tại; dùng thereby protecting.

items.cue: Many people depend on technical support, ( which decreases / it decrease ) their ability to solve problems.
items.answer: which decreases
items.note: Tránh nối câu bằng dấu phẩy; which + V số ít.

items.cue: ( These plights like these / Plights like these ) affect millions of families.
items.answer: Plights like these
items.note: Tránh lặp these.

exercises.title: Bài tập 2 — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Khi trí tuệ nhân tạo thay thế con người, chi phí giảm.
items.translation: When artificial intelligence replaces humans, costs go down.
items.answer: When AI replaces human workers, costs fall.
items.alt: Costs fall when AI replaces human workers.

items.cue: Trí tuệ nhân tạo giúp các công ty tạo ra nhiều lợi nhuận hơn.
items.translation: Artificial intelligence helps companies earn more profit.
items.answer: AI helps companies make more profit.
items.alt: AI enables companies to make greater profits.

items.cue: Tỷ lệ người tham gia ủng hộ kế hoạch là thấp.
items.translation: Only a small percentage of participants supported the plan.
items.answer: The proportion of participants who supported the plan was low.
items.alt: Only a small proportion of participants supported the plan.

items.cue: Việc giải quyết vấn đề này đòi hỏi nhiều đầu tư.
items.translation: Solving this problem requires a lot of investment.
items.answer: Addressing this problem demands a great deal of investment.
items.alt: Tackling this problem requires considerable investment.

items.cue: Xu hướng này có nguy cơ làm gia tăng khoảng cách thu nhập.
items.translation: This trend may increase the income gap.
items.answer: This trend risks widening the income gap.
items.alt: This trend could widen the income gap.

items.cue: Chính sách này đã khiến Ấn Độ trở thành quốc gia duy nhất sử dụng công nghệ đó.
items.translation: Because of this policy, India became the only country that used the technology.
items.answer: This policy made India the only nation to use the technology.
items.alt: As a result of this policy, India became the only nation to use the technology.

items.cue: Chúng ta phải bảo vệ quyền lợi của người lao động.
items.translation: We must protect the rights of workers.
items.answer: We must protect workers' rights.
items.alt: The rights of workers must be protected.

items.cue: Sự phụ thuộc này đã dẫn đến khoảng cách lớn giữa hai nền kinh tế.
items.translation: This dependence created a large gap between the two economies.
items.answer: This dependence led to a large gap between the two economies.
items.alt: This dependence resulted in a wide gap between the two economies.

items.cue: Đô thị hóa làm tăng nhu cầu về giao thông.
items.translation: Urbanisation increases the need for transport.
items.answer: Urbanisation raises the need for transport.
items.alt: Urbanisation increases the demand for transport.

items.cue: Một số phụ huynh dường như không dạy con về tiền bạc.
items.translation: Some parents seem not to teach their children about money.
items.answer: Some parents do not seem to teach their children about money.
items.alt: Some parents appear not to teach their children about money.

items.cue: Họ phải xoay xở để đủ sống và không thể tiết kiệm tiền.
items.translation: They struggle to make ends meet and cannot save money.
items.answer: They have to make ends meet and are unable to save any money.
items.alt: They struggle to make ends meet and cannot save any money.

items.cue: Sinh viên có thể tích lũy kinh nghiệm hoặc vui chơi.
items.translation: Students can get experience or enjoy themselves.
items.answer: Students can gain experience or have fun.
items.alt: Students can either gain experience or enjoy themselves.

items.cue: Mặc dù thủy điện là nguồn chính, than vẫn quan trọng.
items.translation: Hydro power was the main source, but coal was still important.
items.answer: Although hydro power was the main source, coal remained important.
items.alt: Despite hydro power being the main source, coal remained important.

items.cue: Robot được dùng để hàn, nhờ đó bảo vệ công nhân khỏi tổn thương.
items.translation: Robots are used for welding, and this protects workers from injury.
items.answer: Robots are used for welding, thereby protecting workers from harm.
items.alt: Robots are used for welding, which protects workers from injury.

items.cue: Nhiều người phụ thuộc quá nhiều vào hỗ trợ kỹ thuật, điều này làm giảm khả năng tự giải quyết vấn đề của họ.
items.translation: Many people rely too much on technical support, and this reduces their ability to solve problems by themselves.
items.answer: Many people depend too much on technical support, which decreases their ability to solve problems.
items.alt: Excessive reliance on technical support reduces many people's ability to solve problems.

items.cue: Singapore là ví dụ điển hình: quốc gia này đầu tư mạnh vào giao thông công cộng.
items.rewriteWith: dấu hai chấm thay cho dấu phẩy
items.translation: Singapore is a typical example, and it invests heavily in public transport.
items.answer: Singapore perfectly exemplifies this: it invests heavily in public transport.
items.alt: Singapore is a clear example, as it invests heavily in public transport.

items.cue: Chính sách này khiến việc vay tiền khó hơn, điều đó khiến nhiều người phụ thuộc vào gia đình.
items.translation: This policy makes borrowing harder, and as a result many people depend on their families.
items.answer: This policy makes borrowing harder, which makes many people depend on their families.
items.alt: By making borrowing harder, this policy leaves many people dependent on their families.

items.cue: Những hoàn cảnh khó khăn như thế này ảnh hưởng đến hàng triệu gia đình.
items.translation: Difficult situations like these affect millions of families.
items.answer: Plights like these affect millions of families.
items.alt: Such hardships affect millions of families.

items.cue: Những công nhân lao động chân tay có công việc dễ bị tự động hóa cần được đào tạo lại.
items.translation: Manual workers those jobs are easily automated need to be retrained.
items.answer: Manual workers whose jobs are vulnerable to automation need to be retrained.
items.alt: Manual workers whose roles can easily be automated need retraining.

items.cue: Sống ở thành phố lớn, nhiều người trẻ phải trả tiền thuê nhà cao.
items.translation: Many young people who live in big cities have to pay high rents.
items.answer: Living in big cities, many young people have to pay high rents.
items.alt: Many young people living in big cities have to pay high rents.

intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: When AI replace human workers, companies save money.
items.answer: When AI replace REPLACES human workers, companies save money.

items.answer: AI also make MAKES more profit for companies.
notes: GRA AI số ít → makes.
