exercises.title: Bài tập 4 — Áp dụng vào đề thi thật
intro: Với mỗi đề, viết một câu (●, ●●) dùng đúng điểm ngữ pháp được gợi ý, hoặc hai câu (●●●) không có lỗi ngữ pháp và dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: People are living longer than in the past, so older people should continue working for longer. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: V-ing làm chủ ngữ + V số ít
items.answer: Working for longer helps older people stay mentally active.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Advertising discourages people from being different by encouraging everyone to buy similar products. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Advertising encourages many consumers to buy the same products as their friends.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Mobile phones should be banned in public places such as libraries, public transport and shops. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Loud phone conversations make public transport unpleasant for other passengers.

items.cue: Media and communication · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The news media often report violent crimes, which can frighten the public and may encourage criminals. Some people believe that crime news should not be shown on television. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: which + V số ít (thay cho cả mệnh đề)
items.answer: Crime news is often sensational, which makes some people afraid to go out at night.

items.cue: Traffic · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that the best way to improve road safety is to increase the minimum legal age for driving cars and riding motorcycles. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Raising the driving age risks making it harder for young people in rural areas to get to work.

items.cue: Traffic · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way for governments to reduce traffic congestion in cities is to provide free public transport 24 hours a day, seven days a week. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Free public transport could lead to a significant fall in car use.

items.cue: Travelling and tourism · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that tourists should take social and environmental responsibility for the places they visit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Tourists' behaviour can either protect or damage the places they visit.

items.cue: Crime, punishment and law · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Some people believe that allowing police officers to carry guns can lead to higher levels of violence. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: Although armed police may deter some criminals, guns can escalate dangerous situations.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that schools should group students according to their academic ability, while others think students of different abilities should study together. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Mixed-ability classes not only help weaker students but also teach stronger students to explain their ideas.

items.cue: Environment · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that industrial growth is necessary to reduce poverty, while others argue that it causes serious environmental problems. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Uncontrolled industrial growth can result in serious air and water pollution.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Good schools and medical facilities are often concentrated in cities. Some people believe newly qualified teachers and doctors should be required to work in rural areas for a few years, while others think they should be free to choose where they work. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: Young doctors whose families live in cities may be reluctant to move to rural areas.

items.cue: Work · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that no one should stay in the same job for their whole working life, while others think that remaining in one job can benefit individuals, companies and society. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: and are unable to (đủ trợ động từ)
items.answer: Some workers stay in one job for decades and are unable to adapt when their industry changes.

items.cue: Traffic · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that governments should build more rail and underground lines to reduce traffic congestion, while others think they should build more and wider roads. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.answer: The proportion of commuters who use trains is still low in many cities.

items.cue: Environment · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Environmental problems are becoming more serious, but international efforts to solve them have had limited success. Why have these efforts achieved so little, and what can be done to improve the situation?
items.hint: câu đầy đủ (không thiếu thành phần)
items.answer: International efforts have had limited success because many countries put short-term economic growth first.

items.cue: Environment · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Natural resources such as oil, forests and fresh water are being consumed at an alarming rate. What problems does this cause, and what measures can be taken to solve them?
items.hint: Hai câu không có lỗi ngữ pháp, dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức (mệnh đề quan hệ, mệnh đề danh từ, câu điều kiện …).
items.answer: The rapid consumption of natural resources threatens future generations. Reducing waste, which requires changes in both industry and households, is therefore essential.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Young people are often influenced by pressure from people of the same age. Do the disadvantages of peer pressure outweigh the advantages?
items.hint: Hai câu không có lỗi ngữ pháp, dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức (mệnh đề quan hệ, mệnh đề danh từ, câu điều kiện …).
items.answer: Peer pressure can encourage teenagers to study harder or take up sport. However, it can also push them towards risky behaviour, such as smoking.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: In many countries, women are entitled to take maternity leave after giving birth. Do the advantages of maternity leave outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu không có lỗi ngữ pháp, dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức (mệnh đề quan hệ, mệnh đề danh từ, câu điều kiện …).
items.answer: Maternity leave allows mothers to recover and bond with their babies. Employers, whose costs may rise temporarily, can usually adapt by hiring temporary staff.

items.cue: Education · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: More and more people are competing for places at universities. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu không có lỗi ngữ pháp, dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức (mệnh đề quan hệ, mệnh đề danh từ, câu điều kiện …).
items.answer: Competition for university places is increasing because employers demand degrees for more jobs. Although this motivates students, it also places them under considerable pressure.

items.cue: Education · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Sending children to boarding schools, either in their own country or abroad, is becoming increasingly popular. Why is this happening, and is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu không có lỗi ngữ pháp, dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức (mệnh đề quan hệ, mệnh đề danh từ, câu điều kiện …).
items.answer: Boarding schools have become popular because many parents work long hours. Whether this benefits children depends on how well the schools support their emotional needs.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Two-part question
items.prompt: In schools and universities, girls often choose arts subjects while boys are more likely to choose science subjects. Why does this happen, and should this trend be changed?
items.hint: Hai câu không có lỗi ngữ pháp, dùng ít nhất một cấu trúc phức (mệnh đề quan hệ, mệnh đề danh từ, câu điều kiện …).
items.answer: Girls often choose arts subjects partly because they are encouraged to do so from an early age. If schools offered more female role models in science, this pattern could change.

exercises.title: Bài tập 5 — Sửa câu thiếu thành phần
intro: Một số câu dưới đây đã hoàn chỉnh; một số chỉ là cụm từ hoặc mệnh đề phụ (fragment). Dựa vào gợi ý, viết lại thành câu hoàn chỉnh. Nếu câu đã hoàn chỉnh, chép lại.

items.cue: While one school of thought holds that saving money brings benefits, especially for the younger generation.
items.hint: thêm mệnh đề chính sau dấu phẩy: I believe …
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that saving money brings benefits, especially for the younger generation, I believe this is not always realistic for everyone.
items.alt: While one school of thought holds that saving money is beneficial, especially for young people, I believe it is not always possible on a low income.

items.cue: Because many young people cannot afford rent.
items.hint: gắn vào mệnh đề chính: Many young people live with their parents …
items.answer: Many young people live with their parents because they cannot afford rent.
items.alt: Because they cannot afford rent, many young people live with their parents.

items.cue: For example, students who study abroad.
items.hint: thêm động từ chính: … must manage their own budgets.
items.answer: For example, students who study abroad must manage their own budgets.
items.alt: For example, students studying abroad have to manage their own budgets.

items.cue: Which means that many shops have closed.
items.hint: gắn vào câu trước: Online shopping has grown rapidly, …
items.answer: Online shopping has grown rapidly, which means that many shops have closed.
items.alt: Online shopping has grown rapidly. As a result, many shops have closed.

items.cue: Many young people live with their parents.
items.hint: Kiểm tra: câu đã hoàn chỉnh chưa? Nếu rồi, chép lại.
items.answer: Many young people live with their parents.

items.cue: Especially in large cities where rents are high.
items.hint: gắn vào câu: Housing is unaffordable for many young people, …
items.answer: Housing is unaffordable for many young people, especially in large cities where rents are high.
items.alt: Many young people cannot afford housing, particularly in large cities with high rents.

items.cue: Children spending too much time on screens.
items.answer: Children spending too much time on screens may sleep poorly.
items.alt: Children who spend too much time on screens may sleep poorly.

items.cue: Although online learning is convenient.
items.answer: Although online learning is convenient, it lacks social interaction.
items.alt: Online learning is convenient, but it lacks social interaction.

items.cue: Public transport reduces congestion.
items.hint: Kiểm tra: câu đã hoàn chỉnh chưa? Nếu rồi, chép lại.
items.answer: Public transport reduces congestion.

items.cue: Such as cycling and walking.
items.hint: gắn vào câu: Cities should promote active transport, …
items.answer: Cities should promote active transport, such as cycling and walking.
items.alt: Cities should encourage active forms of transport such as cycling and walking.

items.cue: The government, which has introduced a sugar tax.
items.answer: The government, which has introduced a sugar tax, hopes to reduce obesity.
items.alt: The government has introduced a sugar tax in the hope of reducing obesity.

items.cue: In order to reduce plastic waste.
items.answer: In order to reduce plastic waste, supermarkets should charge for plastic bags.
items.alt: Supermarkets should charge for plastic bags in order to reduce plastic waste.

items.cue: Not all students can afford private tutors.
items.hint: Kiểm tra: câu đã hoàn chỉnh chưa? Nếu rồi, chép lại.
items.answer: Not all students can afford private tutors.

items.cue: Not only cheaper but also faster.
items.hint: viết thành câu đầy đủ với chủ ngữ Online shopping is …
items.answer: Online shopping is not only cheaper but also faster.
items.alt: Not only is online shopping cheaper, but it is also faster.

items.cue: As a result of rising living costs.
items.answer: As a result of rising living costs, many families are cutting back on spending.
items.alt: Many families are spending less as a result of rising living costs.

items.cue: Students who work part-time while studying at university.
items.answer: Students who work part-time while studying at university often have less time for revision.
items.alt: Students with part-time jobs at university often have less time to revise.

items.cue: With prices rising, many families are cutting back.
items.hint: Kiểm tra: câu đã hoàn chỉnh chưa? Nếu rồi, chép lại.
items.answer: With prices rising, many families are cutting back.

items.cue: The main reason being that wages have not kept pace with rents.
items.answer: The main reason is that wages have not kept pace with rents.
items.alt: This is mainly because wages have not kept pace with rents.

items.cue: Having finished university and found a job in the city.
items.hint: thêm mệnh đề chính có chủ ngữ phù hợp
items.answer: Having finished university and found a job in the city, many graduates still cannot afford to buy a home.
items.alt: Even after finishing university and finding a job in the city, many graduates cannot afford a home.

items.cue: Only by investing in education can poverty be reduced.
items.hint: Kiểm tra: câu đã hoàn chỉnh chưa? Nếu rồi, chép lại.
items.answer: Only by investing in education can poverty be reduced.

intro.html: Bài ôn tập tổng hợp gồm 50 câu từ tất cả các phần của sách, sắp xếp từ dễ (●) đến khó (●●●). Hãy làm bài như một bài kiểm tra, không xem lại lý thuyết.
Sau khi chữa bài, điền số câu đúng vào Bảng tự đánh giá ở cuối bài. Bảng cho biết mỗi câu kiểm tra kiến thức của Unit nào; những Unit có nhiều câu sai là những Unit bạn nên ôn lại.

exercises.title: Phần A — Mở bài: paraphrase và quan điểm
intro: Viết phần mở bài gồm hai câu cho mỗi đề: (1) paraphrase đề bài; (2) câu nêu quan điểm trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

items.cue: Education · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: University students should pay the full cost of their education themselves. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Paraphrase bằng kỹ thuật ở Unit 1 (từ đồng nghĩa + đổi từ loại) + câu nêu quan điểm (Unit 2)
items.answer: It is argued by some that university students should cover the full cost of their studies. While acknowledging the benefits of this for public finances, I largely disagree with this view.

items.cue: Socio-cultural and global issues · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: The best way to learn about other cultures is to work in a multinational organisation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.answer: It is suggested by some that working in a multinational company is the best way to learn about other cultures. I disagree with this view, despite acknowledging the opportunities such workplaces offer.

items.cue: Work · Agree/disagree
items.prompt: Professional workers such as doctors, nurses and teachers should be paid more than people who work in sports and entertainment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
items.hint: Gọi tên chính xác các nhóm đối tượng (Unit 3) + câu nêu quan điểm (Unit 2)
items.answer: One school of thought holds that professionals such as doctors, nurses and teachers deserve higher pay than those working in the sports and entertainment industries. I firmly agree with this view.

items.cue: Education · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that educating children at home is best for their development, while others think it is important for children to attend school. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Hai câu: paraphrase đề + câu nêu quan điểm. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: While one school of thought holds that home schooling is best for children's development, others maintain that attending school is essential. This essay will examine both views before concluding that I agree with the latter.

items.cue: Media and communication · Discuss both views
items.prompt: Some people believe that radio is the best way to get news, while others think television is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.hint: Hai câu: paraphrase đề + câu nêu quan điểm. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: Some people argue that radio is the best source of news, while others believe that television is better. While there are justifications for both perspectives, I agree with the latter.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Causes/problems/solutions
items.prompt: Children today face increasing pressure from school, society and advertising. What are the main causes of this pressure, and what can be done to reduce it?
items.hint: Hai câu: paraphrase đề + câu nêu quan điểm. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that children today are under growing pressure from school, society and advertising. This essay will first outline the underlying causes of this phenomenon before suggesting some viable measures to tackle it.

items.cue: Language · Advantages/disadvantages
items.prompt: Some people believe that children should begin learning a foreign language in primary school rather than secondary school. Do the advantages of starting earlier outweigh the disadvantages?
items.hint: Hai câu: paraphrase đề bằng cách diễn đạt trong bảng khái niệm (Unit 5) + câu nêu quan điểm.
items.answer: It is suggested by some that a foreign language should be introduced in the primary curriculum rather than at secondary level. In my view, the advantages of an earlier start clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

items.cue: Age, generation and gender · Positive/negative development
items.prompt: Children today have more freedom than children had in the past. Is this a positive or negative development?
items.hint: Hai câu: paraphrase đề + câu nêu quan điểm. Tự chọn khung câu.
items.answer: It is true that today's children enjoy greater freedom than previous generations did. Despite certain concerns surrounding this trend, I believe it is a beneficial one.

exercises.title: Phần B — Dịch, rồi viết lại
intro: Dịch mỗi câu sang tiếng Anh tự nhiên. Sau đó viết lại bản dịch bằng cấu trúc được cho. Câu ● có gợi ý từ khóa; câu ●● và ●●● chỉ cho biết cấu trúc.

items.cue: Nhiều người lao động bận rộn có rất ít hoặc không có thời gian cho gia đình.
items.translation: Many busy workers have very little or no time for their families.
items.answer: Many working adults have little or no time for their families.
items.alt: Many working adults have little or no time to spend with their families.

items.cue: Cần có thêm nhiều không gian xanh ở các thành phố đông đúc.
items.translation: More green spaces are needed in crowded cities.
items.answer: There is a need for more green spaces in crowded cities.
items.alt: There is a need for more parks and green areas in crowded cities.

items.cue: Tình trạng béo phì ở trẻ em phần lớn bắt nguồn từ chế độ ăn uống không lành mạnh.
items.translation: Obesity in children is mainly caused by unhealthy diets.
items.answer: Childhood obesity largely stems from unhealthy diets.
items.alt: Childhood obesity can largely be attributed to unhealthy diets.

items.cue: Nhiều sinh viên học thêm kỹ năng mềm để tăng cơ hội việc làm.
items.translation: Many students learn soft skills to increase their job chances.
items.answer: Many students develop soft skills in order to improve their job prospects.
items.alt: Many students develop soft skills so as to improve their job prospects.

items.cue: Không phải người cao tuổi nào cũng gặp khó khăn với công nghệ.
items.translation: Not every old person has difficulty with technology.
items.answer: Not all older people struggle with technology.
items.alt: Not every older person finds technology difficult.

items.cue: Có khả năng các thành phố lớn sẽ tiếp tục mở rộng trong những thập kỷ tới.
items.translation: Big cities will probably continue to expand in the next decades.
items.answer: It is likely that large cities will continue to expand in the coming decades.
items.alt: Large cities are likely to keep expanding in the coming decades.

items.cue: Người trẻ ngày nay không còn mua đĩa nhạc nữa.
items.translation: Young people nowadays do not buy music CDs any more.
items.answer: Today's young people no longer buy music CDs.
items.alt: Young people no longer buy CDs these days.

items.cue: Chi phí học đại học cao đồng nghĩa với ít cơ hội hơn cho sinh viên nghèo.
items.translation: Because university costs are high, poor students have fewer opportunities.
items.answer: High tuition fees mean fewer opportunities for poor students.
items.alt: High tuition fees mean that students from poor families have fewer opportunities.

items.cue: Nếu thành phố có thêm làn đường dành cho xe đạp, nhiều người sẽ đạp xe đi làm.
items.translation: If the city has more bike lanes, more people will cycle to work.
items.answer: If the city had more cycle lanes, more people would cycle to work.
items.alt: If more cycle lanes were built in the city, more people would cycle to work.

items.cue: Chỉ khi người dân được giáo dục về môi trường, họ mới thay đổi thói quen.
items.translation: People will change their habits only when they are educated about the environment.
items.answer: Only when people are educated about the environment will they change their habits.
items.alt: Only when people learn about the environment will they change their habits.

items.cue: Người ta cho rằng làm việc từ xa giúp tăng năng suất.
items.rewriteWith: S + is thought to / It is believed that
items.translation: People think working from home increases productivity.
items.answer: Remote working is thought to increase productivity.
items.alt: It is believed that remote working increases productivity.

items.cue: Mặc dù có thu nhập cao, nhiều người trẻ vẫn không đủ khả năng mua nhà.
items.translation: Although they have high incomes, many young people still cannot afford a house.
items.answer: Despite earning high incomes, many young people still cannot afford a home.
items.alt: Even though they earn high incomes, many young people cannot afford a home.

exercises.title: Phần C — Tìm và sửa lỗi
intro: Một số câu đúng; những câu khác có một hoặc nhiều lỗi. (a) Tô màu từng lỗi theo màu của tiêu chí tương ứng (TR đỏ, CC cam, LR xanh dương, GRA tím). (b) Viết phần sửa. (c) Đánh dấu ✓ nếu câu đúng.

items.cue: Everyone who eats fast food becomes obese.
items.answer: Everyone who eats fast food becomes obese. REGULARLY EATING FAST FOOD CAN INCREASE THE RISK OF OBESITY.
notes: TR Tuyệt đối hóa (everyone, becomes).

items.cue: Exams are stressful. On the contrary, they are fair.
items.answer: Exams are stressful. On the contrary, NEVERTHELESS, they are fair.
notes: CC Cần từ nối nhượng bộ, không phải bác bỏ.

items.cue: There is a high rate of wastes in big cities.
items.answer: There is a high rate of wastes A LARGE AMOUNT OF WASTE in big cities.
notes: LR waste không đếm được; rate chỉ tỉ lệ.

items.cue: The proportion of students who passed was high.
items.answer: ✓ The proportion of students who passed was high.
notes: Đúng: danh từ chính proportion → was.

items.cue: Students who they study abroad become independent.
items.answer: Students who they study WHO STUDY abroad become independent.
notes: GRA Thừa đại từ they.

items.cue: Arriving late, the lesson had already started.
items.answer: Arriving late, the lesson had already started. WHEN THE STUDENTS ARRIVED LATE, THE LESSON HAD ALREADY STARTED.
notes: GRA Dangling: the lesson không thể arrive late.

items.cue: Not only technology saves time, but it also reduces costs.
items.answer: Not only technology saves NOT ONLY DOES TECHNOLOGY SAVE time, but it also reduces costs.
notes: GRA Not only đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ.

items.cue: Were it not for public libraries, many families would have no access to books.
items.answer: ✓ Were it not for public libraries, many families would have no access to books.
notes: Đúng: câu điều kiện đảo Were it not for.

items.cue: The reason why people move to cities is because jobs are better.
items.answer: The reason why people move to cities is because IS THAT jobs are better.
notes: GRA Cấu trúc đúng: The reason why … is that ….

items.cue: If public transport was free, more people will use it.
items.answer: If public transport was free, more people will use WOULD USE it.
notes: GRA Câu điều kiện loại 2 → would.

items.cue: It is believe that sport builds character.
items.answer: It is believe BELIEVED that sport builds character.
notes: GRA Bị động tường thuật cần V3.

items.cue: Although tourism creates jobs, it can damage local culture.
items.answer: ✓ Although tourism creates jobs, it can damage local culture.
notes: Đúng: Although + mệnh đề, không thêm but.

items.cue: Exercise improves mental health. For example, footballers earn high salaries.
items.answer: Exercise improves mental health. For example, footballers earn high salaries PEOPLE WHO WALK FOR THIRTY MINUTES A DAY OFTEN FEEL LESS STRESSED.
notes: TR Ví dụ không chứng minh luận điểm.

items.cue: Cybercrime is organised by international gangs, so people should change their passwords.
items.answer: Cybercrime is organised MUCH CYBERCRIME IS ORGANISED by international gangs, so people should change their passwords GOVERNMENTS SHOULD COOPERATE TO DISMANTLE THESE NETWORKS.
notes: TR Nhận định về nguyên nhân cũng cần giới hạn (much).
TR Giải pháp không khớp với nguyên nhân.

items.cue: Rising house prices mean that many young people rent for longer.
items.answer: ✓ Rising house prices mean that many young people rent for longer.
notes: Đúng: cụm danh từ làm chủ ngữ + mean that.

exercises.title: Phần D — Biến đổi cấu trúc
intro: Viết lại mỗi câu bằng cấu trúc được cho. Giữ nguyên nghĩa.

items.cue: Some towns have few jobs. Young people leave them.
items.answer: Young people leave towns where there are few jobs.
items.alt: Young people tend to leave towns where jobs are scarce.

items.cue: The museum was opened in 1990. It attracts many visitors.
items.answer: Opened in 1990, the museum attracts many visitors.
items.alt: The museum, opened in 1990, attracts many visitors.

items.cue: Because the cost of living is high, many young people delay marriage.
items.answer: Given the high cost of living, many young people delay marriage.
items.alt: Given the high cost of living, many young people postpone marriage.

items.cue: Many employees work overtime. They want to earn extra money.
items.answer: Many employees work overtime in order to earn extra money.
items.alt: Many employees work overtime so as to earn extra money.

items.cue: Many patients cannot see a doctor quickly because hospitals are overcrowded.
items.answer: Overcrowded hospitals leave many patients unable to see a doctor quickly.
items.alt: Hospital overcrowding leaves many patients unable to see a doctor quickly.

items.cue: Fast food will make everyone obese.
items.answer: Regularly eating fast food can make some people overweight.
items.alt: Fast food can contribute to obesity in some people.

items.cue: Children used to play outside more than they do now.
items.answer: Traditionally, children played outside more than they do nowadays.
items.alt: Children traditionally spent more time playing outside than they do today.

items.cue: Many governments act only after a crisis happens.
items.answer: Only after a crisis do many governments act.
items.alt: Only after a crisis has happened do many governments take action.

items.cue: If it were not for tourism, the island's economy would collapse.
items.answer: But for tourism, the island's economy would collapse.
items.alt: Were it not for tourism, the island's economy would collapse.

items.cue: Teachers, not parents, have the greatest influence on teenagers' study habits.
items.answer: It is teachers, not parents, who have the greatest influence on teenagers' study habits.
items.alt: It is teachers rather than parents who most influence teenagers' study habits.

items.cue: People think that the printing press changed society more than any other invention.
items.answer: The printing press is thought to have changed society more than any other invention.
items.alt: It is thought that the printing press changed society more than any other invention.

items.cue: The real problem is a lack of planning, not a lack of money.
items.answer: The real problem is not so much a lack of money as a lack of planning.
items.alt: The real problem is a lack of planning rather than a lack of money.

items.cue: There are many tourists who visit the beach every summer, and they leave a lot of rubbish.
items.hint: rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ; một động từ chia
items.answer: The many tourists visiting the beach every summer leave a lot of rubbish.
items.alt: Tourists visiting the beach each summer leave behind a great deal of rubbish.

items.cue: Claim: Team sports teach leadership. → Weak example: For example, football.
items.hint: ví dụ mở rộng: ai – làm gì – kết quả
items.answer: For example, a football captain must motivate teammates and make quick decisions during a match, which develops his or her leadership skills.
items.alt: For instance, a team captain learns to motivate others and to take responsibility for decisions.

items.cue: Children must learn to manage money from an early age.
items.hint: It is essential for sb to V
items.answer: It is essential for children to learn to manage money from an early age.
items.alt: It is vital for children to learn how to manage money from an early age.
